/**
 * Sets the run-as identity for the given security context.
 *
 * @param principal the new run-as identity
 * @param sc the security context
 * @return the old run-as identity
 * @throws SecurityException if security manager is checking and the operation is not permitted
 */
static RunAs setRunAsIdentity(final RunAs principal, final SecurityContext sc) {
    if (WildFlySecurityManager.isChecking()) {
        return WildFlySecurityManager.doUnchecked(new PrivilegedAction<RunAs>() {
            @Override
            public RunAs run() {
                if (sc == null) {
                    throw UndertowLogger.ROOT_LOGGER.noSecurityContext();
                }
                RunAs old = sc.getOutgoingRunAs();
                sc.setOutgoingRunAs(principal);
                return old;
            }
        });
    } else {
        if (sc == null) {
            throw UndertowLogger.ROOT_LOGGER.noSecurityContext();
        }
        RunAs old = sc.getOutgoingRunAs();
        sc.setOutgoingRunAs(principal);
        return old;
    }
}

2509	```java
/**
 * Checks if the given class type matches the property type, considering primitive types and their corresponding wrapper classes.
 * 
 * @param classType The class type to check.
 * @param propertyType The property type to check.
 * @return true if the class type matches the property type, false otherwise.
 */
private boolean argumentMatches(String classType, String propertyType) {
    return classType.equals(propertyType) ||
           (classType.equals("java.lang.Byte") && propertyType.equals("byte")) ||
           (classType.equals("java.lang.Short") && propertyType.equals("short")) ||
           (classType.equals("java.lang.Integer") && propertyType.equals("int")) ||
           (classType.equals("java.lang.Long") && propertyType.equals("long")) ||
           (classType.equals("java.lang.Float") && propertyType.equals("float")) ||
           (classType.equals("java.lang.Double") && propertyType.equals("double")) ||
           (classType.equals("java.lang.Boolean") && propertyType.equals("boolean")) ||
           (classType.equals("java.lang.Character") && propertyType.equals("char"));
}
```
2510	```java
/**
 * Finds a method with the specified name and parameter type in the given class or its superclasses.
 * 
 * @param clz The class to search for the method.
 * @param methodName The name of the method to find.
 * @param propertyType The type of the parameter, or null if any parameter type is acceptable.
 * @return The found method, or null if no matching method is found.
 */
protected Method findMethod(Class<?> clz, String methodName, String propertyType) {
    while (!clz.equals(Object.class)) {
        List<Method> hits = null;
        Method[] methods = SecurityActions.getDeclaredMethods(clz);
        for (int i = 0; i < methods.length; i++) {
            final Method method = methods[i];
            if (methodName.equals(method.getName()) && method.getParameterTypes().length == 1) {
                if (propertyType == null || argumentMatches(propertyType, method.getParameterTypes()[0].getName())) {
                    if (hits == null) {
                        hits = new ArrayList<>(1);
                    }
                    SecurityActions.setAccessible(method);
                    hits.add(method);
                }
            }
        }
        if (hits != null) {
            if (hits.size() == 1) {
                return hits.get(0);
            } else {
                Collections.sort(hits, new MethodSorter());
                if (propertyType != null) {
                    for (Method m : hits) {
                        if (propertyType.equals(m.getParameterTypes()[0].getName())) {
                            return m;
                        }
                    }
                }
                return hits.get(0);
            }
        }
        clz = clz.getSuperclass();
    }
    return null;
}
```

/**
 * Retrieves the lock owner from the given transaction synchronization registry.

 *
 * @param transactionSynchronizationRegistry the transaction synchronization registry to retrieve the lock owner from
 * @return the lock owner or the current thread if the transaction key is null
 */
private static Object getLockOwner(final TransactionSynchronizationRegistry transactionSynchronizationRegistry) {
    Object owner = transactionSynchronizationRegistry.getTransactionKey();
    return owner != null ? owner : Thread.currentThread();
}

/**
 * Adds a CDI flag to the web metadata of a deployment unit.

 * @param warMetaData The war metadata to modify.
 * @param deploymentUnit The deployment unit to process.
 */
private void addCDIFlag(WarMetaData warMetaData, DeploymentUnit deploymentUnit) {
    JBossWebMetaData webMetaData = warMetaData.getMergedJBossWebMetaData();
    if (webMetaData == null) {
        webMetaData = new JBossWebMetaData();
        warMetaData.setMergedJBossWebMetaData(webMetaData);
    }

    List<ParamValueMetaData> contextParams = webMetaData.getContextParams();
    if (contextParams == null) {
        contextParams = new ArrayList<>();
    }

    boolean isCDI = false;
    CapabilityServiceSupport support = deploymentUnit.getAttachment(Attachments.CAPABILITY_SERVICE_SUPPORT);
    if (support.hasCapability(WELD_CAPABILITY_NAME)) {
        isCDI = support.getOptionalCapabilityRuntimeAPI(WELD_CAPABILITY_NAME, WeldCapability.class).get().isPartOfWeldDeployment(deploymentUnit);
    }

    ParamValueMetaData param = new ParamValueMetaData();
    param.setParamName(IS_CDI_PARAM);
    param.setParamValue(Boolean.toString(isCDI));
    contextParams.add(param);
    webMetaData.setContextParams(contextParams);
}

/**

protected ComponentView getComponentView() {
    ComponentView cv = componentView;
    if (cv == null) {
        synchronized (this) {
            cv = componentView;
            if (cv == null) {
                cv = getMSCService(componentViewName, ComponentView.class);
                if (cv == null) {
                    throw WSLogger.ROOT_LOGGER.cannotFindComponentView(componentViewName);
                }
                if (reference == null) {
                    try {
                        reference = cv.createInstance();
                    } catch (Exception e) {
                        throw new RuntimeException(e);
                    }
                }
                componentView = cv;
            }
        }
    }
    return cv;
}

2526	The `invoke` method is designed to handle the invocation of a web service endpoint. It performs the following steps:

1. **State Check**: It first checks if the endpoint is in the `STARTED` state. If not, it throws an exception indicating that the endpoint is already stopped.

2. **Security Context Execution**: It retrieves the security domain context from the endpoint and executes the `invokeInternal` method within this security context. This ensures that the invocation is performed with the appropriate security permissions.

3. **Exception Handling**: If any exception occurs during the execution of `invokeInternal`, it is caught and passed to the `handleInvocationException` method for handling.

4. **Post-Invocation Actions**: Regardless of whether an exception occurred or not, the `onAfterInvocation` method is called to perform any necessary actions after the invocation.

In summary, the `invoke` method ensures that a web service endpoint is invoked in a secure and state-appropriate manner, handles any exceptions that may occur, and performs necessary post-invocation actions.
2527	The `getComponentViewMethod` method takes a `Method` object `seiMethod` and a `Collection` of `Method` objects `viewMethods` as parameters. 2528	```java
/**
 * Compares two methods to check if they have the same name and parameter types.
 *
 * @param seiMethod  the first method to compare
 * @param viewMethod the second method to compare
 * @return true if the methods have the same name and parameter types, false otherwise
 */
private boolean matches(final Method seiMethod, final Method viewMethod) {
    if (!seiMethod.getName().equals(viewMethod.getName())) return false;
    final Class<?>[] sourceParams = seiMethod.getParameterTypes();
    final Class<?>[] targetParams = viewMethod.getParameterTypes();
    if (sourceParams.length != targetParams.length) return false;
    for (int i = 0; i < sourceParams.length; i++) {
        if (!sourceParams[i].equals(targetParams[i])) return false;
    }
    return true;
}

public static Resource createManagementStatisticsResource(ManagementAdaptor managementAdaptor, String scopedPersistenceUnitName, DeploymentUnit deploymentUnit) {
    synchronized (existingResourceDescriptionResolver) {
        EntityManagerFactoryLookup entityManagerFactoryLookup = new EntityManagerFactoryLookup();
        Statistics statistics = managementAdaptor.getStatistics();
        if (!existingResourceDescriptionResolver.contains(managementAdaptor.getVersion())) {
            ResourceDescriptionResolver resourceDescriptionResolver = new StandardResourceDescriptionResolver(
                statistics.getResourceBundleKeyPrefix(),
                statistics.getResourceBundleName(),
                statistics.getClass().getClassLoader()
            ) {
                private ResourceDescriptionResolver fallback = JPAExtension.getResourceDescriptionResolver();

                @Override
                public String getResourceAttributeDescription(String attributeName, Locale locale, ResourceBundle bundle) {
                    if (bundle.containsKey(getBundleKey(attributeName))) {
                        return super.getResourceAttributeDescription(attributeName, locale, bundle);
                    } else {
                        return fallback.getResourceAttributeDescription(attributeName, locale, fallback.getResourceBundle(locale));
                    }
                }
            };
            PathElement subsystemPE = PathElement.pathElement(ModelDescriptionConstants.SUBSYSTEM, JPAExtension.SUBSYSTEM_NAME);
            ManagementResourceRegistration deploymentResourceRegistration = deploymentUnit.getAttachment(DeploymentModelUtils.MUTABLE_REGISTRATION_ATTACHMENT);
            ManagementResourceRegistration deploymentSubsystemRegistration = deploymentResourceRegistration.getSubModel(PathAddress.pathAddress(subsystemPE));
            ManagementResourceRegistration subdeploymentSubsystemRegistration = deploymentResourceRegistration.getSubModel(PathAddress.pathAddress(PathElement.pathElement(ModelDescriptionConstants.SUBDEPLOYMENT), subsystemPE));
            ManagementResourceRegistration providerResource = deploymentSubsystemRegistration.registerSubModel(new ManagementResourceDefinition(
                PathElement.pathElement(managementAdaptor.getIdentificationLabel()),
                resourceDescriptionResolver,
                statistics,
                entityManagerFactoryLookup
            ));
            providerResource.registerReadOnlyAttribute(PersistenceUnitServiceHandler.SCOPED_UNIT_NAME, null);
            providerResource = subdeploymentSubsystemRegistration.registerSubModel(new ManagementResourceDefinition(
                PathElement.pathElement(managementAdaptor.getIdentificationLabel()),
                resourceDescriptionResolver,
                statistics,
                entityManagerFactoryLookup
            ));
            providerResource.registerReadOnlyAttribute(PersistenceUnitServiceHandler.SCOPED_UNIT_NAME, null);
            existingResourceDescriptionResolver.add(managementAdaptor.getVersion());
        }
        return new DynamicManagementStatisticsResource(statistics, scopedPersistenceUnitName, managementAdaptor.getIdentificationLabel(), entityManagerFactoryLookup);
    }
}

/**
 * Retrieves the EJB security metadata for a given endpoint.

private EJBSecurityMetaData getEjbSecurityMetaData(final Endpoint endpoint) {
    // Get the short name of the EJB from the endpoint
    final String ejbName = endpoint.getShortName();
    
    // Get the deployment associated with the endpoint's service
    final Deployment dep = endpoint.getService().getDeployment();
    
    // Retrieve the EJB archive metadata from the deployment
    final EJBArchiveMetaData ejbArchiveMD = WSHelper.getOptionalAttachment(dep, EJBArchiveMetaData.class);
    
    // Get the EJB metadata by EJB name if EJB archive metadata is found

    // Return the security metadata of the EJB if EJB metadata is found
    return ejbMD != null ? ejbMD.getSecurityMetaData() : null;
}

2533	```java
void setIDLName(String idlName) {
    // Call the superclass method to set the IDL name
    super.setIDLName(idlName);

    // Check if the first character is uppercase and the second character is not
    if (idlName.charAt(0) >= 0x41 && idlName.charAt(0) <= 0x5a && 
        (idlName.length() <= 1 || idlName.charAt(1) < 0x41 || idlName.charAt(1) > 0x5a)) {
        // Convert the first character to lowercase
        idlName = idlName.substring(0, 1).toLowerCase(Locale.ENGLISH) + idlName.substring(1);
    }

    // If accessorAnalysis is not null, set its IDL name to "_get_" followed by the modified IDL name
    if (accessorAnalysis != null) {
        accessorAnalysis.setIDLName("_get_" + idlName);
    }

    // If mutatorAnalysis is not null, set its IDL name to "_set_" followed by the modified IDL name
    if (mutatorAnalysis != null) {
        mutatorAnalysis.setIDLName("_set_" + idlName);
    }
}

public static <T> NamingEnumeration<T> namingEnumeration(final Collection<T> collection) {
    final Iterator<T> iterator = collection.iterator();
    return new NamingEnumeration<T>() {
        public T next() { return nextElement(); }
        public boolean hasMore() { return hasMoreElements(); }
        public void close() { }
        public boolean hasMoreElements() { return iterator.hasNext(); }
        public T nextElement() { return iterator.next(); }
    };
}
```

**Summary:**
The `namingEnumeration` method takes a `Collection<T>` as input and returns a `NamingEnumeration<T>`. It creates an anonymous inner class that implements the `NamingEnumeration` interface. The inner class uses the iterator from the input collection to provide the `next`, `hasMore`, and `nextElement` methods, which delegate to the corresponding methods of the iterator. The `close` method is left empty.

/**
 * Retrieves the ActiveMQ component control for the given operation context, model node, and write flag.
 *
 * @param context   the operation context
 * @param operation the model node representing the operation
 * @param forWrite  a boolean indicating whether the operation is for writing
 * @return the ActiveMQ component control
 * @throws OperationFailedException if the operation fails
 */
protected final T getActiveMQComponentControl(final OperationContext context, final ModelNode operation, final boolean forWrite) throws OperationFailedException {
    // Get the ActiveMQ service name from the operation address
    ServiceName artemisServiceName = MessagingServices.getActiveMQServiceName(PathAddress.pathAddress(operation.get(ModelDescriptionConstants.OP_ADDR)));
    
    // Get the ActiveMQ service controller from the service registry
    ServiceController<?> artemisService = context.getServiceRegistry(forWrite).getService(artemisServiceName);
    
    // Cast the service value to ActiveMQServer
    ActiveMQServer server = ActiveMQServer.class.cast(artemisService.getValue());
    
    // Get the operation address
    PathAddress address = PathAddress.pathAddress(operation.require(OP_ADDR));
    
    // Retrieve the ActiveMQ component control
    T control = getActiveMQComponentControl(server, address);
    
    // If the control is null, throw an exception indicating that the management resource was not found
    if (control == null) {
        throw ControllerLogger.ROOT_LOGGER.managementResourceNotFound(address);
    }
    
    // Return the ActiveMQ component control
    return control;
}

 */
public static PrimitiveAnalysis getPrimitiveAnalysis(final Class cls) {
    if (cls == null) {
        throw IIOPLogger.ROOT_LOGGER.cannotAnalyzeNullClass();
    }
    if (cls == Void.TYPE) return voidAnalysis;
    if (cls == Boolean.TYPE) return booleanAnalysis;
    if (cls == Character.TYPE) return charAnalysis;
    if (cls == Byte.TYPE) return byteAnalysis;
    if (cls == Short.TYPE) return shortAnalysis;
    if (cls == Integer.TYPE) return intAnalysis;
    if (cls == Long.TYPE) return longAnalysis;
    if (cls == Float.TYPE) return floatAnalysis;
    if (cls == Double.TYPE) return doubleAnalysis;
    throw IIOPLogger.ROOT_LOGGER.notAPrimitive(cls.getName());
}

2556	The `shutdown` method is designed to safely shut down a component by setting a shutdown flag and ensuring that the component does not restart unexpectedly. Here's a summary of the method:

1. **Set the Shutdown Bit**:
   - The method uses a loop to set the shutdown bit in the `invocationCount` variable.
   - It uses a compare-and-set operation (`updater.compareAndSet`) to ensure that the shutdown bit is set atomically.

2. **Synchronize on a Lock**:
   - If the shutdown bit is not set, the method synchronizes on a `lock` object.
   - It waits for the lock to be released using `lock.wait()`.

3. **Check for Shutdown Flag**:
   - Upon acquiring the lock, the method checks if the shutdown flag is still not set.
   - If the shutdown flag is not set, it returns immediately, indicating that the component has been restarted.

4. **Return**:
   - If the shutdown flag is set, the method returns, indicating that the component has been successfully shut down.

In summary, the `shutdown` method ensures that a component is safely shut down by setting a shutdown flag and waiting for any ongoing operations to complete before returning.

private void registerSessionBeanInterceptors(SessionBeanComponentDescription componentDescription, DeploymentUnit deploymentUnit) {
    // If the component is a stateful session bean, set up appropriate interceptors
    if (componentDescription.isStateful()) {
        componentDescription.getConfigurators().addFirst(new ComponentConfigurator() {
            @Override
            public void configure(DeploymentPhaseContext context, ComponentDescription description, ComponentConfiguration configuration) throws DeploymentUnitProcessingException {
                // Add post-construct and pre-destroy interceptors
                configuration.addPostConstructInterceptor(SFSBPreCreateInterceptor.FACTORY, InterceptorOrder.ComponentPostConstruct.JPA_SFSB_PRE_CREATE);
                configuration.addPostConstructInterceptor(SFSBCreateInterceptor.FACTORY, InterceptorOrder.ComponentPostConstruct.JPA_SFSB_CREATE);
                configuration.addPreDestroyInterceptor(SFSBDestroyInterceptor.FACTORY, InterceptorOrder.ComponentPreDestroy.JPA_SFSB_DESTROY);
                // Add component interceptor
                configuration.addComponentInterceptor(SFSBInvocationInterceptor.FACTORY, InterceptorOrder.Component.JPA_SFSB_INTERCEPTOR, false);
                // Add context key for serialized entity manager state
                configuration.getInterceptorContextKeys().add(SFSBInvocationInterceptor.CONTEXT_KEY);
            }
        });
    }

    // Register interceptors for stateful and stateless session beans with transactional entity manager
    if (componentDescription.isStateful() || componentDescription.isStateless()) {
        componentDescription.getConfigurators().add(new ComponentConfigurator() {
            @Override
            public void configure(DeploymentPhaseContext context, ComponentDescription description, ComponentConfiguration configuration) throws DeploymentUnitProcessingException {
                // Add component interceptor
                configuration.addComponentInterceptor(SBInvocationInterceptor.FACTORY, InterceptorOrder.Component.JPA_SESSION_BEAN_INTERCEPTOR, false);
            }
        });
    }
}

2575	```java
@Override
public void stop(final StopContext context) {
    final WeldBootstrapService bootstrapService = bootstrapSupplier.get();
    if (!bootstrapService.isStarted()) {
        throw WeldLogger.ROOT_LOGGER.notStarted("WeldContainer");
    }
    WeldLogger.DEPLOYMENT_LOGGER.stoppingWeldService(bootstrapService.getDeploymentName());
    ClassLoader oldTccl = WildFlySecurityManager.getCurrentContextClassLoaderPrivileged();
    try {
        WildFlySecurityManager.setCurrentContextClassLoaderPrivileged(bootstrapService.getDeployment().getModule().getClassLoader());
        WeldProvider.containerShutDown(Container.instance(bootstrapService.getDeploymentName()));
        bootstrapService.getBootstrap().shutdown();
    } finally {
        WildFlySecurityManager.setCurrentContextClassLoaderPrivileged(oldTccl);
        ModuleGroupSingletonProvider.removeClassLoader(bootstrapService.getDeployment().getModule().getClassLoader());
    }
    bootstrapService.setStarted(false);
}
```

**Summary:**
The `stop` method is an overridden method that handles the stopping of a Weld container. It first retrieves the `WeldBootstrapService` and checks if the container is started. If not, it throws an exception. It then logs the stopping of the Weld service and temporarily sets the context class loader to the deployment's class loader. It shuts down the Weld container and the bootstrap service, and finally resets the context class loader and removes the class loader from the module group singleton provider. It also sets the `bootstrapService` as not started.

@Override
public void suspended(ServerActivityCallback listener) {
    this.suspended = true;
    listenerUpdater.set(this, listener);
    localTransactionContextInjectedValue.getValue().suspendRequests();
    int activeInvocationCount = activeInvocationCountUpdater.get(this);
    if (activeInvocationCount == 0) {
        if (gracefulTxnShutdown) {
            if (activeTransactionCountUpdater.get(this) == 0) {
                this.doneSuspended();
            } else {
                EjbLogger.ROOT_LOGGER.suspensionWaitingActiveTransactions(activeInvocationCount);
            }
        } else {
            this.doneSuspended();
        }
    }
}
```

**Summary:**
The `suspended` method sets the `suspended` flag to `true`, updates the `listener`, suspends requests in the local transaction context, and checks if there are active invocations. If there are no active invocations, it either completes the suspension gracefully or logs a message if a graceful shutdown is not possible.

2588	```java
@Override
public void transactionCreated(AbstractTransaction transaction, CreatedBy createdBy) {
    activeTransactionCountUpdater.incrementAndGet(this);
    try {
        transaction.registerSynchronization(this);
    } catch (RollbackException | IllegalStateException e) {
        decrementTransactionCount();
    } catch (SystemException e) {
        decrementTransactionCount();
        EjbLogger.ROOT_LOGGER.debug("Unexpected exception", e);
        throw new RuntimeException(e);
    }
}
```

**Summary:**
The `transactionCreated` method increments the active transaction count. It attempts to register a synchronization with the transaction. If a `RollbackException` or `IllegalStateException` occurs, it decrements the transaction count. If a `SystemException` occurs, it also decrements the transaction count, logs a debug message, and throws a `RuntimeException`.

2592	```java
/**
 * Creates a list of resource roots for a deployment unit.
 *
 * @param deploymentRoot The virtual file representing the deployment root.
 * @param deploymentUnit The deployment unit.
 * @return A list of resource roots.
 * @throws IOException If an I/O error occurs.
 * @throws DeploymentUnitProcessingException If a deployment unit processing error occurs.
 */
private List<ResourceRoot> createResourceRoots(final VirtualFile deploymentRoot, final DeploymentUnit deploymentUnit) throws IOException, DeploymentUnitProcessingException {
    List<ResourceRoot> entries = new ArrayList<>();

    // Process WEB-INF/classes
    VirtualFile webinfClasses = deploymentRoot.getChild(WEB_INF_CLASSES);
    if (webinfClasses.exists()) {
        ResourceRoot webInfClassesRoot = new ResourceRoot(webinfClasses.getName(), webinfClasses, null);
        ModuleRootMarker.mark(webInfClassesRoot);
        entries.add(webInfClassesRoot);
    }

    // Process WEB-INF/lib
    Map<String, MountedDeploymentOverlay> overlays = deploymentUnit.getAttachment(Attachments.DEPLOYMENT_OVERLAY_LOCATIONS);
    VirtualFile webinfLib = deploymentRoot.getChild(WEB_INF_LIB);
    if (webinfLib.exists()) {
        List<VirtualFile> archives = webinfLib.getChildren(DEFAULT_WEB_INF_LIB_FILTER);
        for (VirtualFile archive : archives) {
            try {
                String relativeName = archive.getPathNameRelativeTo(deploymentRoot);
                MountedDeploymentOverlay overlay = overlays.get(relativeName);
                Closeable closable = null;
                if (overlay != null) {
                    overlay.remountAsZip(false);
                } else if (archive.isFile()) {
                    closable = VFS.mountZip(archive, archive, TempFileProviderService.provider());
                }
                ResourceRoot webInfArchiveRoot = new ResourceRoot(archive.getName(), archive, new MountHandle(closable));
                ModuleRootMarker.mark(webInfArchiveRoot);
                entries.add(webInfArchiveRoot);
            } catch (IOException e) {
                throw new DeploymentUnitProcessingException(UndertowLogger.ROOT_LOGGER.failToProcessWebInfLib(archive), e);
            }
        }
    }

    return entries;
}
```

2598	```java
public static ORB getOrb(String server, int port, Hashtable env) {
    // Initialize ORB properties from environment and predefined properties
    Properties orbProp = new Properties();
    if (env != null) {
        Enumeration envProp = env.keys();
        while (envProp.hasMoreElements()) {
            String key = (String) envProp.nextElement();
            Object val = env.get(key);
            if (val instanceof String) {
                orbProp.put(key, val);
            }
        }
        Enumeration mainProps = orbProperties.keys();
        while (mainProps.hasMoreElements()) {
            String key = (String) mainProps.nextElement();
            Object val = orbProperties.get(key);
            if (val instanceof String) {
                orbProp.put(key, val);
            }
        }
    } else {
        orbProp = orbProperties;
    }

    // Set ORB initial host and port if provided
    if (server != null) {
        orbProp.put("org.omg.CORBA.ORBInitialHost", server);
    }
    if (port >= 0) {
        orbProp.put("org.omg.CORBA.ORBInitialPort", "" + port);
    }

    // Create ORB for an applet if applet context is provided
    if (env != null) {
        Object applet = env.get(Context.APPLET);
        if (applet != null) {
            return initAppletORB(applet, orbProp);
        }
    }

    // Create ORB for a standalone application
    return ORB.init(new String[0], orbProp);
}
```

/**
 * Determines the parameter class type based on the generic parameter type, method, parameter position, and class loader.
 * 
 * @param genParamType The generic parameter type.
 * @param method The method containing the parameter.
 * @param paramPos The position of the parameter in the method.
 * @param classLoader The class loader to use for loading classes.
 * @return The determined parameter class type, or null if not found.
 */
private Class checkParamType(Type genParamType, final Method method, final int paramPos, final ClassLoader classLoader) {
    Class paramClazz = null;
    if (genParamType instanceof ParameterizedType) {
        ParameterizedType pType = (ParameterizedType) genParamType;
        Type[] actualTypeArgs = pType.getActualTypeArguments();
        if (actualTypeArgs.length == 1) {
            try {
                paramClazz = classLoader.loadClass(actualTypeArgs[0].getTypeName());
            } catch (Exception ee) {
                JAXRS_LOGGER.classIntrospectionFailure(ee.getClass().getName(), ee.getMessage());
            }
        }
    } else {
        Class<?>[] paramArr = method.getParameterTypes();
        if (paramArr[paramPos].isArray()) {
            Class compClazz = paramArr[paramPos].getComponentType();
            if (!compClazz.isPrimitive()) {
                paramClazz = compClazz;
            }
        } else {
            if (!paramArr[paramPos].isPrimitive()) {
                paramClazz = paramArr[paramPos];
            }
        }
    }
    return paramClazz;
}

/**
 * Identifies the database dialect based on the given name.
 * 
 * @param name The name of the database.
 * @return The unified dialect name, or null if the dialect is not recognized.
 */
private String identifyDialect(String name) {
    String unified = null;
    if (name != null) {
        if (name.toLowerCase().contains("postgres")) {
            unified = "postgresql";
        } else if (name.toLowerCase().contains("mysql")) {
            unified = "mysql";
        } else if (name.toLowerCase().contains("mariadb")) {
            unified = "mariadb";
        } else if (name.toLowerCase().contains("db2")) {
            unified = "db2";
        } else if (name.toLowerCase().contains("hsql") || name.toLowerCase().contains("hypersonic")) {
            unified = "hsql";
        } else if (name.toLowerCase().contains("h2")) {
            unified = "h2";
        } else if (name.toLowerCase().contains("oracle")) {
            unified = "oracle";
        } else if (name.toLowerCase().contains("microsoft")) {
            unified = "mssql";
        } else if (name.toLowerCase().contains("jconnect")) {
            unified = "sybase";
        }
    }
    EjbLogger.EJB3_TIMER_LOGGER.debugf("Check dialect for '%s', result is '%s'", name, unified);
    return unified;
}

public void deploy(DeploymentPhaseContext phaseContext) throws DeploymentUnitProcessingException {

public static void insertAnyPrimitive(Any any, Object primitive) {
    Class<?> type = primitive.getClass();
    if (type == Boolean.class) {
        any.insert_boolean(((Boolean) primitive).booleanValue());
    } else if (type == Character.class) {
        any.insert_wchar(((Character) primitive).charValue());
    } else if (type == Byte.class) {
        any.insert_octet(((Byte) primitive).byteValue());
    } else if (type == Short.class) {
        any.insert_short(((Short) primitive).shortValue());
    } else if (type == Integer.class) {
        any.insert_long(((Integer) primitive).intValue());
    } else if (type == Long.class) {
        any.insert_longlong(((Long) primitive).longValue());
    } else if (type == Float.class) {
        any.insert_float(((Float) primitive).floatValue());
    } else if (type == Double.class) {
        any.insert_double(((Double) primitive).doubleValue());
    } else {
        throw IIOPLogger.ROOT_LOGGER.notAPrimitive(type.getName());
    }
}

2631	```java
/**
 * Converts a Java name to an IDL name.
 * 
 * @param name The Java name to convert.
 * @return The converted IDL name.
 * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the name is null, empty, or contains spaces.
 */
public static String javaToIDLName(String name) {
    if (name == null || "".equals(name) || name.indexOf(' ') != -1) {
        throw IIOPLogger.ROOT_LOGGER.nameCannotBeNullEmptyOrQualified();
    }
    
    StringBuffer res = new StringBuffer(name.length());
    if (name.charAt(0) == ' ') {
        res.append(' ');
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < name.length(); ++i) {
        char c = name.charAt(i);
        if (isLegalIDLIdentifierChar(c)) {
            res.append(c);
        } else {
            res.append(' ').append(toHexString((int) c));
        }
    }
    
    String s = res.toString();
    if (isReservedIDLKeyword(s)) {
        return "_" + s;
    } else {
        return s;
    }
}
```

/**
 * Checks if the given string is a reserved keyword in IDL.

 */
private static boolean isReservedIDLKeyword(String s) {
    for (int i = 0; i < reservedIDLKeywords.length; ++i) {
        if (reservedIDLKeywords[i].equals(s)) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

/**
 * Returns the Java type signature for a given class.
 * 
 * @param cls The class for which to get the type signature.
 * @return The type signature as a string.
 */
private static String getSignature(Class cls) {
    if (cls.isArray()) {
        return "[" + cls.getComponentType();
    }
    if (cls.isPrimitive()) {
        switch (cls) {
            case Byte.TYPE: return "B";
            case Character.TYPE: return "C";
            case Double.TYPE: return "D";
            case Float.TYPE: return "F";
            case Integer.TYPE: return "I";
            case Long.TYPE: return "J";
            case Short.TYPE: return "S";
            case Boolean.TYPE: return "Z";
            default: throw IIOPLogger.ROOT_LOGGER.unknownPrimitiveType(cls.getName());
        }
    }
    return "L" + cls.getName().replace(' ', ' ') + ";";
}
```

/**
 * Generates a signature for a given method.
 * 
 * @param method The method for which to generate the signature.
 * @return A string representing the method signature.
 */
private static String getSignature(Method method) {
    StringBuffer b = new StringBuffer("(");
    Class<?>[] parameterTypes = method.getParameterTypes();
    for (int i = 0; i < parameterTypes.length; ++i) {
        b.append(getSignature(parameterTypes[i]));
    }
    b.append(' ').append(getSignature(method.getReturnType()));
    return b.toString();
}

synchronized void addListener(final String target, final int scope, final NamingListener namingListener) {
    // Create a TargetScope object with the given target and scope
    final TargetScope targetScope = new TargetScope(target, scope);

    // Check if there is already a holder for the given listener
    ListenerHolder holder = holdersByListener.get(namingListener);
    if (holder == null) {
        // If no holder exists, create a new one and add it to the holdersByListener map
        holder = new ListenerHolder(namingListener, targetScope);
        final Map<NamingListener, ListenerHolder> byListenerCopy = new FastCopyHashMap<>(holdersByListener);
        byListenerCopy.put(namingListener, holder);
        holdersByListener = byListenerCopy;
    } else {
        // If a holder exists, add the target scope to it
        holder.addTarget(targetScope);
    }

    // Get the list of holders for the given target scope
    List<ListenerHolder> holdersForTarget = holdersByTarget.get(targetScope);
    if (holdersForTarget == null) {
        // If no list exists, create a new one and add it to the holdersByTarget map
        holdersForTarget = new CopyOnWriteArrayList<>();
        final Map<TargetScope, List<ListenerHolder>> byTargetCopy = new FastCopyHashMap<>(holdersByTarget);
        byTargetCopy.put(targetScope, holdersForTarget);
        holdersByTarget = byTargetCopy;
    }

    // Add the holder to the list of holders for the given target scope
    holdersForTarget.add(holder);
}

2644	```java
synchronized void removeListener(final NamingListener namingListener) {
    // Retrieve the listener holder for the given listener
    final ListenerHolder holder = holdersByListener.get(namingListener);
    if (holder == null) {
        return;
    }

    // Create a copy of the holdersByListener map to avoid concurrent modification
    final Map<NamingListener, ListenerHolder> byListenerCopy = new FastCopyHashMap<>(holdersByListener);
    byListenerCopy.remove(namingListener);
    holdersByListener = byListenerCopy;

    // Create a copy of the holdersByTarget map to avoid concurrent modification
    final Map<TargetScope, List<ListenerHolder>> byTargetCopy = new FastCopyHashMap<>(holdersByTarget);
    for (TargetScope targetScope : holder.targets) {
        // Remove the holder from the list of holders for the target scope
        final List<ListenerHolder> holders = holdersByTarget.get(targetScope);
        holders.remove(holder);
        if (holders.isEmpty()) {
            // Remove the target scope if it is empty
            byTargetCopy.remove(targetScope);
        }
    }
    holdersByTarget = byTargetCopy;
}
```
2645	```java
void fireEvent(EventContext context, Name name, Binding existingBinding, Binding newBinding, int type, String changeInfo, Integer... scopes) {
    String target = name.toString();
    Set<Integer> scopeSet = new HashSet<>(Arrays.asList(scopes));
    NamingEvent event = new NamingEvent(context, type, newBinding, existingBinding, changeInfo);
    Set<ListenerHolder> holdersToFire = new HashSet<>();

    // Check for OBJECT_SCOPE based listeners
    if (scopeSet.contains(EventContext.OBJECT_SCOPE)) {
        TargetScope targetScope = new TargetScope(target, EventContext.OBJECT_SCOPE);
        List<ListenerHolder> holders = holdersByTarget.get(targetScope);
        if (holders != null) {
            holdersToFire.addAll(holders);
        }
    }

    // Check for ONELEVEL_SCOPE based listeners
    if (scopeSet.contains(EventContext.ONELEVEL_SCOPE) && !name.isEmpty()) {
        TargetScope targetScope = new TargetScope(name.getPrefix(name.size() - 1).toString(), EventContext.ONELEVEL_SCOPE);
        List<ListenerHolder> holders = holdersByTarget.get(targetScope);
        if (holders != null) {
            holdersToFire.addAll(holders);
        }
    }

    // Check for SUBTREE_SCOPE based listeners
    if (scopeSet.contains(EventContext.SUBTREE_SCOPE) && !name.isEmpty()) {
        for (int i = 1; i < name.size(); i++) {
            Name parentName = name.getPrefix(i);
            TargetScope targetScope = new TargetScope(parentName.toString(), EventContext.SUBTREE_SCOPE);
            List<ListenerHolder> holders = holdersByTarget.get(targetScope);
            if (holders != null) {
                holdersToFire.addAll(holders);
            }
        }
    }

    executor.execute(new FireEventTask(holdersToFire, event));
}

/**
 * Creates an in-VM transport configuration based on the provided operation context.
 *
 * @param context The operation context containing the necessary resources and model.
 * @return A TransportConfiguration object representing the in-VM transport.
 * @throws OperationFailedException If no in-VM connector is found or if there is an issue with the model.
 */
private TransportConfiguration createInVMTransportConfiguration(OperationContext context) throws OperationFailedException {
    // Read the server resource from the context.
    final Resource serverResource = context.readResource(EMPTY_ADDRESS, false);
    
    // Retrieve all in-VM connectors from the server resource.
    Set<Resource.ResourceEntry> invmConnectors = serverResource.getChildren(CommonAttributes.IN_VM_CONNECTOR);
    
    // If no in-VM connectors are found, throw an exception.
    if (invmConnectors.isEmpty()) {
        throw MessagingLogger.ROOT_LOGGER.noInVMConnector();
    }
    
    // Get the first in-VM connector entry.
    Resource.ResourceEntry connectorEntry = invmConnectors.iterator().next();
    
    // Read the connector resource using the connector entry's path.
    Resource connectorResource = context.readResource(PathAddress.pathAddress(connectorEntry.getPathElement()), false);
    
    // Get the model of the connector resource.
    ModelNode model = connectorResource.getModel();
    
    // Extract parameters from the model and add the server ID.
    Map<String, Object> params = new HashMap<>(CommonAttributes.PARAMS.unwrap(context, model));
    params.put(InVMTransportDefinition.SERVER_ID.getName(), InVMTransportDefinition.SERVER_ID.resolveModelAttribute(context, model).asInt());
    
    // Create and return the TransportConfiguration object.
    TransportConfiguration transportConfiguration = new TransportConfiguration(InVMConnectorFactory.class.getName(), params);
    return transportConfiguration;
}

/**
 * Retrieves the JBossWebMetaData for a given DeploymentUnit.
 * 
 * @param unit The DeploymentUnit to retrieve the JBossWebMetaData for.
 * @return The JBossWebMetaData, or null if not found.
 */
public static JBossWebMetaData getJBossWebMetaData(final DeploymentUnit unit) {
    // Attempt to get WarMetaData from the DeploymentUnit
    WarMetaData warMetaData = getOptionalAttachment(unit, WarMetaData.ATTACHMENT_KEY);
    JBossWebMetaData result = null;

    // If WarMetaData is found, get the merged JBossWebMetaData
    if (warMetaData != null) {
        result = warMetaData.getMergedJBossWebMetaData();
        // If merged JBossWebMetaData is null, get the original JBossWebMetaData
        if (result == null) {
            result = warMetaData.getJBossWebMetaData();
        }
    } else {
        // If WarMetaData is not found, try to get JBossWebMetaData using a different key
        result = getOptionalAttachment(unit, WSAttachmentKeys.JBOSSWEB_METADATA_KEY);
    }

    return result;
}

2687	```java
/**
 * Creates a new unified WS deployment model for a given deployment unit.
 *
 * @param unit The deployment unit for which to create the deployment model.
 * @return The newly created ArchiveDeployment.
 * @throws DeploymentException If the class loader resolution fails.
 */
private ArchiveDeployment newDeployment(final DeploymentUnit unit) {
    WSLogger.ROOT_LOGGER.tracef("Creating new unified WS deployment model for %s", unit);
    ResourceRoot deploymentRoot = unit.getAttachment(Attachments.DEPLOYMENT_ROOT);
    VirtualFile root = deploymentRoot != null ? deploymentRoot.getRoot() : null;
    ClassLoader classLoader;
    Module module = unit.getAttachment(Attachments.MODULE);
    if (module == null) {
        classLoader = unit.getAttachment(CLASSLOADER_KEY);
        if (classLoader == null) {
            throw WSLogger.ROOT_LOGGER.classLoaderResolutionFailed(unit);
        }
    } else {
        classLoader = module.getClassLoader();
    }
    ArchiveDeployment parentDep = null;
    if (unit.getParent() != null) {
        Module parentModule = unit.getParent().getAttachment(Attachments.MODULE);
        if (parentModule == null) {
            throw WSLogger.ROOT_LOGGER.classLoaderResolutionFailed(deploymentRoot);
        }
        WSLogger.ROOT_LOGGER.tracef("Creating new unified WS deployment model for %s", unit.getParent());
        parentDep = this.newDeployment(null, unit.getParent().getName(), parentModule.getClassLoader(), null);
    }
    UnifiedVirtualFile uvf = root != null ? new VirtualFileAdaptor(root) : new ResourceLoaderAdapter(classLoader);
    ArchiveDeployment dep = this.newDeployment(parentDep, unit.getName(), classLoader, uvf);
    dep.addAttachment(AnnotationsInfo.class, new JandexAnnotationsInfo(unit));
    return dep;
}

protected void addRemoteTransactionsDependency() {
    this.getConfigurators().add(new ComponentConfigurator() {
        @Override
        public void configure(DeploymentPhaseContext context, ComponentDescription description, ComponentConfiguration componentConfiguration) throws DeploymentUnitProcessingException {
            if (this.hasRemoteView((EJBComponentDescription) description)) {
                componentConfiguration.getCreateDependencies().add((sb, cs) -> sb.requires(TxnServices.JBOSS_TXN_REMOTE_TRANSACTION_SERVICE));
            }
        }

        private boolean hasRemoteView(final EJBComponentDescription ejbComponentDescription) {
            final Set<ViewDescription> views = ejbComponentDescription.getViews();
            for (final ViewDescription view : views) {
                if (!(view instanceof EJBViewDescription)) {
                    continue;
                }
                final MethodIntf viewType = ((EJBViewDescription) view).getMethodIntf();
                if (viewType == MethodIntf.REMOTE || viewType == MethodIntf.HOME) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
            return false;
        }
    });
}
```

**Summary:**
This method `addRemoteTransactionsDependency` adds a dependency on the remote transaction service for EJB components that have remote views. It uses a `ComponentConfigurator` to check if the component description has any remote views by calling the `hasRemoteView` method. If a remote view is found, it adds a dependency on the remote transaction service using `componentConfiguration.getCreateDependencies().add`.

public static ResourceDefinition getElytronKeyStoreResourceDefinition() {
    // Define attributes for the resource
    AttributeDefinition[] attributes = new AttributeDefinition[] { LEGACY_JSSE_CONFIG };

    // Create an add handler for the resource
    AbstractAddStepHandler addHandler = new BasicAddHandler<KeyStore>(attributes, KEY_STORE_RUNTIME_CAPABILITY) {
        @Override
        protected BasicService.ValueSupplier<KeyStore> getValueSupplier(ServiceBuilder<KeyStore> serviceBuilder, OperationContext context, ModelNode model) throws OperationFailedException {
            // Get the legacy JSSE configuration value
            String legacyJSSEConfig = asStringIfDefined(context, LEGACY_JSSE_CONFIG, model);
            // Create an injector for the security domain context
            InjectedValue<SecurityDomainContext> securityDomainContextInjector = new InjectedValue<>();

            // If legacy JSSE configuration is not null, add a dependency on the security domain service
            if (legacyJSSEConfig != null) {
                serviceBuilder.addDependency(SecurityDomainService.SERVICE_NAME.append(legacyJSSEConfig), SecurityDomainContext.class, securityDomainContextInjector);
            }

            // Return a value supplier that retrieves the key store from the JSSE domain
            return () -> {
                SecurityDomainContext domainContext = securityDomainContextInjector.getValue();
                JSSESecurityDomain jsseDomain = domainContext.getJSSE();
                if (jsseDomain == null) {
                    throw SecurityLogger.ROOT_LOGGER.unableToLocateJSSEConfig(legacyJSSEConfig);
                }
                KeyStore keyStore = jsseDomain.getKeyStore();
                if (keyStore == null) {
                    throw SecurityLogger.ROOT_LOGGER.unableToLocateComponentInJSSEDomain("KeyStore", legacyJSSEConfig);
                }
                return keyStore;
            };
        }
    };

    // Create and return the resource definition
    return new BasicResourceDefinition(Constants.ELYTRON_KEY_STORE, addHandler, attributes, KEY_STORE_RUNTIME_CAPABILITY);
}

2703	```java
/**
 * Splits a string into components based on separators and escapes.
 * 
 * @param str The input string to be split.
 * @return A Vector containing the stringified components.
 * @throws InvalidNameException If an invalid escape sequence is encountered.
 */
private static Vector insStringToStringifiedComps(String str) throws InvalidNameException {
    int len = str.length();
    Vector components = new Vector(10);
    char[] id = new char[len];
    char[] kind = new char[len];
    int idCount, kindCount;
    boolean idMode;

    for (int i = 0; i < len; ) {
        idCount = kindCount = 0; // reset for new component
        idMode = true; // always start off parsing id

        while (i < len) {
            if (str.charAt(i) == compSeparator) {
                break;
            } else if (str.charAt(i) == escapeChar) {
                if (i + 1 >= len) {
                    throw IIOPLogger.ROOT_LOGGER.unescapedCharacter(str);
                } else if (isMeta(str.charAt(i + 1))) {
                    ++i; // skip escape and let meta through
                    if (idMode) {
                        id[idCount++] = str.charAt(i++);
                    } else {
                        kind[kindCount++] = str.charAt(i++);
                    }
                } else {
                    throw IIOPLogger.ROOT_LOGGER.invalidEscapedCharacter(str);
                }
            } else if (idMode && str.charAt(i) == kindSeparator) {
                // just look for the first kindSeparator
                ++i; // skip kind separator
                idMode = false;
            } else {
                if (idMode) {
                    id[idCount++] = str.charAt(i++);
                } else {
                    kind[kindCount++] = str.charAt(i++);
                }
            }
        }

        components.addElement(stringifyComponent(new NameComponent(new String(id, 0, idCount), new String(kind, 0, kindCount))));
        if (i < len) {
            ++i; // skip separator
        }
    }

    return components;
}
```
2704	```java
/**
 * Parses a component string into a NameComponent object.
 * 
 * @param compStr The component string to parse.
 * @return A NameComponent object representing the parsed component.
 * @throws InvalidNameException If the component string is invalid.
 */
private static NameComponent parseComponent(String compStr) throws InvalidNameException {
    NameComponent comp = new NameComponent();
    int kindSep = -1;
    int len = compStr.length();
    int j = 0;
    char[] newStr = new char[len];
    boolean escaped = false;

    // Find the kind separator
    for (int i = 0; i < len && kindSep < 0; i++) {
        if (escaped) {
            newStr[j++] = compStr.charAt(i);
            escaped = false;
        } else if (compStr.charAt(i) == escapeChar) {
            if (i + 1 >= len) {
                throw IIOPLogger.ROOT_LOGGER.unescapedCharacter(compStr);
            } else if (isMeta(compStr.charAt(i + 1))) {
                escaped = true;
            } else {
                throw IIOPLogger.ROOT_LOGGER.invalidEscapedCharacter(compStr);
            }
        } else if (compStr.charAt(i) == kindSeparator) {
            kindSep = i;
        } else {
            newStr[j++] = compStr.charAt(i);
        }
    }

    // Set id
    comp.id = new String(newStr, 0, j);

    // Set kind
    if (kindSep < 0) {
        comp.kind = ""; // no kind separator
    } else {
        // Unescape kind
        j = 0;
        escaped = false;
        for (int i = kindSep + 1; i < len; i++) {
            if (escaped) {
                newStr[j++] = compStr.charAt(i);
                escaped = false;
            } else if (compStr.charAt(i) == escapeChar) {
                if (i + 1 >= len) {
                    throw IIOPLogger.ROOT_LOGGER.unescapedCharacter(compStr);
                } else if (isMeta(compStr.charAt(i + 1))) {
                    escaped = true;
                } else {
                    throw IIOPLogger.ROOT_LOGGER.invalidEscapedCharacter(compStr);
                }
            } else {
                newStr[j++] = compStr.charAt(i);
            }
        }
        comp.kind = new String(newStr, 0, j);

2707	```java
/**
 * Authenticates a user with the given username and password.
 *
 * @param username The username to authenticate.
 * @param password The password to authenticate.
 * @return The authorized identity if authentication is successful, otherwise null.
 */
private SecurityIdentity authenticate(final String username, final String password) {
    ServerAuthenticationContext context = this.securityDomain.createNewAuthenticationContext();
    PasswordGuessEvidence evidence = null;
    try {
        if (password == null) {
            if (username == null) {
                if (context.authorizeAnonymous()) {
                    context.succeed();
                    return context.getAuthorizedIdentity();
                } else {
                    context.fail();
                    return null;
                }
            } else {
                context.fail();
                return null;
            }
        }
        context.setAuthenticationName(username);
        evidence = new PasswordGuessEvidence(password.toCharArray());
        if (context.verifyEvidence(evidence)) {
            if (context.authorize()) {
                context.succeed();
                return context.getAuthorizedIdentity();
            } else {
                context.fail();
                MessagingLogger.ROOT_LOGGER.failedAuthorization(username);
            }
        } else {
            context.fail();
            MessagingLogger.ROOT_LOGGER.failedAuthentication(username);
        }
    } catch (IllegalArgumentException | IllegalStateException | RealmUnavailableException e) {
        context.fail();
        MessagingLogger.ROOT_LOGGER.failedAuthenticationWithException(e, username, e.getMessage());
    } finally {
        if (evidence != null) {
            evidence.destroy();
        }
    }
    return null;
}

           clz.equals(float.class) || clz.equals(Float.class) ||
           clz.equals(double.class) || clz.equals(Double.class) ||
           clz.equals(boolean.class) || clz.equals(Boolean.class) ||
           clz.equals(char.class) || clz.equals(Character.class) ||

2710	```java
/**
 * Unbinds a JNDI name from the container.
 * 
 * @param name The JNDI name to unbind.
 * @throws IllegalArgumentException If the name is null or empty.
 */
@Override
public void unbind(String name) {
    if (name == null || name.isEmpty()) {
        throw MessagingLogger.ROOT_LOGGER.cannotUnbindJndiName();
    }

    ContextNames.BindInfo bindInfo = ContextNames.bindInfoFor(name);
    ServiceController<?> bindingService = container.getService(bindInfo.getBinderServiceName());

    if (bindingService == null) {
        ROOT_LOGGER.debugf("Cannot unbind %s since no binding exists with that name", name);
        return;
    }

    // Remove the binding service
    bindingService.setMode(ServiceController.Mode.REMOVE);
    StabilityMonitor monitor = new StabilityMonitor();
    monitor.addController(bindingService);

    try {
        monitor.awaitStability();
        ROOT_LOGGER.unboundJndiName(bindInfo.getAbsoluteJndiName());
    } catch (InterruptedException e) {
        ROOT_LOGGER.failedToUnbindJndiName(name, 5, SECONDS.toString().toLowerCase(Locale.US));
    } finally {
        monitor.removeController(bindingService);
    }
}

2712	```java
public static void configure(BeanMetaDataConfig beanConfig, BeanInfo beanInfo, Module module, Object bean, boolean nullify) throws Throwable {
    Set<PropertyConfig> properties = beanConfig.getProperties();
    if (properties != null) {
        List<PropertyConfig> used = new ArrayList<>();
        for (PropertyConfig pc : properties) {
            try {
                configure(beanInfo, module, bean, pc, nullify);
                used.add(pc);
            } catch (Throwable t) {
                if (nullify == false) {
                    for (PropertyConfig upc : used) {
                        try {
                            configure(beanInfo, module, bean, upc, true);
                        } catch (Throwable ignored) {
                        }
                    }
                    throw new StartException(t);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

**Summary:**
The `configure` method processes a set of `PropertyConfig` objects from a `BeanMetaDataConfig`. It iterates through each property, attempting to configure the bean using the `configure` method with the current property and the `nullify` flag. If an exception occurs and `nullify` is `false`, it attempts to nullify previously used properties and then rethrows the exception as a `StartException`.

2720	```java
public static String validateDescriptor(String descriptor) {
    if (descriptor.length() == 0) {
        throw EeLogger.ROOT_LOGGER.cannotBeEmpty("descriptors");
    }
    if (descriptor.length() > 1) {
        if (descriptor.startsWith("L")) {
            if (!descriptor.endsWith(";")) {
                throw EeLogger.ROOT_LOGGER.invalidDescriptor(descriptor);
            }
        } else if (descriptor.startsWith("[")) {
            // Additional validation for array descriptors can be added here
        } else {
            throw EeLogger.ROOT_LOGGER.invalidDescriptor(descriptor);
        }
    } else {
        char type = descriptor.charAt(0);
        switch (type) {
            case 'B': case 'C': case 'D': case 'F': case 'I': case 'J': case 'S': case 'Z':
                break;
            default:
                throw EeLogger.ROOT_LOGGER.invalidDescriptor(descriptor);
        }
    }
    return descriptor;
}
```

**Summary:**
The `validateDescriptor` method checks if the input `descriptor` string is valid according to certain rules. If the descriptor is empty, it throws an error indicating that the descriptor cannot be empty. If the descriptor length is greater than 1, it checks if the descriptor starts with 'L' and ensures it ends with ';'. If it starts with '[', additional validation for array descriptors can be added. For single-character descriptors, it checks if the character is one of the valid primitive types ('B', 'C', 'D', 'F', 'I', 'J', 'S', 'Z'). If any of these conditions are not met, it throws an error indicating that the descriptor is invalid. If all checks pass, it returns the descriptor.

void create(final Deployment dep) {
    // Retrieve the DeploymentUnit from the Deployment
    final DeploymentUnit unit = WSHelper.getRequiredAttachment(dep, DeploymentUnit.class);
    
    // Retrieve the WarMetaData from the DeploymentUnit, if available
    WarMetaData warMD = ASHelper.getOptionalAttachment(unit, WarMetaData.ATTACHMENT_KEY);
    
    // Retrieve the JBossWebMetaData from the WarMetaData, if available
    JBossWebMetaData jbossWebMD = warMD != null ? warMD.getMergedJBossWebMetaData() : null;
    
    // If WarMetaData is not available, create a new one
    if (warMD == null) {
        warMD = new WarMetaData();
    }
    
    // If JBossWebMetaData is not available, create a new one and set it in WarMetaData
    if (jbossWebMD == null) {
        jbossWebMD = new JBossWebMetaData();
        warMD.setMergedJBossWebMetaData(jbossWebMD);
        unit.putAttachment(WarMetaData.ATTACHMENT_KEY, warMD);
    }
    
    // Create the web application descriptor
    createWebAppDescriptor(dep, jbossWebMD);
    
    // Create the JBoss web application descriptor
    createJBossWebAppDescriptor(dep, jbossWebMD);
    
    // Add the JBossWebMetaData to the Deployment
    dep.addAttachment(JBossWebMetaData.class, jbossWebMD);
}

/**
 * Creates a stub class for the given class.
 *
 * @param myClass The class for which to create the stub.
 * @return The created stub class.
 * @throws Exception If an error occurs during the creation of the stub class.
 */
public static Class<?> makeStubClass(final Class<?> myClass) {
    String stubClassName = myClass + "_Stub";
    ClassLoader cl = WildFlySecurityManager.getCurrentContextClassLoaderPrivileged();
    if (cl == null) {
        cl = myClass.getClassLoader();
    }
    if (cl == null) {
        throw EjbLogger.ROOT_LOGGER.couldNotFindClassLoaderForStub(stubClassName);
    }
    Class<?> theClass;
    try {
        theClass = cl.loadClass(stubClassName);
    } catch (ClassNotFoundException e) {
        try {
            ClassFile clazz = IIOPStubCompiler.compile(myClass, stubClassName);
            theClass = clazz.define(cl, myClass.getProtectionDomain());
        } catch (Throwable ex) {
            try {
                theClass = cl.loadClass(stubClassName);
            } catch (ClassNotFoundException e1) {
                EjbLogger.ROOT_LOGGER.dynamicStubCreationFailed(stubClassName, ex);
                throw ex;
            }
        }
    }
    return theClass;
}

/**
 * Adds a deployment-specific persistence provider to a map, associating it with a set of class loaders.
 * 
 * @param persistenceProvider The persistence provider to add.
 * @param deploymentClassLoaders The set of class loaders associated with the deployment.
 */
public void addDeploymentSpecificPersistenceProvider(PersistenceProvider persistenceProvider, Set<ClassLoader> deploymentClassLoaders) {
    synchronized (persistenceProviderPerClassLoader) {
        for (ClassLoader deploymentClassLoader : deploymentClassLoaders) {
            List<Class<? extends PersistenceProvider>> list = persistenceProviderPerClassLoader.get(deploymentClassLoader);
            ROOT_LOGGER.tracef("Getting persistence provider list (%s) for deployment (%s)", list, deploymentClassLoader);
            if (list == null) {
                list = new ArrayList<>();
                persistenceProviderPerClassLoader.put(deploymentClassLoader, list);
                ROOT_LOGGER.tracef("Saving new persistence provider list (%s) for deployment (%s)", list, deploymentClassLoader);
            }
            list.add(persistenceProvider.getClass());
            ROOT_LOGGER.tracef("Added new persistence provider (%s) to provider list (%s)", persistenceProvider.getClass().getName(), list);
        }
    }
}

/**

 * @param adaptorModule The adaptor module.
 * @param adaptor The persistence provider adaptor.
 * @param provider The persistence provider.
 * @return The saved persistence provider adaptor.

    if (deploymentUnit.getParent() != null) {
        deploymentUnit = deploymentUnit.getParent();
    }
    synchronized (deploymentUnit) {
        Map<String, PersistenceProviderAdaptor> map = deploymentUnit.getAttachment(providerAdaptorMapKey);
        String key;
        if (adaptorModule != null) {
            key = adaptorModule; // Handle legacy adapter module
        } else {
            key = provider.getClass().getName();
        }
        PersistenceProviderAdaptor current = map.get(key); // Get the current adaptor
        if (current == null) {
            map.put(key, adaptor); // Put the adaptor if not already set
            current = adaptor;
        }
        return current; // Return the saved adaptor
    }

2742	```java
/**
 * Retrieves or creates a ContainerAnalysis for a given class.
 * 
 * @param cls The class for which to retrieve or create the ContainerAnalysis.
 * @return The ContainerAnalysis for the given class.
 * @throws RMIIIOPViolationException If an IOR violation occurs.
 */
ContainerAnalysis getAnalysis(final Class cls) throws RMIIIOPViolationException {
    ContainerAnalysis ret = null;
    boolean created = false;
    try {
        synchronized (this) {
            ret = lookupDone(cls);
            if (ret != null) {
                return ret;
            }
            final ContainerAnalysis inProgress = workInProgress.get(new InProgressKey(cls, Thread.currentThread()));
            if (inProgress != null) {
                return inProgress;
            }
            ret = createWorkInProgress(cls);
        }
        created = true;
        doTheWork(cls, ret);
    } finally {
        synchronized (this) {
            if (created) {
                workInProgress.remove(new InProgressKey(cls, Thread.currentThread()));
                workDone.put(cls, new SoftReference<>(ret));
                ClassLoader classLoader = cls.getClassLoader();
                if (classLoader != null) {
                    Set<Class<?>> classes = classesByLoader.get(classLoader);
                    if (classes == null) {
                        classesByLoader.put(classLoader, classes = new HashSet<Class<?>>());
                    }
                    classes.add(cls);
                }
            }
            notifyAll();
        }
    }
    return ret;
}
```
2743	The `lookupDone` method is designed to retrieve a `ContainerAnalysis` object associated with a given class from a cache (`workDone`). It uses a `SoftReference` to store the `ContainerAnalysis` object, allowing it to be garbage collected if memory is low. Here's a step-by-step summary of the method:

1. **Retrieve SoftReference**: The method first attempts to retrieve a `SoftReference` from the `workDone` map using the provided class (`cls`) as the key.
2. **Check for Null Reference**: If the retrieved `SoftReference` is `null`, the method returns `null`, indicating that no `ContainerAnalysis` object is available in the cache.
3. **Dereference SoftReference**: If the `SoftReference` is not `null`, the method attempts to dereference it to get the `ContainerAnalysis` object.
4. **Check for Null Object**: If the dereferenced `ContainerAnalysis` object is `null`, it means the object was garbage collected. In this case, the method removes the entry from the `workDone` map to clear the cache.
5. **Return Object**: If the dereferenced `ContainerAnalysis` object is not `null`, the method returns it.

In summary, the `lookupDone` method provides a way to safely retrieve a `ContainerAnalysis` object from a cache, handling cases where the object may have been garbage collected.
2744	```java
/**
 * Creates a work-in-progress instance of the given class and stores it in a map.
 *
 * @param cls the class for which to create the work-in-progress instance
 * @return the created work-in-progress instance
 * @throws RuntimeException if an exception occurs during instance creation
 */
private ContainerAnalysis createWorkInProgress(final Class cls) {
    ContainerAnalysis analysis;
    try {
        analysis = (ContainerAnalysis) constructor.newInstance(cls);
    } catch (InstantiationException | IllegalAccessException | InvocationTargetException ex) {
        throw new RuntimeException(ex.toString());
    }
    workInProgress.put(new InProgressKey(cls, Thread.currentThread()), analysis);
    return analysis;
}

2748	```java
/**
 * Determines if a method is an accessor method.
 * 
 * @param m The method to check.
 * @return true if the method is an accessor, false otherwise.
 */
protected boolean isAccessor(Method m) {
    Class<?> returnType = m.getReturnType();
    String name = m.getName();
    
    // Check if the method name starts with "get" or "is"
    if (!(name.startsWith("get") && name.length() > "get".length()) &&
        !(name.startsWith("is") && name.length() > "is".length() && returnType == Boolean.TYPE)) {
        return false;
    }
    
    // Check if the return type is not Void
    if (returnType == Void.TYPE) {
        return false;
    }
    
    // Check if the method has no parameters
    if (m.getParameterTypes().length != 0) {
        return false;
    }
    
    // Check if the method has non-application exceptions
    return hasNonAppExceptions(m);
}
```
2749	```java
/**
 * Determines if a given method is a mutator method.
 * A mutator method is defined as a method that starts with "set", returns void, and takes exactly one parameter.
 * 
 * @param m The method to check.
 * @return true if the method is a mutator method, false otherwise.
 */
protected boolean isMutator(Method m) {
    String name = m.getName();
    if (!(name.startsWith("set") && name.length() > "set".length())) return false;
    if (m.getReturnType() != Void.TYPE) return false;
    if (m.getParameterTypes().length != 1) return false;
    return hasNonAppExceptions(m);
}
```
2750	```java
/**
 * Checks if a method has non-RemoteException exceptions.
 *
 * @param m the method to check
 * @return true if the method has non-RemoteException exceptions, false otherwise
 */
protected boolean hasNonAppExceptions(Method m) {
    Class<?>[] ex = m.getExceptionTypes();
    for (int i = 0; i < ex.length; ++i) {
        if (!java.rmi.RemoteException.class.isAssignableFrom(ex[i])) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}
```

2753	This method, `fixupOverloadedOperationNames`, is designed to handle overloaded operations in a Java class by generating unique IDL (Interface Definition Language) names for each method. Here's a summary of the method:

1. **Loop Through Methods**: The method iterates through an array of methods (`methods`).

2. **Check for Overloaded Methods**: For each method, it checks if the method is overloaded by examining the `m_flags` array. If the method is not overloaded, it skips to the next method.

3. **Find Operation Analysis**: It then finds the corresponding `OperationAnalysis` object for the current method by iterating through an array of operations (`operations`).

4. **Check if Method is Mapped**: If the method is not mapped to an operation, it continues to the next method.

5. **Calculate New IDL Name**:
   - It retrieves the parameters of the method and initializes a `StringBuffer` with the existing IDL name.
   - If there are no parameters, it appends "__" to the IDL name.
   - For each parameter, it processes the type name to remove any leading "::" or "_", and appends it to the `StringBuffer`.

6. **Set New IDL Name**: Finally, it sets the new IDL name for the operation using the `setIDLName` method of the `OperationAnalysis` object.

This method ensures that each overloaded method has a unique IDL name, which is crucial for proper communication in distributed systems using IDL.

/**

 *
 * @param reader The XML reader.
 * @param subsystem The model node for the subsystem.
 * @throws XMLStreamException If an error occurs while parsing the XML.
 */
private void parseXTSEnvironmentElement(XMLExtendedStreamReader reader, ModelNode subsystem) throws XMLStreamException {
    processAttributes(reader, (index, attribute) -> {
        final String value = reader.getAttributeValue(index);
        switch (attribute) {
            case URL:
                ENVIRONMENT_URL.parseAndSetParameter(value, subsystem, reader);
                break;
            default:
                throw ParseUtils.unexpectedAttribute(reader, index);
        }
    });
    // Ensure no content is present in the element
    ParseUtils.requireNoContent(reader);
}

/**
 * Parses the default context propagation element from the XML reader and sets the corresponding attribute in the subsystem model node.
 *
 * @param reader The XMLExtendedStreamReader to read the XML data.
 * @param subsystem The ModelNode representing the subsystem.
 * @throws XMLStreamException If an error occurs while parsing the XML.
 */
private void parseDefaultContextPropagationElement(XMLExtendedStreamReader reader, ModelNode subsystem) throws XMLStreamException {
    processAttributes(reader, (index, attribute) -> {
        final String value = reader.getAttributeValue(index);
        switch (attribute) {
            case ENABLED:
                if (value == null || (!value.toLowerCase().equals("true") && !value.toLowerCase().equals("false"))) {
                    throw ParseUtils.invalidAttributeValue(reader, index);
                }
                DEFAULT_CONTEXT_PROPAGATION.parseAndSetParameter(value, subsystem, reader);
                break;
            default:
                throw ParseUtils.unexpectedAttribute(reader, index);
        }
    });
    // Handle elements
    ParseUtils.requireNoContent(reader);
}

@Override
public void deploy(DeploymentPhaseContext phaseContext) throws DeploymentUnitProcessingException {

    moduleSpecification.addSystemDependency(new ModuleDependency(moduleLoader, JAX_RPC_API, false, false, true, false));
    moduleSpecification.addSystemDependency(new ModuleDependency(moduleLoader, EJB_CLIENT, false, false, true, false));
    moduleSpecification.addSystemDependency(new ModuleDependency(moduleLoader, EJB_NAMING_CLIENT, false, false, true, false));
    moduleSpecification.addSystemDependency(new ModuleDependency(moduleLoader, EJB_IIOP_CLIENT, false, false, false, false));
    moduleSpecification.addSystemDependency(new ModuleDependency(moduleLoader, EJB_SUBSYSTEM, false, false, true, false));
    moduleSpecification.addSystemDependency(new ModuleDependency(moduleLoader, HTTP_EJB, false, false, true, false));
    moduleSpecification.addSystemDependency(new ModuleDependency(moduleLoader, HTTP_NAMING, false, false, true, false));
    moduleSpecification.addSystemDependency(new ModuleDependency(moduleLoader, HTTP_TRANSACTION, false, false, true, false));

    // Add system dependency for IIOP if it's an IIOP deployment
    if (IIOPDeploymentMarker.isIIOPDeployment(deploymentUnit)) {
        moduleSpecification.addSystemDependency(new ModuleDependency(moduleLoader, IIOP_OPENJDK, false, false, false, false));
    }

    // Fetch EjbJarMetaData
    // TODO: remove the app client bit after the next EJB release

    // Add system dependency for EJB client if it's not an EJB deployment and not an application client
    if (!isEjbDeployment(deploymentUnit) && !DeploymentTypeMarker.isType(DeploymentType.APPLICATION_CLIENT, deploymentUnit)) {
        return;
    }

    // Add system dependency for embedded mode if specified
    if (Boolean.getBoolean("org.jboss.as.ejb3.EMBEDDED")) {
        moduleSpecification.addSystemDependency(new ModuleDependency(moduleLoader, ModuleIdentifier.CLASSPATH, false, false, false, false));
    }
}

/**
 * Writes an attribute to the XML stream if it is marshallable.
 *
 * @param writer     the XMLExtendedStreamWriter to write to
 * @param attribute  the SimpleAttributeDefinition to write
 * @param node       the ModelNode containing the attribute value
 * @param startWriten a boolean indicating if the start element has been written
 * @param origin     the origin of the attribute
 * @return true if the start element has been written, false otherwise
 * @throws XMLStreamException if an error occurs while writing to the stream
 */
private boolean writeAttribute(XMLExtendedStreamWriter writer, SimpleAttributeDefinition attribute, ModelNode node, boolean startWriten, String origin) throws XMLStreamException {
    if (attribute.isMarshallable(node, false)) {
        if (!startWriten) {
            startWriten = true;
            writer.writeStartElement(origin);
        }
        attribute.marshallAsAttribute(node, false, writer);
    }
    return startWriten;
}

/**
 * Unbinds a name from the naming context.
 *
 * @param path The name path to unbind.
 * @throws NamingException If an error occurs during the unbind operation.
 */
private void callUnbind(NameComponent[] path) throws NamingException {
    if (_nc == null) {
        throw IIOPLogger.ROOT_LOGGER.notANamingContext(path.toString());
    }
    try {
        _nc.unbind(path);
    } catch (NotFound e) {
        if (leafNotFound(e, path[path.length - 1])) {
            // Do nothing if the leaf is not found
        } else {
            throw org.wildfly.iiop.openjdk.naming.jndi.ExceptionMapper.mapException(e, this, path);
        }
    } catch (Exception e) {
        throw org.wildfly.iiop.openjdk.naming.jndi.ExceptionMapper.mapException(e, this, path);
    }
}
```

/**
 * Lists bindings for a given name in the naming context.
 * 
 * @param name The name for which to list bindings.
 * @return A NamingEnumeration containing the bindings.
 * @throws NamingException If an error occurs during the operation.
 */
public NamingEnumeration listBindings(Name name) throws NamingException {
    if (_nc == null) {
        throw IIOPLogger.ROOT_LOGGER.notANamingContext(name.toString());
    }
    if (name.size() > 0) {
        try {
            java.lang.Object obj = lookup(name);
            if (obj instanceof CNCtx) {
                return new org.wildfly.iiop.openjdk.naming.jndi.CNBindingEnumeration((CNCtx) obj, true, _env);
            } else {
                throw new NotContextException(name.toString());
            }
        } catch (NamingException ne) {
            throw ne;
        } catch (BAD_PARAM e) {
            NamingException ne = new NotContextException(name.toString());
            ne.setRootCause(e);
            throw ne;
        }
    }
    return new org.wildfly.iiop.openjdk.naming.jndi.CNBindingEnumeration(this, false, _env);
}

2776	```java
public void destroySubcontext(Name name) throws NamingException {
    if (_nc == null) throw IIOPLogger.ROOT_LOGGER.notANamingContext(name.toString());
    NamingContext the_nc = _nc;
    NameComponent[] path = CNNameParser.nameToCosName(name);
    if (name.size() > 0) {
        try {
            javax.naming.Context ctx = (javax.naming.Context) callResolve(path);
            CNCtx cnc = (CNCtx) ctx;
            the_nc = cnc._nc;
            cnc.close(); // Remove the reference to the context
        } catch (ClassCastException e) {
            throw new NotContextException(name.toString());
        } catch (CannotProceedException e) {
            javax.naming.Context cctx = getContinuationContext(e);
            cctx.destroySubcontext(e.getRemainingName());
            return;
        } catch (NameNotFoundException e) {
            if (e.getRootCause() instanceof NotFound && leafNotFound((NotFound) e.getRootCause(), path[path.length - 1])) {
                return; // Leaf missing OK
            }
            throw e;
        } catch (NamingException e) {
            throw e;
        }
    }
    callDestroy(the_nc);
    callUnbind(path);
}
```

        for (String opName:Operations.getAllWriteAttributeOperationNames ()){ builder.addOperationTransformationOverride (opName).inheritResourceAttributeDefinitions ().setCustomOperationTransformer (new LegacyPropertyWriteOperationTransformer ());}
    }

}

It checks if the version requires transformation for JGroupsModel versions 5.0.0 and 3.0.0. 2783	```java
@Override
protected Credential parseCredential(XMLStreamReader reader) throws XMLStreamException, ParserException, ValidateException {
    String userName = null;
    String password = null;
    String securityDomain = null;
    boolean elytronEnabled = false;
    String authenticationContext = null;

    while (reader.hasNext()) {
        switch (reader.nextTag()) {
            case END_ELEMENT:
                if (DataSource.Tag.forName(reader.getLocalName()) == DataSource.Tag.SECURITY || Recovery.Tag.forName(reader.getLocalName()) == Recovery.Tag.RECOVER_CREDENTIAL) {
                    return new CredentialImpl(userName, password, elytronEnabled ? authenticationContext : securityDomain, elytronEnabled, null);
                } else if (Credential.Tag.forName(reader.getLocalName()) == Credential.Tag.UNKNOWN) {
                    throw new ParserException(bundle.unexpectedEndTag(reader.getLocalName()));
                }
                break;
            case START_ELEMENT:
                switch (Credential.Tag.forName(reader.getLocalName())) {
                    case PASSWORD:
                        password = elementAsString(reader);
                        if (propertyResolver != null && password != null) {
                            String resolvedPassword = propertyResolver.resolve(password);
                            if (resolvedPassword != null) password = resolvedPassword;
                        }
                        break;
                    case USER_NAME:
                        userName = elementAsString(reader);
                        break;
                    case SECURITY_DOMAIN:
                        securityDomain = elementAsString(reader);
                        break;
                    case ELYTRON_ENABLED:
                        Boolean value = elementAsBoolean(reader);
                        elytronEnabled = value == null ? true : value;
                        break;
                    case AUTHENTICATION_CONTEXT:
                        authenticationContext = elementAsString(reader);
                        break;
                    default:
                        throw new ParserException(bundle.unexpectedElement(reader.getLocalName()));
                }
                break;
        }
    }

    throw new ParserException(bundle.unexpectedEndOfDocument());
}
```
