/**
 * Binds information for an environment entry based on the provided application, module, component, and environment entry name.
 * 
 * @param app The application name.
 * @param module The module name.
 * @param comp The component name.
 * @param useCompNamespace A boolean indicating whether to use the component namespace.
 * @param envEntryName The environment entry name.
 * @return The bind information.
 */
public static BindInfo bindInfoForEnvEntry(String app, String module, String comp, boolean useCompNamespace, final String envEntryName) {
    if (envEntryName.startsWith("java:")) {
        if (useCompNamespace) {
            return bindInfoFor(app, module, comp, envEntryName);
        } else {
            if (envEntryName.startsWith("java:comp")) {
                return bindInfoFor(app, module, module, "java:module" + envEntryName.substring("java:comp".length()));
            } else {
                return bindInfoFor(app, module, module, envEntryName);
            }
        }
    } else {
        if (useCompNamespace) {
            return bindInfoFor(app, module, comp, "java:comp/env/" + envEntryName);
        } else {
            return bindInfoFor(app, module, module, "java:module/env/" + envEntryName);
        }
    }
}

2824	```java
/**
 * Binds a JNDI name to a service name.
 *
 * @param jndiName The JNDI name to bind.
 * @return A BindInfo object containing the parent context name and the bind name.
 * @throws NamingException If the JNDI name is illegal.
 */
public static BindInfo bindInfoFor(final String jndiName) {
    String bindName;
    if (jndiName.startsWith("java:")) {
        bindName = jndiName.substring(5);
    } else if (!jndiName.startsWith("jboss") && !jndiName.startsWith("global") && !jndiName.startsWith("/")) {
        bindName = "/" + jndiName;
    } else {
        bindName = jndiName;
    }

    ServiceName parentContextName;
    if (bindName.startsWith("jboss/exported/")) {
        parentContextName = EXPORTED_CONTEXT_SERVICE_NAME;
        bindName = bindName.substring(15);
    } else if (bindName.startsWith("jboss/")) {
        parentContextName = JBOSS_CONTEXT_SERVICE_NAME;
        bindName = bindName.substring(6);
    } else if (bindName.startsWith("global/")) {
        parentContextName = GLOBAL_CONTEXT_SERVICE_NAME;
        bindName = bindName.substring(7);
    } else if (bindName.startsWith("/")) {
        parentContextName = JAVA_CONTEXT_SERVICE_NAME;
        bindName = bindName.substring(1);
    } else {
        throw NamingLogger.ROOT_LOGGER.illegalContextInName(jndiName);
    }

    return new BindInfo(parentContextName, bindName);
}
```

2829	```java
/**
 * Parses the configuration from an XMLExtendedStreamReader and constructs a ModelNode.
 *
 * @param reader The XMLExtendedStreamReader to read from.
 * @param xmlElement The expected XML element.
 * @param key The key to use for the model node.
 * @param lastNode The last node in the model.
 * @param attributes The list of SimpleAttributeDefinition to parse.
 * @param addOperations The list to add the model node to.
 * @return The constructed ModelNode or null if the local name does not match.
 * @throws XMLStreamException If an XML stream error occurs.
 */
protected ModelNode parseConfig(XMLExtendedStreamReader reader, ModelElement xmlElement, String key, ModelNode lastNode, List<SimpleAttributeDefinition> attributes, List<ModelNode> addOperations) throws XMLStreamException {
    if (!reader.getLocalName().equals(xmlElement.getName())) {
        return null;
    }
    ModelNode modelNode = Util.getEmptyOperation(ADD, null);
    int attributeCount = reader.getAttributeCount();
    for (int i = 0; i < attributeCount; i++) {
        String attributeLocalName = reader.getAttributeLocalName(i);
        if (ModelElement.forName(attributeLocalName) == null) {
            throw unexpectedAttribute(reader, i);
        }
    }
    for (SimpleAttributeDefinition simpleAttributeDefinition : attributes) {
        String attributeValue = reader.getAttributeValue("", simpleAttributeDefinition.getXmlName());
        simpleAttributeDefinition.parseAndSetParameter(attributeValue, modelNode, reader);
    }
    String name = xmlElement.getName();
    if (key != null) {
        name = key;
        if (modelNode.hasDefined(key)) {
            name = modelNode.get(key).asString();
        } else {
            String attributeValue = reader.getAttributeValue("", key);
            if (attributeValue != null) {
                name = attributeValue;
            }
        }
    }
    modelNode.get(ModelDescriptionConstants.OP_ADDR).set(lastNode.clone().get(OP_ADDR).add(xmlElement.getName(), name));
    addOperations.add(modelNode);
    return modelNode;
}
```

2848	```java
/**
 * Ensures that a package exists within a given container.
 * 
 * @param c The container to search within.
 * @param previous The previous package path.
 * @param remainder The remaining path to process.
 * @return The ModuleDefImpl representing the package.
 * @throws IRConstructionException If a collision is detected or an error occurs.
 */
private ModuleDefImpl ensurePackageExists(LocalContainer c, String previous, String remainder) throws IRConstructionException {
    if (remainder.isEmpty()) return (ModuleDefImpl) c; // Package already exists
    int idx = remainder.indexOf(' ');
    String base = (idx == -1) ? remainder : remainder.substring(0, idx);
    base = Util.javaToIDLName(base);
    if (previous.isEmpty()) previous = base; else previous = previous + "/" + base;
    remainder = (idx == -1) ? "" : remainder.substring(idx + 1);
    LocalContainer next = null;
    LocalContained contained = (LocalContained) c._lookup(base);
    if (contained instanceof LocalContainer) next = (LocalContainer) contained;
    else if (contained != null) throw IIOPLogger.ROOT_LOGGER.collisionWhileCreatingPackage();
    if (next == null) {
        String id = "IDL:" + previous + ":1.0";
        ModuleDefImpl m = new ModuleDefImpl(id, base, "1.0", c, impl);
        c.add(base, m);
        if (idx == -1) return m; // Package created
        next = (LocalContainer) c._lookup(base); // Ensure package is there
    } else if (next.def_kind() != DefinitionKind.dk_Module) {
        throw IIOPLogger.ROOT_LOGGER.collisionWhileCreatingPackage();
    }
    return ensurePackageExists(next, previous, remainder);
}
```

2851	```java
/**
 * Adds a class to the analysis based on its type.
 * 
 * @param cls The class to be added.
 * @throws RMIIIOPViolationException If the class violates RMIIIOP rules.
 * @throws IRConstructionException If there is an issue constructing the IR.
 */
private void addClass(Class cls) throws RMIIIOPViolationException, IRConstructionException {
    if (cls.isPrimitive()) return; // Skip primitive types.
    if (cls.isArray()) {
        addArray(cls); // Handle array types.
    } else if (cls.isInterface()) {
        if (!RmiIdlUtil.isAbstractValueType(cls)) {
            InterfaceAnalysis ia = InterfaceAnalysis.getInterfaceAnalysis(cls);
            addInterface(ia); // Handle non-abstract interface types.
        } else {
            ValueAnalysis va = ValueAnalysis.getValueAnalysis(cls);
            addValue(va); // Handle abstract value types.
        }
    } else if (Exception.class.isAssignableFrom(cls)) {
        ExceptionAnalysis ea = ExceptionAnalysis.getExceptionAnalysis(cls);
        addException(ea); // Handle exception types.
    } else {
        ValueAnalysis va = ValueAnalysis.getValueAnalysis(cls);
        addValue(va); // Handle value types.
    }
}
```

If it has, it returns the existing interface. If not, it ensures that the package for the interface exists and then adds any superinterfaces. It creates a new `InterfaceDefImpl` object, sets its properties, and adds it to the module. The method also adds constants, attributes, and operations to the interface. Finally, it returns the newly created or existing interface.

    ValueDefImpl vDef = addValue(ea);

    // 1.3.7.2: map to exception
    ModuleDefImpl m = ensurePackageExists(cls.getPackage().getName());
    String base = cls.getName();
    base = base.substring(base.lastIndexOf(' ') + 1);
    if (base.endsWith("Exception")) base = base.substring(0, base.length() - 9);
    base = Util.javaToIDLName(base + "Ex");

    StructMember[] members = new StructMember[1];
    members[0] = new StructMember("value", vDef.type(), null /*ignored*/);
    TypeCode typeCode = orb.create_exception_tc(ea.getExceptionRepositoryId(), base, members);

    eDef = new ExceptionDefImpl(ea.getExceptionRepositoryId(), base, "1.0", typeCode, vDef, m, impl);
    m.add(base, eDef);
    exceptionMap.put(cls, eDef); // Remember we mapped this.
    return eDef;
}

2871	```java
/**
 * Maps a CosNaming Binding to a javax.naming.Binding.
 *
 * @param bndg The CosNaming Binding to map.
 * @return A javax.naming.Binding representing the mapped binding.
 * @throws NamingException If an error occurs during the mapping process.
 */
private javax.naming.Binding mapBinding(org.omg.CosNaming.Binding bndg) throws NamingException {
    // Resolve the object associated with the binding name.
    java.lang.Object obj = _ctx.callResolve(bndg.binding_name);
    
    // Convert the CosNaming name to a javax.naming.Name.
    Name cname = org.wildfly.iiop.openjdk.naming.jndi.CNNameParser.cosNameToName(bndg.binding_name);
    
    try {
        // Get the object instance using the NamingManager.
        obj = NamingManager.getObjectInstance(obj, cname, _ctx, _env);
    } catch (NamingException e) {
        throw e;
    } catch (Exception e) {
        // Log an error if an exception occurs during object generation.
        NamingException ne = IIOPLogger.ROOT_LOGGER.errorGeneratingObjectViaFactory();
        ne.setRootCause(e);
        throw ne;
    }
    
    // Create a new javax.naming.Binding using the converted name.
    String cnameStr = cname.toString();
    javax.naming.Binding jbndg = new javax.naming.Binding(cnameStr, obj);
    
    // Get the full name of the binding.
    NameComponent[] comps = _ctx.makeFullName(bndg.binding_name);
    String fullName = org.wildfly.iiop.openjdk.naming.jndi.CNNameParser.cosNameToInsString(comps);
    
    // Set the full name in the javax.naming.Binding.
    jbndg.setNameInNamespace(fullName);
    
    return jbndg;
}
```

2879	```java
/**
 * Adds a component to the system.
 * 
 * @param description The description of the component to be added.
 * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the component name or class name is null.
 * @throws IllegalStateException if a component with the same name already exists.
 */
public void addComponent(ComponentDescription description) {
    final String componentName = description.getComponentName();
    final String componentClassName = description.getComponentClassName();
    
    // Validate component name and class name
    if (componentName == null) {
        throw EeLogger.ROOT_LOGGER.nullVar("componentName", "module", moduleName);
    }
    if (componentClassName == null) {
        throw EeLogger.ROOT_LOGGER.nullVar("componentClassName", "module", moduleName);
    }
    
    // Check if component name already exists
    if (componentsByName.containsKey(componentName)) {
        throw EeLogger.ROOT_LOGGER.componentAlreadyDefined(componentName);
    }
    
    // Add component to the map by name
    componentsByName.put(componentName, description);
    
    // Add component to the list by class name
    List<ComponentDescription> list = componentsByClassName.get(componentClassName);
    if (list == null) {
        componentsByClassName.put(componentClassName, list = new ArrayList<>(1));
    }
    list.add(description);
}

2885	```java
public synchronized void addFactory(ContextHandleFactory factory) {
    // Get the name of the factory
    final String factoryName = factory.getName();
    
    // Check if the factory already exists in the map
    if (factoryMap.containsKey(factoryName)) {
        // Throw an exception if the factory already exists
        throw EeLogger.ROOT_LOGGER.factoryAlreadyExists(this, factoryName);
    }
    
    // Add the factory to the map
    factoryMap.put(factoryName, factory);
    
    // Create a comparator to sort factories by chain priority
    final Comparator<ContextHandleFactory> comparator = new Comparator<ContextHandleFactory>() {
        @Override
        public int compare(ContextHandleFactory o1, ContextHandleFactory o2) {
            return Integer.compare(o1.getChainPriority(), o2.getChainPriority());
        }
    };
    
    // Create a sorted set to store factories in order of chain priority
    SortedSet<ContextHandleFactory> sortedSet = new TreeSet<>(comparator);
    sortedSet.addAll(factoryMap.values());
    
    // Create a list to store the sorted factories
    factoryOrderedList = new ArrayList<>(sortedSet);
}
```

protected void doDeploy(ServiceTarget target, DeploymentUnit unit) {
    List<DeploymentAspect> aspects = getDeploymentAspects();
    ClassLoader origClassLoader = WildFlySecurityManager.getCurrentContextClassLoaderPrivileged();
    Deployment dep = null;
    try {
        WildFlySecurityManager.setCurrentContextClassLoaderPrivileged(ClassLoaderProvider.getDefaultProvider().getServerIntegrationClassLoader());
        dep = unit.getAttachment(WSAttachmentKeys.DEPLOYMENT_KEY);
        dep.addAttachment(ServiceTarget.class, target);
        DeploymentAspectManager dam = new DeploymentAspectManagerImpl();
        dam.setDeploymentAspects(aspects);
        dam.deploy(dep);
    } finally {
        if (dep != null) {
            dep.removeAttachment(ServiceTarget.class);
        }
        WildFlySecurityManager.setCurrentContextClassLoaderPrivileged(origClassLoader);
    }
}

public synchronized void start(final StartContext context) {
    if (started) {
        throw WeldLogger.ROOT_LOGGER.alreadyRunning("WeldContainer");
    }
    started = true;
    WeldLogger.DEPLOYMENT_LOGGER.startingWeldService(deploymentName);
    addWeldService(SecurityServices.class, securityServicesSupplier.get());
    TransactionServices transactionServices = weldTransactionServicesSupplier != null ? weldTransactionServicesSupplier.get() : null;
    if (transactionServices != null) {
        addWeldService(TransactionServices.class, transactionServices);
    }
    if (!deployment.getServices().contains(ExecutorServices.class)) {
        addWeldService(ExecutorServices.class, executorServicesSupplier.get());
    }
    ModuleGroupSingletonProvider.addClassLoaders(deployment.getModule().getClassLoader(), deployment.getSubDeploymentClassLoaders());
    ClassLoader oldTccl = WildFlySecurityManager.getCurrentContextClassLoaderPrivileged();
    try {
        WildFlySecurityManager.setCurrentContextClassLoaderPrivileged(deployment.getModule().getClassLoader());
        bootstrap.startContainer(deploymentName, environment, deployment);
        WeldProvider.containerInitialized(Container.instance(deploymentName), getBeanManager(), deployment);
    } finally {
        WildFlySecurityManager.setCurrentContextClassLoaderPrivileged(oldTccl);
    }
    weldBootstrapServiceConsumer.accept(this);
}
```

The `start` method is a synchronized method that initializes a Weld container. It first checks if the container is already started and throws an exception if it is. private void addMessagingActiveMQExtension(OperationContext context, Map<PathAddress, ModelNode> migrationOperations, boolean describe) {
    Resource root = context.readResourceFromRoot(PathAddress.EMPTY_ADDRESS, false);
    if (root.getChildrenNames(EXTENSION).contains(MESSAGING_ACTIVEMQ_EXTENSION)) {
        // Extension is already added, do nothing
        return;
    }
    PathAddress extensionAddress = pathAddress(EXTENSION, MESSAGING_ACTIVEMQ_EXTENSION);
    OperationEntry addEntry = context.getRootResourceRegistration().getOperationEntry(extensionAddress, ADD);
    ModelNode addOperation = createAddOperation(extensionAddress);
    addOperation.get(MODULE).set(MESSAGING_ACTIVEMQ_MODULE);
    if (describe) {
        migrationOperations.put(extensionAddress, addOperation);
    } else {
        context.addStep(context.getResult().get(extensionAddress.toString()), addOperation, addEntry.getOperationHandler(), MODEL);
    }
}

/**
 * Sets the type of a property internally.

protected void setTypeInternal(final OType iType) {
    getDatabase().checkSecurity(ORule.ResourceGeneric.SCHEMA, ORole.PERMISSION_UPDATE);
    acquireSchemaWriteLock();
    try {
        if (iType == globalRef.getType()) return; // No changes needed
        if (!iType.getCastable().contains(globalRef.getType())) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cannot change property type from " + globalRef.getType() + " to " + iType);
        }
        this.globalRef = owner.owner.findOrCreateGlobalProperty(this.globalRef.getName(), iType);
    } finally {
        releaseSchemaWriteLock();
    }
}

The `estimate` method calculates an estimated count of records in a given class (`OClass`) based on certain conditions and a threshold. Here's a summary of the method:

1. **Initial Count Calculation**:
   - The method starts by counting the total number of records in the class using `oClass.count()`.
   - If the count is greater than 1, it halves the count.

2. **Threshold Check**:
   - If the halved count is less than the provided threshold, the method returns the halved count.

3. **Index Estimation**:
   - The method initializes `indexesCount` to 0.
   - It flattens the conditions using `flatten()` and retrieves all indexes from the class using `oClass.getIndexes()`.
   - For each condition in the flattened list:
     - It checks for indexed function conditions and estimates the count using `cond.estimateIndexed()`.
     - If no indexed function conditions are found, it iterates through the indexes to find those that match the condition fields.
     - For each matching index, it estimates the count using `estimateFromIndex()` and updates `conditionEstimation` if the new count is lower.
   - If `conditionEstimation` is greater than the initial count, it returns the initial count.

4. **Final Count Calculation**:
   - The method returns the minimum of `indexesCount` and the initial count.

This method aims to provide an efficient estimate of the number of records that meet the specified conditions, considering both indexed and non-indexed fields.

2912	The `findClasses` method is a recursive function that searches for all classes within a given directory and its subdirectories. It takes three parameters: a `File` object representing the directory to search, a `String` representing the package name, and a `ClassLoader` object to load the classes. The method returns a `List` of `Class` objects representing all the classes found.

Here's a step-by-step breakdown of the method:

1. **Initialization**: The method initializes an empty list `classes` to store the found classes.

2. **Directory Check**: It checks if the provided directory exists. If not, it returns the empty list.

3. **Package Name Update**: It appends the directory name to the package name, ensuring the package name is correctly formatted.

4. **File Listing**: It lists all files and subdirectories in the provided directory.

5. **File Processing**: For each file in the directory:
   - If the file is a directory and its name contains a period (indicating it's not a valid directory name), it skips the file.
   - If the file is a directory, it recursively calls `findClasses` to search within the subdirectory.
   - If the file is a class file (ends with `.class`), it extracts the class name, constructs the full class name using the package name, and loads the class using the provided `ClassLoader`. The class is then added to the `classes` list.

6. **Return**: Finally, the method returns the list of found classes.

This method is useful for dynamically discovering and loading classes within a specified directory structure.

/**

protected OType deriveFieldType(ODocument iRecord, String fieldName, OType requestedFieldType) {

        return iRecord.getSchemaClass().getProperty(fieldName).getType();
    }

/**
 * Adds additional order by projections to the query planning information.
 * 
 * @param info The query planning information.
 */
private static void addOrderByProjections(QueryPlanningInfo info) {
    // Check if order by is already applied or if there are no projections to add
    if (info.orderApplied || info.expand || info.unwind != null || info.orderBy == null || info.orderBy.getItems().size() == 0 || info.projection == null || info.projection.getItems() == null || (info.projection.getItems().size() == 1 && info.projection.getItems().get(0).isAll())) {
        return;
    }

    // Create a copy of the existing order by
    OOrderBy newOrderBy = info.orderBy == null ? null : info.orderBy.copy();

    // Calculate additional order by projections
    List<OProjectionItem> additionalOrderByProjections = calculateAdditionalOrderByProjections(info.projection.getAllAliases(), newOrderBy);

    // If there are additional projections, update the order by and projection
    if (additionalOrderByProjections.size() > 0) {
        info.orderBy = newOrderBy; // the ORDER BY has changed
        info.projectionAfterOrderBy = new OProjection(-1);
        info.projectionAfterOrderBy.setItems(new ArrayList<>());

        // Add aliases to the projection after order by
        for (String alias : info.projection.getAllAliases()) {
            info.projectionAfterOrderBy.getItems().add(projectionFromAlias(new OIdentifier(alias)));
        }

        // Add additional order by projections to the projection
        for (OProjectionItem item : additionalOrderByProjections) {
            if (info.preAggregateProjection != null) {
                info.preAggregateProjection.getItems().add(item);
                info.aggregateProjection.getItems().add(projectionFromAlias(item.getAlias()));
                info.projection.getItems().add(projectionFromAlias(item.getAlias()));
            } else {
                info.projection.getItems().add(item);
            }
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Determines the order direction from the given query planning information.
 *
 * @param info The query planning information containing order by details.
 * @return The order direction if consistent, otherwise null.
 */
private Boolean getOrderDirection(QueryPlanningInfo info) {
    if (info.orderBy == null) {
        return null;
    }
    String result = null;
    for (OOrderByItem item : info.orderBy.getItems()) {
        if (result == null) {
            result = item.getType() == null ? OOrderByItem.ASC : item.getType();
        } else {
            String newType = item.getType() == null ? OOrderByItem.ASC : item.getType();
            if (!newType.equals(result)) {
                return null;
            }
        }
    }
    return result == null || result.equals(OOrderByItem.ASC);
}

2928	```java
/**
 * Finds the best index for a given query block and class.
 * 
 * @param ctx The command context.
 * @param indexes The set of available indexes.
 * @param block The query block.
 * @param clazz The class of the objects being queried.
 * @return The best index descriptor or null if no suitable index is found.
 */
private IndexSearchDescriptor findBestIndexFor(OCommandContext ctx, Set<OIndex<?>> indexes, OAndBlock block, OClass clazz) {
    // Filter and build descriptors for regular indexes
    List<IndexSearchDescriptor> descriptors = indexes.stream()
        .filter(x -> x.getInternal().canBeUsedInEqualityOperators())
        .map(index -> buildIndexSearchDescriptor(ctx, index, block, clazz))
        .filter(Objects::nonNull)
        .filter(x -> x.keyCondition != null)
        .filter(x -> x.keyCondition.getSubBlocks().size() > 0)
        .collect(Collectors.toList());

    // Filter and build descriptors for full-text indexes
    List<IndexSearchDescriptor> fullTextIndexDescriptors = indexes.stream()
        .filter(idx -> idx.getType().equalsIgnoreCase("FULLTEXT"))
        .filter(idx -> !idx.getAlgorithm().equalsIgnoreCase("LUCENE"))
        .map(idx -> buildIndexSearchDescriptorForFulltext(ctx, idx, block, clazz))
        .filter(Objects::nonNull)
        .filter(x -> x.keyCondition != null)
        .filter(x -> x.keyCondition.getSubBlocks().size() > 0)
        .collect(Collectors.toList());

    // Combine and remove redundant descriptors
    descriptors.addAll(fullTextIndexDescriptors);
    descriptors = removePrefixIndexes(descriptors);

    // Sort by cost and select the lowest cost
    List<OPair<Integer, IndexSearchDescriptor>> sortedDescriptors = descriptors.stream()
        .map(x -> new OPair<>(x.cost(ctx), x))
        .sorted()
        .collect(Collectors.toList());
    descriptors = sortedDescriptors.isEmpty() ? Collections.emptyList() : sortedDescriptors.stream()
        .filter(x -> x.key.equals(sortedDescriptors.get(0).key))
        .map(x -> x.value)
        .collect(Collectors.toList());

    // Sort by the number of indexed fields and return the best one
    descriptors = descriptors.stream()
        .sorted(Comparator.comparingInt(x -> x.keyCondition.getSubBlocks().size()))
        .collect(Collectors.toList());
    return descriptors.isEmpty() ? null : descriptors.get(descriptors.size() - 1);
}
```
2929	```java
/**
 * Builds an index search descriptor for full-text search.
 *
 * @param ctx       the command context.
 * @param index     the index to search.
 * @param block     the block of conditions.
 * @param clazz     the class of the index.
 * @return the index search descriptor if found, otherwise null.
 */
private IndexSearchDescriptor buildIndexSearchDescriptorForFulltext(OCommandContext ctx, OIndex<?> index, OAndBlock block, OClass clazz) {
    List<String> indexFields = index.getDefinition().getFields();
    OBinaryCondition keyCondition = new OBinaryCondition(-1);
    OIdentifier key = new OIdentifier("key");
    keyCondition.setLeft(new OExpression(key));
    boolean found = false;
    OAndBlock blockCopy = block.copy();
    Iterator<OBooleanExpression> blockIterator;
    OAndBlock indexKeyValue = new OAndBlock(-1);
    IndexSearchDescriptor result = new IndexSearchDescriptor();
    result.idx = index;
    result.keyCondition = indexKeyValue;

    for (String indexField : indexFields) {
        blockIterator = blockCopy.getSubBlocks().iterator();
        boolean breakHere = false;
        boolean indexFieldFound = false;
        while (blockIterator.hasNext()) {
            OBooleanExpression singleExp = blockIterator.next();
            if (singleExp instanceof OContainsTextCondition) {
                OExpression left = ((OContainsTextCondition) singleExp).getLeft();
                if (left.isBaseIdentifier()) {
                    String fieldName = left.getDefaultAlias().getStringValue();
                    if (indexField.equals(fieldName)) {
                        found = true;
                        indexFieldFound = true;
                        OContainsTextCondition condition = new OContainsTextCondition(-1);
                        condition.setLeft(left);
                        condition.setRight(((OContainsTextCondition) singleExp).getRight().copy());
                        indexKeyValue.getSubBlocks().add(condition);
                        blockIterator.remove();
                        breakHere = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if (breakHere || !indexFieldFound) {
            break;
        }
    }

    if (result.keyCondition.getSubBlocks().size() < index.getDefinition().getFields().size() && !index.supportsOrderedIterations()) {
        return null;
    }

    if (found) {
        result.remainingCondition = blockCopy;
        return result;
    }

    return null;
}
```

@Override
public void memberRemoved(final MembershipEvent iEvent) {
    try {
        updateLastClusterChange();
        if (iEvent.getMember() == null) return;
        final String nodeLeftName = getNodeName(iEvent.getMember());
        if (nodeLeftName == null) return;
        removeServer(nodeLeftName, true);

        OLogManager.instance().error(this, "Hazelcast is not running", e);
    } catch (Exception e) {
        OLogManager.instance().error(this, "Error on removing the server '%s'", e, getNodeName(iEvent.getMember()));
    }
}

2. Checks if the `iEvent.getMember()` is null and returns if true.
3. Retrieves the node name of the member that left using `getNodeName(iEvent.getMember())` and returns if the node name is null.

2938	```plaintext
### Summary of the Code

The method `electNewLockManager` is designed to elect a new lock manager in a distributed system. Here's a step-by-step breakdown of what the method does:

1. **Check Hazelcast Instance**: The method first checks if the `hazelcastInstance` is null. If it is, it throws a `HazelcastInstanceNotActiveException`.

2. **Acquire Lock**: It acquires a lock on the "orientdb.lockManagerElection" resource to ensure that only one instance can proceed with the election at a time.

3. **Get Current Lock Manager**: The method retrieves the current lock manager server using `getLockManagerRequester().getServer()`.

4. **Check for Double Election**: It checks if the current lock manager server is still active and available. If it is, the method returns the current server.

5. **Elect New Lock Manager**:
   - If the current server is not available, the method logs a debug message indicating that the current lock manager is unreachable and starts the election process.
   - It iterates through a list of registered servers, starting from the server that failed.
   - For each server, it checks if the server is not null, not the local node, and is active.
   - If a suitable server is found, it attempts to set it as the new lock manager using `getLockManagerRequester().setServer(newServer)`.
   - If the server is successfully set, the method logs the new lock manager and breaks out of the loop.
   - If an exception occurs during the election process, it logs an error message and continues to the next server.

6. **Release Lock**: Finally, the method releases the lock.

### Key Points
- **Lock Management**: Ensures that only one instance can perform the election at a time.
- **Election Logic**: Iterates through a list of servers to find a suitable new lock manager.
- **Error Handling**: Continues to the next server if an exception occurs during the election process.

```

2942	```java
public void updateIdentityAfterRecordCommit(final ORID oldRid, final ORID newRid) {
    if (oldRid.equals(newRid)) return; // No change, ignore

    List<KeyChangesUpdateRecord> keyRecordsToReinsert = new ArrayList<>();
    OIndexManager indexManager = getDatabase().getMetadata().getIndexManager();

    for (Map.Entry<String, OTransactionIndexChanges> entry : indexOperations.entrySet()) {
        OIndex<?> index = indexManager.getIndex(entry.getKey());
        if (index == null) throw new OTransactionException("Cannot find index '" + entry.getValue() + "' while committing transaction");

        Dependency[] fieldRidDependencies = getIndexFieldRidDependencies(index);
        if (!isIndexMayDependOnRids(fieldRidDependencies)) continue;

        OTransactionIndexChanges indexChanges = entry.getValue();
        for (Iterator<OTransactionIndexChangesPerKey> iterator = indexChanges.changesPerKey.values().iterator(); iterator.hasNext(); ) {
            OTransactionIndexChangesPerKey keyChanges = iterator.next();
            if (isIndexKeyMayDependOnRid(keyChanges.key, oldRid, fieldRidDependencies)) {

/**
 * Attempts to atomically move a file from the source path to the target path.
 * If atomic move is not supported, it falls back to a regular move.
 *
 * @param source   the source path of the file to be moved
 * @param target   the target path where the file should be moved
 * @param requester the object requesting the move operation
 * @throws IOException if an I/O error occurs
 */
public static void atomicMoveWithFallback(Path source, Path target, Object requester) throws IOException {
    try {
        Files.move(source, target, StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE);
    } catch (AtomicMoveNotSupportedException ignore) {
        OLogManager.instance().warn(requester, "atomic file move is not possible, falling back to regular move (moving '%s' to '%s')", source, target);
        Files.move(source, target);
    }
}

@Override
public boolean remove(Object key, final OIdentifiable value) {
    if (key == null) {
        return false;
    }
    key = getCollatingValue(key);
    final Set<String> words = splitIntoWords(key.toString());
    final OModifiableBoolean removed = new OModifiableBoolean(false);
    for (final String word : words) {
        acquireSharedLock();
        try {
            if (apiVersion == 0) {
                removeV0(value, removed, word);
            } else if (apiVersion == 1) {
                removeV1(value, removed, word);
            } else {
                throw new IllegalStateException("Invalid API version, " + apiVersion);
            }
        } finally {
            releaseSharedLock();
        }
    }
    return removed.getValue();
}
```

**Summary:**
The `remove` method attempts to remove an entry from a data structure using a given key and value. It first checks if the key is null and returns false if it is. The key is then processed to extract words, and for each word, it acquires a shared lock, checks the API version, and calls the appropriate removal method (`removeV0` or `removeV1`). If the API version is invalid, it throws an `IllegalStateException`. After processing all words, it releases the lock and returns whether the removal was successful.

public List<T> run(final Object... iArgs) {
    final ODatabaseDocumentInternal database = ODatabaseRecordThreadLocal.instance().get();
    if (database == null) {
        throw new OQueryParsingException("No database configured");
    }

            LockedRecordMetadata lockedRecordMetadata = lock.getValue();

2972	```java
public synchronized void synchronizeSchema() {
    OObjectDatabaseTx database = getDatabase();
    Collection<Class<?>> registeredEntities = database.getEntityManager().getRegisteredEntities();
    boolean automaticSchemaGeneration = database.isAutomaticSchemaGeneration();
    boolean reloadSchema = false;

    for (Class<?> iClass : registeredEntities) {
        if (isExcludedClass(iClass)) return;

        if (!database.getMetadata().getSchema().existsClass(iClass.getSimpleName())) {
            database.getMetadata().getSchema().createClass(iClass.getSimpleName());
            reloadSchema = true;
        }

        for (Class<?> currentClass = iClass; currentClass != Object.class; ) {
            if (automaticSchemaGeneration && !currentClass.equals(Object.class) && !currentClass.equals(ODocument.class)) {
                ((OSchemaProxyObject) database.getMetadata().getSchema()).generateSchema(currentClass, database.getUnderlying());
            }

            String iClassName = currentClass.getSimpleName();
            currentClass = currentClass.getSuperclass();

            if (currentClass == null || currentClass.equals(ODocument.class)) {
                currentClass = Object.class;
            }

            if (database != null && !database.isClosed() && !currentClass.equals(Object.class)) {
                OClass oSuperClass;
                OClass currentOClass = database.getMetadata().getSchema().getClass(iClassName);

                if (!database.getMetadata().getSchema().existsClass(currentClass.getSimpleName())) {
                    oSuperClass = database.getMetadata().getSchema().createClass(currentClass.getSimpleName());
                    reloadSchema = true;
                } else {
                    oSuperClass = database.getMetadata().getSchema().getClass(currentClass.getSimpleName());
                    reloadSchema = true;
                }

                if (!currentOClass.getSuperClasses().contains(oSuperClass)) {
                    currentOClass.setSuperClasses(Arrays.asList(oSuperClass));
                    reloadSchema = true;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if (database != null && !database.isClosed() && reloadSchema) {
        database.getMetadata().getSchema().reload();
    }
}

private OObjectDatabaseTx getDatabase() {
    return (OObjectDatabaseTx) ODatabaseRecordThreadLocal.instance().get().getDatabaseOwner();
}

private boolean isExcludedClass(Class<?> iClass) {
    return Proxy.class.isAssignableFrom(iClass) || iClass.isEnum() || OReflectionHelper.isJavaType(iClass) || iClass.isAnonymousClass();
}

2979	```java
/**
 * Determines the open files limit for the disk cache based on the platform and provided limits.
 *
 * @param verbose     If true, logs detailed information.
 * @param recommended The recommended open files limit.
 * @param defLimit    The default open files limit.
 * @return The open files limit for the disk cache.
 */
public int getOpenFilesLimit(boolean verbose, int recommended, int defLimit) {
    if (Platform.isLinux()) {
        OCLibrary.Rlimit rlimit = new OCLibrary.Rlimit();
        int result = C_LIBRARY.getrlimit(OCLibrary.RLIMIT_NOFILE, rlimit);
        if (result == 0 && rlimit.rlim_cur > 0) {
            if (verbose) {
                OLogManager.instance().infoNoDb(this, "Detected limit of amount of simultaneously open files is %d, " +
                        " limit of open files for disk cache will be set to %d", rlimit.rlim_cur, rlimit.rlim_cur / 2 - 512);
            }
            if (rlimit.rlim_cur < recommended) {
                OLogManager.instance().warnNoDb(this, "Value of limit of simultaneously open files is too small, recommended value is %d", recommended);
            }
            return (int) rlimit.rlim_cur / 2 - 512;
        } else {
            if (verbose) {
                OLogManager.instance().infoNoDb(this, "Can not detect value of limit of open files.");
            }
        }
    } else if (Platform.isWindows()) {
        if (verbose) {

@Override
public <RET extends OCommandExecutor> RET parse(OCommandRequest iRequest) {
    OCommandRequestText textRequest = (OCommandRequestText) iRequest;
    OSQLSynchQuery<ODocument> request;

    if (iRequest instanceof OSQLSynchQuery) {
        request = (OSQLSynchQuery<ODocument>) iRequest;
    } else if (iRequest instanceof OSQLAsynchQuery) {
        request = (OSQLAsynchQuery<ODocument>) iRequest;
    } else {
        request = new OSQLSynchQuery<>(textRequest.getText());
        if (textRequest.getResultListener() != null) {
            request.setResultListener(textRequest.getResultListener());
        }
    }

    String queryText = textRequest.getText();
    InputStream is = new ByteArrayInputStream(queryText.getBytes());
    OrientSql osql = null;

    try {
        ODatabaseDocumentInternal db = getDatabase();
        if (db == null) {
            osql = new OrientSql(is);
        } else {
            osql = new OrientSql(is, db.getStorage().getConfiguration().getCharset());
        }
    } catch (UnsupportedEncodingException e) {
        OLogManager.instance().warn(this, "Invalid charset for database " + getDatabase() + " " + getDatabase().getStorage().getConfiguration().getCharset());
        osql = new OrientSql(is);
    }

    try {
        OMatchStatement result = (OMatchStatement) osql.parse();
        this.matchExpressions = result.matchExpressions;
        this.notMatchExpressions = result.notMatchExpressions;
        this.returnItems = result.returnItems;
        this.returnAliases = result.returnAliases;
        this.limit = result.limit;
    } catch (ParseException e) {
        OCommandSQLParsingException ex = new OCommandSQLParsingException(e, queryText);
        OErrorCode.QUERY_PARSE_ERROR.throwException(ex.getMessage(), ex);
    }

    buildPatterns();
    pattern.validate();
    return (RET) this;
}

2994	```java
/**
 * Retrieves the collate information for a given document based on a field chain.
 * 
 * @param doc The document to retrieve the collate information for.
 * @return The collate information if found, otherwise null.
 */
public OCollate getCollate(Object doc) {
    if (collate != null || operationsChain == null || !isFieldChain()) {
        return collate;
    }
    if (!(doc instanceof OIdentifiable)) {
        return null;
    }
    FieldChain chain = getFieldChain();
    ODocument lastDoc = ((OIdentifiable) doc).getRecord();
    for (int i = 0; i < chain.getItemCount() - 1; i++) {
        if (lastDoc == null) {
            return null;
        }
        Object nextDoc = lastDoc.field(chain.getItemName(i));
        if (nextDoc == null || !(nextDoc instanceof OIdentifiable)) {
            return null;
        }
        lastDoc = ((OIdentifiable) nextDoc).getRecord();
    }
    if (lastDoc == null) {
        return null;
    }
    OClass schemaClass = lastDoc.getSchemaClass();
    if (schemaClass == null) {
        return null;
    }
    OProperty property = schemaClass.getProperty(chain.getItemName(chain.getItemCount() - 1));
    if (property == null) {
        return null;
    }
    return property.getCollate();
}
```

3009	```java
protected boolean parseTimeout(final String w) throws OCommandSQLParsingException {
    if (!w.equals(KEYWORD_TIMEOUT)) return false;
    String word = parserNextWord(true);
    try {
        timeoutMs = Long.parseLong(word);
    } catch (NumberFormatException ignore) {
        throwParsingException("Invalid " + KEYWORD_TIMEOUT + " value set to '" + word + "' but it should be a valid long. Example: " + KEYWORD_TIMEOUT + " 3000");
    }
    if (timeoutMs < 0) {
        throwParsingException("Invalid " + KEYWORD_TIMEOUT + ": value set minor than ZERO. Example: " + KEYWORD_TIMEOUT + " 10000");
    }
    word = parserNextWord(true);
    if (word != null) {
        if (word.equals(TIMEOUT_STRATEGY.EXCEPTION.toString())) {
            timeoutStrategy = TIMEOUT_STRATEGY.EXCEPTION;
        } else if (word.equals(TIMEOUT_STRATEGY.RETURN.toString())) {
            timeoutStrategy = TIMEOUT_STRATEGY.RETURN;
        } else {
            parserGoBack();
        }
    }
    return true;
}
```

**Summary:**
The `parseTimeout` method checks if the input string `w` matches the keyword `KEYWORD_TIMEOUT`. If it does, it attempts to parse the next word as a long integer and sets it to `timeoutMs`. If the parsing fails or the value is negative, it throws a `OCommandSQLParsingException` with an appropriate error message. It also checks for an optional timeout strategy, setting `timeoutStrategy` to either `EXCEPTION` or `RETURN` based on the next word, or leaving it unchanged if the word does not match either. The method returns `true` if successful.

3011	```java
/**
 * Creates a cluster in the database.
 * 
 * @param className The name of the class to which the cluster will be added.
 * @param clusterName The name of the cluster to be created.
 */
public void createCluster(final String className, final String clusterName) {
    final ODatabaseDocumentInternal currentDB = ODatabaseRecordThreadLocal.instance().getIfDefined();
    try {
        final ODatabaseDocumentInternal sysdb = openSystemDatabase();
        try {
            if (!sysdb.existsCluster(clusterName)) {
                OSchema schema = sysdb.getMetadata().getSchema();
                OClass cls = schema.getClass(className);
                if (cls != null) {
                    cls.addCluster(clusterName);
                } else {
                    OLogManager.instance().error(this, "createCluster() Class name %s does not exist", null, className);
                }
            }
        } finally {
            sysdb.close();
        }
    } finally {
        if (currentDB != null) {
            ODatabaseRecordThreadLocal.instance().set(currentDB);
        } else {
            ODatabaseRecordThreadLocal.instance().remove();
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Merges another ORidBag into this one.
 * 
 * @param otherValue The ORidBag to merge.
 * @param iMergeSingleItemsOfMultiValueFields Whether to merge single items of multi-value fields.
 * @return true if the merge was successful, false otherwise.
 */
public boolean tryMerge(final ORidBag otherValue, boolean iMergeSingleItemsOfMultiValueFields) {
    if (!isEmbedded() && !otherValue.isEmbedded()) {
        OSBTreeRidBag thisTree = (OSBTreeRidBag) delegate;
        OSBTreeRidBag otherTree = (OSBTreeRidBag) otherValue.delegate;
        if (thisTree.getCollectionPointer().equals(otherTree.getCollectionPointer())) {
            thisTree.mergeChanges(otherTree);
            uuid = otherValue.uuid;
            return true;
        }
    } else if (iMergeSingleItemsOfMultiValueFields) {
        Iterator<OIdentifiable> iter = otherValue.rawIterator();
        while (iter.hasNext()) {
            OIdentifiable value = iter.next();
            if (value != null) {
                Iterator<OIdentifiable> localIter = rawIterator();
                boolean found = false;
                while (localIter.hasNext()) {
                    OIdentifiable v = localIter.next();
                    if (value.equals(v)) {
                        found = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (!found) add(value);
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

public static Object transformResult(Object result) {
    if (java8MethodIsArray == null || !(result instanceof Map)) {
        return result;
    }
    try {
        if ((Boolean) java8MethodIsArray.invoke(result)) {
            List<?> partial = new ArrayList<>(((Map) result).values());
            List<Object> finalResult = new ArrayList<>();
            for (Object o : partial) {
                finalResult.add(transformResult(o));
            }
            return finalResult;
        } else {
            Map<Object, Object> mapResult = (Map) result;
            List<Object> keys = new ArrayList<>(mapResult.keySet());
            for (Object key : keys) {
                mapResult.put(key, transformResult(mapResult.get(key)));
            }
            return mapResult;
        }
    } catch (Exception e) {
        OLogManager.instance().error(OCommandExecutorUtility.class, "", e);
    }
    return result;
}
```

**Summary:**

@Override
public void close() {
    if (isClosed()) return;
    checkOpenness();
    if (ownerPool != null && ownerPool.getConnectionsInCurrentThread(getURL(), userName) > 1) {
        ownerPool.release(this);
        return;
    }
    try {
        commit(true);
    } catch (Exception e) {
        OLogManager.instance().error(this, "Error on releasing database '%s' in pool", e, getName());
    }
    try {
        callOnCloseListeners();
    } catch (Exception e) {
        OLogManager.instance().error(this, "Error on releasing database '%s' in pool", e, getName());
    }
    getLocalCache().clear();
    if (ownerPool != null) {
        final ODatabaseDocumentPool localCopy = ownerPool;
        ownerPool = null;
        localCopy.release(this);
    }
    ODatabaseRecordThreadLocal.instance().remove();
}

/**
 * Stops the write cache flush timer and updates the cache counters.
 *
 * @param pagesFlushed The number of pages flushed.
 */
public void stopWriteCacheFlushTimer(int pagesFlushed) {
    // Lazy initialization to prevent memory consumption
    if (writCacheCountersHolder == null) {
        writCacheCountersHolder = new WritCacheCountersHolder();
    }

    // Get the current timestamp in nanoseconds
    final long endTs = nanoTimer.getNano();

    // Calculate the time difference since the last timestamp
    final long timeDiff = (endTs - timeStamps.pop());

    // Update the cache counters
    writCacheCountersHolder.flushOperationsCount++;
    writCacheCountersHolder.amountOfPagesFlushed += pagesFlushed;
    writCacheCountersHolder.flushOperationsTime += timeDiff;

    // Make a snapshot if needed
    makeSnapshotIfNeeded(endTs);
}

public void stopWALRecordTimer(boolean isStartRecord, boolean isStopRecord) {

    final long timeDiff = (endTs - timeStamps.pop());

/**
 * Parses a given SQL statement into an OStatement object.
 * 
 * @param statement The SQL statement to parse.
 * @return The parsed OStatement object.
 * @throws OCommandSQLParsingException If there is an error parsing the statement.
 */
protected static OStatement parse(String statement) throws OCommandSQLParsingException {
    try {
        ODatabaseDocumentInternal db = ODatabaseRecordThreadLocal.instance().getIfDefined();
        InputStream is;
        if (db == null) {
            is = new ByteArrayInputStream(statement.getBytes());
        } else {
            try {
                is = new ByteArrayInputStream(statement.getBytes(db.getStorage().getConfiguration().getCharset()));
            } catch (UnsupportedEncodingException e2) {
                OLogManager.instance().warn(null, "Unsupported charset for database " + db + " " + db.getStorage().getConfiguration().getCharset());
                is = new ByteArrayInputStream(statement.getBytes());
            }
        }
        OrientSql osql = null;
        if (db == null) {
            osql = new OrientSql(is);
        } else {
            try {
                osql = new OrientSql(is, db.getStorage().getConfiguration().getCharset());
            } catch (UnsupportedEncodingException e2) {
                OLogManager.instance().warn(null, "Unsupported charset for database " + db + " " + db.getStorage().getConfiguration().getCharset());
                osql = new OrientSql(is);
            }
        }
        OStatement result = osql.parse();
        result.originalStatement = statement;
        return result;
    } catch (ParseException e) {
        throwParsingException(e, statement);
    } catch (TokenMgrError e2) {
        throwParsingException(e2, statement);
    }
    return null;
}

}

**Summary:**
The `removeProperty` method removes a property from a vertex in an OrientDB graph. It first checks if the vertex has been deleted in the current transaction and throws an `IllegalStateException` if it has. It then starts a transaction if the graph is not null. 3069	```java
/**
 * Checks if a class exists in the schema and creates it if it doesn't.
 * If the class exists but is not a subclass of the base class, throws an IllegalArgumentException.
 *
 * @param className The name of the class to check.
 * @return The class name if it exists or is created successfully.
 * @throws IllegalArgumentException If the class exists but is not a subclass of the base class.
 */
protected String checkForClassInSchema(final String className) {
    if (className == null) return null;
    OrientBaseGraph graph = getGraph();
    if (graph == null) return className;
    OSchema schema = graph.getRawGraph().getMetadata().getSchema();
    if (!schema.existsClass(className)) {
        try {
            graph.executeOutsideTx(new OCallable<OClass, OrientBaseGraph>() {
                @Override
                public OClass call(final OrientBaseGraph g) {
                    return schema.createClass(className, schema.getClass(getBaseClassName()));
                }
            }, "Committing the active transaction to create the new type '" + className + "' as subclass of '" + getBaseClassName() + "'. The transaction will be reopened right after that. To avoid this behavior create the classes outside the transaction");
        } catch (OSchemaException e) {
            if (!schema.existsClass(className)) throw e;
        }
    } else {
        OClass cls = schema.getClass(className);
        if (!cls.isSubClassOf(getBaseClassName())) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Class '" + className + "' is not an instance of " + getBaseClassName());
    }
    return className;
}
```

/**
 * Wraps an index cursor with additional functionality.
 * 
 * @param source The source index.
 * @param cursor The cursor to wrap.
 * @param indexRebuildVersion The rebuild version of the index.
 * @return A wrapped cursor with changes tracking or size functionality.
 */
public static OIndexCursor wrap(OIndex<?> source, OIndexCursor cursor, long indexRebuildVersion) {
    if (cursor instanceof OIndexChangesWrapper) return cursor;
    if (cursor instanceof OSizeable) return new OIndexChangesSizeable(source, cursor, indexRebuildVersion);
    return new OIndexChangesWrapper(source, cursor, indexRebuildVersion);
}

3075	```java
/**
 * Adds an index entry to the transaction.
 *
 * @param delegate The index delegate.
 * @param iIndexName The name of the index.
 * @param iOperation The operation type (e.g., INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE).
 * @param key The key of the index entry.
 * @param iValue The value associated with the key.
 * @param clientTrackOnly Indicates if the change should be tracked only on the client side.
 */
public void addIndexEntry(final OIndex<?> delegate, final String iIndexName, final OTransactionIndexChanges.OPERATION iOperation, final Object key, final OIdentifiable iValue, boolean clientTrackOnly) {
    OTransactionIndexChanges indexEntry = indexEntries.get(iIndexName);
    if (indexEntry == null) {
        indexEntry = new OTransactionIndexChanges();
        indexEntries.put(iIndexName, indexEntry);
    }
    if (iOperation == OPERATION.CLEAR) {
        indexEntry.setCleared();
    } else {
        OTransactionIndexChangesPerKey changes = indexEntry.getChangesPerKey(key);
        changes.clientTrackOnly = clientTrackOnly;
        changes.add(iValue, iOperation);
        if (iValue == null) return;
        List<OTransactionRecordIndexOperation> transactionIndexOperations = recordIndexOperations.get(iValue.getIdentity());
        if (transactionIndexOperations == null) {
            transactionIndexOperations = new ArrayList<>();
            recordIndexOperations.put(iValue.getIdentity().copy(), transactionIndexOperations);
        }
        transactionIndexOperations.add(new OTransactionRecordIndexOperation(iIndexName, key, iOperation));
    }
}
```
3076	```java
/**
 * Merges two sets of ORecord objects.
 * 
 * @param target The target set to merge into.
 * @param source The source set to merge from.
 * @return The merged set, either the target or the source, depending on their sizes.
 */
private static Set<ORecord> mergeSet(Set<ORecord> target, Set<ORecord> source) {
    if (source != null) {
        if (target == null) {
            return source;
        } else {
            if (target.size() > source.size()) {
                target.addAll(source);
                return target;
            } else {
                source.addAll(target);
                return source;
            }
        }
    } else {
        return target;
    }
}
```

/**
 * Truncates the segment channel to the specified page index.
 *
 * @param pageIndex The page index to truncate the channel to.
 * @throws IOException If an I/O error occurs.
 */
void truncate(long pageIndex) throws IOException {
    synchronized (lockObject) {
        lastAccessTime = System.nanoTime();
        flushBuffer();
        lastWrittenPageIndex = -1;
        lastWrittenPage = null;
        segChannel.truncate(pageIndex * OWALPage.PAGE_SIZE);
    }
}

3092	```java
/**
 * Retrieves the list of master servers from the cluster configuration.
 * 
 * @return A list of master server addresses.
 */
public List<String> getMasterServers() {
    // Get the list of servers from the cluster configuration.
    List<String> serverList = getClusterConfiguration(null).field(SERVERS);
    
    // If the server list is not null, process it.
    if (serverList != null) {
        // Create a new list to store master servers.
        List<String> masters = new ArrayList<>(serverList.size());
        
        // Iterate over the server list and add only those servers that are not marked as NEW_NODE_TAG.
        for (String s : serverList) {
            if (!s.equals(NEW_NODE_TAG)) {
                masters.add(s);
            }
        }
        
        // Get the default server role.
        ROLES defRole = getDefaultServerRole();
        
        // Get the server roles from the configuration.
        ODocument servers = configuration.field(SERVERS);
        
        // If the server roles are not null, filter the master list based on the roles.
        if (servers != null) {
            for (Iterator<String> it = masters.iterator(); it.hasNext();) {
                String server = it.next();
                String roleAsString = servers.field(server);
                ROLES role = roleAsString != null ? ROLES.valueOf(roleAsString.toUpperCase(Locale.ENGLISH)) : defRole;
                
                // Remove the server if it is not a master.
                if (role != ROLES.MASTER) {
                    it.remove();
                }
            }
        }
        
        // Return the list of master servers.
        return masters;
    }
    
    // Return an empty list if the server list is null.
    return Collections.EMPTY_LIST;
}
```

/**
 * Retrieves the cluster configuration for a given cluster name.
 * If the cluster name is null, it defaults to a wildcard.
 * If the cluster is not found in the configuration, it returns the default cluster configuration.
 * If no default configuration is found, it returns an empty ODocument.
 *

 * @return The cluster configuration as an ODocument.

protected ODocument getClusterConfiguration(String iClusterName) {
    final ODocument clusters = getConfiguredClusters();
    if (iClusterName == null) iClusterName = ALL_WILDCARD;
    final ODocument cfg;
    if (!clusters.containsField(iClusterName)) {
        cfg = clusters.field(ALL_WILDCARD);

3110	```java
/**
 * Retrieves an index of a specific type.
 *
 * @param indexName The name of the index.
 * @param indexClass The class of the index.
 * @param <T> The type of the index elements.
 * @return The index if it exists and supports the given class, otherwise null.
 * @throws ExceptionFactory.indexDoesNotSupportClass If the index does not support the given class.
 */
@SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
@Override
public <T extends Element> Index<T> getIndex(final String indexName, final Class<T> indexClass) {
    makeActive();
    final OIndexManager indexManager = getDatabase().getMetadata().getIndexManager();
    final OIndex idx = indexManager.getIndex(indexName);
    if (idx == null || !hasIndexClass(idx)) {
        return null;
    }
    final Index<? extends Element> index = new OrientIndex(this, idx);
    if (indexClass.isAssignableFrom(index.getIndexClass())) {
        return (Index<T>) index;
    } else {
        throw ExceptionFactory.indexDoesNotSupportClass(indexName, indexClass);
    }
}

3111	```java
/**
 * Drops an index from the database.
 *
 * @param indexName The name of the index to be dropped.
 */
public void dropIndex(final String indexName) {
    makeActive();
    executeOutsideTx(new OCallable<Object, OrientBaseGraph>() {
        @Override
        public Object call(OrientBaseGraph g) {
            try {
                OIndexManager indexManager = getRawGraph().getMetadata().getIndexManager();
                OIndex index = indexManager.getIndex(indexName);
                ODocument metadata = index.getConfiguration().field("metadata");
                String recordMapIndexName = null;
                if (metadata != null) {
                    recordMapIndexName = metadata.field(OrientIndex.CONFIG_RECORD_MAP_NAME);
                }
                indexManager.dropIndex(indexName);
                if (recordMapIndexName != null) {
                    getRawGraph().getMetadata().getIndexManager().dropIndex(recordMapIndexName);
                }
                saveIndexConfiguration();
                return null;
            } catch (Exception e) {
                g.rollback();
                throw new RuntimeException(e.getMessage(), e);
            }
        }
    }, "drop index '", indexName, "'");
}

@Override
public OrientEdge addEdge(final Object id, Vertex outVertex, Vertex inVertex, final String label) {
    makeActive();
    String className = null;
    String clusterName = null;
    if (id != null) {
        if (id instanceof String) {
            // Parse arguments
            String[] args = ((String) id).split(",");
            for (String s : args) {
                if (s.startsWith(CLASS_PREFIX)) {
                    // Get the class name
                    className = s.substring(CLASS_PREFIX.length());
                } else if (s.startsWith(CLUSTER_PREFIX)) {
                    // Get the cluster name
                    clusterName = s.substring(CLUSTER_PREFIX.length());
                }
            }
        }
    }
    // Save the ID too?
    final Object[] fields = isSaveOriginalIds() && id != null ? new Object[] { OrientElement.DEF_ORIGINAL_ID_FIELDNAME, id } : null;
    if (outVertex instanceof PartitionVertex) {
        // Wrapped: Get the base vertex
        outVertex = ((PartitionVertex) outVertex).getBaseVertex();
    }
    if (inVertex instanceof PartitionVertex) {
        // Wrapped: Get the base vertex
        inVertex = ((PartitionVertex) inVertex).getBaseVertex();
    }
    return ((OrientVertex) outVertex).addEdge(label, (OrientVertex) inVertex, className, clusterName, fields);
}

3114	```java
/**
 * Retrieves a vertex from the graph using the given ID.
 * 
 * @param id The ID of the vertex to retrieve.
 * @return The vertex instance if found, otherwise null.
 * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the ID is null or if the vertex is an edge.
 */
public OrientVertex getVertex(final Object id) {
    makeActive();
    if (id == null) throw ExceptionFactory.vertexIdCanNotBeNull();
    if (id instanceof OrientVertex) return (OrientVertex) id;
    if (id instanceof ODocument) return getVertexInstance((OIdentifiable) id);
    setCurrentGraphInThreadLocal();
    ORID rid;
    if (id instanceof OIdentifiable) rid = ((OIdentifiable) id).getIdentity();
    else {
        try {
            rid = new ORecordId(id.toString());
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException iae) {
            return null;
        }
    }
    if (!rid.isValid()) return null;
    ORecord rec = rid.getRecord();
    if (rec == null || !(rec instanceof ODocument)) return null;
    OClass cls = ((ODocument) rec).getSchemaClass();
    if (cls != null && cls.isEdgeType()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cannot retrieve a vertex with the RID " + rid + " because it is an edge");
    return getVertexInstance(rec);
}

3119	```java
/**
 * Shuts down the database context.
 * 
 * @param closeDb Whether to close the database.
 * @param commitTx Whether to commit the transaction.
 * 
 * @throws ONeedRetryException If a retry is needed.
 * @throws RuntimeException If an unexpected runtime exception occurs.
 * @throws Exception If an unexpected exception occurs.
 */
public void shutdown(boolean closeDb, boolean commitTx) {
    makeActive();
    try {
        if (!isClosed()) {
            if (commitTx) {
                OStorage storage = getDatabase().getStorage().getUnderlying();
                if (storage instanceof OAbstractPaginatedStorage) {
                    if (((OAbstractPaginatedStorage) storage).getWALInstance() != null) {
                        getDatabase().commit();
                    }
                } else {
                    getDatabase().commit();
                }
            } else if (closeDb) {
                getDatabase().rollback();
            }
        }
    } catch (ONeedRetryException e) {
        throw e;
    } catch (RuntimeException e) {
        OLogManager.instance().error(this, "Error during context close for db " + url, e);
        throw e;
    } catch (Exception e) {
        OLogManager.instance().error(this, "Error during context close for db " + url, e);
        throw OException.wrapException(new ODatabaseException("Error during context close for db " + url), e);
    } finally {
        try {
            if (closeDb) {
                getDatabase().close();
                if (getDatabase().isPooled()) {
                    database = null;
                }
            }
            pollGraphFromStack(closeDb);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            OLogManager.instance().error(this, "Error during context close for db " + url, e);
        }
    }
    url = null;
    username = null;
    password = null;
    if (!closeDb) {
        getDatabase().activateOnCurrentThread();
    }
}
```

/**
 * Retrieves an OrientElement based on the given id.
 * 
 * @param id The id of the element to retrieve.
 * @return The OrientElement if found, otherwise null.
 * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the id is null.
 */
public OrientElement getElement(final Object id) {
    makeActive();
    if (id == null) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("id cannot be null");
    }
    if (id instanceof OrientElement) {
        return (OrientElement) id;
    }
    OIdentifiable rec;
    if (id instanceof OIdentifiable) {
        rec = (OIdentifiable) id;
    } else {
        try {
            rec = new ORecordId(id.toString());
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException iae) {
            return null;
        }
    }
    final ODocument doc = rec.getRecord();
    if (doc != null) {
        final OImmutableClass schemaClass = ODocumentInternal.getImmutableSchemaClass(doc);
        if (schemaClass != null && schemaClass.isEdgeType()) {
            return getEdge(doc);
        } else {
            return getVertexInstance(doc);
        }
    }
    return null;
}

3134	The `fetchWriteCacheCounters` method accumulates write cache counters from live threads and aggregates statistics from dead threads. It first creates snapshots of performance statistics for all threads, then iterates through these snapshots to accumulate counters from live threads into a `WritCacheCountersHolder`. Dead threads are identified and their statistics are updated. Finally, if there are any statistics from dead threads, they are aggregated into the `WritCacheCountersHolder`. 3135	The `fetchSystemCounters` method in the provided code is designed to accumulate performance statistics from live threads and handle dead threads separately. Here's a summary of the method:

1. **Initialization**:
   - Creates two collections: `snapshots` to store thread and their performance snapshots, and `threadsToRemove` to store threads that are no longer alive.

2. **Snapshot Collection**:
   - Iterates over a map of `statistics` where each entry contains a `Thread` and its corresponding `OSessionStoragePerformanceStatistic`.
   - For each entry, it adds a new `ORawPair` of the thread and its performance snapshot to the `snapshots` collection.

3. **Snapshot Processing**:
   - Iterates over the `snapshots` collection.
   - For each thread, checks if it is alive.
   - If the thread is alive, it pushes the performance data from the snapshot to the `countersHolder`.
   - If the thread is not alive, it adds the thread to the `threadsToRemove` collection.

4. **Handling Dead Threads**:
   - If there are any threads in the `threadsToRemove` collection, it calls the `updateDeadThreadsStatistic` method to handle these threads.

5. **Aggregation of Dead Threads Statistics**:
   - Retrieves the `deadThreadsStatistic` if it is not null.
   - If `deadThreadsStatistic` is not null, it pushes the data from the `countersHolder` of `deadThreadsStatistic` to the `countersHolder`.

This method ensures that performance statistics are efficiently collected and aggregated, minimizing inter-thread communication delays by first collecting snapshots and then processing them.
3136	The `fetchComponentCounters` method is designed to accumulate performance counters for a specific component across all threads. It follows these steps:

1. **Initialization**: It initializes two collections: `snapshots` to store thread and their performance snapshots, and `threadsToRemove` to store threads that are no longer alive.

2. **Snapshot Collection**: It iterates over a map of threads and their performance statistics, collecting snapshots of the live threads into the `snapshots` list. Threads that are not alive are added to the `threadsToRemove` list.

3. **Snapshot Processing**: It processes each snapshot in the `snapshots` list. For each live thread, it retrieves the performance counters for the specified component and pushes them into the `componentCountersHolder`. If a thread is not alive, it is added to the `threadsToRemove` list.

4. **Dead Threads Handling**: If there are any threads in the `threadsToRemove` list, it updates the `deadThreadsStatistic` with their performance counters.

5. **Aggregation**: It aggregates the performance counters from the `deadThreadsStatistic` into the `componentCountersHolder`.

This method ensures that only live threads' performance data is considered, and it efficiently handles both live and dead threads by using snapshots and aggregation.
3137	```java
/**
 * Compresses a given JSON string using GZIP compression.
 *
 * @param jsonStr The JSON string to be compressed.
 * @return The compressed byte array of the JSON string, or null if an error occurs.
 */
public byte[] compress(String jsonStr) {
    if (jsonStr == null || jsonStr.length() == 0) {
        return null;
    }

    GZIPOutputStream gout = null;
    ByteArrayOutputStream baos = null;

    try {
        byte[] incoming = jsonStr.getBytes("UTF-8");
        baos = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        gout = new GZIPOutputStream(baos, 16384); // 16KB
        gout.write(incoming);
        gout.finish();
        return baos.toByteArray();
    } catch (Exception ex) {
        OLogManager.instance().error(this, "Error on compressing HTTP response", ex);
    } finally {
        try {
            if (gout != null) {
                gout.close();
            }
            if (baos != null) {
                baos.close();
            }
        } catch (Exception ex) {
        }
    }

    return null;
}
```

3147	```java
/**
 * Retrieves a list of conflict responses from response groups, excluding the best group.
 * 
 * @return A list of ODistributedResponse objects representing the conflict responses.
 */
protected List<ODistributedResponse> getConflictResponses() {
    List<ODistributedResponse> servers = new ArrayList<>();
    int bestGroupSoFar = getBestResponsesGroup();
    for (int i = 0; i < responseGroups.size(); ++i) {
        if (i != bestGroupSoFar) {
            for (ODistributedResponse r : responseGroups.get(i)) {
                servers.add(r);
            }
        }
    }
    return servers;
}
```
3148	This method, `getBestResponsesGroup`, iterates through a list of response groups to find the group with the maximum number of coherent responses. It initializes two variables: `maxCoherentResponses` to keep track of the maximum size found and `bestGroupSoFar` to store the index of the group with this maximum size. The method then loops through each group, checking its size. If the current group's size is greater than `maxCoherentResponses`, it updates `maxCoherentResponses` and sets `bestGroupSoFar` to the current group's index. Finally, it returns the index of the group with the most coherent responses.
3149	```java
/**
 * Computes the quorum response based on the group responses and nodes in the quorum.
 * 
 * @param reachedTimeout Indicates if the timeout has been reached.
 * @return true if the quorum response is computed, false otherwise.
 */
private boolean computeQuorumResponse(boolean reachedTimeout) {
    if (quorumResponse != null) {
        return true;
    }

    if (groupResponsesByResult) {
        for (List<ODistributedResponse> group : responseGroups) {
            if (group.size() >= quorum) {
                int responsesForQuorum = 0;
                for (ODistributedResponse r : group) {
                    if (nodesConcurInQuorum.contains(r.getExecutorNodeName())) {
                        final Object payload = r.getPayload();
                        if (payload instanceof Throwable) {
                            if (payload instanceof ODistributedRecordLockedException || payload instanceof OConcurrentCreateException) {
                                break;
                            }
                        } else if (++responsesForQuorum >= quorum) {
                            setQuorumResponse(r);
                            return true;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    } else {
        if (receivedResponses >= quorum) {
            int responsesForQuorum = 0;
            for (Map.Entry<String, Object> response : responses.entrySet()) {
                if (response.getValue() != NO_RESPONSE && nodesConcurInQuorum.contains(response.getKey()) && ++responsesForQuorum >= quorum) {
                    ODistributedResponse resp = (ODistributedResponse) response.getValue();
                    if (resp != null && !(resp.getPayload() instanceof Throwable)) {
                        setQuorumResponse(resp);
                        return true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    return false;
}
```

It iterates over the values of a map called `responses`, and for each value, it checks if it is not equal to `NO_RESPONSE`. If the value is not `NO_RESPONSE`, it casts the value to `ODistributedResponse` and adds it to a new list called `parsed`. Finally, it returns the `parsed` list.

3163	```java
@Override
public void enqueueRepairRecord(final ORecordId rid) {
    if (!active) return;
    if (rid == null || !rid.isPersistent()) return;
    if (rid.getClusterPosition() < -1) return; // Skip transactional RIDs
    recordProcessed.incrementAndGet(); // Increment the count of processed records
    records.put(rid, Boolean.TRUE); // Add the record ID to the repair records map
}
```
3164	```java
@Override
public void cancelRepairRecord(final ORecordId rid) {
    if (!active) return;
    if (rid.getClusterPosition() < -1) return; // Skip transactional RIDs
    if (records.remove(rid) != null) {
        recordCanceled.incrementAndGet();
    }
}
```

**Summary:**
The `cancelRepairRecord` method checks if the repair process is active. If not, it returns immediately. It then checks if the record ID is transactional (cluster position less than -1) and skips it if true. If the record is found in the `records` set, it is removed, and a counter `recordCanceled` is incremented.

The `enqueueRepairCluster` method is designed to add a cluster to the repair queue. It first checks if the method is active. If not, it returns immediately. If the checks pass, it increments a counter indicating that a record has been processed and adds the `clusterId` to a map with a value of `Boolean.TRUE`, indicating that the cluster is in the repair queue.

/**
 * Creates a POJO (Plain Old Java Object) instance based on the given class name.
 * 
 * @param iClassName The fully qualified name of the class to instantiate.
 * @return An instance of the specified class.
 * @throws OConfigurationException If the class name is null, the class cannot be found, or an error occurs during instantiation.
 */
public synchronized Object createPojo(final String iClassName) throws OConfigurationException {
    if (iClassName == null) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cannot create the object: class name is empty");
    }

    Class<?> entityClass = classHandler.getEntityClass(iClassName);
    try {
        if (entityClass != null) {
            return createInstance(entityClass);
        }
    } catch (Exception e) {
        throw OException.wrapException(new OConfigurationException("Error while creating new pojo of class '" + iClassName + "'"), e);
    }

    try {
        // Attempt to instantiate the class directly by its name
        return createInstance(Class.forName(iClassName));
    } catch (Exception e) {
        throw OException.wrapException(new OConfigurationException("The class '" + iClassName + "' was not found between the entity classes. Ensure registerEntityClasses(package) has been called first"), e);
    }
}

3168	```java
/**
 * Registers entity classes based on the provided class names and class loader.
 * 
 * @param iClassNames A collection of class names to be registered.
 * @param iClassLoader The class loader used to load the classes.
 * @throws ODatabaseException If a class cannot be found.
 */
public synchronized void registerEntityClasses(final Collection<String> iClassNames, final ClassLoader iClassLoader) {
    OLogManager.instance().debug(this, "Discovering entity classes for class names: %s", iClassNames);
    try {

protected String authenticate(final String username, final String password, final String iDatabaseName) throws IOException {

3195	```java
/**
 * Retrieves a value from a map using a key, which can be a string with optional sub-key.
 * If the key is a string, it can contain a sub-key separated by a space. The method first
 * extracts the main key and, if a sub-key is present, recursively retrieves the value from
 * the nested map or document.
 *
 * @param iMap The map from which to retrieve the value.
 * @param iKey The key or sub-key to retrieve the value for.
 * @return The value associated with the key or sub-key, or null if the key is not found.
 */
@SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
public static Object getMapEntry(final Map<String, ?> iMap, final Object iKey) {
    if (iMap == null || iKey == null) return null;
    if (iKey instanceof String) {
        String iName = (String) iKey;
        int pos = iName.indexOf(' ');
        if (pos > -1) iName = iName.substring(0, pos);
        final Object value = iMap.get(iName);
        if (value == null) return null;
        if (pos > -1) {
            final String restFieldName = iName.substring(pos + 1);
            if (value instanceof ODocument) return getFieldValue(value, restFieldName);
            else if (value instanceof Map<?, ?>) return getMapEntry((Map<String, ?>) value, restFieldName);
        }
        return value;
    } else return iMap.get(iKey);
}

3197	```java
/**
 * Reads the current record based on the given movement.
 * 
 * @param iRecord The record to read.
 * @param iMovement The movement direction (-1 for previous, 1 for next, 0 for current).
 * @return The read record or null if the limit is reached or an error occurs.
 */
protected ORecord readCurrentRecord(ORecord iRecord, final int iMovement) {
    if (limit > -1 && browsedRecords >= limit) return null; // LIMIT REACHED
    do {
        boolean moveResult;
        switch (iMovement) {
            case 1:
                moveResult = nextPosition();
                break;
            case -1:
                moveResult = prevPosition();
                break;
            case 0:
                moveResult = checkCurrentPosition();
                break;
            default:
                throw new IllegalStateException("Invalid movement value: " + iMovement);
        }
        if (!moveResult) return null;
        try {
            if (iRecord != null) {
                ORecordInternal.setIdentity(iRecord, new ORecordId(current.getClusterId(), current.getClusterPosition()));
                iRecord = database.load(iRecord, fetchPlan, false);
            } else {
                iRecord = database.load(current, fetchPlan, false);
            }
        } catch (ODatabaseException e) {
            if (Thread.interrupted() || database.isClosed()) throw e; // THREAD INTERRUPTED: RETURN
            if (e.getCause() instanceof OSecurityException) throw e;
            brokenRIDs.add(current.copy());
            OLogManager.instance().error(this, "Error on fetching record during browsing. The record has been skipped", e);
        }
        if (iRecord != null) {
            browsedRecords++;
            return iRecord;
        }
    } while (iMovement != 0);
    return null;
}
