3561	```java
/**
 * Creates a JestClient instance with the specified URI and configuration properties.
 *
 * @param uri The URI for the JestClient.
 * @return A configured JestClient instance.
 */
private JestClient createJestClient(String uri) {
    HttpClientConfig.Builder builder = new HttpClientConfig.Builder(uri)
        .maxTotalConnection(properties.getMaxTotalConnection())
        .defaultMaxTotalConnectionPerRoute(properties.getDefaultMaxTotalConnectionPerRoute())
        .maxConnectionIdleTime(properties.getMaxConnectionIdleTime(), TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)
        .readTimeout(properties.getReadTimeout())
        .multiThreaded(properties.getMultiThreaded());

    if (StringUtils.hasText(this.properties.getUsername())) {
        builder.defaultCredentials(this.properties.getUsername(), this.properties.getPassword());
    }

    String proxyHost = this.properties.getProxy().getHost();
    if (StringUtils.hasText(proxyHost)) {
        Integer proxyPort = this.properties.getProxy().getPort();
        Assert.notNull(proxyPort, "Proxy port must not be null");
        builder.proxy(new HttpHost(proxyHost, proxyPort));
    }

    List<HttpClientConfigBuilderCustomizer> configBuilderCustomizers = builderCustomizers != null ? builderCustomizers.getIfAvailable() : new ArrayList<>();
    if (!CollectionUtils.isEmpty(configBuilderCustomizers)) {
        logger.info("Custom HttpClientConfigBuilderCustomizers detected. Applying these to the HttpClientConfig builder.");
        configBuilderCustomizers.stream().forEach(customizer -> customizer.customize(builder));
        logger.info("Custom HttpClientConfigBuilderCustomizers applied.");
    }

    JestClientFactory factory = jestClientFactory != null ? jestClientFactory : new JestClientFactory();
    factory.setHttpClientConfig(builder.build());
    return factory.getObject();
}

/**
 * Parses a JSON string containing payment method nonces and returns a list of PaymentMethodNonce objects.
 *
 * @param jsonBody The JSON string containing payment method nonces.
 * @return A list of PaymentMethodNonce objects parsed from the JSON string.
 * @throws JSONException If there is an error parsing the JSON string.
 */
public static List<PaymentMethodNonce> parsePaymentMethodNonces(String jsonBody) throws JSONException {
    JSONArray paymentMethods = new JSONObject(jsonBody).getJSONArray(PAYMENT_METHOD_NONCE_COLLECTION_KEY);
    if (paymentMethods == null) {
        return Collections.emptyList();
    }
    List<PaymentMethodNonce> paymentMethodsNonces = new ArrayList<>();
    JSONObject json;
    PaymentMethodNonce paymentMethodNonce;
    for (int i = 0; i < paymentMethods.length(); i++) {
        json = paymentMethods.getJSONObject(i);
        paymentMethodNonce = parsePaymentMethodNonces(json, json.getString(PAYMENT_METHOD_TYPE_KEY));
        if (paymentMethodNonce != null) {
            paymentMethodsNonces.add(paymentMethodNonce);
        }
    }
    return paymentMethodsNonces;
}

protected static void onActivityResult(final BraintreeFragment fragment, int resultCode, Intent data) {
    Request request = getPersistedRequest(fragment.getApplicationContext());
    String paymentType = paymentTypeForRequest(request);
    String switchType = switchTypeForIntent(data);
    String eventPrefix = paymentType + "." + switchType;

    if (resultCode == AppCompatActivity.RESULT_OK && data != null && request != null) {
        Result result = PayPalOneTouchCore.parseResponse(fragment.getApplicationContext(), request, data);
        switch (result.getResultType()) {
            case Error:
                fragment.postCallback(new BrowserSwitchException(result.getError().getMessage()));
                fragment.sendAnalyticsEvent(eventPrefix + ".failed");
                break;
            case Cancel:
                fragment.postCancelCallback(BraintreeRequestCodes.PAYPAL);
                fragment.sendAnalyticsEvent(eventPrefix + ".canceled");
                break;
            case Success:
                onSuccess(fragment, data, request, result);
                fragment.sendAnalyticsEvent(eventPrefix + ".succeeded");
                break;
        }
    } else {
        fragment.sendAnalyticsEvent(eventPrefix + ".canceled");
        if (resultCode != AppCompatActivity.RESULT_CANCELED) {
            fragment.postCancelCallback(BraintreeRequestCodes.PAYPAL);
        }
    }
}
```

**Summary:**
This method handles the `onActivityResult` callback for a `BraintreeFragment`. It processes the result based on the `resultCode` and `data` received. If the result is successful, it parses the response and calls the `onSuccess` method. If there is an error or the result is canceled, it posts the appropriate callback and sends an analytics event. If the result is not canceled, it posts a cancel callback.

/**
 * Parses the response from a PayPal request and constructs a PayPalAccountBuilder object.
 *
 * @param paypalRequest The PayPal request object.
 * @param request The request object.
 * @param result The result object.
 * @param intent The intent object.
 * @return A PayPalAccountBuilder object populated with data from the input parameters.
 */
private static PayPalAccountBuilder parseResponse(PayPalRequest paypalRequest, Request request, Result result, Intent intent) {
    PayPalAccountBuilder paypalAccountBuilder = new PayPalAccountBuilder()
            .clientMetadataId(request.getClientMetadataId());

    if (paypalRequest != null && paypalRequest.getMerchantAccountId() != null) {
        paypalAccountBuilder.merchantAccountId(paypalRequest.getMerchantAccountId());
    }

    if (request instanceof CheckoutRequest && paypalRequest != null) {
        paypalAccountBuilder.intent(paypalRequest.getIntent());
    }

    if (isAppSwitch(intent)) {
        paypalAccountBuilder.source("paypal-app");
    } else {
        paypalAccountBuilder.source("paypal-browser");
    }

    paypalAccountBuilder.oneTouchCoreData(result.getResponse());

    return paypalAccountBuilder;
}

### Summary of the `encode` method:

The `encode` method is used to encode a symbol using a modified context mixture (MCM) algorithm. It takes two parameters: `symbol` (the symbol to be encoded) and `cm` (the context mixture). The method throws an `IOException` if an I/O error occurs.

1. **Initialization**:
   - `rangeLps` is initialized to the value of `MQConst.pLps[cm.getState()]`, which represents the lower probability range for the current state.

2. **Encoding Logic**:
   - If the `symbol` is equal to the most probable symbol (`mps`) in the context:
     - Subtract `rangeLps` from `range`.
     - Add `rangeLps` to `offset`.
     - If `range` is less than `0x8000`, call `renormalize()` until `range` is at least `0x8000`.
     - Update the state to `MQConst.transitMPS[cm.getState()]`.
   - If the `symbol` is not equal to the `mps`:
     - Set `range` to `rangeLps`.
     - Call `renormalize()` until `range` is at least `0x8000`.
     - If `MQConst.mpsSwitch[cm.getState()]` is not zero, toggle the `mps` (i.e., set it to `1 - cm.getMps()`).
     - Update the state to `MQConst.transitLPS[cm.getState()]`.

3. **Renormalization**:
   - The `renormalize` method is called to adjust the `range` and `offset` to ensure they remain within a valid range.

This method effectively encodes a symbol by adjusting the `range` and `offset` based on the symbol's value and the current state of the context mixture.

3623	```java
/**
 * Reads and decodes picture marking information from a NAL unit and slice header.
 * 
 * @param nalUnit The NAL unit containing the picture marking information.
 * @param sh The slice header to store the decoded picture marking information.
 * @param _in The bit reader to read the NAL unit data.
 */
private static void readDecoderPicMarking(NALUnit nalUnit, SliceHeader sh, BitReader _in) {
    if (nalUnit.type == NALUnitType.IDR_SLICE) {
        // Read flags for IDR slice
        boolean noOutputOfPriorPicsFlag = readBool(_in, "SH: no_output_of_prior_pics_flag");
        boolean longTermReferenceFlag = readBool(_in, "SH: long_term_reference_flag");
        // Create RefPicMarkingIDR object and store in slice header
        sh.refPicMarkingIDR = new RefPicMarkingIDR(noOutputOfPriorPicsFlag, longTermReferenceFlag);
    } else {
        // Read adaptive reference picture marking mode flag
        boolean adaptiveRefPicMarkingModeFlag = readBool(_in, "SH: adaptive_ref_pic_marking_mode_flag");
        if (adaptiveRefPicMarkingModeFlag) {
            // Initialize list to store memory management operations
            ArrayList<Instruction> mmops = new ArrayList<>();
            int memoryManagementControlOperation;
            // Read and process memory management control operations
            do {
                memoryManagementControlOperation = readUEtrace(_in, "SH: memory_management_control_operation");
                Instruction instr = null;
                switch (memoryManagementControlOperation) {
                    case 1:
                        instr = new RefPicMarking.Instruction(InstrType.REMOVE_SHORT, readUEtrace(_in, "SH: difference_of_pic_nums_minus1") + 1, 0);
                        break;
                    case 2:
                        instr = new RefPicMarking.Instruction(InstrType.REMOVE_LONG, readUEtrace(_in, "SH: long_term_pic_num"), 0);

/**
 * Calculates the length of the EBML (Elementary Bitstream Meta Language) representation of a given long value.
 * 
 * @param v The long value to calculate the EBML length for.
 * @return The length of the EBML representation.
 */
public static int ebmlLength(long v) {
    if (v == 0) return 1;
    int length = 8;
    while (length > 0 && (v & ebmlLengthMasks[length]) == 0) length--;
    return length;
}

3642	The `rewindReverse32` function takes an integer `v` and an integer `len` as input. It performs a series of bitwise operations on `v` to reverse the order of its bits and then shifts off the low bits to return a value with the specified length. The function uses arrays `S` and `B` to define the shift amounts and bit masks, respectively.
3643	```java
static int[] rewindReverse64(int hi, int lo, int len) {
    int[] result = new int[2];
    if (len <= 32) {
        result[0] = 0;
        result[1] = rewindReverse32(lo, len);
    } else {
        // Perform bit manipulation on hi and lo
        for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
            hi = ((hi >> S[i]) & B[i]) | ((hi << S[i]) & ~B[i]);
            lo = ((lo >> S[i]) & B[i]) | ((lo << S[i]) & ~B[i]);
        }
        // Shift off low bits
        result[1] = (hi >> (64 - len)) | (lo << (len - 32));
        result[1] = lo >> (64 - len);
    }
    return result;
}
```

/**
 * Calculates the median prediction value based on the given inputs.
 * 
 * @param a The first value.
 * @param b The second value.
 * @param c The third value.
 * @param d The fourth value.
 * @param aAvb Flag indicating if the first value is valid.
 * @param bAvb Flag indicating if the second value is valid.
 * @param cAvb Flag indicating if the third value is valid.
 * @param dAvb Flag indicating if the fourth value is valid.
 * @param ref The reference value.
 * @param comp The comparison value.
 * @return The median prediction value.
 */
public static int calcMVPredictionMedian(int a, int b, int c, int d, boolean aAvb, boolean bAvb, boolean cAvb, boolean dAvb, int ref, int comp) {
    if (!cAvb) {
        c = d;
        cAvb = dAvb;
    }
    if (aAvb && !bAvb && !cAvb) {
        b = c = a;
        bAvb = cAvb = aAvb;
    }
    a = aAvb ? a : NULL_VECTOR;
    b = bAvb ? b : NULL_VECTOR;
    c = cAvb ? c : NULL_VECTOR;

    if (mvRef(a) == ref && mvRef(b) != ref && mvRef(c) != ref) {
        return mvC(a, comp);
    } else if (mvRef(b) == ref && mvRef(a) != ref && mvRef(c) != ref) {
        return mvC(b, comp);
    } else if (mvRef(c) == ref && mvRef(a) != ref && mvRef(b) != ref) {
        return mvC(c, comp);
    }

    return mvC(a, comp) + mvC(b, comp) + mvC(c, comp) - min(mvC(a, comp), mvC(b, comp), mvC(c, comp)) - max(mvC(a, comp), mvC(b, comp), mvC(c, comp));
}

 */
private static BufferedImage displayVideoAtCorrectTime(long streamStartTime, final MediaPicture picture, final MediaPictureConverter converter, BufferedImage image, final ImageFrame window, long systemStartTime, final Rational systemTimeBase, final Rational streamTimebase) throws InterruptedException {
    long streamTimestamp = picture.getTimeStamp(); // Convert stream timestamp to system units (nano-seconds)
    streamTimestamp = systemTimeBase.rescale(streamTimestamp - streamStartTime, streamTimebase); // Get the current clock time with the most accurate clock
    long systemTimestamp = System.nanoTime(); // Loop in a sleeping loop until we're within 1 ms of the time for that video frame
    while (streamTimestamp > (systemTimestamp - systemStartTime + 1000000)) {
        Thread.sleep(1);
        systemTimestamp = System.nanoTime();
    }
    // Convert the image from Humble format into Java images
    image = converter.toImage(image, picture);
    // Ask the UI thread to repaint with the new image
    window.setImage(image);
    return image;
}

3679	```java
public static void printOption(java.io.PrintStream stream, Configurable configObj, Property prop) {
    if (prop.getType() != Property.Type.PROPERTY_FLAGS) {
        stream.printf("  %s; default= %s; type=%s;\n", prop.getName(), configObj.getPropertyAsString(prop.getName()), prop.getType());
    } else {
        stream.printf("  %s; default= %d; valid values=(", prop.getName(), configObj.getPropertyAsLong(prop.getName()));
        int numSettings = prop.getNumFlagSettings();
        long value = configObj.getPropertyAsLong(prop.getName());
        for (int i = 0; i < numSettings; i++) {
            Property fprop = prop.getFlagConstant(i);
            long flagMask = fprop.getDefault();
            boolean isSet = (value & flagMask) > 0;
            stream.printf("%s%s; ", isSet ? "+" : "-", fprop.getName());
        }
        stream.printf("); type=%s;\n", prop.getType());
    }
    stream.printf("    help for %s: %s\n", prop.getName(), prop.getHelp() == null ? "no help available" : prop.getHelp());
}
```

**Summary:**
This method `printOption` is designed to print details about a configuration property to a given `PrintStream`. It checks if the property type is `PROPERTY_FLAGS`. If not, it prints the property name, default value, and type. If the property is a flag, it prints the property name, default value, and a list of valid flag values, indicating which flags are set. Finally, it prints help information for the property, or a message if no help is available.

/**
 * Determines the CPU architecture based on the input Java CPU string.
 *
 * @param javaCPU The Java CPU string to parse.
 * @return The corresponding CPU architecture.
 */
public static CPUArch getCPUArch(String javaCPU) {
    final String javaCPUArch = javaCPU != null ? javaCPU.toLowerCase() : ""; // Normalize the input
    CPUArch javaArch;

    // Check for specific architecture prefixes
    if (javaCPUArch.startsWith("x86_64") || javaCPUArch.startsWith("amd64") || javaCPUArch.startsWith("ia64")) {
        javaArch = CPUArch.X86_64;
    } else if (javaCPUArch.startsWith("ppc64") || javaCPUArch.startsWith("powerpc64")) {
        javaArch = CPUArch.PPC64;
    } else if (javaCPUArch.startsWith("ppc") || javaCPUArch.startsWith("powerpc")) {
        javaArch = CPUArch.PPC;
    } else if (javaCPUArch.contains("86")) {
        javaArch = CPUArch.X86;
    } else {
        javaArch = CPUArch.UNKNOWN;
    }

    return javaArch;
}
```

synchronized void loadLibrary0(String aLibraryName, Long aMajorVersion) {

    List<String> libCandidates = getLibraryCandidates(aLibraryName, aMajorVersion); // Get candidate libraries
    if (libCandidates != null && libCandidates.size() > 0 && !loadCandidateLibrary(aLibraryName, aMajorVersion, libCandidates)) {

            System.loadLibrary(aLibraryName); // Try to load the library using System.loadLibrary

### Summary of `recordScreen` Method

The `recordScreen` method is designed to record the screen and save it as a video file. It takes several parameters including the filename, format name, codec name, duration, and snapshots per second. The method uses the Java AWT library to capture the screen and the Xuggler library to encode and save the video.

1. **Setup AWT Infrastructure**:
   - Creates a `Robot` object to capture the screen.
   - Retrieves the screen size using `Toolkit.getDefaultToolkit()`.

2. **Create Muxer**:
   - Initializes a `Muxer` object to handle the output file and format.

3. **Select Codec**:
   - Determines the appropriate codec for encoding the video. If a codec name is provided, it uses that; otherwise, it selects a default codec supported by the muxer.

4. **Create Encoder**:
   - Initializes an `Encoder` object with the selected codec.
   - Sets the encoder's properties such as width, height, pixel format, and frame rate.

5. **Open Encoder and Muxer**:
   - Opens the encoder and adds the stream to the muxer.
   - Opens the muxer to start writing the video file.

6. **Convert Image Format**:
   - Converts the captured screen image from RGB to YUV420P format using a `MediaPictureConverter`.

7. **Main Loop**:
   - Captures the screen at the specified interval.
   - Encodes the captured image and writes the encoded data to the output file.
   - Handles the encoding and writing process in a loop until the specified duration is reached.

8. **Cleanup**:
   - Flushes the encoder to ensure all cached data is written.
   - Closes the muxer to finalize the video file.

This method provides a comprehensive solution for screen recording and video encoding using Java and Xuggler libraries.

3718	The `generateSeed` method generates a seed phrase using a combination of cryptographic functions and bit manipulation. Here's a summary of the method:

1. **Generate Random Bytes**: The method starts by generating 21 random bytes using `SecureRandom`.
2. **Hash the Bytes**: It then hashes the first 20 bytes using SHA-256 to produce a hash value.
3. **Combine Hash with Bytes**: The first byte of the hash is combined with the last byte of the random bytes array.
4. **Convert to BigInteger**: The combined bytes are converted into a `BigInteger`.
5. **Create Mask**: A mask is created to isolate the lower 11 bits of the `BigInteger`.
6. **Generate Seed Phrase**: The method iterates 15 times, each time appending a word from a predefined list (`SEED_WORDS`) based on the masked value. The `BigInteger` is then right-shifted by 11 bits for the next iteration.
7. **Return Seed Phrase**: Finally, the method returns the generated seed phrase as a string.

This method ensures a secure and random seed phrase generation process.

3727	```java
/**
 * Writes a primitive array to the output stream.
 *
 * @param array the array to write
 * @param off   the offset in the array
 * @param len   the number of elements to write
 * @throws IOException if an I/O error occurs
 */
public void writePrimitiveArray(Object array, int off, int len) throws IOException {
    Class<?> componentType = array.getClass().getComponentType();
    if (componentType == byte.class) {
        writeRawBytes((byte[]) array, off, len);
    } else if (componentType == char.class) {
        writeFCharArr((char[]) array, off, len);
    } else if (componentType == short.class) {
        writeFShortArr((short[]) array, off, len);
    } else if (componentType == int.class) {
        writeFIntArr((int[]) array, off, len);
    } else if (componentType == double.class) {
        writeFDoubleArr((double[]) array, off, len);
    } else if (componentType == float.class) {
        writeFFloatArr((float[]) array, off, len);
    } else if (componentType == long.class) {
        writeFLongArr((long[]) array, off, len);
    } else if (componentType == boolean.class) {
        writeFBooleanArr((boolean[]) array, off, len);
    } else {
        throw new RuntimeException("expected primitive array");
    }
}

public void writeArray(Object primitiveArray, int start, int len) {
    byte type = MinBin.ARRAY_MASK;
    Class<?> componentType = primitiveArray.getClass().getComponentType();
    
    // Determine the type of the array elements
    if (componentType == boolean.class) type |= MinBin.INT_8;
    else if (componentType == byte.class) type |= MinBin.INT_8;
    else if (componentType == short.class) type |= MinBin.INT_16;
    else if (componentType == char.class) type |= MinBin.INT_16 | MinBin.UNSIGN_MASK;
    else if (componentType == int.class) type |= MinBin.INT_32;
    else if (componentType == long.class) type |= MinBin.INT_64;
    else throw new RuntimeException("unsupported type " + componentType.getName());
    
    // Write the type and length of the array
    writeOut(type);
    writeIntPacked(len);
    
    // Write the array elements based on their type
    switch (type) {
        case MinBin.INT_8 | MinBin.ARRAY_MASK:
            if (componentType == boolean.class) {
                boolean[] arr = (boolean[]) primitiveArray;
                for (int i = start; i < start + len; i++) {
                    writeRawInt(type, arr[i] ? 1 : 0);
                }
            } else {
                byte[] arr = (byte[]) primitiveArray;
                for (int i = start; i < start + len; i++) {
                    writeRawInt(type, arr[i]);
                }
            }
            break;
        case MinBin.CHAR | MinBin.ARRAY_MASK:
            char[] charArr = (char[]) primitiveArray;
            for (int i = start; i < start + len; i++) {
                writeRawInt(type, charArr[i]);
            }
            break;
        case MinBin.INT_32 | MinBin.ARRAY_MASK:
            int[] arr = (int[]) primitiveArray;
            for (int i = start; i < start + len; i++) {
                writeRawInt(type, arr[i]);
            }
            break;
        case MinBin.INT_64 | MinBin.ARRAY_MASK:
            long[] arr = (long[]) primitiveArray;
            for (int i = start; i < start + len; i++) {
                writeRawInt(type, arr[i]);

protected void writeArray(FSTClazzInfo.FSTFieldInfo referencee, Object array) throws IOException {

        getCodec().writeClass(Object.class);
        getCodec().writeFInt(-1);
        return;
    }
    final int len = Array.getLength(array);
    Class<?> componentType = array.getClass().getComponentType();
    getCodec().writeClass(array.getClass());
    getCodec().writeFInt(len);
    if (!componentType.isArray()) {
        if (getCodec().isPrimitiveArray(array, componentType)) {
            getCodec().writePrimitiveArray(array, 0, len);
        } else {
            Object[] arr = (Object[]) array;
            Class<?> lastClz = null;
            FSTClazzInfo lastInfo = null;
            for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
                Object toWrite = arr[i];
                if (toWrite != null) {
                    lastInfo = writeObjectWithContext(referencee, toWrite, lastClz == toWrite.getClass() ? lastInfo : null);
                    lastClz = toWrite.getClass();
                } else {
                    writeObjectWithContext(referencee, toWrite, null);
                }
            }
        }
    } else {
        Object[] arr = (Object[]) array;
        FSTClazzInfo.FSTFieldInfo ref1 = new FSTClazzInfo.FSTFieldInfo(referencee.getPossibleClasses(), null, conf.getCLInfoRegistry().isIgnoreAnnotations());
        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            Object subArr = arr[i];
            boolean needsWrite = true;
            if (getCodec().isTagMultiDimSubArrays()) {
                if (subArr == null) {
                    needsWrite = !getCodec().writeTag(NULL, null, 0, null, this);
                } else {
                    needsWrite = !getCodec().writeTag(ARRAY, subArr, 0, subArr, this);
                }
            }
            if (needsWrite) {
                writeArray(ref1, subArr);
                getCodec().writeArrayEnd();
            }
        }
    }
}

public static void printThreadInfo(PrintWriter stream, String title) {
    final int STACK_DEPTH = 20;
    boolean contention = threadBean.isThreadContentionMonitoringEnabled();
    long[] threadIds = threadBean.getAllThreadIds();
    stream.println("Process Thread Dump: " + title);
    stream.println(threadIds.length + " active threads");
    for (long tid : threadIds) {
        ThreadInfo info = threadBean.getThreadInfo(tid, STACK_DEPTH);
        if (info == null) {
            stream.println("  Inactive");
            continue;
        }
        stream.println("Thread " + getTaskName(info.getThreadId(), info.getThreadName()) + ":");
        Thread.State state = info.getThreadState();
        stream.println("  State: " + state);
        stream.println("  Blocked count: " + info.getBlockedCount());
        stream.println("  Waited count: " + info.getWaitedCount());
        if (contention) {
            stream.println("  Blocked time: " + info.getBlockedTime());
            stream.println("  Waited time: " + info.getWaitedTime());
        }
        if (state == Thread.State.WAITING) {
            stream.println("  Waiting on " + info.getLockName());
        } else if (state == Thread.State.BLOCKED) {
            stream.println("  Blocked on " + info.getLockName());
            stream.println("  Blocked by " + getTaskName(info.getLockOwnerId(), info.getLockOwnerName()));
        }
        stream.println("  Stack:");
        for (StackTraceElement frame : info.getStackTrace()) {
            stream.println("    " + frame.toString());
        }
    }
    stream.flush();
}
```

3777	```java
/**
 * Checks if any element in the given complex N-dimensional array satisfies the specified condition.
 *
 * @param n     the complex N-dimensional array to check
 * @param cond  the condition to apply to each element
 * @return true if any element satisfies the condition, false otherwise
 */
public static boolean or(IComplexNDArray n, Condition cond) {
    boolean ret = false;
    IComplexNDArray linear = n.linearView();
    for (int i = 0; i < linear.length(); i++) {
        ret = ret || cond.apply(linear.getComplex(i));
    }
    return ret;
}
```

3781	```java
public static void applyWhere(final INDArray to, final Condition condition, final Number number) {
    if (condition instanceof BaseCondition) {
        Nd4j.getExecutioner().exec(new CompareAndSet(to, number.doubleValue(), condition));
    } else {
        double value = number.doubleValue();
        Function<Number, Number> dynamic = new Function<Number, Number>() {
            @Override
            public Number apply(Number number) {
                return value;
            }
        };
        Shape.iterate(to, new CoordinateFunction() {
            @Override
            public void process(long[]... coord) {
                if (condition.apply(to.getDouble(coord[0]))) {
                    to.putScalar(coord[0], dynamic.apply(to.getDouble(coord[0])).doubleValue());
                }
            }
        });
    }
}
```

**Summary:**
The `applyWhere` method applies a condition to an `INDArray` and sets the elements that meet the condition to a specified number. If the condition is a static condition, it uses a native execution method. Otherwise, it iterates over the array, checks each element against the condition, and updates the element if the condition is met.

/**
 * Finds the index of the first element in the given array that satisfies the specified condition.
 * 
 * @param array The input array to search.
 * @param condition The condition to check for each element.
 * @return The index of the first element that satisfies the condition, or -1 if no such element exists.
 * @throws UnsupportedOperationException If the condition is not an instance of BaseCondition.
 */
public static INDArray firstIndex(INDArray array, Condition condition) {
    if (!(condition instanceof BaseCondition)) {
        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Only static Conditions are supported");
    }
    FirstIndex idx = new FirstIndex(array, condition);
    Nd4j.getExecutioner().exec(idx);
    return Nd4j.scalar((double) idx.getFinalResult());
}

/**
 * Returns the current device architecture.
 * 
 * @return The current device architecture.
 */
public int getCurrentDeviceArchitecture() {
    int deviceId = Nd4j.getAffinityManager().getDeviceForCurrentThread();
    if (!arch.containsKey(deviceId)) {
        int major = NativeOpsHolder.getInstance().getDeviceNativeOps().getDeviceMajor(new CudaPointer(deviceId));
        int minor = NativeOpsHolder.getInstance().getDeviceNativeOps().getDeviceMinor(new CudaPointer(deviceId));
        Integer cc = Integer.parseInt("" + major + minor);
        arch.put(deviceId, cc);
        return cc;
    }
    return arch.get(deviceId);
}

public static CompressionDescriptor fromByteBuffer(ByteBuffer byteBuffer) {
    CompressionDescriptor compressionDescriptor = new CompressionDescriptor();
    // Read and set compression type
    int compressionTypeOrdinal = byteBuffer.getInt();
    CompressionType compressionType = CompressionType.values()[compressionTypeOrdinal];
    compressionDescriptor.setCompressionType(compressionType);
    
    // Read and set compression algorithm
    int compressionAlgoOrdinal = byteBuffer.getInt();
    CompressionAlgorithm compressionAlgorithm = CompressionAlgorithm.values()[compressionAlgoOrdinal];
    compressionDescriptor.setCompressionAlgorithm(compressionAlgorithm.name());
    
    // Read and set other long values
    compressionDescriptor.setOriginalLength(byteBuffer.getLong());
    compressionDescriptor.setCompressedLength(byteBuffer.getLong());
    compressionDescriptor.setNumberOfElements(byteBuffer.getLong());
    compressionDescriptor.setOriginalElementSize(byteBuffer.getLong());
    
    return compressionDescriptor;
}

/**
 * Splits a list into batches of a specified size.
 *
 * @param <U>        the type of elements in the list
 * @param list       the list to be split
 * @param partitionSize the size of each batch
 * @return a list of batches, where each batch is a list of elements
 */
public static <U extends Aggregate> List<Batch<U>> getBatches(List<U> list, int partitionSize) {
    List<List<U>> partitions = Lists.partition(list, partitionSize);
    List<Batch<U>> split = new ArrayList<>();
    for (List<U> partition : partitions) {

    }

}

3797	```java
protected static void validateConcat(int dimension, INDArray... arrs) {
    if (arrs[0].isScalar()) {
        for (int i = 1; i < arrs.length; i++) {
            if (!arrs[i].isScalar()) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("All arrays must have the same dimensions");
            }
        }
    } else {
        int dims = arrs[0].shape().length;
        long[] shape = ArrayUtil.removeIndex(arrs[0].shape(), dimension);
        for (int i = 1; i < arrs.length; i++) {
            assert Arrays.equals(shape, ArrayUtil.removeIndex(arrs[i].shape(), dimension));
            assert arrs[i].shape().length == dims;
        }
    }
}
```

3822	```java
/**
 * Splits a string into an array of substrings based on a specified separator.
 * 
 * @param str The string to be split.
 * @param separator The character used as the separator.
 * @return An array of substrings.
 */
public static String[] split(String str, char separator) {
    if (str.isEmpty()) {
        return new String[] { "" };
    }
    
    ArrayList<String> strList = new ArrayList<>();
    int startIndex = 0;
    int nextIndex = 0;
    
    while ((nextIndex = str.indexOf(separator, startIndex)) != -1) {
        strList.add(str.substring(startIndex, nextIndex));
        startIndex = nextIndex + 1;
    }
    
    strList.add(str.substring(startIndex));
    
    // Remove trailing empty splits
    int last = strList.size();
    while (--last >= 0 && "".equals(strList.get(last))) {
        strList.remove(last);
    }
    
    return strList.toArray(new String[strList.size()]);
}
```

 * @return true if the device side has equal or greater access than the host side, false otherwise.
 */
public boolean isActualOnDeviceSide() {
    boolean result = accessDeviceWrite.get() >= accessHostWrite.get() || accessDeviceRead.get() >= accessHostWrite.get();
    return result;
}

3835	```java
/**
 * Checks if the given DataBuffer represents a vector.
 * 
 * @param shapeInfo The DataBuffer containing shape information.
 * @return true if the shapeInfo represents a vector, false otherwise.
 */
public static boolean isVector(DataBuffer shapeInfo) {
    int rank = Shape.rank(shapeInfo);
    if (rank > 2 || rank < 1) {
        return false;
    } else {
        int len = Shape.length(shapeInfo);
        DataBuffer shape = Shape.shapeOf(shapeInfo);
        return shape.getInt(0) == len || shape.getInt(1) == len;
    }
}

3840	```java
@Override
public DataBuffer reallocate(long length) {
    Pointer oldPointer = pointer;
    if (isAttached()) {
        long capacity = length * getElementSize();
        switch (dataType()) {
            case DOUBLE:
                pointer = getParentWorkspace().alloc(capacity, Type.DOUBLE, false).asDoublePointer();
                indexer = DoubleIndexer.create((DoublePointer) pointer);
                break;
            case FLOAT:
                pointer = getParentWorkspace().alloc(capacity, Type.FLOAT, false).asFloatPointer();
                indexer = FloatIndexer.create((FloatPointer) pointer);
                break;
            case INT:
                pointer = getParentWorkspace().alloc(capacity, Type.INT, false).asIntPointer();
                indexer = IntIndexer.create((IntPointer) pointer);
                break;
        }
        workspaceGenerationId = getParentWorkspace().getGenerationId();
    } else {
        switch (dataType()) {
            case INT:
                pointer = new IntPointer(length);
                indexer = IntIndexer.create((IntPointer) pointer);
                break;
            case DOUBLE:
                pointer = new DoublePointer(length);
                indexer = DoubleIndexer.create((DoublePointer) pointer);
                break;
            case FLOAT:
                pointer = new FloatPointer(length);
                indexer = FloatIndexer.create((FloatPointer) pointer);
                break;
        }
    }
    Pointer.memcpy(pointer, oldPointer, this.length() * getElementSize());
    // this.underlyingLength = length;
    return this;
}
```

**Summary:**
The `reallocate` method in the provided code is designed to resize a `DataBuffer` object. It first checks if the buffer is attached to a workspace. If it is, it allocates new memory of the specified length and copies the old data to the new memory. If the buffer is not attached, it simply allocates new memory without copying the old data. The method then updates the buffer's pointer, indexer, and workspace generation ID accordingly.

@Override
public DataSet next() {
    if (!iter.hasNext() && passes < numPasses) {
        passes++;
        batch = 0;
        log.info("Epoch " + passes + " batch " + batch);
        iter.reset();
    }
    batch++;
    DataSet next = iter.next();
    if (preProcessor != null) preProcessor.preProcess(next);
    return next;
}
```

**Summary:**
The `next` method iterates through a dataset in batches. If there are no more elements in the current batch and the number of passes is less than the total number of passes, it increments the pass count, resets the iterator, and logs the new epoch and batch. It then increments the batch count, retrieves the next dataset, and preprocesses it if a preprocessor is available. Finally, it returns the preprocessed dataset.
3856	```java
/**
 * Performs QR decomposition on a matrix using LAPACK's sgeqrf and sorgqr functions.
 * 
 * @param M The number of rows in the matrix A.
 * @param N The number of columns in the matrix A.
 * @param A The input matrix to be decomposed.
 * @param R The output matrix to store the upper triangular matrix R.
 * @param INFO The output array to store the status of the operation.
 */
@Override
public void sgeqrf(int M, int N, INDArray A, INDArray R, INDArray INFO) {
    INDArray tau = Nd4j.create(N);
    int status = LAPACKE_sgeqrf(getColumnOrder(A), M, N, (FloatPointer) A.data().addressPointer(), getLda(A), (FloatPointer) tau.data().addressPointer());
    if (status != 0) {
        throw new BlasException("Failed to execute sgeqrf", status);
    }
    if (R != null) {
        R.assign(A.get(NDArrayIndex.interval(0, A.columns()), NDArrayIndex.all()));
        INDArrayIndex[] ix = new INDArrayIndex[2];
        for (int i = 1; i < Math.min(A.rows(), A.columns()); i++) {
            ix[0] = NDArrayIndex.point(i);
            ix[1] = NDArrayIndex.interval(0, i);
            R.put(ix, 0);
        }
    }
    status = LAPACKE_sorgqr(getColumnOrder(A), M, N, N, (FloatPointer) A.data().addressPointer(), getLda(A), (FloatPointer) tau.data().addressPointer());
    if (status != 0) {
        throw new BlasException("Failed to execute sorgqr", status);
    }
}
```

3860	```java
protected void sweepTail() {
    Integer deviceId = allocator.getDeviceId();
    int cnt = 0;
    long lastCommandId = deviceClocks.get(deviceId).get();
    for (int l = 0; l < configuration.getCommandLanesNumber(); l++) {
        Queue<cudaEvent_t> queue = eventsBarrier.get(deviceId).get(l);
        if (queue.size() >= MAX_EXECUTION_QUEUE || laneClocks.get(deviceId).get(l).get() < lastCommandId - MAX_EXECUTION_QUEUE) {
            cudaEvent_t event = queue.poll();
            if (event != null && !event.isDestroyed()) {
                event.synchronize();
                event.destroy();
                cnt++;
            }
        }
    }
    deviceClocks.get(deviceId).incrementAndGet();
    // log.info("Events sweeped: [{}]", cnt);
}
```

**Summary:**
The `sweepTail` method is designed to manage and clean up events in a specific device's command lanes. It iterates through each lane, checking if the queue size exceeds a maximum execution queue size or if the lane clock is behind the last command ID by a certain margin. If either condition is met, it removes and destroys events from the queue, incrementing a counter for each destroyed event. Finally, it increments the device clock to reflect the cleanup.

@Override
public INDArray createFromNpyFile(File file) {
    byte[] pathBytes = file.getAbsolutePath().getBytes(Charset.forName("UTF-8"));
    ByteBuffer directBuffer = ByteBuffer.allocateDirect(pathBytes.length).order(ByteOrder.nativeOrder());
    directBuffer.put(pathBytes);
    directBuffer.rewind();
    Pointer pointer = nativeOps.numpyFromFile(new BytePointer(directBuffer));
    INDArray result = createFromNpyPointer(pointer);
    nativeOps.releaseNumpy(pointer);
    return result;
}

3866	```java
@Override
public Op exec(Op op) {
    // Pass the op to GridProcessor for possible MetaOp concatenation and as the GridOp entry point
    checkForCompression(op);
    invokeWatchdog(op);

    if (op instanceof Accumulation) {
        exec((Accumulation) op, new int[] { Integer.MAX_VALUE });
    } else if (op instanceof IndexAccumulation) {
        exec((IndexAccumulation) op, new int[] { Integer.MAX_VALUE });
    } else if (op instanceof ScalarOp || op instanceof TransformOp) {
        // Entry point for TADless ops
        processAsGridOp(op);
    } else if (op instanceof BroadcastOp) {
        invoke((BroadcastOp) op);
    } else {
        // Handle random ops
        pushToGrid(new OpDescriptor(op));
    }

    return op;
}
```

3871	```java
/**
 * Returns the next available CUDA device for a given thread ID.
 * If forced to use a single GPU, it returns that GPU.
 * Otherwise, it uses a round-robin approach to distribute devices among threads.
 * 
 * @param threadId The ID of the thread requesting a device.
 * @return The ID of the next available CUDA device.
 */
protected Integer getNextDevice(long threadId) {
    Integer device = null;
    if (!CudaEnvironment.getInstance().getConfiguration().isForcedSingleGPU() && getNumberOfDevices() > 0) {
        synchronized (this) {
            device = CudaEnvironment.getInstance().getConfiguration().getAvailableDevices().get(devPtr.getAndIncrement());
            if (devPtr.get() >= CudaEnvironment.getInstance().getConfiguration().getAvailableDevices().size()) {
                devPtr.set(0);
            }
            logger.debug("Mapping thread [{}] to device [{}], out of [{}] devices...", threadId, device, CudaEnvironment.getInstance().getConfiguration().getAvailableDevices().size());
        }
    } else {
        device = CudaEnvironment.getInstance().getConfiguration().getAvailableDevices().get(0);
        logger.debug("Single device is forced, mapping to device [{}]", device);
    }
    return device;
}

3873	```java
/**
 * Determines the architecture type based on the system's architecture.
 * 
 * @return The architecture type as an ARCHType enum.
 */
public static ARCHType calculateArch() {
    String osArch = System.getProperty("os.arch").toLowerCase(Locale.ENGLISH);
    if (osArch.equals("i386") || osArch.equals("x86") || osArch.equals("i686")) {
        return ARCHType.X86;
    }
    if (osArch.startsWith("amd64") || osArch.startsWith("x86_64")) {
        return ARCHType.X86_64;
    }
    if (osArch.equals("ppc") || osArch.equals("powerpc")) {
        return ARCHType.PPC;
    }
    if (osArch.startsWith("ppc")) {
        return ARCHType.PPC_64;
    }
    if (osArch.startsWith("sparc")) {
        return ARCHType.SPARC;
    }
    if (osArch.startsWith("arm")) {
        return ARCHType.ARM;
    }
    if (osArch.startsWith("mips")) {
        return ARCHType.MIPS;
    }
    if (osArch.contains("risc")) {
        return ARCHType.RISC;
    }
    return ARCHType.UNKNOWN;
}
```

3904	```markdown
### Summary of the `tan` method

The `tan` method calculates the tangent of a `BigDecimal` number `x`. It handles special cases for zero and negative inputs, reduces the input modulo π, and then uses a series expansion to compute the tangent. The method ensures high precision by adjusting the number of terms in the series based on the input value and the error estimate.

1. **Special Cases**:
   - If `x` is zero, it returns zero.
   - If `x` is negative, it returns the negative of the tangent of the positive counterpart.

2. **Reduction Modulo π**:
   - The input `x` is reduced modulo π to ensure the argument is within one period of the tangent function.

3. **Error Estimation**:
   - The method estimates the absolute error in the result using the formula `err(x)/cos^2(x)`.

4. **Series Expansion**:
   - For large values of `x` (greater than 0.8), it uses the identity `tan(x) = 1/cot(x)` to compute the tangent.
   - For smaller values of `x`, it uses a series expansion involving Bernoulli numbers to compute the tangent.

5. **Precision Adjustment**:
   - The number of terms in the series is adjusted based on the input value and the error estimate to ensure the desired precision.

6. **Final Result**:
   - The result is rounded to the appropriate precision using the `MathContext` class.

### Example Usage

```java
BigDecimal x = new BigDecimal("0.5");
BigDecimal result = tan(x);
System.out.println(result); // Output: 0.5463024898437905
```

This method provides a robust and accurate way to compute the tangent of a `BigDecimal` number, handling various edge cases and ensuring high precision.

/**
 * Computes the hyperbolic cosine of a BigDecimal number.
 * 
 * @param x The input BigDecimal number.
 * @return The hyperbolic cosine of the input number.
 */
static public BigDecimal cosh(final BigDecimal x) {
    if (x.compareTo(BigDecimal.ZERO) < 0) {
        return cos(x.negate());
    } else if (x.compareTo(BigDecimal.ZERO) == 0) {
        return BigDecimal.ONE;
    } else {
        if (x.doubleValue() > 1.5) {
            return hypot(1, sinh(x));
        } else {
            BigDecimal xhighpr = scalePrec(x, 2);
            BigDecimal resul = BigDecimal.ONE;
            BigDecimal xpowi = BigDecimal.ONE;
            BigInteger ifac = BigInteger.ONE;
            double xUlpDbl = 0.5 * x.ulp().doubleValue() * x.doubleValue();
            int k = (int)(Math.log(xUlpDbl) / Math.log(x.doubleValue())) / 2;
            MathContext mcTay = new MathContext(err2prec(1., xUlpDbl / k));
            for (int i = 1; ; i++) {
                ifac = ifac.multiply(BigInteger.valueOf(2 * i - 1));
                ifac = ifac.multiply(BigInteger.valueOf(2 * i));
                xpowi = xpowi.multiply(xhighpr).multiply(xhighpr);
                BigDecimal corr = xpowi.divide(new BigDecimal(ifac), mcTay);
                resul = resul.add(corr);
                if (corr.abs().doubleValue() < 0.5 * xUlpDbl) {
                    break;
                }
            }
            MathContext mc = new MathContext(err2prec(resul.doubleValue(), xUlpDbl));
            return resul.round(mc);
        }
    }
}

3906	```java
static public BigDecimal sinh(final BigDecimal x) {
    if (x.compareTo(BigDecimal.ZERO) < 0) {
        return sinh(x.negate()).negate();
    } else if (x.compareTo(BigDecimal.ZERO) == 0) {
        return BigDecimal.ZERO;
    } else {
        if (x.doubleValue() > 2.4) {
            BigDecimal two = new BigDecimal(2);
            BigDecimal xhalf = x.divide(two);
            BigDecimal result = sinh(xhalf).multiply(cosh(xhalf)).multiply(two);
            double eps = Math.tanh(x.doubleValue());
            MathContext mc = new MathContext(err2prec(0.5 * x.ulp().doubleValue() / eps));
            return result.round(mc);
        } else {
            BigDecimal xhighpr = scalePrec(x, 2);
            BigDecimal result = xhighpr;
            BigDecimal xpowi = xhighpr;
            BigInteger ifac = BigInteger.ONE;
            double xUlpDbl = x.ulp().doubleValue();
            int k = (int)(x.precision() / Math.log10(1.0 / xhighpr.doubleValue())) / 2;
            MathContext mcTay = new MathContext(err2prec(x.doubleValue(), xUlpDbl / k));
            for (int i = 1; ; i++) {
                ifac = ifac.multiply(BigInteger.valueOf(2 * i));
                ifac = ifac.multiply(BigInteger.valueOf(2 * i + 1));
                xpowi = xpowi.multiply(xhighpr).multiply(xhighpr);
                BigDecimal corr = xpowi.divide(new BigDecimal(ifac), mcTay);
                result = result.add(corr);
                if (corr.abs().doubleValue() < 0.5 * xUlpDbl) {
                    break;
                }
            }
            MathContext mc = new MathContext(x.precision());
            return result.round(mc);
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Computes the hyperbolic tangent of a BigDecimal number.
 * 
 * @param x The input BigDecimal number.
 * @return The hyperbolic tangent of the input number.
 */
static public BigDecimal tanh(final BigDecimal x) {
    if (x.compareTo(BigDecimal.ZERO) < 0) {
        return tanh(x.negate()).negate();
    } else if (x.compareTo(BigDecimal.ZERO) == 0) {
        return BigDecimal.ZERO;
    } else {
        BigDecimal xhighpr = scalePrec(x, 2);
        BigDecimal exp2x = exp(xhighpr.multiply(new BigDecimal(-2)));
        double eps = 0.5 * x.ulp().doubleValue() / Math.pow(Math.cosh(x.doubleValue()), 2.0);
        MathContext mc = new MathContext(err2prec(Math.tanh(x.doubleValue()), eps));
        return BigDecimal.ONE.subtract(exp2x).divide(BigDecimal.ONE.add(exp2x), mc);
    }
}

3911	```java
static protected BigDecimal broadhurstBBP(final int n, final int p, final int a[], MathContext mc) {
    // Estimate the magnitude of the result using a quick calculation.
    double x = 0.0;
    for (int k = 1; k < 10; k++) {
        x += a[(k - 1) % 8] / Math.pow(2., p * (k + 1) / 2) / Math.pow((double) k, n);
    }

    // Convert the relative precision and estimate into an absolute precision.
    double eps = prec2err(x, mc.getPrecision());

    // Adjust the error estimate to account for error accumulation in the sum.
    int kmax = (int)(6.6 * mc.getPrecision() / p);
    eps /= kmax;

    BigDecimal res = BigDecimal.ZERO;
    for (int c = 0; ; c++) {
        Rational r = new Rational();
        for (int k = 0; k < 8; k++) {
            Rational tmp = new Rational(BigInteger.valueOf(a[k]), BigInteger.valueOf(1 + 8 * c + k).pow(n));
            int pk1h = p * (2 + 8 * c + k) / 2;
            tmp = tmp.divide(BigInteger.ONE.shiftLeft(pk1h));
            r = r.add(tmp);
        }
        if (Math.abs(r.doubleValue()) < eps) {
            break;
        }
        MathContext mcloc = new MathContext(1 + err2prec(r.doubleValue(), eps));
        res = res.add(r.BigDecimalValue(mcloc));
    }
    return res.round(mc);
}
```

**Summary:**
The `broadhurstBBP` method calculates a `BigDecimal` value using the BBP (Bailey–Borwein–Plouffe) formula. It first estimates the magnitude of the result, then converts the relative precision into an absolute precision. The method iteratively refines the result by summing terms until the error is below a specified threshold. Each term is calculated using a `Rational` number to maintain precision, and the final result is rounded according to the provided `MathContext`.

public void addOutgoingFor(String[] varNames, DifferentialFunction function) {
    if (function.getOwnName() == null) {

        throw new ND4JIllegalStateException("Outgoing arguments already declared for " + function);

            throw new ND4JIllegalStateException("Variable name elements can not be null!");
        }

    outgoingArgsReverse.put(function.getOwnName(), varNames);
    outgoingArgs.put(varNames, function);

        List<DifferentialFunction> funcs = functionOutputFor.get(resultName);
        if (funcs == null) {
            funcs = new ArrayList<>();
            functionOutputFor.put(resultName, funcs);

        funcs.add(function);

}

public void addArgsFor(String[] variables, DifferentialFunction function) {

            placeHolderFunctions.add(function.getOwnName());

        List<DifferentialFunction> funcs = functionsArgsFor.get(variableName);
        if (funcs == null) {
            funcs = new ArrayList<>();

3939	```java
@Override
public Pointer allocate(long bytes, MemoryKind kind, boolean initialize) {
    AtomicAllocator allocator = AtomicAllocator.getInstance();
    
    if (kind == MemoryKind.HOST) {
        Pointer ptr = NativeOpsHolder.getInstance().getDeviceNativeOps().mallocHost(bytes, 0);
        if (ptr == null) throw new RuntimeException("Failed to allocate " + bytes + " bytes from HOST memory");
        if (initialize) Pointer.memset(ptr, 0, bytes);
        return ptr;
    } else if (kind == MemoryKind.DEVICE) {
        Pointer ptr = NativeOpsHolder.getInstance().getDeviceNativeOps().mallocDevice(bytes, null, 0);
        if (ptr == null) throw new RuntimeException("Failed to allocate " + bytes + " bytes from DEVICE [" + Nd4j.getAffinityManager().getDeviceForCurrentThread() + "] memory");
        if (initialize) {
            CudaContext context = (CudaContext) AtomicAllocator.getInstance().getDeviceContext().getContext();
            int i = NativeOpsHolder.getInstance().getDeviceNativeOps().memsetAsync(ptr, 0, bytes, 0, context.getSpecialStream());
            if (i == 0) throw new ND4JIllegalStateException("memset failed on device_" + Nd4j.getAffinityManager().getDeviceForCurrentThread());
            context.getSpecialStream().synchronize();
        }
        return ptr;
    } else {
        throw new RuntimeException("Unknown MemoryKind requested: " + kind);
    }
}
```

        case DOUBLE: return 8;
        case FLOAT: return 4;
        case INT: return 4;
        case HALF: return 2;
        case LONG: return 8;
        case COMPRESSED:

@Override
public void trmv(char order, char Uplo, char TransA, char Diag, INDArray A, INDArray X) {

        OpProfiler.getInstance().processBlasCall(false, A, X);
    }

        DefaultOpExecutioner.validateDataType(DataBuffer.Type.DOUBLE, A, X);
        dtrmv(order, Uplo, TransA, Diag, (int) X.length(), A, (int) A.size(0), X, X.majorStride());

        strmv(order, Uplo, TransA, Diag, (int) X.length(), A, (int) A.size(0), X, X.majorStride());
    }

    OpExecutionerUtil.checkForAny(X);
}

@Override
public void synchronizeHostData(DataBuffer buffer) {

        return;
    }
    // Perform synchronization only in device-dependent environments
    if (memoryHandler.isDeviceDependant()) {
        AllocationPoint point = getAllocationPoint(buffer.getTrackingPoint());
        if (point == null) {
            throw new RuntimeException("AllocationPoint is NULL");
        }
        memoryHandler.synchronizeThreadDevice(Thread.currentThread().getId(), memoryHandler.getDeviceId(), point);
    }
}

3964	```java
/**
 * Applies the updater to the given gradient.
 * 
 * @param gradient The gradient to be updated.
 * @param iteration The current iteration number.
 * @param epoch The current epoch number.
 */
@Override
public void applyUpdater(INDArray gradient, int iteration, int epoch) {
    if (historicalGradient == null) {
        throw new IllegalStateException("Updater has not been initialized with view state");
    }
    
    double learningRate = config.getLearningRate(iteration, epoch);
    double epsilon = config.getEpsilon();
    
    historicalGradient.addi(gradient.mul(gradient));
    
    INDArray sqrtHistory = sqrt(historicalGradient.dup(gradientReshapeOrder), false).addi(epsilon);
    
    gradient.muli(sqrtHistory.rdivi(learningRate));
}
```

3970	```java
public String format(INDArray arr, boolean summarize) {
    // Initialize scientific format and precision
    this.scientificFormat = "0.";
    int addPrecision = this.precision;
    while (addPrecision > 0) {
        this.scientificFormat += "#";
        addPrecision -= 1;
    }
    this.scientificFormat += "E0";

    // Adjust padding if necessary
    if (this.scientificFormat.length() + 2 > this.padding) {
        this.padding = this.scientificFormat.length() + 2;
    }

    // Set thresholds for switching to scientific notation
    this.maxToPrintWithoutSwitching = Math.pow(10, this.precision);
    this.minToPrintWithoutSwitching = 1.0 / (this.maxToPrintWithoutSwitching);

    // If summarize is true and array length is greater than 1000, recursively call format with summarize set to false
    if (summarize && arr.length() > 1000) {
        return format(arr, 0, true);
    }

    // Otherwise, recursively call format with summarize set to false
    return format(arr, 0, false);
}
```

@Override
public IComplexNDArray subi(INDArray other, INDArray result) {
    IComplexNDArray cOther = (IComplexNDArray) other;
    IComplexNDArray cResult = (IComplexNDArray) result;

    if (other.isScalar()) {
        return subi(cOther.getComplex(0), result);
    }

    if (result == this) {
        Nd4j.getBlasWrapper().axpy(Nd4j.NEG_UNIT, cOther, cResult);
    } else if (result == other) {
        if (data.dataType() == DataBuffer.Type.DOUBLE) {
            Nd4j.getBlasWrapper().scal(Nd4j.NEG_UNIT.asDouble(), cResult);
            Nd4j.getBlasWrapper().axpy(Nd4j.UNIT, this, cResult);
        } else {
            Nd4j.getBlasWrapper().scal(Nd4j.NEG_UNIT.asFloat(), cResult);
            Nd4j.getBlasWrapper().axpy(Nd4j.UNIT, this, cResult);
        }
    } else {
        Nd4j.getBlasWrapper().copy(this, result);
        Nd4j.getBlasWrapper().axpy(Nd4j.NEG_UNIT, cOther, cResult);
    }

    return cResult;
}
```

**Summary:**
The `subi` method performs an in-place subtraction of another `INDArray` from the current `INDArray` and stores the result in the provided `result` array. If the `result` array is the same as the current array, it uses the `axpy` method with a negative unit scalar. If the `result` array is the same as the `other` array, it first scales the `result` array with a negative unit scalar and then adds the current array. If the `result` array is different from both the current and `other` arrays, it first copies the current array to the `result` array and then performs the subtraction. The method returns the `result` array after the operation.

@Override
public IComplexNDArray addi(INDArray other, INDArray result) {
    IComplexNDArray cOther = (IComplexNDArray) other;
    IComplexNDArray cResult = (IComplexNDArray) result;

    if (cOther.isScalar()) {
        return cResult.addi(cOther.getComplex(0), result);
    }
    if (isScalar()) {
        return cOther.addi(getComplex(0), result);
    }

    if (result == this) {
        Nd4j.getBlasWrapper().axpy(Nd4j.UNIT, cOther, cResult);
    } else if (result == other) {
        Nd4j.getBlasWrapper().axpy(Nd4j.UNIT, this, cResult);
    } else {
        INDArray resultLinear = result.linearView();
        INDArray otherLinear = other.linearView();
        INDArray linear = linearView();

        for (int i = 0; i < resultLinear.length(); i++) {
            resultLinear.putScalar(i, otherLinear.getDouble(i) + linear.getDouble(i));
        }
    }

    return (IComplexNDArray) result;
}
```

**Summary:**
The `addi` method adds the elements of another `INDArray` to the current `INDArray` and stores the result in a specified `result` array. If either the current array or the other array is a scalar, it performs the addition directly. If the result array is the same as the current array, it uses BLAS's `axpy` function for efficient addition. If the result array is the same as the other array, it also uses `axpy`. Otherwise, it iterates through the elements, adding corresponding elements from the other array and the current array, and stores the result in the result array. The method returns the result array cast to `IComplexNDArray`.
3986	The `assign` method takes a `Number` value as input and assigns it to all elements of the `IComplexNDArray` object. It creates a linear view of the array and then iterates over each element, setting it to the specified value with an imaginary part of 0. Finally, it returns the modified array.
3987	The `ravel` method in the provided code is designed to flatten a complex N-dimensional array into a one-dimensional array. Here's a summary of the method:

1. **Check Length**: The method first checks if the length of the array is greater than or equal to `Integer.MAX_VALUE`. If it is, it throws an `IllegalArgumentException` because the length cannot be so large.

2. **Create New Array**: It creates a new complex N-dimensional array (`ret`) with a length equal to the current array's length and the same ordering.

3. **Linear View**: It obtains a linear view of the current array (`linear`), which allows accessing elements in a flattened manner.

4. **Copy Elements**: It iterates through each element of the linear view and copies it to the new array (`ret`) using the `putScalar` method.

5. **Return Result**: Finally, it returns the new one-dimensional complex array.

In summary, the `ravel` method flattens a complex N-dimensional array into a one-dimensional array while ensuring the length does not exceed `Integer.MAX_VALUE`.

/**
 * Computes the eigenvalues of a square matrix.
 *
 * @param A The input square matrix.
 * @return A complex number array containing the eigenvalues of the matrix.
 */
public static IComplexNDArray eigenvalues(INDArray A) {
    assert A.rows() == A.columns();
    INDArray WR = Nd4j.create(A.rows(), A.rows());
    INDArray WI = WR.dup();
    Nd4j.getBlasWrapper().geev(' ', ' ', A.dup(), WR, WI, dummy, dummy);
    return Nd4j.createComplex(WR, WI);
}

/**
 * Computes the symmetric generalized eigenvalues of two square matrices A and B.
 * 
 * @param A The first square matrix.
 * @param B The second square matrix.
 * @return An INDArray containing the symmetric generalized eigenvalues.
 * 
 * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the input matrices are not square or if they are not of the same size.
 */
public static INDArray symmetricGeneralizedEigenvalues(INDArray A, INDArray B) {
    // Ensure the input matrices are square and of the same size
    assert A.rows() == A.columns();
    assert B.rows() == B.columns();
    
    // Create an INDArray to store the eigenvalues
    INDArray W = Nd4j.create(A.rows());
    
    // Invert matrix B and multiply it with matrix A
    A = InvertMatrix.invert(B, false).mmuli(A);
    
    // Compute the symmetric generalized eigenvalues using the syev method
    Nd4j.getBlasWrapper().syev(' ', ' ', A, W);
    
    // Return the eigenvalues
    return W;
}

3995	```java
/**
 * Reduces the loss by applying a specified reduction method.
 *
 * @param sd The SameDiff object containing the operations.
 * @param outputName The name of the output variable.
 * @param isMean Whether to compute the mean or sum.
 * @param b The LossInfo.Builder to build the loss information.
 * @param reduction The reduction method to apply.
 * @param preReduceLoss The pre-reduced loss variable.
 * @param label The label variable.
 * @param weights The weight variable.
 * @param dimensions The dimensions to reduce along.
 * @return The built LossInfo object.
 */
private static LossInfo doReduce(SameDiff sd, String outputName, boolean isMean, LossInfo.Builder b, Reduction reduction, SDVariable preReduceLoss, SDVariable label, SDVariable weights, int[] dimensions) {
    switch (reduction) {
        case NONE:
            b.loss(preReduceLoss);
            break;
        case SPECIFIED_DIMS:
            if (isMean) {
                b.loss(sd.mean(outputName, preReduceLoss, dimensions));
            } else {
                b.loss(sd.sum(outputName, preReduceLoss, dimensions));
            }
            break;
        case SUM:
            if (isMean) {
                SDVariable m = sd.mean(preReduceLoss, dimensions);
                b.loss(sd.sum(outputName, m));
            } else {
                b.loss(sd.sum(outputName, preReduceLoss));
            }
            break;
        case MEAN_BY_WEIGHT:
            SDVariable weightSum = sd.sum(weights);
            if (isMean) {
                SDVariable m2 = sd.mean(preReduceLoss);
                b.loss(m2.div(outputName, weightSum));
            } else {
                SDVariable sum = sd.sum(preReduceLoss, dimensions);
                b.loss(sum.div(outputName, weightSum));
            }
            break;
        case MEAN_BY_COUNT:
            SDVariable nonZeroWeights = nonZeroCount(weights, label);
            SDVariable r;
            if (isMean) {
                r = sd.sum(preReduceLoss);
            } else {
                SDVariable sum = sd.sum(preReduceLoss, dimensions);
                r = sd.mean(sum);
            }
            b.loss(r.div(outputName, nonZeroWeights));
            break;
        default:
            throw new RuntimeException("Unknown reduction: " + reduction);
    }
    return b.build();
}
```

/**
 * Retrieves the no-argument constructor for a given class.
 * 
 * @param <T> the type of the class
 * @param clazz the class to retrieve the constructor for
 * @return the no-argument constructor of the class
 * @throws IllegalStateException if the class is a nonstatic inner class, anonymous class, or local class without a no-argument constructor
 */
public static <T> Constructor<T> getNoArgConstructor(Class<T> clazz) {
    try {
        Constructor<T> ctor = clazz.getDeclaredConstructor(new Class[0]);
        ctor.setAccessible(true);
        return ctor;
    } catch (NoSuchMethodException e) {
        if (clazz.isMemberClass() || clazz.isAnonymousClass() || clazz.isLocalClass()) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(clazz.getName() + " must be static and must have a no-arg constructor", e);
        } else {
            throw new IllegalStateException(clazz.getName() + " must have a no-arg constructor", e);
        }
    }
}

public static String msg(Path path, String msg) {
    StringBuilder bld = new StringBuilder();
    bld.append("\t.");
    bld.append(path.toPathString());
    if (bld.length() < PATH_PADDING) {
        while (bld.length() < PATH_PADDING) {
            bld.append(' ');
        }
    } else {
        bld.append(' ');
    }
    bld.append(msg);
    return bld.toString();
}

4021	```java
/**
 * Determines if the given `subType` is a subtype of `superType`.
 *
 * @param superType the potential supertype
 * @param subType the potential subtype
 * @return true if `subType` is a subtype of `superType`, false otherwise
 */
public static boolean isSuperType(Type superType, Type subType) {
    // Erase the type to a raw type if it's parameterized or a generic array type
    Class<?> superClass = erase(superType);
    Type mappedSubType = getExactSuperType(capture(subType), superClass);

    if (mappedSubType == null) {
        return false;
    } else if (superType instanceof Class<?>) {
        return true;
    } else if (mappedSubType instanceof Class<?>) {
        // TODO: Handle supertype by being raw type differently ("supertype, but with warnings")
        return true; // class has no parameters, or it's a raw type
    } else if (mappedSubType instanceof GenericArrayType) {
        Type superComponentType = getArrayComponentType(superType);
        Type mappedSubComponentType = getArrayComponentType(mappedSubType);
        return isSuperType(superComponentType, mappedSubComponentType);
    } else {
        assert mappedSubType instanceof ParameterizedType;
        ParameterizedType pMappedSubType = (ParameterizedType) mappedSubType;
        ParameterizedType pSuperType = (ParameterizedType) superType;
        Type[] superTypeArgs = pSuperType.getActualTypeArguments();
        Type[] subTypeArgs = pMappedSubType.getActualTypeArguments();
        assert superTypeArgs.length == subTypeArgs.length;
        for (int i = 0; i < superTypeArgs.length; i++) {
            if (!contains(superTypeArgs[i], subTypeArgs[i])) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        // Params of the class itself match, so if the owner types are supertypes too, it's a supertype.
        return pSuperType.getOwnerType() == null || isSuperType(pSuperType.getOwnerType(), pMappedSubType.getOwnerType());
    }
}
```
4022	```java
/**
 * Retrieves the exact direct super types of a given type.
 *
 * @param type The type for which to retrieve the exact direct super types.
 * @return An array of types representing the exact direct super types of the given type.
 */
private static Type[] getExactDirectSuperTypes(Type type) {
    if (type instanceof ParameterizedType || type instanceof Class) {
        Class<?> clazz;
        if (type instanceof ParameterizedType) {
            clazz = (Class<?>) ((ParameterizedType) type).getRawType();
        } else {
            clazz = (Class<?>) type;
            if (clazz.isArray()) {
                return getArrayExactDirectSuperTypes(clazz);
            }
        }

        Type[] superInterfaces = clazz.getGenericInterfaces();
        Type superClass = clazz.getGenericSuperclass();

        // Handle the case where the type is an interface without superinterfaces
        if (superClass == null && superInterfaces.length == 0 && clazz.isInterface()) {
            return new Type[] { Object.class };
        }

        Type[] result;
        int resultIndex;
        if (superClass == null) {
            result = new Type[superInterfaces.length];
            resultIndex = 0;
        } else {
            result = new Type[superInterfaces.length + 1];
            resultIndex = 1;
            result[0] = mapTypeParameters(superClass, type);
        }

        for (Type superInterface : superInterfaces) {
            result[resultIndex++] = mapTypeParameters(superInterface, type);
        }

        return result;
    } else if (type instanceof TypeVariable) {
        TypeVariable<?> tv = (TypeVariable<?>) type;
        return tv.getBounds();
    } else if (type instanceof WildcardType) {
        return ((WildcardType) type).getUpperBounds();
    } else if (type instanceof CaptureType) {
        return ((CaptureType) type).getUpperBounds();
    } else if (type instanceof GenericArrayType) {
        return getArrayExactDirectSuperTypes(type);
    } else if (type == null) {
        throw new NullPointerException();
    } else {
        throw new RuntimeException("not implemented type: " + type);
    }
}

4030	```java
/**
 * Retrieves a result for a given key.
 * 
 * @param key The key for which the result is to be retrieved.
 * @return The result associated with the key.
 */
public <T> Result<T> get(final Key<T> key) {
    assert !isExecuted();
    SessionValue<T> sv = getSession().get(key);
    if (sv == null) {
        log.trace("Adding to round (session miss): {}", key);
        this.pending.add(key.getRaw());
        Result<T> result = new ResultCache<T>() {
            @Override
            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
            public T nowUncached() {
                loadEngine.execute();
                return (T) translated.now().get(key);
            }

            @Override
            public String toString() {
                return "(Fetch result for " + key + ")";
            }
        };
        sv = new SessionValue<>(result, getLoadArrangement());
        getSession().add(key, sv);
    } else {
        log.trace("Adding to round (session hit): {}", key);
        if (sv.loadWith(getLoadArrangement())) {
            log.trace("New load group arrangement, checking for upgrades: {}", getLoadArrangement());
            T thing = sv.getResult().now();
            if (thing != null) {
                SaveContext saveCtx = new SaveContext() {
                    @Override
                    public boolean skipLifecycle() {
                        return true;
                    }

                    @Override
                    public com.google.cloud.datastore.Key saveRef(Ref<?> value, LoadConditions loadConditions) {
                        com.google.cloud.datastore.Key key = super.saveRef(value, loadConditions);
                        if (loadEngine.shouldLoad(loadConditions)) {
                            log.trace("Upgrading key {}", key);
                            loadEngine.load(value.key());
                        }
                        return key;
                    }
                };
                loadEngine.ofy.factory().getMetadataForEntity(thing).save(thing, saveCtx);
            }
        }
    }
    return sv.getResult();
}
```

public void execute() {
    if (needsExecution()) {
        log.trace("Executing round: {}", pending);
        Result<Map<com.google.cloud.datastore.Key, Entity>> fetched = fetchPending();
        translated = loadEngine.translate(fetched);
        
        if (loadEngine.ofy.getTransaction() != null && depth > 0) {
            translated.now();
        }
    }
}

**Summary:**

/**
 * Fetches pending entities from the datastore.
 * 
 * @return A Result containing a map of keys to entities. If there are no entities to fetch, the map is returned immediately.
 *         Otherwise, the map is updated with the fetched entities and returned.
 */
private Result<Map<com.google.cloud.datastore.Key, Entity>> fetchPending() {
    Map<com.google.cloud.datastore.Key, Entity> combined = new HashMap<>();
    Set<com.google.cloud.datastore.Key> fetch = new HashSet<>();
    
    for (com.google.cloud.datastore.Key key : pending) {
        Entity ent = stuffed.get(key);
        if (ent == null) {
            fetch.add(key);
        } else {
            combined.put(key, ent);
        }
    }
    
    if (fetch.isEmpty()) {
        return new ResultNow<>(combined);
    } else {
        final Result<Map<com.google.cloud.datastore.Key, Entity>> fetched = loadEngine.fetch(fetch);
        return () -> {
            combined.putAll(fetched.now());
            return combined;
        };
    }
}

4033	The `addIndexedDiscriminators` method is a recursive function that processes a given class and its superclasses to identify and add indexed discriminators. Here's a summary of the method:

1. **Base Case**: If the input class is `Object.class`, the method returns immediately, as there are no further superclasses to process.

2. **Recursive Call**: The method calls itself with the superclass of the current class. This ensures that all superclasses are processed before the current class.

   - If the name is empty, the method uses the simple name of the class (`clazz.getSimpleName()`).

In summary, the method recursively processes a class and its superclasses, identifying and adding indexed discriminators based on the `@Subclass` annotation.

4057	```java
/**
 * Translates a Result containing a Map of Datastore Keys to Entities into a Result containing a Map of Keys to Objects.
 * 
 * @param raw The input Result containing a Map of Datastore Keys to Entities.
 * @return A Result containing a Map of Keys to Objects.
 */
public Result<Map<Key<?>, Object>> translate(final Result<Map<com.google.cloud.datastore.Key, Entity>> raw) {
    return new ResultCache<Map<Key<?>, Object>>() {
        private LoadContext ctx;

        @Override
        public Map<Key<?>, Object> nowUncached() {
            final Map<Key<?>, Object> result = new HashMap<>(raw.now().size() * 2);
            ctx = new LoadContext(LoadEngine.this);
            for (final Entity ent : raw.now().values()) {
                final Key<?> key = Key.create(ent.getKey());
                final Object entity = load(ent, ctx);
                result.put(key, entity);
            }
            return result;
        }

        @Override
        protected void postExecuteHook() {
            ctx.done();
            ctx = null;
        }
    };
}
```

4066	```java
/**
 * Executes a single transaction using the provided ObjectifyImpl parent and Work task.
 * 
 * @param <R> The type of result returned by the Work task.
 * @param parent The parent ObjectifyImpl instance.
 * @param work The Work task to be executed within the transaction.
 * @return The result of the Work task.
 * @throws RuntimeException If the transaction fails to commit or rollback.
 */
private <R> R transactOnce(final ObjectifyImpl parent, final Work<R> work) {
    // Open a new transaction using the parent's options and a custom TransactorYes.
    final ObjectifyImpl txnOfy = factory.open(parent.getOptions(), next -> new TransactorYes(next, this));
    boolean committedSuccessfully = false;
    try {
        // Execute the Work task and flush the transaction.
        final R result = work.run();
        txnOfy.flush();
        // Commit the transaction.
        txnOfy.getTransaction().commit();
        committedSuccessfully = true;
        return result;
    } finally {
        // If the transaction is still active, attempt to rollback.
        if (txnOfy.getTransaction().isActive()) {
            try {
                txnOfy.getTransaction().rollback();
            } catch (RuntimeException ex) {
                log.error("Rollback failed, suppressing error", ex);
            }
        }
        // Close the transaction.
        txnOfy.close();
        // If the transaction was committed successfully, run any commit listeners.
        if (committedSuccessfully) {
            ((PrivateAsyncTransaction) txnOfy.getTransaction()).runCommitListeners();
        }
    }
}
```
4067	The `matches` method checks if a given value or POJO matches any of the provided conditions. It takes two parameters: `onPojo`, which is the object to be checked, and `conditions`, an array of `If` objects representing the conditions to be evaluated. The method first checks if the `conditions` array is null. If it is, the method returns false. Then, it retrieves the value to be checked from the `onPojo` object using the `get` method. The method iterates over each condition in the `conditions` array. For each condition, it casts the condition to `If<Object, Object>` and checks if the value matches the condition using the `matchesValue` method. If the value matches, the method returns true. If the value does not match, the method checks if the `onPojo` object matches the condition using the `matchesPojo` method. If the `onPojo` object matches, the method returns true. If none of the conditions match, the method returns false.
4068	```java
/**
 * Returns an Objectify instance, ensuring that it is up-to-date by creating a new context if the current one is expired or not active.
 * @return An Objectify instance.
 */

4092	```java
/**
 * Writes the extensions of a message to a JSON generator.
 * 
 * @param msg The message containing the extensions.
 * @param gen The JSON generator to write to.
 * @throws IOException If an I/O error occurs.
 */
@SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
protected final <EM extends ExtendableMessage<EM>> void writeExtensions(EM msg, JsonGenerator gen) throws IOException {
    boolean openExt = false;
    for (Map.Entry<FieldDescriptor, Object> field : msg.getAllFields().entrySet()) {
        FieldDescriptor fd = field.getKey();
        if (fd.isExtension()) {
            if (fd.isRepeated()) {
                List<Object> extValue = (List<Object>) field.getValue();
                if (!extValue.isEmpty()) {
                    OpenRtbJsonExtWriter<Object> extWriter = factory.getWriter(msg.getClass(), extValue.get(0).getClass(), fd.getName());
                    if (extWriter != null) {
                        openExt = openExt(gen, openExt);
                        extWriter.writeRepeated(extValue, gen);
                    }
                }
            } else {
                Object extValue = field.getValue();
                OpenRtbJsonExtWriter<Object> extWriter = factory.getWriter(msg.getClass(), extValue.getClass(), fd.getName());
                if (extWriter != null) {
                    openExt = openExt(gen, openExt);
                    extWriter.writeSingle(extValue, gen);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if (openExt) {
        gen.writeEndObject();
    }
}
```

4101	```java
/**
 * Reads extensions from a JSON parser and populates them into a message object.
 * 
 * @param <EB> The type of the ExtendableBuilder.
 * @param msg The message object to populate with extensions.
 * @param par The JSON parser to read from.
 * @throws IOException If an I/O error occurs.
 */
protected final < EB extends ExtendableBuilder <?,EB > > void readExtensions (EB msg,JsonParser par) throws IOException {
    @SuppressWarnings ("unchecked")
    Set < OpenRtbJsonExtReader < EB > > extReaders = factory.getReaders ((Class < EB >)msg.getClass ());
    if (extReaders.isEmpty ()) {
        par.skipChildren ();
        return;
    }
    startObject (par);
    JsonToken tokLast = par.getCurrentToken ();
    JsonLocation locLast = par.getCurrentLocation ();
    while (true) {
        boolean extRead = false;
        for (OpenRtbJsonExtReader < EB > extReader : extReaders) {
            if (extReader.filter (par)) {
                extReader.read (msg, par);
                JsonToken tokNew = par.getCurrentToken ();
                JsonLocation locNew = par.getCurrentLocation ();
                boolean advanced = tokNew != tokLast || !locNew.equals (locLast);
                extRead |= advanced;
                if (!endObject (par)) {
                    return;
                } else if (advanced && par.getCurrentToken () != JsonToken.FIELD_NAME) {
                    tokLast = par.nextToken ();
                    locLast = par.getCurrentLocation ();
                } else {
                    tokLast = tokNew;
                    locLast = locNew;
                }
            }
        }
        if (!endObject (par)) {
            return;
        }
        if (!extRead) {
            if (logger.isDebugEnabled ()) {
                logger.debug ("Extension field not consumed by any reader, skipping: {} @{}:{}", par.getCurrentName (), locLast.getLineNr (), locLast.getCharOffset ());
            }
            par.nextToken ();
            par.skipChildren ();
            tokLast = par.nextToken ();
            locLast = par.getCurrentLocation ();
        }
    }
}
```
