6445	```java
/**
 * Filters a list of completion proposals based on a given prefix.
 * 
 * @param prefix The prefix to filter the proposals by.
 * @param props The list of completion proposals to filter.
 */
protected static void filterProposalsOnPrefix(String prefix, List<ICompletionProposal> props) {
    if (prefix != null && !prefix.trim().isEmpty()) {
        Iterator<ICompletionProposal> iterator = props.iterator();
        String prefixLc = prefix.toLowerCase();
        while (iterator.hasNext()) {
            ICompletionProposal item = iterator.next();
            String content = item.getDisplayString().toLowerCase();
            if (!content.startsWith(prefixLc)) {
                iterator.remove();
            }
        }
    }
}
```

/**
 * Returns the appropriate EditPart for a given model element.

 * @param modelElement The model element for which to get the EditPart.
 * @return The EditPart corresponding to the model element, or null if the model element is not supported.
 */
private EditPart getPartForElement(Object modelElement) {
    if (modelElement instanceof ReteGraph) {
        return new DiagramEditPart();
    } else if (modelElement instanceof BaseVertex) {
        return new VertexEditPart();
    } else if (modelElement instanceof Connection) {

6477	```java
/**
 * Sets the properties of a resource on the server.
 *
 * @param properties A collection of properties to be set.
 * @throws DAVException If an error occurs during the property setting process.
 */
public void setProperties(Collection properties) throws DAVException {
    // Ensure the properties collection is not null.
    Assert.isNotNull(properties);
    
    // If the properties collection is empty, do nothing.
    if (properties.isEmpty()) {
        return;
    }
    
    // Create a new document to build the request body.
    Document document = newDocument();
    PropertyUpdate propertyUpdate = PropertyUpdate.create(document);
    Prop prop = propertyUpdate.addSet();
    
    // Iterate through the properties collection and add each property to the request body.
    Iterator propertiesItr = properties.iterator();
    while (propertiesItr.hasNext()) {
        Element element = (Element) propertiesItr.next();
        try {
            prop.addProperty(element);
        } catch (MalformedElementException exception) {
            throw new SystemException(exception);
        }
    }
    
    // Send the request to the server and examine the response for failures.
    IResponse response = null;
    try {
        response = davClient.proppatch(locator, newContext(), document);
        examineResponse(response);
        examineMultiStatusResponse(response);
    } catch (IOException e) {
        throw new SystemException(e);
    } finally {
        closeResponse(response);
    }
}
```

6491	```java
public static String stripLastWord(String prefix) {
    if (prefix.isEmpty()) {
        return prefix;
    }
    if (prefix.charAt(prefix.length() - 1) == ' ') {
        return "";
    } else {
        char[] c = prefix.toCharArray();
        int start = 0;
        for (int i = c.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c[i])) {
                start = i + 1;
                break;
            }
        }
        prefix = prefix.substring(start, prefix.length());
        return prefix;
    }
}
```

**Summary:**
The `stripLastWord` method removes the last word from a given string `prefix`. If the string is empty or ends with a space, it returns the string as is. Otherwise, it iterates from the end of the string to find the first whitespace character, then returns the substring from the start of the string to the position just after the whitespace.

6494	```java
/**
 * Steps over the current line in the debugger, handling MVEL-specific logic.
 * If the top stack frame is an instance of MVELStackFrame, it performs a MVEL-specific step over.
 * Otherwise, it calls the superclass's stepOver method.
 * 
 * @throws DebugException if an error occurs during the step over operation.
 */
public synchronized void stepOver() throws DebugException {
    // Check if the top stack frame is an instance of MVELStackFrame
    if (!(getTopStackFrame() instanceof MVELStackFrame)) {
        super.stepOver();
        return;
    }

    // Cast the top stack frame to MVELStackFrame
    MVELStackFrame mvelStack = (MVELStackFrame) getTopStackFrame();

    // Check if stepping over is possible
    if (!canStepOver() || !mvelStack.canStepOver()) {
        return;
    }

    // Set remote on break return
    if (!setRemoteOnBreakReturn(Debugger.STEP)) {
        return;
    }

    // Set running state
    setRunning(true);

    // Preserve stack frames
    preserveStackFrames();

    // Fire a resume event
    fireEvent(new DebugEvent(this, DebugEvent.RESUME, DebugEvent.STEP_OVER));

    try {
        // Resume the underlying thread
        getUnderlyingThread().resume();
    } catch (RuntimeException e) {
        // Handle runtime exception during stepping
        // stepEnd();
        targetRequestFailed(MessageFormat.format(JDIDebugModelMessages.JDIThread_exception_stepping, e.toString()), e);
    }
}
```

If the error is an instance of `KnowledgeBuilderResult`, it uses the error message and the first line number from the error lines array, or -1 if the array is empty. If the error is an instance of `ExpanderException`, it uses the error message and -1 for the line number (with a TODO comment indicating a potential issue with line mapping). For any other type of error, it uses the error's string representation.

6497	```java
/**
 * Adds a resource to Guvnor.
 *
 * @param repLoc   the repository location
 * @param targetLoc the target location
 * @param selectedFile the selected file
 * @return true if the resource is added successfully, false otherwise
 */
public static boolean addResourceToGuvnor(String repLoc, String targetLoc, IFile selectedFile) {
    boolean res = false;
    try {
        String fullPath = targetLoc + selectedFile.getName();
        IWebDavClient client = WebDavServerCache.getWebDavClient(repLoc);
        if (client == null) {
            client = WebDavClientFactory.createClient(new URL(repLoc));
            WebDavServerCache.cacheWebDavClient(repLoc, client);
        }
        try {
            res = client.createResource(fullPath, new ByteArrayInputStream(new byte[0]), false);
            if (res) {
                client.putResource(fullPath, selectedFile.getContents());
            }
        } catch (WebDavException wde) {
            if (wde.getErrorCode() != IResponse.SC_UNAUTHORIZED) {
                throw wde;
            }
            boolean retry = PlatformUtils.getInstance().authenticateForServer(repLoc, client);
            if (retry) {
                res = client.createResource(fullPath, new ByteArrayInputStream(new byte[0]), false);
                if (res) {
                    client.putResource(fullPath, selectedFile.getContents());
                }
            }
        }
        if (res) {
            GuvnorMetadataUtils.markCurrentGuvnorResource(selectedFile);
            ResourceProperties resProps = client.queryProperties(fullPath);
            GuvnorMetadataProps mdProps = new GuvnorMetadataProps(selectedFile.getName(), repLoc, fullPath, resProps.getLastModifiedDate(), resProps.getRevision());
            GuvnorMetadataUtils.setGuvnorMetadataProps(selectedFile.getFullPath(), mdProps);
        }
    } catch (Exception e) {
        Activator.getDefault().displayError(IStatus.ERROR, e.getMessage(), e, true);
    }
    return res;
}
```
6498	```java
public static void commitFileChanges(IFile selectedFile) {
    try {
        // Retrieve metadata properties of the selected file
        GuvnorMetadataProps props = GuvnorMetadataUtils.getGuvnorMetadata(selectedFile);
        
        // Get or create a WebDav client for the repository
        IWebDavClient client = WebDavServerCache.getWebDavClient(props.getRepository());
        if (client == null) {
            client = WebDavClientFactory.createClient(new URL(props.getRepository()));
            WebDavServerCache.cacheWebDavClient(props.getRepository(), client);
        }
        
        // Query properties of the remote resource
        ResourceProperties remoteProps = null;
        try {
            remoteProps = client.queryProperties(props.getFullpath());
        } catch (WebDavException wde) {
            if (wde.getErrorCode() != IResponse.SC_UNAUTHORIZED) {
                throw wde;
            }
            // Retry authentication if not an authorization failure
            boolean retry = PlatformUtils.getInstance().authenticateForServer(props.getRepository(), client);
            if (retry) {
                remoteProps = client.queryProperties(props.getFullpath());
            }
        }
        
        // Check if the remote version matches the local version
        if (remoteProps == null) {
            throw new Exception("Could not retrieve server version of " + props.getFullpath());
        }
        if (!props.getRevision().equals(remoteProps.getRevision())) {
            // Confirm overwrite if versions do not match
            String msg = MessageFormat.format(Messages.getString("overwrite.confirmation"), selectedFile.getName(), remoteProps.getRevision(), props.getRevision());
            Display display = PlatformUI.getWorkbench().getDisplay();
            boolean proceed = MessageDialog.openQuestion(display.getActiveShell(), Messages.getString("overwrite.confirmation.caption"), msg);
            if (!proceed) {
                return;
            }
        }
        
        // Commit the file changes to the server
        client.putResource(props.getFullpath(), selectedFile.getContents());
        GuvnorMetadataUtils.markCurrentGuvnorResource(selectedFile);
        ResourceProperties resProps = client.queryProperties(props.getFullpath());
        GuvnorMetadataProps mdProps = GuvnorMetadataUtils.getGuvnorMetadata(selectedFile);
        mdProps.setVersion(resProps.getLastModifiedDate());
        mdProps.setRevision(resProps.getRevision());

6531	```java
/**
 * Adds Guvnor resource properties to the given ResourceProperties object.
 * 
 * @param props The ResourceProperties object to add properties to.
 * @param filename The filename to retrieve properties for.
 * @param resource The resource path.
 * @throws Exception If an error occurs while retrieving or processing the properties.
 */
private void addGuvnorResourceProperties(ResourceProperties props, String filename, String resource) throws Exception {
    if (props == null) {
        return;
    }

    IResponse response = null;
    try {
        String path = resource.substring(0, resource.lastIndexOf(' '));
        String apiVer = changeToAPICall(path);
        Properties guvProps = new Properties();
        response = getResourceInputStream(apiVer);
        guvProps.load(response.getInputStream());

        String val = guvProps.getProperty(filename);
        if (val != null) {
            StringTokenizer tokens = new StringTokenizer(val, ",");
            if (tokens.hasMoreElements()) {
                props.setLastModifiedDate(tokens.nextToken());
            }
            if (tokens.hasMoreElements()) {
                props.setRevision(tokens.nextToken());
            }
        } else {
            Exception nfe = new Exception("Failed to get Guvnor properties for " + filename);
            Activator.getDefault().writeLog(IStatus.WARNING, nfe.getMessage(), nfe);
        }
    } finally {
        if (response != null) {
            response.close();
        }
    }
}
```

6555	```java
/**
 * Returns the class of the given argument, handling primitive types and their corresponding wrapper classes.
 * If the argument is null, returns null.
 * If the argument is a wrapper class for a primitive type, returns the corresponding primitive type class.
 * If the argument is a Number, returns the most specific primitive type class (e.g., Integer, Double).
 * If the argument is a Character, returns Character.TYPE.
 * Otherwise, returns the original class of the argument.
 *
 * @param arg the argument to get the class of
 * @return the class of the argument, or null if the argument is null
 */
public static final Class getArgClass(Object arg) {
    if (arg == null) return null;
    Class<?> c = arg.getClass();
    if (c == Boolean.class) return Boolean.TYPE;
    else if (c.getSuperclass() == Number.class) {
        if (c == Integer.class) return Integer.TYPE;
        if (c == Double.class) return Double.TYPE;
        if (c == Byte.class) return Byte.TYPE;
        if (c == Long.class) return Long.TYPE;
        if (c == Float.class) return Float.TYPE;
        if (c == Short.class) return Short.TYPE;
    } else if (c == Character.class) return Character.TYPE;
    return c;
}
```

/**
 * Retrieves the property descriptors for a given class.
 * 
 * @param targetClass The class for which to retrieve the property descriptors.
 * @return A map containing the property descriptors for the given class.
 * @throws IntrospectionException If an error occurs during introspection.
 * @throws OgnlException If an error occurs during OGNL processing.
 */
public static Map getPropertyDescriptors(Class targetClass) throws IntrospectionException, OgnlException {
    Map result;
    if ((result = (Map) _propertyDescriptorCache.get(targetClass)) == null) {
        synchronized (_propertyDescriptorCache) {
            if ((result = (Map) _propertyDescriptorCache.get(targetClass)) == null) {
                PropertyDescriptor[] pda = Introspector.getBeanInfo(targetClass).getPropertyDescriptors();
                result = new HashMap<>(101);
                for (int i = 0, icount = pda.length; i < icount; i++) {
                    if (pda[i].getReadMethod() != null && !isMethodCallable(pda[i].getReadMethod())) {
                        pda[i].setReadMethod(findClosestMatchingMethod(targetClass, pda[i].getReadMethod(), pda[i].getName(), pda[i].getPropertyType(), true));
                    }
                    if (pda[i].getWriteMethod() != null && !isMethodCallable(pda[i].getWriteMethod())) {
                        pda[i].setWriteMethod(findClosestMatchingMethod(targetClass, pda[i].getWriteMethod(), pda[i].getName(), pda[i].getPropertyType(), false));
                    }
                    result.put(pda[i].getName(), pda[i]);
                }
                findObjectIndexedPropertyDescriptors(targetClass, result);
                _propertyDescriptorCache.put(targetClass, result);
            }
        }
    }
    return result;
}

6562	```java
/**
 * Reads a character from the input stream.
 * 
 * @return The character read from the input stream.
 * @throws IOException If an I/O error occurs.
 */
public char readChar() throws IOException {
    if (inBuf > 0) {
        --inBuf;
        if (++bufpos == bufsize) bufpos = 0;
        return buffer[bufpos];
    }
    char c;
    if (++bufpos == available) AdjustBuffSize();
    if ((buffer[bufpos] = c = ReadByte()) == ' ') {
        UpdateLineColumn(c);
        int backSlashCnt = 1;
        for (;;) {
            if (++bufpos == available) AdjustBuffSize();
            try {
                if ((buffer[bufpos] = c = ReadByte()) != ' ') {
                    UpdateLineColumn(c);
                    if ((c == ' ') && ((backSlashCnt & 1) == 1)) {
                        if (--bufpos < 0) bufpos = bufsize - 1;
                        break;
                    }
                    backup(backSlashCnt);
                    return ' ';
                }
            } catch (IOException e) {
                if (backSlashCnt > 1) backup(backSlashCnt - 1);
                return ' ';
            }
            UpdateLineColumn(c);
            backSlashCnt++;
        }
        try {
            while ((c = ReadByte()) == ' ') ++column;
            buffer[bufpos] = c = (char) (hexval(c) << 12 | hexval(ReadByte()) << 8 | hexval(ReadByte()) << 4 | hexval(ReadByte()));
            column += 4;
        } catch (IOException e) {
            throw new Error("Invalid escape character at line " + line + " column " + column + ".");
        }
        if (backSlashCnt == 1) return c;
        else {
            backup(backSlashCnt - 1);
            return ' ';
        }
    } else {
        UpdateLineColumn(c);
        return c;
    }
}

6565	```java
public static long longValue(Object value) throws NumberFormatException {
    if (value == null) return 0L;
    Class<?> c = value.getClass();
    if (c.getSuperclass() == Number.class) return ((Number) value).longValue();
    if (c == Boolean.class) return ((Boolean) value).booleanValue() ? 1 : 0;
    if (c == Character.class) return ((Character) value).charValue();
    return Long.parseLong(stringValue(value, true));
}
```

**Summary:**
The `longValue` method converts an `Object` to a `long`. If the object is `null`, it returns `0L`. If the object is an instance of `Number`, it returns its `longValue`. If the object is a `Boolean`, it returns `1` if `true` and `0` if `false`. If the object is a `Character`, it returns its `charValue`. For other types, it converts the object to a string and then parses it to a `long`.
6566	The `doubleValue` method converts an `Object` to a `double` value. If the input is `null`, it returns `0.0`. If the input is an instance of `Number`, it returns its `doubleValue`. If the input is a `Boolean`, it returns `1.0` if `true` and `0.0` if `false`. If the input is a `Character`, it returns its `charValue`. For other types, it first converts the input to a `String` using the `stringValue` method. If the resulting `String` is empty, it returns `0.0`. Otherwise, it parses the `String` to a `double` using `Double.parseDouble`.

/**
 * Converts an object to a BigInteger value.
 * 
 * @param value The object to convert.
 * @return The BigInteger representation of the object.
 * @throws NumberFormatException If the object cannot be converted to a BigInteger.
 */
public static BigInteger bigIntValue(Object value) throws NumberFormatException {
    if (value == null) return BigInteger.valueOf(0L);
    Class<?> c = value.getClass();
    if (c == BigInteger.class) return (BigInteger) value;
    if (c == BigDecimal.class) return ((BigDecimal) value).toBigInteger();
    if (c.getSuperclass() == Number.class) return BigInteger.valueOf(((Number) value).longValue());
    if (c == Boolean.class) return BigInteger.valueOf(((Boolean) value).booleanValue() ? 1 : 0);
    if (c == Character.class) return BigInteger.valueOf(((Character) value).charValue());
    return new BigInteger(stringValue(value, true));
}

/**

 *         - INT for Integer
 *         - DOUBLE for Double
 *         - BOOL for Boolean
 *         - BYTE for Byte
 *         - CHAR for Character
 *         - SHORT for Short
 *         - LONG for Long
 *         - FLOAT for Float
 *         - BIGINT for BigInteger
 *         - BIGDEC for BigDecimal
 *         - NONNUMERIC if the object is not a numeric type.

public static int getNumericType(Object value) {
    if (value != null) {
        Class<?> c = value.getClass();
        if (c == Integer.class) return INT;
        if (c == Double.class) return DOUBLE;
        if (c == Boolean.class) return BOOL;
        if (c == Byte.class) return BYTE;
        if (c == Character.class) return CHAR;
        if (c == Short.class) return SHORT;
        if (c == Long.class) return LONG;
        if (c == Float.class) return FLOAT;
        if (c == BigInteger.class) return BIGINT;
        if (c == BigDecimal.class) return BIGDEC;
    }
    return NONNUMERIC;
}

6575	```java
public static Number newInteger(int type, long value) {
    switch (type) {
        case BOOL:
        case CHAR:
        case INT:
            return new Integer((int) value);
        case FLOAT:
            if ((long) (float) value == value) {
                return new Float((float) value);
            }
            // fall through
        case DOUBLE:
            if ((long) (double) value == value) {
                return new Double((double) value);
            }
            // fall through
        case LONG:
            return new Long(value);
        case BYTE:
            return new Byte((byte) value);
        case SHORT:
            return new Short((short) value);
        default:
            return BigInteger.valueOf(value);
    }
}
```

**Summary:**
The `newInteger` method takes an integer `type` and a long `value` as parameters. It returns a `Number` object based on the type:
- For `BOOL`, `CHAR`, and `INT`, it returns an `Integer`.
- For `FLOAT`, it returns a `Float` if the value is an integer, otherwise it falls through.
- For `DOUBLE`, it returns a `Double` if the value is an integer, otherwise it falls through.
- For `LONG`, it returns a `Long`.
- For `BYTE`, it returns a `Byte`.
- For `SHORT`, it returns a `Short`.
- For any other type, it returns a `BigInteger`.

public static String getDefaultWatchServiceId() {
    String result = "polling";
    String osName = System.getProperty("os.name");
    if (osName != null) {
        osName = osName.toLowerCase(Locale.ENGLISH);
        if (osName.contains("windows") || osName.contains("linux")) {
            result = isAtLeastJava7() ? "jdk7" : "jnotify";
        } else if (osName.contains("mac")) {
            result = "jnotify";
        }
    }
    return result;
}

**Summary:**
This method determines the default watch service ID based on the operating system. It starts with "polling" as the default. If the operating system is Mac, it sets the result to "jnotify". If the operating system is not recognized, it returns "polling".

 *
 * @param rootUrl      the URL of the Play! server

 * @param startTimeout the maximum time to wait for the server to start, in milliseconds
 * @param spawned      whether the server was spawned by this method

 * @throws IOException          if an I/O error occurs
 */
protected void waitForServerStarted(String rootUrl, JavaRunnable runner, int startTimeout, boolean spawned) throws MojoExecutionException, IOException {
    long endTimeMillis = startTimeout > 0 ? System.currentTimeMillis() + startTimeout : 0L;
    boolean started = false;

                    // just ignore
                }

            // ignore
        }

            if (startTimeout > 0) {

            }

6602	```java
/**
 * Creates a new folder in the selected directory.
 * 
 * @return An integer indicating the result of the operation:
 *         - R.string.create_folder_success if the folder is created successfully.
 *         - R.string.create_folder_error_already_exists if the folder already exists.
 *         - R.string.create_folder_error_no_write_access if the selected directory does not have write access.
 *         - R.string.create_folder_error if any other error occurs.
 */
private int createFolder() {
    if (mNewDirectoryName != null && mSelectedDir != null && mSelectedDir.canWrite()) {
        File newDir = new File(mSelectedDir, mNewDirectoryName);
        if (newDir.exists()) {
            return R.string.create_folder_error_already_exists;
        } else {
            boolean result = newDir.mkdir();
            if (result) {
                return R.string.create_folder_success;
            } else {
                return R.string.create_folder_error;
            }
        }
    } else if (mSelectedDir != null && !mSelectedDir.canWrite()) {
        return R.string.create_folder_error_no_write_access;
    } else {
        return R.string.create_folder_error;
    }
}

6620	```java
public void setAttribute(AttributesImpl atts, String name, String type, String value) {
    // Ignore attributes with names starting with "xmlns"
    if (name.equals("xmlns") || name.startsWith("xmlns:")) {
        return;
    }

    // Extract namespace and local name from the attribute name
    String namespace = namespace(name, true);
    String localName = localName(name);

    // Check if the attribute already exists in the AttributesImpl object
    int i = atts.getIndex(name);
    if (i == -1) {
        // If the attribute does not exist, add it with the specified namespace, local name, type, and value
        name = name.intern();
        if (type == null) type = "CDATA";
        if (!type.equals("CDATA")) value = normalize(value);
        atts.addAttribute(namespace, localName, name, type, value);
    } else {
        // If the attribute already exists, update it with the specified namespace, local name, type, and value
        if (type == null) type = atts.getType(i);
        if (!type.equals("CDATA")) value = normalize(value);
        atts.setAttribute(i, namespace, localName, name, type, value);
    }
}

6624	The `needNewBuffer` method manages a buffer system by either recycling an existing buffer or creating a new one when needed. It takes an integer `newcount` as input, which represents the required size of the new buffer. If there are still available buffers in the `buffers` list, it recycles the current buffer by incrementing the `currentBufferIndex`, adding the length of the current buffer to `filledBufferSum`, and updating `currentBuffer` to the next buffer in the list. If there are no available buffers, it creates a new buffer. The size of the new buffer is determined by comparing the double of the current buffer's length with `newcount - filledBufferSum`, and the `filledBufferSum` is updated accordingly. The `currentBufferIndex` is incremented, and a new buffer is added to the `buffers` list.
6625	```java
@Override
public void write(byte[] b, int off, int len) {
    // Check for invalid indices or length
    if ((off < 0) || (off > b.length) || (len < 0) || ((off + len) > b.length) || ((off + len) < 0)) {
        throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException();
    } else if (len == 0) {
        return;
    }

    // Synchronize to ensure thread safety
    synchronized (this) {
        int newcount = count + len;
        int remaining = len;
        int inBufferPos = count - filledBufferSum;

        // Copy data to the buffer
        while (remaining > 0) {
            int part = Math.min(remaining, currentBuffer.length - inBufferPos);
            System.arraycopy(b, off + len - remaining, currentBuffer, inBufferPos, part);
            remaining -= part;

            // If buffer is full, create a new one
            if (remaining > 0) {
                needNewBuffer(newcount);
                inBufferPos = 0;
            }
        }

        // Update the count
        count = newcount;
    }
}
```
6626	```java
@Override
public synchronized void write(int b) {
    int inBufferPos = count - filledBufferSum;
    if (inBufferPos == currentBuffer.length) {
        needNewBuffer(count + 1);
        inBufferPos = 0;
    }
    currentBuffer[inBufferPos] = (byte) b;
    count++;
}
```

**Summary:**
The `write` method is a synchronized method that writes a single byte to the buffer. It calculates the position in the buffer where the byte should be written. If the buffer is full, it calls `needNewBuffer` to create a new buffer and resets the position. The byte is then written to the buffer, and the count of bytes written is incremented.

    int panDeltaX1 = Math.max(0, mLeft - r.left);
    int panDeltaX2 = Math.min(0, mRight - r.right);
    int panDeltaY1 = Math.max(0, mTop - r.top);
    int panDeltaY2 = Math.min(0, mBottom - r.bottom);
    int panDeltaX = panDeltaX1 != 0 ? panDeltaX1 : panDeltaX2;
    int panDeltaY = panDeltaY1 != 0 ? panDeltaY1 : panDeltaY2;
    if (panDeltaX != 0 || panDeltaY != 0) {
        panBy(panDeltaX, panDeltaY);
    }
}

6643	The `applyToSelection` method in the provided code is designed to apply a specific value to a selection in an `RTEditText` editor. Here's a summary of the method:

1. **Get Selection**: The method starts by retrieving the current selection from the `RTEditText` editor. The default span type for empty spans is `SPAN_INCLUSIVE_INCLUSIVE`.

2. **Determine Span Type**: It checks if the selection is empty. If it is, the span type remains `SPAN_INCLUSIVE_INCLUSIVE`; otherwise, it is set to `SPAN_EXCLUSIVE_INCLUSIVE`.

3. **Iterate Over Spans**: The method iterates over all spans in the selected text that match the specified value.

4. **Process Preceding Spans**:
   - If a preceding span has the same value, it adjusts the span type to `SPAN_EXCLUSIVE_INCLUSIVE` and offsets the selection accordingly.
   - If a preceding span has a different value, it removes the span and inserts a new span with the same value but a different span type.

5. **Process Succeeding Spans**:
   - If a succeeding span has the same value, it offsets the selection accordingly.
   - If a succeeding span has a different value, it removes the span and inserts a new span with the same value but a different span type.

6. **Remove Existing Spans**: The method removes all existing spans that match the specified value.

7. **Add New Span**: If the value is not null, it creates a new span with the specified value and applies it to the selected text with the determined span type.

In summary, the method ensures that the selected text is updated with the specified value, adjusting the span types and removing any conflicting spans as necessary.
6644	```java
/**
 * Validates if the given domain is either a valid IP address enclosed in brackets or a valid symbolic domain name.
 * 
 * @param domain The domain to validate.
 * @param allowLocal Whether to allow local domain names.
 * @return true if the domain is valid, false otherwise.
 */
protected boolean isValidDomain(String domain, boolean allowLocal) {
    // Check if the domain is an IP address enclosed in brackets
    Matcher ipDomainMatcher = IP_DOMAIN_PATTERN.matcher(domain);
    if (ipDomainMatcher.matches()) {
        InetAddressValidator inetAddressValidator = InetAddressValidator.getInstance();
        return inetAddressValidator.isValid(ipDomainMatcher.group(1));
    }
    // Validate the domain as a symbolic name
    DomainValidator domainValidator = DomainValidator.getInstance(allowLocal);
    return domainValidator.isValid(domain) || domainValidator.isValidTld(domain);
}
```

6646	```markdown
### Summary:
The `redo` method in the provided code is designed to handle the redo functionality for an `RTEditText` editor. It performs the following steps:

1. **Retrieve Redo Stack**: It retrieves the redo stack associated with the given `RTEditText` editor.
2. **Check Redo Stack**: If the redo stack is not empty, it proceeds to the next step.
3. **Retrieve Undo Stack**: It retrieves the undo stack associated with the same editor.
4. **Pop Operation**: It pops the top operation from the redo stack.
5. **Push Operation to Undo Stack**: It pushes the popped operation to the undo stack.
6. **Redo Operation**: It calls the `redo` method on the operation to apply the changes to the editor.
7. **Merge Operations**: It checks if the current operation can be merged with the next operation in the redo stack. If so, it pops the next operation, pushes it to the undo stack, and applies the `redo` method again.
8. **Repeat**: Steps 6 and 7 are repeated until the redo stack is empty or no more operations can be merged.

This method ensures that operations can be redone and merged if possible, maintaining a consistent state in the editor.

6653	```java
/**
 * Retrieves a map of asset fonts by their names.
 *
 * @param context The application context.
 * @return A map where the keys are font names and the values are file paths.
 */
private static Map<String, String> getAssetFonts(Context context) {
    synchronized (ASSET_FONTS_BY_NAME) {
        if (ASSET_FONTS_BY_NAME.isEmpty()) {
            AssetManager assets = context.getResources().getAssets();
            Collection<String> fontFiles = AssetIndex.getAssetIndex(context);
            if (fontFiles == null || fontFiles.isEmpty()) {
                fontFiles = listFontFiles(context.getResources());
            }
            for (String filePath : fontFiles) {
                if (filePath.toLowerCase(Locale.getDefault()).endsWith("ttf")) {
                    String fontName = TTFAnalyzer.getFontName(assets, filePath);
                    if (fontName == null) {
                        fontName = getFileName(filePath);
                    }
                    ASSET_FONTS_BY_NAME.put(fontName, filePath);
                }
            }
        }
        return ASSET_FONTS_BY_NAME;
    }
}
```

### Summary of `pop()` Method

6674	```java
/**
 * Adjusts the given matrix to properly scale and center a bitmap within a view.
 * 
 * @param bitmap The bitmap to be scaled and centered.
 * @param matrix The matrix to be adjusted.
 */
private void getProperBaseMatrix(RotateBitmap bitmap, Matrix matrix) {
    float viewWidth = getWidth();
    float viewHeight = getHeight();
    float w = bitmap.getWidth();
    float h = bitmap.getHeight();
    
    matrix.reset(); // Reset the matrix to its default state.
    
    // Calculate the maximum scaling factor to avoid up-scaling more than 2x.
    float widthScale = Math.min(viewWidth / w, 2.0f);
    float heightScale = Math.min(viewHeight / h, 2.0f);
    float scale = Math.min(widthScale, heightScale);
    
    // Apply the bitmap's rotation matrix.
    matrix.postConcat(bitmap.getRotateMatrix());
    
    // Scale the matrix by the calculated scale factor.
    matrix.postScale(scale, scale);
    
    // Translate the matrix to center the bitmap within the view.
    matrix.postTranslate((viewWidth - w * scale) / 2F, (viewHeight - h * scale) / 2F);
}
```

/**
 * Checks if the given value matches any element in the booleans array.
 * 
 * @param localName The local name of the attribute.
 * @param qName The qualified name of the attribute.
 * @param value The value to be checked.
 * @return true if the value matches any element in the booleans array, false otherwise.
 */
private boolean booleanAttribute(String localName, String qName, String value) {
    String name = localName;
    if (name == null) {
        int i = qName.indexOf(' ');
        if (i != -1) {
            name = qName.substring(i + 1, qName.length());
        }
    }
    if (!name.equals(value)) {
        return false;
    }
    for (int j = 0; j < booleans.length; j++) {
        if (name.equals(booleans[j])) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

/**
 * Writes namespace declarations.
 * 
 * @throws SAXException if an error occurs during the process.
 */
@SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
private void writeNSDecls() throws SAXException {
    Enumeration<String> prefixes = (Enumeration<String>) nsSupport.getDeclaredPrefixes();
    while (prefixes.hasMoreElements()) {
        String prefix = (String) prefixes.nextElement();
        String uri = nsSupport.getURI(prefix);
        if (uri == null) {
            uri = "";
        }
        write(' ');
        if ("".equals(prefix)) {
            write("xmlns=\"");
        } else {
            write("xmlns:");
            write(prefix);
            write("=\"");
        }
        writeEscUTF16(uri, 0, uri.length(), true);
        write(' ');
    }
}

6690	```java
/**
 * Waits for a Kinesis stream to become active.
 *
 * @param consumer The Kinesis consumer.
 * @param streamName The name of the stream to wait for.
 * @param streamCreationTimeoutMillis The maximum time to wait for the stream to become active.
 * @throws AwsKinesisException If the stream does not become active within the timeout period.
 */
private static void waitStreamActivation(AmazonKinesis consumer, String streamName, long streamCreationTimeoutMillis) {
    DescribeStreamRequest describeStreamRequest = new DescribeStreamRequest()
            .withStreamName(streamName)
            .withLimit(1);
    DescribeStreamResult describeStreamResult = null;
    String streamStatus = null;
    long endTime = System.currentTimeMillis() + streamCreationTimeoutMillis;

    do {
        try {
            describeStreamResult = consumer.describeStream(describeStreamRequest);
            streamStatus = describeStreamResult.getStreamDescription().getStreamStatus();
            if (ACTIVE_STREAM_STATUS.equals(streamStatus)) {
                break;
            }
            Thread.sleep(100);
        } catch (ResourceNotFoundException | LimitExceededException ignored) {
            // Ignored
        } catch (InterruptedException e) {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
            throw new AwsKinesisException("Thread interrupted while waiting for stream activation", args -> args.add("streamName", streamName), e);
        }
    } while (System.currentTimeMillis() < endTime);

    if (describeStreamResult == null || streamStatus == null || !streamStatus.equals(ACTIVE_STREAM_STATUS)) {
        throw new AwsKinesisException("Stream never went active", args -> args.add("streamName", streamName).add("streamCreationTimeoutMillis", streamCreationTimeoutMillis));
    }
}

6691	```java
/**
 * Completes the store snapshot by adding missing instance snapshots.
 * 
 * @param targetStoresPath The path to the target stores directory.
 */
private static void completeStoreSnapshotWithMissingInstanceSnapshots(Path targetStoresPath) {
    // Define regex patterns for transaction ID extraction and replacement.
    String transactionIdRegexAlone = "\"transactionId\"\\s*:\\s*\\d+\\s*,";
    String transactionIdRegexReplace = "(.*\"transactionId\"\\s*:\\s*)\\d+(\\s*,.*)";
    Pattern transactionIdPattern = Pattern.compile(transactionIdRegexAlone);

    // Set to store previous snapshots.
    Set<File> previousSnapshots = new HashSet<>();

    // Iterate over snapshots in the target stores directory.
    Arrays.stream(targetStoresPath.resolve(SNAPSHOT_DIRECTORY_NAME).toFile().listFiles())
        .sorted()
        .forEach(snapshot -> {
            // Collect names of files in the current snapshot.
            Set<String> snapshotNames = Arrays.stream(snapshot.listFiles())
                .map(File::getName)
                .collect(Collectors.toSet());

            // Filter and process previous snapshots that are missing in the current snapshot.
            previousSnapshots.stream()
                .filter(previousSnapshot -> !snapshotNames.contains(previousSnapshot.getName()))
                .forEach(previousSnapshot -> {
                    try {
                        // Resolve target and source paths.
                        Path targetPath = snapshot.toPath().resolve(previousSnapshot.getName());
                        Path sourcePath = previousSnapshot.toPath();

                        // Count occurrences of transaction ID in the source path.
                        long count = countTransactionId(transactionIdPattern, sourcePath);
                        if (count != 1L) {
                            throw new StoreException("transactionId not found once", args -> args.add("found count", count));
                        }

                        // Generate new transaction ID from the snapshot name.
                        BigInteger newTransactionId = new BigInteger(snapshot.getName());

                        // Replace transaction ID in the source path with the new transaction ID.
                        replaceTransactionIdValue(transactionIdRegexReplace, sourcePath, targetPath, newTransactionId.toString());
                    } catch (IOException e) {
                        throw new UncheckedIOException(e);
                    }
                });

            // Clear and update the set of previous snapshots.
            previousSnapshots.clear();
            previousSnapshots.addAll(Arrays.stream(snapshot.listFiles()).collect(Collectors.toSet()));
        });
}
```

/**
 * Waits for the minimal duration to execute the next provisioning request.

 * @return true if the minimal duration has been waited, false otherwise.
 */
private boolean waitTheMinimalDurationToExecuteTheNextProvisioningRequest() {

        long delay = m_durationBetweenRequests.get() - (System.currentTimeMillis() - m_lastGetShardIteratorRequestTime);
        if (delay > 0) {
            try {
                Thread.sleep(delay);
            } catch (InterruptedException e) {
                Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
                return false;
            }
        }
    }
    m_lastGetShardIteratorRequestTime = System.currentTimeMillis();

6694	```java
/**
 * Performs an Amazon action with retry logic.
 * 
 * @param <T> The type of the result returned by the action.
 * @param actionLabel A label for the action being performed.
 * @param action A supplier that represents the action to be performed.
 * @param retryLimit The maximum number of retries allowed.
 * @param durationInMillis The duration to wait between retries in milliseconds.
 * @return The result of the action if successful.
 * @throws AwsException If the action fails after the maximum number of retries.
 */
public static <T> T performAmazonActionWithRetry(String actionLabel, Supplier<T> action, int retryLimit, int durationInMillis) {
    int retryCount = 0;
    do {
        try {
            return action.get();
        } catch (LimitExceededException | ProvisionedThroughputExceededException | KMSThrottlingException e) {
            int remainingRetries = retryLimit - retryCount;
            LOG.debug("Amazon exception caught", args -> args.add("exception", e.getClass().getName()).add("action", actionLabel).add("remainingRetryCount", remainingRetries));
        }
        sleepUntilInterrupted(actionLabel, durationInMillis);
    } while (++retryCount < retryLimit);
    throw new AwsException("Limit exceeded, all retries failed", args -> args.add("action", actionLabel).add("retryLimit", retryLimit));
}
```

/**
 * Initializes a WroManagerFactory based on the provided properties.
 * 
 * @param properties The properties containing configuration settings.
 * @return A WroManagerFactory instance.
 * @throws WroRuntimeException If an exception occurs while loading the WroManagerFactory class.
 */
private WroManagerFactory initFactory(final Properties properties) {
    WroManagerFactory factory = null;
    final String wroManagerClassName = properties.getProperty(ConfigConstants.managerFactoryClassName.name());
    
    if (StringUtils.isEmpty(wroManagerClassName)) {
        // Return the default factory if no context param is specified
        factory = newManagerFactory();
    } else {
        // Attempt to load and instantiate the specified factory class
        Class<?> factoryClass = null;
        try {
            factoryClass = Thread.currentThread().getContextClassLoader().loadClass(wroManagerClassName);
            factory = (WroManagerFactory) factoryClass.newInstance();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new WroRuntimeException("Exception while loading WroManagerFactory class: " + wroManagerClassName, e);
        }
    }
    
    // Add properties if the factory is configurable
    if (factory instanceof ConfigurableWroManagerFactory) {
        ((ConfigurableWroManagerFactory) factory).addConfigProperties(properties);
    }
    
    return factory;
}

6744	```java
/**
 * Rewrites the image URL based on the CSS URI.
 * 
 * @param cssUri The CSS URI.
 * @param imageUrl The image URL.
 * @return The rewritten image URL.
 * @throws WroRuntimeException If the image URL cannot be replaced.
 */
public String rewrite(final String cssUri, final String imageUrl) {
    notNull(cssUri);
    notNull(imageUrl);
    
    if (StringUtils.isEmpty(imageUrl)) {
        return imageUrl;
    }
    
    if (ServletContextUriLocator.isValid(cssUri)) {
        if (ServletContextUriLocator.isValid(imageUrl)) {
            return prependContextPath(imageUrl);
        }
        
        if (ServletContextUriLocator.isProtectedResource(cssUri)) {
            return context.proxyPrefix + computeNewImageLocation(cssUri, imageUrl);
        }
        
        String aggregatedPathPrefix = computeAggregationPathPrefix(context.aggregatedFolderPath);
        LOG.debug("computed aggregatedPathPrefix {}", aggregatedPathPrefix);
        String newImageLocation = computeNewImageLocation(aggregatedPathPrefix + cssUri, imageUrl);
        
        if (newImageLocation.startsWith(ServletContextUriLocator.PREFIX)) {
            newImageLocation = prependContextPath(newImageLocation);
        }
        
        LOG.debug("newImageLocation: {}", newImageLocation);
        return newImageLocation;
    }
    
    if (ClasspathUriLocator.isValid(cssUri)) {
        String proxyUrl = context.proxyPrefix + computeNewImageLocation(cssUri, imageUrl);
        String contextRelativeUrl = prependContextPath(imageUrl);
        return ServletContextUriLocator.isValid(imageUrl) ? contextRelativeUrl : proxyUrl;
    }
    
    if (UrlUriLocator.isValid(cssUri)) {
        String computedCssUri = ServletContextUriLocator.isValid(imageUrl) ? computeCssUriForExternalServer(cssUri) : cssUri;
        return computeNewImageLocation(computedCssUri, imageUrl);
    }
    
    throw new WroRuntimeException("Could not replace imageUrl: " + imageUrl + ", contained at location: " + cssUri);
}
```
6745	```java
/**
 * Computes the new image location based on the given CSS URI and image URL.
 * 
 * @param cssUri The CSS URI.
 * @param imageUrl The image URL.
 * @return The computed image location.
 * @throws IllegalStateException If the CSS URI is invalid.
 */
private String computeNewImageLocation(final String cssUri, final String imageUrl) {
    LOG.debug("cssUri: {}, imageUrl {}", cssUri, imageUrl);
    final String cleanImageUrl = cleanImageUrl(imageUrl);

    int idxLastSeparator = cssUri.lastIndexOf(ServletContextUriLocator.PREFIX);
    if (idxLastSeparator == -1) {
        if (ClasspathUriLocator.isValid(cssUri)) {
            idxLastSeparator = cssUri.lastIndexOf(ClasspathUriLocator.PREFIX);
            if (idxLastSeparator >= 0) {
                idxLastSeparator += ClasspathUriLocator.PREFIX.length() - 1;
            }
        }
        if (idxLastSeparator < 0) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Invalid cssUri: " + cssUri + ". Should contain at least one '/' character!");
        }
    }

    final String cssUriFolder = cssUri.substring(0, idxLastSeparator + 1);
    final String processedImageUrl = cleanImageUrl.startsWith(ServletContextUriLocator.PREFIX) ? cleanImageUrl.substring(1) : cleanImageUrl;
    final String computedImageLocation = cleanPath(cssUriFolder + processedImageUrl);

    LOG.debug("computedImageLocation: {}", computedImageLocation);
    return computedImageLocation;
}
```

6747	```java
public void serveProcessedBundle() throws IOException {
    // Retrieve configuration, request, and response objects from context
    final WroConfiguration configuration = context.getConfig();
    final HttpServletRequest request = context.getRequest();
    final HttpServletResponse response = context.getResponse();

    OutputStream os = null;
    try {
        // Generate cache key and initialize aggregated folder path
        final CacheKey cacheKey = getSafeCacheKey(request);
        initAggregatedFolderPath(request, cacheKey.getType());

        // Retrieve cache value using cache strategy
        final CacheValue cacheValue = cacheStrategy.get(cacheKey);

        // Check ETag header and respond with 304 Not Modified if ETag matches
        final String ifNoneMatch = request.getHeader(HttpHeader.IF_NONE_MATCH.toString());
        final String etagValue = String.format("\"%s\"", cacheValue.getHash());
        if (etagValue != null && etagValue.equals(ifNoneMatch)) {
            LOG.debug("ETag hash detected: {}. Sending {} status code", etagValue, HttpServletResponse.SC_NOT_MODIFIED);
            response.setStatus(HttpServletResponse.SC_NOT_MODIFIED);
            return;
        }

        // Set content type and ETag header
        response.setContentType(cacheKey.getType().getContentType() + "; charset=" + configuration.getEncoding());
        response.setHeader(HttpHeader.ETAG.toString(), etagValue);

        // Get output stream and write content based on gzip support
        os = response.getOutputStream();
        if (cacheValue.getRawContent() != null) {
            if (isGzipAllowed()) {
                response.setContentLength(cacheValue.getGzippedContent().length);
                response.setHeader(HttpHeader.CONTENT_ENCODING.toString(), "gzip");
                response.setHeader("Vary", "Accept-Encoding");
                IOUtils.write(cacheValue.getGzippedContent(), os);
            } else {
                response.setContentLength(cacheValue.getRawContent().getBytes(configuration.getEncoding()).length);
                IOUtils.write(cacheValue.getRawContent(), os, configuration.getEncoding());
            }
        }
    } finally {
        // Close output stream quietly
        if (os != null) {
            IOUtils.closeQuietly(os);
        }
    }
}
```

/**
 * Converts a ResourcePostProcessor to a ResourcePreProcessor.
 * 
 * @param postProcessor The ResourcePostProcessor to convert.
 * @return A ResourcePreProcessor that delegates to the given ResourcePostProcessor.
 */
private static ResourcePreProcessor toPreProcessor(final ResourcePostProcessor postProcessor) {
    return new AbstractProcessorDecoratorSupport<ResourcePostProcessor>(postProcessor) {
        @Override
        public void process(final Resource resource, final Reader reader, final Writer writer) throws IOException {
            postProcessor.process(reader, writer);
        }

        @Override
        protected boolean isMinimizeInternal() {
            return isMinimizeForProcessor(postProcessor);
        }

        @Override
        protected SupportedResourceType getSupportedResourceTypeInternal() {
            return getSupportedResourceTypeForProcessor(postProcessor);
        }

        @Override
        public String toString() {
            return postProcessor.toString();
        }
    };
}

6754	```java
/**
 * Applies gzip compression to the response before sending it to the client.
 *
 * @param req The HttpServletRequest object.
 * @param response The HttpServletResponse object.
 * @param chain The FilterChain object.
 * @throws IOException If an I/O error occurs.
 * @throws ServletException If a servlet error occurs.
 */
private void doGzipResponse(final HttpServletRequest req, final HttpServletResponse response, final FilterChain chain) throws IOException, ServletException {
    LOG.debug("Applying gzip on resource: " + req.getRequestURI());
    response.setHeader(HttpHeader.CONTENT_ENCODING.toString(), "gzip");

    ByteArrayOutputStream baos = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
    CountingOutputStream countingStream = new CountingOutputStream(new GZIPOutputStream(new BufferedOutputStream(baos)));

    HttpServletResponseWrapper wrappedResponse = new RedirectedStreamServletResponseWrapper(countingStream, response);
    chain.doFilter(req, wrappedResponse);

    countingStream.close();
    response.setContentLength(countingStream.getCount());

    if (countingStream.getCount() > 0) {
        IOUtils.write(baos.toByteArray(), response.getOutputStream());
    }
}

6758	```java
/**
 * This method is responsible for remembering a resource by calculating its fingerprint and storing it.
 * If the resource has already been updated in the current run, it skips the fingerprint calculation.
 * For CSS resources, it also checks and persists fingerprints in any imported resources.
 *
 * @param resource The resource to be remembered.
 */
public void remember(final Resource resource) {
    final WroManager manager = getManagerFactory().create();
    final HashStrategy hashStrategy = manager.getHashStrategy();
    final UriLocatorFactory locatorFactory = manager.getUriLocatorFactory();

    if (rememberedSet.contains(resource.getUri())) {
        getLog().debug("Resource with uri '" + resource.getUri() + "' has already been updated in this run.");
    } else {
        try {
            final String fingerprint = hashStrategy.getHash(locatorFactory.locate(resource.getUri()));
            getBuildContextHolder().setValue(resource.getUri(), fingerprint);
            rememberedSet.add(resource.getUri());
            getLog().debug("Persist fingerprint for resource '" + resource.getUri() + "' : " + fingerprint);

            if (resource.getType() == ResourceType.CSS) {
                final Reader reader = new InputStreamReader(locatorFactory.locate(resource.getUri()));
                getLog().debug("Check @import directive from " + resource);
                persistFingerprintsForCssImports(resource, reader);
            }
        } catch (final IOException e) {
            getLog().debug("Could not check fingerprint of resource: " + resource);
        }
    }
}
```

/**
 * Computes the destination folder for a given resource type.
 *
 * @param resourceType The type of resource.
 * @return The destination folder for the resource type.
 * @throws MojoExecutionException If the destination folder cannot be computed.
 */
private File computeDestinationFolder(final ResourceType resourceType) throws MojoExecutionException {
    File folder = destinationFolder;
    if (resourceType == ResourceType.JS && jsDestinationFolder != null) {
        folder = jsDestinationFolder;
    } else if (resourceType == ResourceType.CSS && cssDestinationFolder != null) {
        folder = cssDestinationFolder;
    }
    getLog().info("folder: " + folder);
    if (folder == null) {
        throw new MojoExecutionException("Couldn't compute destination folder for resourceType: " + resourceType + ". That means that you didn't define one of the following parameters: destinationFolder, cssDestinationFolder, jsDestinationFolder");
    }
    if (!folder.exists()) {
        folder.mkdirs();
    }
    return folder;
}

6775	```java
/**
 * Checks if the resource at the given URI has changed for the specified group.
 *
 * @param uri       the URI of the resource
 * @param groupName the name of the group to check for changes
 * @return true if the resource has changed for the group, false otherwise
 * @throws IOException if an I/O error occurs
 */
public boolean checkChangeForGroup(final String uri, final String groupName) throws IOException {
    notNull(uri);
    notNull(groupName);
    LOG.debug("group={}, uri={}", groupName, uri);

    ResourceChangeInfo resourceInfo = changeInfoMap.get(uri);
    if (resourceInfo.isCheckRequiredForGroup(groupName)) {
        InputStream inputStream = locatorFactory.locate(uri);
        try {
            String currentHash = hashStrategy.getHash(inputStream);
            resourceInfo.updateHashForGroup(currentHash, groupName);
        } finally {
            IOUtils.closeQuietly(inputStream);
        }
    }
    return resourceInfo.isChanged(groupName);
}

/**
 * Generates a Data URI from the given input stream and file name.
 *
 * @param inputStream The input stream containing the data.
 * @param fileName The name of the file.
 * @return A Data URI string.
 * @throws IOException If an I/O error occurs.
 */
public String generateDataURI(final InputStream inputStream, final String fileName) throws IOException {
    StringWriter writer = new StringWriter();
    byte[] bytes = IOUtils.toByteArray(inputStream);
    inputStream.close();
    String mimeType = getMimeType(fileName);
    generateDataURI(bytes, writer, mimeType);
    return writer.toString();
}

6804	```java
/**
 * Generates a data URI from the given byte array and writes it to the specified output writer.
 *
 * @param bytes     the byte array to encode
 * @param out       the writer to output the data URI
 * @param mimeType  the MIME type of the data
 * @throws IOException if an I/O error occurs
 */
private void generateDataURI(final byte[] bytes, final Writer out, final String mimeType) throws IOException {
    // Create the output buffer
    final StringBuffer buffer = new StringBuffer();
    // Append the data URI prefix
    buffer.append(DATA_URI_PREFIX);
    // Append the MIME type
    buffer.append(mimeType);
    // Append the base64-encoded data
    buffer.append(";base64,");
    buffer.append(Base64.encodeBytes(bytes));
    // Write the buffer to the output writer
    out.write(buffer.toString());
}
```

/**
 * Checks if the group associated with the given cache key has changed and performs actions accordingly.
 * 
 * @param cacheKey The cache key to check.
 * @param callback The callback to be invoked if the group has changed.
 */
public void check(final CacheKey cacheKey, final Callback callback) {
    notNull(cacheKey);
    LOG.debug("started");
    final StopWatch watch = new StopWatch();
    watch.start("detect changes");
    try {
        final Group group = new WroModelInspector(modelFactory.create()).getGroupByName(cacheKey.getGroupName());
        if (isGroupChanged(group.collectResourcesOfType(cacheKey.getType()), callback)) {
            callback.onGroupChanged(cacheKey);
            cacheStrategy.put(cacheKey, null);
        }
        resourceChangeDetector.reset();
    } catch (final Exception e) {
        onException(e);
    } finally {
        watch.stop();
        LOG.debug("resource watcher info: {}", watch.prettyPrint());
    }
}

6812	```java
/**
 * Creates and starts a process to execute a command line operation.
 * 
 * @param sourceFile The source file for the operation.
 * @param destFile The destination file for the operation.
 * @return The started process.
 * @throws IOException If an I/O error occurs.
 */
private Process createProcess(final File sourceFile, final File destFile) throws IOException {
    notNull(sourceFile);
    String[] commandLine = getCommandLine(sourceFile.getPath(), destFile.getPath());
    LOG.debug("CommandLine arguments: {}", Arrays.asList(commandLine));
    Process process = new ProcessBuilder(commandLine)
            .redirectErrorStream(true)
            .start();
    
    // Stream gobblers to read from process streams and avoid blocking
    StreamGobbler errorGobbler = new StreamGobbler(process.getErrorStream(), "ERROR");
    StreamGobbler outputGobbler = new StreamGobbler(process.getInputStream(), "OUTPUT");
    
    // Start the stream gobblers
    errorGobbler.start();
    outputGobbler.start();
    
    return process;
}

6815	```java
/**
 * Parses a group element and returns its resources.
 * 
 * @param element The group element to parse.
 * @return The resources of the parsed group.
 * @throws RecursiveGroupDefinitionException If a recursive group definition is detected.
 */
private Collection<Resource> parseGroup(final Element element) {
    final String name = element.getAttribute(ATTR_GROUP_NAME);
    final boolean isAbstractGroup = StringUtils.isNotEmpty(element.getAttribute(ATTR_GROUP_ABSTRACT)) && Boolean.valueOf(element.getAttribute(ATTR_GROUP_ABSTRACT));

    if (groupsInProcess.contains(name)) {
        throw new RecursiveGroupDefinitionException("Infinite Recursion detected for the group: " + name + ". Recursion path: " + groupsInProcess);
    }

    LOG.debug("\tadding group: {}", name);
    groupsInProcess.add(name);

    // Skip if this group is already parsed
    final Group parsedGroup = new WroModelInspector(model).getGroupByName(name);
    if (parsedGroup != null) {
        groupsInProcess.remove(name);
        return parsedGroup.getResources();
    }

    final Group group = createGroup(element);
    groupsInProcess.remove(name);

    if (!isAbstractGroup) {
        model.addGroup(group);
    }

    return group.getResources();
}
```

If a child node is an `Element`, it calls the `parseResource` method to parse the resource and add it to a list of resources. Finally, it sets the list of resources on the `Group` object and returns it.

6826	```java
/**
 * Updates the counters for finished jobs and ensures that all contexts for processed jobs are marked as saturated.
 * 
 * @param localStatistics The local statistics object to update.
 * @throws InterruptedException If the thread is interrupted.
 */
private void updateFinishedCounters(ThisStatistics localStatistics) throws InterruptedException {
    int snapshotJobsProcessed = countJobsProcessedLower_.get();
    
    // Ensure all contexts for processed jobs are marked as saturated
    for (;;) {
        int snapshotCountContextsSaturatedLower = countContextsSaturatedLower_.get();
        saturationState_.setContextsSaturated(snapshotCountContextsSaturatedLower);
        if (saturationState_.getContextSetSaturatedCount() < snapshotCountContextsSaturatedLower) {
            // Another worker marked contexts as saturated, so mark finished jobs instead
            return;
        }
        
        // Ensure the counter for processed jobs is still up to date
        int updatedSnapshotJobsProcessed = countJobsProcessedLower_.get();
        if (updatedSnapshotJobsProcessed == snapshotJobsProcessed) {
            break;
        }
        // Else refresh counters
        snapshotJobsProcessed = updatedSnapshotJobsProcessed;
    }
    
    // Ensure all processed jobs are finished
    for (;;) {
        int snapshotJobsFinished = countJobsFinishedUpper_.get();
        if (snapshotJobsFinished >= snapshotJobsProcessed) {
            break;
        }
        
        // Update the finished context counter and mark the corresponding number of jobs as processed
        if (!countJobsFinishedUpper_.compareAndSet(snapshotJobsFinished, snapshotJobsFinished + 1)) {
            // Retry
            continue;
        }
        
        Job nextJob = jobsInProgress_.poll();
        IndexedContextRoot root = nextJob.getInput();
        Context rootSaturation = saturationState_.getContext(root);
        if (rootSaturation.isInitialized() && !rootSaturation.isSaturated()) {
            LOGGER_.error("{}: context for a finished job not saturated!", rootSaturation);
        }
        nextJob.setOutput(rootSaturation);
        LOGGER_.trace("{}: saturation finished", root);
        localStatistics.jobsProcessedNo++;
        listener_.notifyFinished(nextJob); // Can be interrupted
    }
}

6849	```java
/**
 * Puts a key-value pair into the arrays and returns the old value associated with the key.
 * If the key does not exist, it is added and null is returned.
 * If the key already exists, its value is updated and the old value is returned.
 *
 * @param keys   the array of keys
 * @param values the array of values
 * @param key    the key to be inserted or updated
 * @param value  the value to be associated with the key
 * @param <K>    the type of the keys
 * @param <V>    the type of the values
 * @return the old value associated with the key, or null if the key was not previously present
 */
private static <K, V> V putKeyValue(K[] keys, V[] values, K key, V value) {
    int pos = LinearProbing.getPosition(keys, key);
    if (keys[pos] == null) {
        keys[pos] = key;
        values[pos] = value;
        return null;
    } else {
        V oldValue = values[pos];
        values[pos] = value;
        return oldValue;
    }
}
```

/**
 * Removes an entry from the key-value pairs based on the given key.
 *
 * @param keys   the array of keys
 * @param values the array of values
 * @param key    the key to remove
 * @param <K>    the type of keys
 * @param <V>    the type of values
 * @return the value associated with the removed key, or null if the key is not found
 */
private static <K, V> V removeEntry(K[] keys, V[] values, Object key) {
    int pos = LinearProbing.getPosition(keys, key);
    if (keys[pos] == null) {
        return null;
    } else {
        V result = values[pos];
        LinearProbing.remove(keys, values, pos);
        return result;
    }
}

protected static <T extends ElkEntity> void processTaxonomy(final Taxonomy<T> taxonomy, final Appendable writer) throws IOException {
    // Create an object factory.
    final ElkObject.Factory factory = new ElkObjectEntityRecyclingFactory();

    // Collect members, excluding top and bottom nodes.
    final List<T> members = new ArrayList<>(taxonomy.getNodes().size() * 2);
    for (final TaxonomyNode<T> node : taxonomy.getNodes()) {
        for (final T member : node) {
            if (!member.getIri().equals(taxonomy.getTopNode().getCanonicalMember().getIri()) &&
                !member.getIri().equals(taxonomy.getBottomNode().getCanonicalMember().getIri())) {
                members.add(member);
            }
        }
    }
    Collections.sort(members, taxonomy.getKeyProvider().getComparator());
    printDeclarations(members, factory, writer);

    // Process relations.
    final TreeSet<T> canonicalMembers = new TreeSet<>(taxonomy.getKeyProvider().getComparator());
    for (final TaxonomyNode<T> node : taxonomy.getNodes()) {
        canonicalMembers.add(node.getCanonicalMember());
    }
    for (final T canonicalMember : canonicalMembers) {
        final TaxonomyNode<T> node = taxonomy.getNode(canonicalMember);
        final ArrayList<T> orderedEquivalentMembers = new ArrayList<>(node.size());
        for (final T member : node) {
            orderedEquivalentMembers.add(member);
        }
        Collections.sort(orderedEquivalentMembers, taxonomy.getKeyProvider().getComparator());
        final TreeSet<T> orderedSuperMembers = new TreeSet<>(taxonomy.getKeyProvider().getComparator());
        for (final TaxonomyNode<T> superNode : node.getDirectSuperNodes()) {
            orderedSuperMembers.add(superNode.getCanonicalMember());
        }
        printMemberAxioms(canonicalMember, orderedEquivalentMembers, orderedSuperMembers, taxonomy, factory, writer);
    }
}
```

/**
 * Verifies that the start position exists in the given full chain of object properties.
 * 
 * @param fullChain The full chain of object properties to be checked.
 * @param startPos The start position to be verified.
 * @throws IllegalArgumentException If the start position is out of bounds for the given chain.
 */
protected static void checkChainMatch(final ElkSubObjectPropertyExpression fullChain, final int startPos) {
    fullChain.accept(new ElkSubObjectPropertyExpressionVisitor<Void>() {
        void fail() {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(fullChain + ", " + startPos);
        }

        Void defaultVisit(ElkObjectPropertyExpression expression) {
            if (startPos != 0) {
                fail();
            }
            return null;
        }

        @Override
        public Void visit(ElkObjectPropertyChain expression) {
            if (startPos < 0 || startPos >= expression.getObjectPropertyExpressions().size()) {
                fail();
            }
            return null;
        }

        @Override
        public Void visit(ElkObjectInverseOf expression) {
            return defaultVisit(expression);
        }

        @Override
        public Void visit(ElkObjectProperty expression) {
            return defaultVisit(expression);
        }
    });
}

public static <T> Set<T> filter(final Set<? extends T> input, final Condition<? super T> condition, final int size) {
    return new Set<T>() {
        @Override
        public int size() {
            return size;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean isEmpty() {
            return size == 0;
        }

        @Override
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        public boolean contains(Object o) {
            if (!input.contains(o)) return false;
            T elem = null;
            try {
                elem = (T) o;
            } catch (ClassCastException cce) {
                return false;
            }
            return condition.holds(elem);
        }

        @Override
        public Iterator<T> iterator() {
            return filter(input, condition).iterator();
        }

        @Override
        public Object[] toArray() {
            Object[] result = new Object[size];
            int i = 0;
            for (Object o : filter(input, condition)) {
                result[i++] = o;
            }
            return result;
        }

        @Override
        public <S> S[] toArray(S[] a) {
            throw new UnsupportedOperationException();
        }

        @Override
        public boolean add(T e) {
            throw new UnsupportedOperationException();
        }

        @Override
        public boolean remove(Object o) {
            throw new UnsupportedOperationException();
        }

        @Override
        public boolean containsAll(Collection<?> c) {
            for (Object o : c) {
                if (contains(o)) return false;
            }
            return true;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean addAll(Collection<? extends T> c) {
            throw new UnsupportedOperationException();
        }

        @Override
        public boolean retainAll(Collection<?> c) {
            throw new UnsupportedOperationException();
        }

        @Override
        public boolean removeAll(Collection<?> c) {
            throw new UnsupportedOperationException();
        }

        @Override
        public void clear() {
            throw new UnsupportedOperationException();
        }
    };
}
```

/**
 * Adds an element to the data structure.
 *
 * @param s The index of the slot where the element should be added.
 * @param e The element to be added.
 * @return true if the element was added successfully, false otherwise.
 * @throws NullPointerException if the element is null.
 */
public boolean add(int s, E e) {
    if (e == null) throw new NullPointerException();
    int mask = (1 << s);
    int oldMask = addMask(logs, data, masks, e, mask);
    int newMask = oldMask | mask;
    if (newMask == oldMask) return false;
    else if (oldMask == 0 && ++occupied == LinearProbing.getUpperSize(data.length)) enlarge();
    sizes[s]++;
    return true;
}
```
6870	```java
/**
 * Removes an object from the specified slot in the data structure.
 *
 * @param s the slot index
 * @param o the object to remove
 * @return true if the object was successfully removed, false otherwise
 * @throws NullPointerException if the object is null
 */
public boolean remove(int s, Object o) {
    if (o == null) throw new NullPointerException();
    int mask = 1 << s;
    int oldMask = removeMask(logs, data, masks, o, mask);
    int newMask = oldMask & ~mask;
    if (newMask == oldMask) return false;
    sizes[s]--;
    return true;
}

/**
 * Writes a resource or collection of resources to an XhtmlWriter.
 * 
 * @param writer The XhtmlWriter to write to.
 * @param object The object to write, which can be a Resource, Resources, ResourceSupport, or Collection.
 * @throws RuntimeException if an exception occurs during the write process.
 */
private void writeResource(XhtmlWriter writer, Object object) {
    if (object == null) {
        return;
    }
    try {
        if (object instanceof Resource) {
            Resource<?> resource = (Resource<?>) object;
            writer.beginListItem();
            writeResource(writer, resource.getContent());
            writer.writeLinks(resource.getLinks());
            writer.endListItem();
        } else if (object instanceof Resources) {
            Resources<?> resources = (Resources<?>) object;
            writer.beginListItem();
            writer.beginUnorderedList();
            Collection<?> content = resources.getContent();
            writeResource(writer, content);
            writer.endUnorderedList();
            writer.writeLinks(resources.getLinks());
            writer.endListItem();
        } else if (object instanceof ResourceSupport) {
            ResourceSupport resource = (ResourceSupport) object;
            writer.beginListItem();
            writeObject(writer, resource);
            writer.writeLinks(resource.getLinks());
            writer.endListItem();
        } else if (object instanceof Collection) {
            Collection<?> collection = (Collection<?>) object;
            for (Object item : collection) {
                writeResource(writer, item);
            }
        } else {
            writeObject(writer, object);
        }
    } catch (Exception ex) {
        throw new RuntimeException("failed to transform object " + object, ex);
    }
}
```

/**
 * Retrieves an action input parameter by name.
 * 
 * @param name The name of the parameter to retrieve.
 * @return The action input parameter, or null if not found.
 */
@Override
public ActionInputParameter getActionInputParameter(String name) {
    ActionInputParameter ret = requestParams.get(name);
    if (ret == null) {
        ret = pathVariables.get(name);
    }
    if (ret == null) {
        for (ActionInputParameter annotatedParameter : getInputParameters()) {
            PropertyDescriptor pd = getPropertyDescriptorForPropertyPath(name, annotatedParameter.getParameterType());
            if (pd != null && pd.getWriteMethod() != null) {
                Object callValue = annotatedParameter.getValue();
                Object propertyValue = null;
                if (callValue != null) {
                    BeanWrapper beanWrapper = PropertyAccessorFactory.forBeanPropertyAccess(callValue);
                    propertyValue = beanWrapper.getPropertyValue(name);
                }
                ret = new SpringActionInputParameter(new MethodParameter(pd.getWriteMethod(), 0), propertyValue);
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    return ret;
}
```

public boolean isRequired() {
    boolean ret;
    if (isRequestBody()) {
        ret = requestBody.required();
    } else if (isRequestParam()) {
        ret = !(isDefined(requestParam.defaultValue()) || !requestParam.required());
    } else if (isRequestHeader()) {
        ret = !(isDefined(requestHeader.defaultValue()) || !requestHeader.required());
    } else {
        ret = true;
    }
    return ret;
}

/**
 * Retrieves the vocabulary for a given bean and mixin class.
 * 
 * @param mixinSource The source of the mixin.
 * @param bean The bean to retrieve the vocabulary for.
 * @param mixInClass The mixin class to retrieve the vocabulary for.
 * @return The vocabulary for the bean and mixin class.
 */
public String getVocab(MixinSource mixinSource, Object bean, Class<?> mixInClass) {
    if (proxyUnwrapper != null) {
        bean = proxyUnwrapper.unwrapProxy(bean);
    }
    
    // Determine vocab in context
    String classVocab = bean == null ? null : vocabFromClassOrPackage(bean.getClass());
    final Vocab mixinVocab = findAnnotation(mixInClass, Vocab.class);
    Object nestedContextProviderFromMixin = getNestedContextProviderFromMixin(mixinSource, bean, mixInClass);
    String contextProviderVocab = null;
    
    if (nestedContextProviderFromMixin != null) {
        contextProviderVocab = getVocab(mixinSource, nestedContextProviderFromMixin, null);
    }
    
    String vocab;
    
    if (mixinVocab != null) {
        vocab = mixinVocab.value(); // wins over class
    } else if (classVocab != null) {
        vocab = classVocab; // wins over context provider
    } else if (contextProviderVocab != null) {
        vocab = contextProviderVocab; // wins over last resort
    } else {
        vocab = HTTP_SCHEMA_ORG;
    }
    
    return vocab;
}

6903	```markdown
### Summary of `appendForm` Method

The `appendForm` method is responsible for generating an HTML form based on the provided `Affordance` and `ActionDescriptor`. Here's a breakdown of its functionality:

1. **Extracting Form Details**:
   - Retrieves the form name from the `ActionDescriptor`.
   - Determines the HTTP method from the `ActionDescriptor` and converts it to a `RequestMethod`.
   - Expands the affordance to get the action URL.

2. **Form Initialization**:
   - Begins the form with the necessary attributes (`action`, `method`, and `name`).

3. **Form Header**:
   - Writes an `<h4>` header displaying the form name.

4. **Hidden HTTP Method Field**:
   - Writes a hidden field for the HTTP method to ensure compatibility with older browsers.

5. **Building the Form**:
   - Checks if the action descriptor has a request body:
     - If it does, it processes the parameter bean and recursively builds the form fields.
     - If it doesn't, it processes the plain parameter list:
       - For each parameter, it checks if there are possible values:
         - If there are, it appends a select field (single or multi-select).
         - If there are none, it appends input fields based on whether the parameter is an array or collection.

6. **Form Submission Button**:
   - Adds a submit button with the HTTP method name in uppercase.

7. **Form Closure**:
   - Ends the form.

This method ensures that the form is dynamically generated based on the provided action descriptor, handling both parameter beans and plain parameter lists appropriately.
```

/**
 * Appends input or select based on the child input parameter and possible values.
 * If possible values are present, it appends a select element; otherwise, it appends an input element.
 * 
 * @param parentInputParameter The parent input parameter.
 * @param paramName The name of the parameter.
 * @param childInputParameter The child input parameter.

 */
private void appendInputOrSelect(ActionInputParameter parentInputParameter, String paramName, ActionInputParameter childInputParameter, Object[] possibleValues) throws IOException {
    if (possibleValues.length > 0) {
        if (childInputParameter.isArrayOrCollection()) {
            appendSelectMulti(paramName, possibleValues, childInputParameter);
        } else {
            appendSelectOne(paramName, possibleValues, childInputParameter);

    }
}

6918	```java
/**
 * This method performs a fold operation on an iterable source using a series of operations.
 * @param <H> The type of the result.
 * @param source The iterable source to process.
 * @param ops An array of operations to apply.
 * @param opIdx The starting index of operations to apply.
 * @param ident The identity value for the reduction.
 * @param reducer The function to combine elements.
 * @return The result of the fold operation.
 */
@SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
private static <H> H _fold(Iterable source, Operation[] ops, int opIdx, H ident, Fn2 reducer) {
    Object ret = ident; // Initialize the result with the identity value.
    sourceLoop: for (Object o : source) {
        for (int j = opIdx; j < ops.length; j++) {
            Operation op = ops[j];
            if (op.filter != null && !op.filter.apply(o)) {
                // Skip this item if it does not pass the filter.
                continue sourceLoop;
            }
            if (op.map != null) {
                o = op.map.apply(o);
                if (o == TERMINATE) {
                    return (H) ret; // Terminate if the map function returns TERMINATE.
                }
            } else if (op.flatMap != null) {
                ret = _fold(op.flatMap.apply(o), ops, j + 1, (H) ret, reducer);
                continue sourceLoop; // Continue with the next item in the source.
            }
            // Combine the current item with the result using the reducer.
            ret = reducer.apply(ret, o);
        }
    }
    return (H) ret; // Return the final result.
}
```
