6925	```java
/**
 * Appends an element to the PersistentVector.
 * 
 * @param val The element to append.
 * @return A new PersistentVector with the element appended.
 */
@SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
@Override
public PersistentVector<E> append(E val) {
    // Check if there is room in the tail
    if (size - tailoff() < MAX_NODE_LENGTH) {
        // Create a new tail with the additional element
        E[] newTail = (E[]) new Object[tail.length + 1];
        System.arraycopy(tail, 0, newTail, 0, tail.length);
        newTail[tail.length] = val;
        return new PersistentVector<>(size + 1, shift, root, newTail);
    } else {
        // Full tail, push into tree
        Node newroot;
        Node tailnode = new Node(root.edit, tail);
        int newshift = shift;

        // Overflow root?
        if ((size >>> NODE_LENGTH_POW_2) > (1 << shift)) {
            newroot = new Node(root.edit);
            newroot.array[0] = root;
            newroot.array[1] = newPath(root.edit, shift, tailnode);
            newshift += NODE_LENGTH_POW_2;
        } else {
            newroot = pushTail(shift, root, tailnode);
        }

        return new PersistentVector<>(size + 1, newshift, newroot, (E[]) new Object[]{val});
    }
}

6932	```java
public static StringBuilder indentSpace(int len) {
    StringBuilder sB = new StringBuilder();
    if (len < 1) {
        return sB;
    }
    while (len > SPACES_LENGTH_MINUS_ONE) {
        sB.append(SPACES[SPACES_LENGTH_MINUS_ONE]);
        len = len - SPACES_LENGTH_MINUS_ONE;
    }
    return sB.append(SPACES[len]);
}
```

**Summary:**
The `indentSpace` method constructs a `StringBuilder` with a specified number of spaces. If the input length is less than 1, it returns an empty `StringBuilder`. Otherwise, it appends spaces from a predefined array `SPACES` until the remaining length is less than or equal to `SPACES_LENGTH_MINUS_ONE`. Finally, it appends the remaining spaces and returns the `StringBuilder`.

}

    // Create a new array of the appropriate size
    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    T[] newItems = (T[]) ((tClass == null) ? new Object[length] : Array.newInstance(tClass, length));

/**
 * Retrieves the profile table activity for a given profile table name.
 *
 * @param profileTableName the name of the profile table
 * @return the profile table activity
 * @throws NullPointerException if the profile table name is null
 * @throws UnrecognizedProfileTableNameException if the profile table name is not recognized
 * @throws FacilityException if a facility error occurs
 */
public ProfileTableActivity getProfileTableActivity(String profileTableName) throws NullPointerException, UnrecognizedProfileTableNameException, FacilityException {
    if (logger.isTraceEnabled()) {
        logger.trace("getProfileTableActivity(profileTableName = " + profileTableName + ")");
    }
    final SleeTransactionManager sleeTransactionManager = profileManagement.getSleeContainer().getTransactionManager();
    boolean terminateTx = sleeTransactionManager.requireTransaction();
    try {
        return profileManagement.getProfileTable(profileTableName).getActivity();
    } catch (NullPointerException e) {

        throw e;
    } catch (Throwable e) {
        throw new FacilityException("Failed to obtain profile table.", e);
    } finally {
        // never rollback
        try {
            sleeTransactionManager.requireTransactionEnd(terminateTx, false);
        } catch (Throwable e) {
            throw new FacilityException(e.getMessage(), e);
        }
    }
}

6966	```java
/**
 * Extracts the contents of a JAR file to a specified destination directory.
 *
 * @param jarFile The JAR file to extract.
 * @param dstDir  The destination directory where the contents will be extracted.
 * @throws DeploymentException If an error occurs during the extraction process.
 */
private void extractJar(JarFile jarFile, File dstDir) throws DeploymentException {
    JarInputStream jarIs = null;
    try {
        jarIs = new JarInputStream(new BufferedInputStream(new FileInputStream(jarFile.getName())));
        for (JarEntry entry = jarIs.getNextJarEntry(); jarIs.available() > 0 && entry != null; entry = jarIs.getNextJarEntry()) {
            logger.trace("jar entry = " + entry.getName());
            if (entry.isDirectory()) {
                // Create directory for the JAR entry.
                File dir = new File(dstDir, entry.getName());
                if (!dir.exists()) {
                    if (!dir.mkdirs()) {
                        logger.debug("Failed to create directory " + dir.getAbsolutePath());
                        throw new IOException("Failed to create directory " + dir.getAbsolutePath());
                    }
                } else {
                    logger.trace("Created directory " + dir.getAbsolutePath());
                }
            } else {
                // Extract file from the JAR entry.
                File file = new File(dstDir, entry.getName());
                File dir = file.getParentFile();
                if (!dir.exists()) {
                    if (!dir.mkdirs()) {
                        logger.debug("Failed to create directory " + dir.getAbsolutePath());
                        throw new IOException("Failed to create directory " + dir.getAbsolutePath());
                    } else {
                        logger.trace("Created directory " + dir.getAbsolutePath());
                    }
                }
                pipeStream(jarFile.getInputStream(entry), new FileOutputStream(file));
            }
        }
    } catch (Exception e) {
        throw new DeploymentException("Failed to extract jar file " + jarFile.getName());
    } finally {
        if (jarIs != null) {
            try {
                jarIs.close();
            } catch (IOException e) {
                logger.error("Failed to close jar input stream", e);
            }
        }
    }
}
```
6967	The `pipeStream` method is designed to copy data from an `InputStream` to an `OutputStream` using a buffer. It ensures that both streams are properly closed after the transfer is complete, even if an exception occurs during the process. Here's a summary of the method:

1. **Synchronization**: The method uses a synchronized block to ensure that only one thread can execute the copying process at a time, preventing concurrent access issues.

2. **Buffer Initialization**: A buffer is used to store data read from the `InputStream`.

3. **Reading and Writing Loop**: The method enters a loop where it reads data from the `InputStream` into the buffer and writes the buffer to the `OutputStream` until the end of the stream is reached (indicated by `read` returning `-1`).

4. **Exception Handling**: If an `IOException` occurs during the reading or writing process, the method attempts to close both the `InputStream` and `OutputStream`. If closing either stream fails, it catches the exception but does not handle it further (the comment suggests that some action could be taken, but it is currently commented out).

5. **Resource Cleanup**: Regardless of whether an exception occurs, the method ensures that both the `InputStream` and `OutputStream` are closed to free up resources.

### Summary:
The `pipeStream` method synchronously copies data from an `InputStream` to an `OutputStream` using a buffer. It handles exceptions by attempting to close both streams, even if closing one fails. The method ensures that both streams are properly closed after the transfer is complete.

7003	```java
@ SuppressWarnings ({ "unchecked","rawtypes" })public void activate ()throws InvalidStateException {
    // Check if the entity is in an inactive state
    if (!this.state.isInactive ()) {
        throw new InvalidStateException ("entity " + name + " is in state: " + this.state);
    }
    // Set the state to ACTIVE
    this.state = ResourceAdaptorEntityState.ACTIVE;
    // Check if the SLEE container is running
    if (sleeContainer.getSleeState () == SleeState.RUNNING) {
        // If fault tolerance context needs to be set
        if (setFTContext) {
            setFTContext = false;
            // Check if the resource adaptor is fault tolerant
            if (object.isFaultTolerant ()) {
                try {
                    // Set the fault tolerant context
                    this.ftResourceAdaptorContext = new FaultTolerantResourceAdaptorContextImpl (name, sleeContainer, (FaultTolerantResourceAdaptor) object.getResourceAdaptorObject ());
                    object.setFaultTolerantResourceAdaptorContext (ftResourceAdaptorContext);
                } catch (Throwable t) {
                    logger.error ("Got exception invoking setFaultTolerantResourceAdaptorContext(...) for entity " + name, t);
                }
            }
        }
        try {
            // Activate the resource adaptor object
            object.raActive ();
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            logger.error ("Got exception invoking raActive() for entity " + name, t);
        }
    }
}

7004	```java
/**
 * Deactivates the entity if it is currently active.
 * Throws an InvalidStateException if the entity is not in the active state.
 * Schedules the deactivation logic to run half a second later.
 * 
 * @throws InvalidStateException if the entity is not in the active state.
 * @throws TransactionRequiredLocalException if a transaction is required.
 */
public void deactivate() throws InvalidStateException, TransactionRequiredLocalException {
    if (!this.state.isActive()) {
        throw new InvalidStateException("entity " + name + " is in state: " + this.state);
    }
    this.state = ResourceAdaptorEntityState.STOPPING;
    if (object.getState() == ResourceAdaptorObjectState.ACTIVE) {
        object.raStopping();
    }
    TimerTask t = new TimerTask() {
        @Override
        public void run() {
            try {
                cancel();
                if (state == ResourceAdaptorEntityState.STOPPING) {
                    if (object.getState() == ResourceAdaptorObjectState.STOPPING) {
                        scheduleAllActivitiesEnd();
                    } else {
                        allActivitiesEnded();
                    }
                }
            } catch (Throwable e) {
                logger.error(e.getMessage(), e);
            }
        }
    };
    resourceAdaptorContext.getTimer().schedule(t, 500);
}
```

7012	```java
/**
 * Verifies and updates the configuration properties.
 * 
 * @param newProperties The new configuration properties to verify.
 * @throws InvalidConfigurationException If any property has a null value or if the RA object verification fails.
 */
private void verifyConfigProperties(ConfigProperties newProperties) throws InvalidConfigurationException {
    if (doTraceLogs) {
        logger.trace("verifyConfigProperties( newProperties = " + newProperties + " )");
    }

    // Merge properties
    for (ConfigProperties.Property configProperty : configProperties.getProperties()) {
        if (newProperties.getProperty(configProperty.getName()) == null) {
            newProperties.addProperty(configProperty);
        }
    }

    // Validate properties
    for (ConfigProperties.Property entityProperty : newProperties.getProperties()) {
        if (entityProperty.getValue() == null) {
            throw new InvalidConfigurationException("the property " + entityProperty.getName() + " has null value");
        }
    }

    // Validate in RA object
    object.raVerifyConfiguration(newProperties);

    // Switch config
    configProperties = newProperties;
}
```

7025	```java
public static void fireEvent(SbbEntity sbbEntity, EventTypeID eventTypeID, Object eventObject, ActivityContextInterface aci, Address address, ServiceID serviceID) {
    // Check for congestion control
    if (sleeContainer.getCongestionControl().refuseFireEvent()) {
        throw new SLEEException("congestion control refused event");
    }

    // Validate input parameters
    if (sbbEntity == null || sbbEntity.getSbbObject() == null || sbbEntity.getSbbObject().getState() != SbbObjectState.READY) {
        throw new IllegalStateException("SbbObject not assigned!");
    }
    if (eventObject == null) {
        throw new NullPointerException("JAIN SLEE (TM) specs - Section 8.4.1: The event cannot be null. If event argument is null, the fire event method throws a java.lang.NullPointerException.");
    }
    if (aci == null) {
        throw new NullPointerException("JAIN SLEE (TM) specs - Section 8.4.1: The activity cannot be null. If activity argument is null, the fire event method throws a java.lang.NullPointerException.");
    }

    // Ensure transactional method
    final SleeTransactionManager txManager = sleeContainer.getTransactionManager();
    txManager.mandateTransaction();

    // Get activity context
    ActivityContext ac = ((org.mobicents.slee.container.activity.ActivityContextInterface) aci).getActivityContext();
    if (logger.isTraceEnabled()) {
        logger.trace("invoke(): firing event on " + ac);
    }

    // Check if activity context is ending
    if (ac.isEnding()) {
        throw new IllegalStateException("activity context " + ac.getActivityContextHandle() + " is ending");
    }

    // Get transaction data
    final EventRoutingTransactionData transactionData = txManager.getTransactionContext().getEventRoutingTransactionData();
    if (transactionData != null) {
        final EventContext eventBeingDelivered = transactionData.getEventBeingDelivered();
        if (eventBeingDelivered != null && eventBeingDelivered.getEvent() == eventObject) {
            // Copy reference handler and fire event
            ac.fireEvent(eventTypeID, eventObject, (Address) address, serviceID, eventBeingDelivered);
            return;
        }
    }

    // Fire event
    ac.fireEvent(eventTypeID, eventObject, (Address) address, serviceID, null, null, null);
}
```

7036	```java
/**
 * Determines if a deployable unit should be accepted based on its URL and name.
 * 
 * @param deployableUnitURL The URL of the deployable unit.
 * @param deployableUnitName The name of the deployable unit.
 * @return true if the deployable unit should be accepted, false otherwise.
 */
public boolean accepts(URL deployableUnitURL, String deployableUnitName) {
    DeployableUnitWrapper du = new DeployableUnitWrapper(deployableUnitURL, deployableUnitName);
    URL url = du.getUrl();
    if (logger.isTraceEnabled()) {
        logger.trace("Method accepts called for " + url + " [DU: " + deployableUnitName + "]");
    }
    try {
        String fullPath = url.getFile();
        String fileName = fullPath.substring(fullPath.lastIndexOf('/') + 1, fullPath.length());
        // Check if the file is in the toAccept list
        if (toAccept.containsKey(fileName)) {
            if (logger.isTraceEnabled()) {
                logger.trace("Accepting " + url.toString() + ".");
            }
            return true;
        }
        // Check if the file is a jar and might be a DU jar
        else if (fileName.endsWith(".jar")) {
            JarFile duJarFile = null;
            try {
                // Try to obtain the DU descriptor
                if (du.getEntry("META-INF/deployable-unit.xml") != null) {
                    if (logger.isTraceEnabled()) {
                        logger.trace("Accepting " + url.toString() + ".");
                    }
                    return true;
                }
            } finally {
                // Clean up
                if (duJarFile != null) {
                    try {
                        duJarFile.close();
                    } catch (IOException ignore) {
                    } finally {
                        duJarFile = null;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    } catch (Exception ignore) {
        // Ignore exception, will reject
    }
    // Reject if no conditions are met
    return false;
}
```

public void init(URL deployableUnitURL, String deployableUnitName) throws DeploymentException {
    URL url = deployableUnitURL;
    DeployableUnitWrapper du = new DeployableUnitWrapper(deployableUnitURL, deployableUnitName);
    if (logger.isTraceEnabled()) {
        logger.trace("Method init called for " + deployableUnitURL + " [DU: " + deployableUnitName + "]");
    }
    String fullPath = du.getFullPath();
    String fileName = du.getFileName();
    try {
        DeployableUnitWrapper duWrapper = toAccept.remove(fileName);
        if (duWrapper != null) {
            DeployableComponent dc = new DeployableComponent(du, url, fileName, sleeContainerDeployer);
            DeployableUnit deployerDU = deployableUnits.get(duWrapper.getFileName());
            for (DeployableComponent subDC : dc.getSubComponents()) {
                deployerDU.addComponent(subDC);
            }
        } else if (fileName.endsWith(".jar")) {
            JarFile duJarFile = null;
            try {
                duJarFile = new JarFile(fullPath);
                JarEntry duXmlEntry = duJarFile.getJarEntry("META-INF/deployable-unit.xml");
                if (duXmlEntry != null) {
                    DeployableUnit deployerDU = new DeployableUnit(du, sleeContainerDeployer);

                    DeployableUnitDescriptor duDesc = dudf.parse(duJarFile.getInputStream(duXmlEntry));
                    while (deployableUnits.containsKey(fileName)) {
                        Thread.sleep(getWaitTimeBetweenOperations());
                    }
                    deployableUnits.put(fileName, deployerDU);
                    for (String componentJarName : duDesc.getJarEntries()) {
                        int beginIndex = componentJarName.lastIndexOf(' ') == -1 ? componentJarName.lastIndexOf(' ') : componentJarName.lastIndexOf(' ') + 1;
                        componentJarName = componentJarName.substring(beginIndex, componentJarName.length());
                        toAccept.put(componentJarName, du);
                    }
                    for (String serviceXMLName : duDesc.getServiceEntries()) {

/**
 * Starts the deployment of a deployable unit.
 * 
 * @param deployableUnitURL The URL of the deployable unit.
 * @param deployableUnitName The name of the deployable unit.
 * @throws DeploymentException If an error occurs during deployment.
 */
public void start(URL deployableUnitURL, String deployableUnitName) throws DeploymentException {
    DeployableUnitWrapper du = new DeployableUnitWrapper(deployableUnitURL, deployableUnitName);
    if (logger.isTraceEnabled()) {
        logger.trace("Method start called for " + du.getUrl() + " [DU: " + deployableUnitName + "]");
    }
    try {
        // Get the deployable unit object
        DeployableUnit realDU = deployableUnits.get(du.getFileName());
        // If it exists, install it
        if (realDU != null) {
            while (isInUndeployList(du.getFileName())) {
                Thread.sleep(getWaitTimeBetweenOperations());
            }
            sleeContainerDeployer.getDeploymentManager().installDeployableUnit(realDU);
        }
    } catch (Exception e) {
        logger.error("", e);
    }
}

7039	```java
/**
 * Stops a deployable unit by its URL and name.
 * 
 * @param deployableUnitURL The URL of the deployable unit to stop.
 * @param deployableUnitName The name of the deployable unit to stop.
 * @throws DeploymentException If an error occurs during the deployment process.
 */
public void stop(URL deployableUnitURL, String deployableUnitName) throws DeploymentException {
    if (logger.isTraceEnabled()) {
        logger.trace("stop(deployableUnitURL = " + deployableUnitURL + ")");
    }
    DeployableUnitWrapper du = new DeployableUnitWrapper(deployableUnitURL, deployableUnitName);
    DeployableUnit realDU = null;
    String fileName = du.getFileName();
    if ((realDU = deployableUnits.get(fileName)) != null) {
        if (logger.isTraceEnabled()) {
            logger.trace("Got DU: " + realDU.getDeploymentInfoShortName());
        }
        if (!isInUndeployList(fileName)) {
            addToUndeployList(fileName);
        }
        try {
            // Uninstall the deployable unit
            sleeContainerDeployer.getDeploymentManager().uninstallDeployableUnit(realDU);
            // Remove it from the list if successful
            deployableUnits.remove(fileName);
            removeFromUndeployList(fileName);
        } catch (DependencyException e) {
            // Ignore, will be tried again once there is another undeployment
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Throwable cause = e.getCause();
            if (cause instanceof InvalidStateException) {
                logger.warn(cause.getLocalizedMessage() + "... WAITING ...");
            } else if (e instanceof DeploymentException) {
                throw new IllegalStateException(e.getLocalizedMessage(), e);
            } else {
                logger.error(e.getMessage(), e);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

7055	```java
void _endActivity(ActivityHandle handle, final SleeTransaction barrierTx) throws UnrecognizedActivityHandleException {
    // Create an ActivityContextHandle using the provided handle and raEntity
    final ActivityContextHandle ach = new ResourceAdaptorActivityContextHandleImpl(raEntity, handle);
    // Retrieve the ActivityContext using the ActivityContextHandle
    final ActivityContext ac = acFactory.getActivityContext(ach);
    
    if (ac != null) {
        // If a barrier transaction is provided, create a barrier and add actions to remove it after commit or rollback
        if (barrierTx != null) {
            final ActivityEventQueueManager aeqm = ac.getLocalActivityContext().getEventQueueManager();
            aeqm.createBarrier(barrierTx);
            TransactionalAction action = new TransactionalAction() {
                public void execute() {
                    aeqm.removeBarrier(barrierTx);
                }
            };
            final TransactionContext tc = barrierTx.getTransactionContext();
            tc.getAfterCommitActions().add(action);
            tc.getAfterRollbackActions().add(action);
        }
        // End the activity
        ac.endActivity();
    } else {
        // Throw an exception if the activity handle is unrecognized
        throw new UnrecognizedActivityHandleException(handle.toString());
    }
}
```

   - If `fieldClass` is a primitive type, the method attempts to convert `optArg` to the corresponding wrapper class using the `valueOf` method.
   - For example, if `fieldClass` is `int.class`, it converts `optArg` to an `Integer`.

2. **Wrapper Classes Handling**:
   - If `fieldClass` is a wrapper class (e.g., `Integer`, `Long`, etc.), the method uses reflection to get the constructor that takes a `String` parameter and then creates a new instance of the wrapper class with `optArg`.

3. **Unsupported Types**:
   - If `fieldClass` is neither a primitive type nor a wrapper class, the method throws a `CommandException` indicating an unexpected type.

4. **Return Value**:
   - The method returns the converted object or the original `optArg` if no conversion is needed.

This method ensures that the input string can be converted to the desired type, handling both primitive and wrapper classes efficiently.

/**
 * This method is used to resolve the object during deserialization.

 * If the `level` does not match any known constant, it throws a `StreamCorruptedException`.
 *
 * @return The constant corresponding to the `level` value.
 * @throws StreamCorruptedException If the `level` is invalid.
 */
private Object readResolve() throws StreamCorruptedException {
    if (level == LEVEL_OFF) return OFF;
    if (level == LEVEL_SEVERE) return SEVERE;
    if (level == LEVEL_WARNING) return WARNING;
    if (level == LEVEL_INFO) return INFO;
    if (level == LEVEL_CONFIG) return CONFIG;
    if (level == LEVEL_FINE) return FINE;
    if (level == LEVEL_FINER) return FINER;
    if (level == LEVEL_FINEST) return FINEST;
    throw new StreamCorruptedException("Invalid internal state found");
}

7069	```java
/**
 * Adds a profile call to the transaction context.
 *
 * @param po the profile object implementation
 * @throws SLEEException if an error occurs
 */
@SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
public static void addProfileCall(ProfileObjectImpl po) throws SLEEException {
    SleeTransactionManager sleeTransactionManager = sleeContainer.getTransactionManager();
    try {
        if (sleeTransactionManager.getTransaction() == null) {
            return;
        }
    } catch (SystemException se) {
        throw new SLEEException("Unable to verify SLEE Transaction.", se);
    }

    String key = makeKey(po);
    if (logger.isTraceEnabled()) {
        logger.trace("Recording call to profile. Key[" + key + "]");
    }

    final TransactionContext txContext = sleeTransactionManager.getTransactionContext();
    ProfileCallRecorderTransactionData data = (ProfileCallRecorderTransactionData) txContext.getData().get(TRANSACTION_CONTEXT_KEY);

    // If data does not exist, create it
    if (data == null) {
        data = new ProfileCallRecorderTransactionData();
        txContext.getData().put(TRANSACTION_CONTEXT_KEY, data);
    }

    if (!po.isProfileReentrant()) {
        // Check for loopback call
        if (data.invokedProfiles.contains(key) && data.invokedProfiles.getLast().compareTo(key) != 0) {
            throw new SLEEException("Detected loopback call. Call sequence: " + data.invokedProfiles);
        }
        data.invokedProfiles.add(key);
        data.invokedProfileTablesNames.add(po.getProfileTable().getProfileTableName());
    }
}
```

7071	```java
public static void passivateProfileObjectOnTxEnd(SleeTransactionManager txManager, ProfileObjectImpl profileObject, ProfileObjectPool pool) {
    // Define actions to be executed after rollback
    TransactionalAction afterRollbackAction = new TransactionalAction() {
        public void execute() {
            profileObject.invalidateObject();
            pool.returnObject(profileObject);
        }
    };

    // Define actions to be executed before commit
    TransactionalAction beforeCommitAction = new TransactionalAction() {
        public void execute() {
            if (profileObject.getState() == ProfileObjectState.READY) {
                if (!profileObject.getProfileEntity().isRemove()) {
                    profileObject.fireAddOrUpdatedEventIfNeeded();
                    profileObject.profilePassivate();
                } else {
                    profileObject.profileRemove(true, false);
                }
                pool.returnObject(profileObject);
            }
        }
    };

    // Get the transaction context and add actions
    final TransactionContext txContext = txManager.getTransactionContext();
    txContext.getAfterRollbackActions().add(afterRollbackAction);
    txContext.getBeforeCommitActions().add(beforeCommitAction);
}
```

 * Creates a method named `asSbbActivityContextInterface` in the given `activityContextInterface` class.
 * This method takes a `javax.slee.ActivityContextInterface` as a parameter and returns an instance of the `concreteActivityContextInterfaceClass`.
 * If the input `aci` is null, it throws an `IllegalStateException`.
 * If the `sbbEntity` is null or its state is not `READY`, it also throws an `IllegalStateException`.
 * If `aci` is an instance of `concreteActivityContextInterfaceClass`, it returns `aci`.
 * Otherwise, it creates a new instance of `concreteActivityContextInterfaceClass` with the given `aci` and `sbbEntity.getSbbComponent()`.
 * 
 * @param activityContextInterface The class to which the method will be added.
 * @param concreteActivityContextInterfaceClass The concrete class of the activity context interface.
 * @throws DeploymentException If there is an error while creating the method.

protected void createGetSbbActivityContextInterfaceMethod(CtClass activityContextInterface, Class<?> concreteActivityContextInterfaceClass) throws DeploymentException {
    String methodToAdd = "public " + activityContextInterface.getName() + " asSbbActivityContextInterface(javax.slee.ActivityContextInterface aci) {" +
            "if(aci==null)" +

            "else return  new " + concreteActivityContextInterfaceClass.getName() + " ( (" + ActivityContextInterface.class.getName() + ") $1, " +
            "sbbEntity.getSbbComponent());" +
            "}";
    CtMethod methodTest;
    try {
        methodTest = CtNewMethod.make(methodToAdd, sbbConcreteClass);
        sbbConcreteClass.addMethod(methodTest);
        if (logger.isTraceEnabled()) {
            logger.trace("Method " + methodToAdd + " added");

    }

7115	```java
/**
 * Sets the profile context for the current object.
 * 
 * @param profileContext The profile context to be set.
 * @throws NullPointerException if the passed context is null.
 * @throws IllegalStateException if the current state is not "DOES_NOT_EXIST".
 */
public void setProfileContext(ProfileContextImpl profileContext) {
    if (logger.isTraceEnabled()) {
        logger.trace("[setProfileContext] " + this);
    }
    if (profileContext == null) {
        throw new NullPointerException("Passed context must not be null.");
    }
    if (state != ProfileObjectState.DOES_NOT_EXIST) {
        throw new IllegalStateException("Wrong state: " + this.state + ", on profile set context operation, for profile table: " + this.profileTable.getProfileTableName() + " with specification: " + this.profileTable.getProfileSpecificationComponent().getProfileSpecificationID());
    }
    this.profileContext = profileContext;
    this.profileContext.setProfileObject(this);
    if (profileConcreteClassInfo.isInvokeSetProfileContext()) {
        final ClassLoader oldClassLoader = SleeContainerUtils.getCurrentThreadClassLoader();
        try {
            final ClassLoader cl = this.profileTable.getProfileSpecificationComponent().getClassLoader();
            if (System.getSecurityManager() != null) {
                AccessController.doPrivileged(new PrivilegedAction<Object>() {
                    public Object run() {
                        Thread.currentThread().setContextClassLoader(cl);
                        return null;
                    }
                });
            } else {
                Thread.currentThread().setContextClassLoader(cl);
            }
            try {
                if (isSlee11) {
                    try {
                        profileConcrete.setProfileContext(profileContext);
                    } catch (RuntimeException e) {
                        runtimeExceptionOnProfileInvocation(e);
                    }
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                if (logger.isDebugEnabled()) {
                    logger.debug("Exception encountered while setting profile context for profile table: " + this.profileTable.getProfileTableName() + " with specification: " + this.profileTable.getProfileSpecificationComponent().getProfileSpecificationID(), e);
                }
            } finally {
                if (System.getSecurityManager() != null) {
                    AccessController.doPrivileged(new PrivilegedAction<Object>() {
                        public Object run() {
                            Thread.currentThread().setContextClassLoader(oldClassLoader);
                            return null;
                        }
                    });
                } else {
                    Thread.currentThread().setContextClassLoader(oldClassLoader);
                }
            }
        } finally {
            state = ProfileObjectState.POOLED;
        }
    }
}

        throw new NullPointerException("Class name cannot be null");

    CtClass clazz = classPool.makeClass(className);

7133	This method `checkTracerName` is designed to validate a tracer name based on specific rules. It takes two parameters: `tracerName` (a `String`) and `notificationSource` (a `NotificationSource`). The method throws an `IllegalArgumentException` if the tracer name is invalid.

Here's a summary of the method:

1. **Check for Empty Tracer Name**: If the `tracerName` is an empty string, it is considered valid and the method returns immediately.

2. **Tokenize the Tracer Name**: The `tracerName` is tokenized using a `StringTokenizer` with a period (`.`) as the delimiter. This allows the method to process each part of the tracer name individually.

3. **Initialize Variables**: A variable `fqdnPartIndex` is initialized to keep track of the number of valid FQDN (Fully Qualified Domain Name) parts encountered.

4. **Iterate Through Tokens**: The method iterates through each token obtained from the tokenizer:
   - If the token is the first one (`lastToken` is `null`), it is stored as `lastToken`.
   - If the current token is the same as the previous token and is a period (`.`), an `IllegalArgumentException` is thrown because consecutive periods are not allowed.
   - If the current token is not a period, the method checks each character in the token:
     - If the character is a letter or a digit, it is considered valid.
     - If the character is not a letter or a digit, an `IllegalArgumentException` is thrown because the token contains an illegal character.
   - The `fqdnPartIndex` is incremented for each valid token that is not a period.
   - The `lastToken` is updated to the current token.

5. **Final Check for Period**: After the loop, if the last token is a period, an `IllegalArgumentException` is thrown because a period at the end of the tracer name is not allowed.

In summary, the method ensures that the tracer name is a valid FQDN with no consecutive periods and only contains letters and digits. If any of these conditions are not met, an `IllegalArgumentException` is thrown with a descriptive error message.

/**
 * Creates a temporary directory for a Deployable Unit (DU) deployment.
 *
 * @param deploymentRoot the root directory for deployment
 * @param deployableUnitID the ID of the Deployable Unit
 * @return the created temporary directory
 * @throws SLEEException if the directory cannot be created
 */
private File createTempDUDeploymentDir(File deploymentRoot, DeployableUnitID deployableUnitID) {
    try {
        // Create a dummy file to ensure uniqueness
        File tempFile = File.createTempFile("restcomm-slee-du-", "", deploymentRoot);
        File tempDUDeploymentDir = new File(tempFile.getAbsolutePath() + "-contents");

        if (!tempDUDeploymentDir.exists()) {
            tempDUDeploymentDir.mkdirs();
        } else {
            throw new SLEEException("Dir " + tempDUDeploymentDir + " already exists, unable to create deployment dir for DU " + deployableUnitID);
        }

        tempFile.delete();
        return tempDUDeploymentDir;
    } catch (IOException e) {
        throw new SLEEException("Failed to create deployment dir for DU " + deployableUnitID, e);
    }
}

/**

7140	```java
/**
 * Executes a safe proxy call on the given proxy object.
 * 
 * @param proxy The proxy object to call the method on.
 * @param methodToCallname The name of the method to call.
 * @param signature The parameter types of the method to call.
 * @param values The arguments to pass to the method.
 * @return The result of the method call.
 * @throws PrivilegedActionException If an exception occurs during the privileged action.
 */
public static Object makeSafeProxyCall(final Object proxy, final String methodToCallname, final Class<?>[] signature, final Object[] values) throws PrivilegedActionException {
    try {
        return AccessController.doPrivileged(new PrivilegedExceptionAction<Object>() {
            public Object run() throws Exception {
                Method m = proxy.getClass().getMethod(methodToCallname, signature);
                return m.invoke(proxy, values);
            }
        });
    } catch (SecurityException e) {
        e.printStackTrace();
    } catch (PrivilegedActionException e) {
        e.printStackTrace();
    }
    return null;
}
```

/**
 * Assigns a TraceLevel based on the given log4j Level.
 *
 * @param log4jLevel The log4j Level to convert.
 */
private void assignLog4JLevel(Level log4jLevel) {
    if (log4jLevel == null) {
        return;
    }
    switch (log4jLevel) {
        case DEBUG:
            level = TraceLevel.FINE;
            break;
        case INFO:
            level = TraceLevel.INFO;
            break;
        case WARN:
            level = TraceLevel.WARNING;
            break;
        case ERROR:
            level = TraceLevel.SEVERE;
            break;
        case TRACE:
            level = TraceLevel.FINEST;
            break;
        case OFF:
            level = TraceLevel.OFF;
            break;
    }
}

7154	```java
void resetCacheFlags(boolean resetChilds) {
    if (isTraceable(TraceLevel.FINEST)) {
        enableAllFlags();
    } else if (isTraceable(TraceLevel.FINER)) {
        enableFlagsUpTo(TraceLevel.FINER);
    } else if (isTraceable(TraceLevel.FINE)) {
        enableFlagsUpTo(TraceLevel.FINE);
    } else if (isTraceable(TraceLevel.CONFIG)) {
        enableFlagsUpTo(TraceLevel.CONFIG);
    } else if (isTraceable(TraceLevel.INFO)) {
        enableFlagsUpTo(TraceLevel.INFO);
    } else if (isTraceable(TraceLevel.WARNING)) {
        enableFlagsUpTo(TraceLevel.WARNING);
    } else if (isTraceable(TraceLevel.SEVERE)) {
        enableFlagsUpTo(TraceLevel.SEVERE);
    }

    if (resetChilds) {
        for (TracerImpl child : childs) {
            if (child.level == null) {
                child.resetCacheFlags(true);
            }
        }
    }
}

private void enableAllFlags() {
    finestEnabled = true;
    finerEnabled = true;
    fineEnabled = true;
    configEnabled = true;
    infoEnabled = true;
    warningEnabled = true;
    severeEnabled = true;
}

private void enableFlagsUpTo(TraceLevel level) {
    switch (level) {
        case FINEST:
            finestEnabled = true;
        case FINER:
            finerEnabled = true;
        case FINE:
            fineEnabled = true;
        case CONFIG:
            configEnabled = true;
        case INFO:
            infoEnabled = true;
        case WARNING:
            warningEnabled = true;
        case SEVERE:
            severeEnabled = true;
    }
}
```

protected Class<?> findClassLocally(String name) throws ClassNotFoundException {
    if (logger.isTraceEnabled()) {
        logger.trace(toString() + " findClassLocally: " + name);
    }
    final boolean acquiredLock = acquireGlobalLock();
    try {
        return findClassLocallyLocked(name);

        if (acquiredLock) {
            releaseGlobalLock();
        }
    }

/**
 * Creates and registers a ProfileMBean.
 *
 * @param profileName The name of the profile.
 * @param profileTable The profile table.
 * @return The created and registered ProfileMBean.
 * @throws ManagementException If an error occurs during the creation or registration.
 */
private AbstractProfileMBeanImpl createAndRegisterProfileMBean(String profileName, ProfileTableImpl profileTable) throws ManagementException {
    if (logger.isDebugEnabled()) {
        logger.debug("createAndRegisterProfileMBean(profileTable = " + profileTable + ", profileName = " + profileName + ")");
    }
    try {
        ProfileSpecificationComponent component = profileTable.getProfileSpecificationComponent();
        Constructor<?> constructor = component.getProfileMBeanConcreteImplClass().getConstructor(Class.class, String.class, ProfileTableImpl.class);
        AbstractProfileMBeanImpl profileMBean = (AbstractProfileMBeanImpl) constructor.newInstance(component.getProfileMBeanConcreteInterfaceClass(), profileName, profileTable);
        profileMBean.register();

        // Add a rollback action to unregister the MBean
        TransactionalAction rollbackAction = new TransactionalAction() {
            public void execute() {
                try {
                    profileMBean.unregister();
                } catch (Throwable e) {
                    logger.error(e.getMessage(), e);
                }
            }
        };
        sleeTransactionManagement.getTransactionContext().getAfterRollbackActions().add(rollbackAction);

        return profileMBean;
    } catch (Throwable e) {
        throw new ManagementException(e.getMessage(), e);
    }
}

/**
 * Shuts down the SLEE and performs necessary operations.
 * 
 * @throws InvalidStateException if the SLEE is not in the STOPPED state.
 */
public void shutdownSlee() throws InvalidStateException {
    if (sleeState != SleeState.STOPPED) {
        throw new InvalidStateException("SLEE in " + sleeState + " state");
    }
    beforeModulesShutdown();
    for (Iterator<SleeContainerModule> i = modules.descendingIterator(); i.hasNext();) {
        i.next().sleeShutdown();
    }
    afterModulesShutdown();
    sleeState = null;
}

7170	```java
/**
 * Validates the transition between two states in a sleep system.
 * 
 * @param oldState The previous state.
 * @param newState The new state.
 * @throws InvalidStateException If the transition is not allowed.
 */
private void validateStateTransition(SleeState oldState, SleeState newState) throws InvalidStateException {
    if (oldState == SleeState.STOPPED) {
        if (newState == SleeState.STARTING) return;
    } else if (oldState == SleeState.STARTING) {
        if (newState == SleeState.RUNNING || newState == SleeState.STOPPING) return;
    } else if (oldState == SleeState.RUNNING) {
        if (newState == SleeState.STOPPING) return;
    } else if (oldState == SleeState.STOPPING) {
        if (newState == SleeState.STOPPED) return;
    }
    throw new InvalidStateException("illegal sleep state transition: " + oldState + " -> " + newState);
}
```

7191	```java
/**
 * Pushes a file named "handlePopBox.jar" from the classpath to a device using ADB.
 * 
 * @return true if the push operation was successful, false otherwise.
 */
private boolean pushHandleGps2Device() {
    // Get the input stream for the file "handlePopBox.jar" from the classpath
    InputStream io = AbstractDevice.class.getResourceAsStream("handlePopBox.jar");
    
    // Define the destination file path in the temporary directory
    File dest = new File(FileUtils.getTempDirectory(), "handlePopBox.jar");
    
    try {
        // Copy the file from the input stream to the destination file
        FileUtils.copyInputStreamToFile(io, dest);
    } catch (IOException e) {
        // Print the stack trace if an I/O error occurs
        e.printStackTrace();
    }
    
    // Construct the ADB push command to transfer the file to the device
    CommandLine pushcommand = adbCommand("push ", dest.getAbsolutePath(), "/data/local/tmp/");
    
    // Execute the ADB push command quietly and capture the output
    String outputPush = executeCommandQuietly(pushcommand);
    
    // Log the output of the push command
    log.debug("Push automator.jar to device {}", outputPush);
    
    try {
        // Wait for 1 second to allow the device to recover from the activity start
        Thread.sleep(1000);
    } catch (InterruptedException ie) {
        // Throw a runtime exception if the thread is interrupted
        throw new RuntimeException(ie);
    }
    
    // Return true if the output contains "KB/s", indicating a successful push
    return outputPush.contains("KB/s");
}

7197	```java
/**
 * Tokenizes the given HTML text into a collection of HTML tokens.
 * 
 * @param text The HTML text to be tokenized.
 * @return A collection of HTML tokens.
 */
public Collection<HTMLToken> tokenizeHTML() {
    List<HTMLToken> tokens = new ArrayList<>();
    String nestedTags = nestedTagsRegex(6);
    Pattern p = Pattern.compile("(?s:<!(--.*?--\\s*)+>)|" + "(?s:<\\?.*?\\?>)|" + nestedTags, Pattern.CASE_INSENSITIVE);
    Matcher m = p.matcher(text);
    int lastPos = 0;
    while (m.find()) {
        if (lastPos < m.start()) {
            tokens.add(HTMLToken.text(text.substring(lastPos, m.start())));
        }
        tokens.add(HTMLToken.tag(text.substring(m.start(), m.end())));
        lastPos = m.end();
    }
    if (lastPos < text.length()) {
        tokens.add(HTMLToken.text(text.substring(lastPos, text.length())));
    }
    return tokens;
}
```

/**
 * Retrieves a list of objects of a specified class from a given path with optional filters.
 *
 * @param path         The base path.
 * @param key          The key to retrieve the list.
 * @param expectedClass The class of the objects in the list.
 * @param filters      Optional filters to apply to the list.
 * @return A list of objects of the specified class.
 */
protected static <TYPE> List<TYPE> getList(String path, String key, Class<TYPE> expectedClass, List<String> filters) {
    StringBuilder tempPath = new StringBuilder(path);
    tempPath.append("?");
    for (String filter : filters) {
        tempPath.append(filter).append(' ');
    }
    return getList(tempPath.substring(0, tempPath.length() - 1), key, expectedClass);
}

7238	```java
/**
 * Loads all key-value pairs from the database for the given keys.
 * 
 * @param keys The collection of keys to load.
 * @return A map containing the key-value pairs for the given keys.
 */
@Override
public Map<byte[], byte[]> loadAllByKeys(Collection<byte[]> keys) {
    if (keys == null || keys.size() == 0) {
        return Collections.EMPTY_MAP;
    }
    
    Map<byte[], byte[]> results = new LinkedHashMap<>(keys.size());
    DBIterator iterator = null;
    try {
        iterator = database.iterator();
        iterator.seek(keys.iterator().next());
        while (iterator.hasNext()) {
            final Map.Entry<byte[], byte[]> next = iterator.next();
            results.put(next.getKey(), next.getValue());
        }
    } finally {
        try {
            if (iterator != null) {
                iterator.close();
            }
        } catch (IOException e) {
            Exceptions.handle(e);
        }
    }
    return results;
}
```

7240	```java
public static <T> double reduceBy(final double[] array, T object) {
    if (object.getClass().isAnonymousClass()) {
        return reduceByR(array, object);
    }
    try {
        ConstantCallSite callSite = Invoker.invokeReducerLongIntReturnLongMethodHandle(object);
        MethodHandle methodHandle = callSite.dynamicInvoker();
        try {
            double sum = 0;
            for (double v : array) {
                sum = (double) methodHandle.invokeExact(sum, v);
            }
            return sum;
        } catch (Throwable throwable) {
            return handle(Long.class, throwable, "Unable to perform reduceBy");
        }
    } catch (Exception ex) {
        return reduceByR(array, object);
    }
}
```

**Summary:**
The `reduceBy` method is a generic method that takes an array of doubles and an object. It checks if the object is an anonymous class and calls `reduceByR` if true. Otherwise, it attempts to invoke a method handle obtained from a call site to perform a reduction operation on the array elements. If successful, it returns the sum; if an exception occurs, it handles the exception and calls `reduceByR` again.
7241	```java
/**
 * Reduces an array of doubles using a method from the provided object.
 * 
 * @param array The array of doubles to be reduced.
 * @param object The object containing the reduction method.
 * @return The result of the reduction.
 */
private static <T> double reduceByR(final double[] array, T object) {
    try {
        Method method = Invoker.invokeReducerLongIntReturnLongMethod(object);
        double sum = 0;
        for (double v : array) {
            sum = (double) method.invoke(object, sum, v);
        }
        return sum;
    } catch (Throwable throwable) {
        return handle(Long.class, throwable, "Unable to perform reduceBy");
    }
}

7264	```java
public static String generateLabelValue(final String fieldName) {
    final StringBuilder buffer = new StringBuilder(fieldName.length() * 2);
    class GenerationCommand {
        boolean capNextChar = false;
        boolean lastCharWasUpperCase = false;
        boolean lastCharWasNumber = false;
        boolean lastCharWasSpecial = false;
        boolean shouldContinue = true;
        char[] chars = fieldName.toCharArray();

        void processFieldName() {
            for (int index = 0; index < chars.length; index++) {
                char cchar = chars[index];
                shouldContinue = true;
                processCharWasNumber(buffer, index, cchar);
                if (!shouldContinue) continue;
                processCharWasUpperCase(buffer, index, cchar);
                if (!shouldContinue) continue;
                processSpecialChars(buffer, cchar);
                if (!shouldContinue) continue;
                cchar = processCapitalizeCommand(cchar);
                cchar = processFirstCharacterCheck(buffer, index, cchar);
                if (!shouldContinue) continue;
                buffer.append(cchar);
            }
        }

        private void processCharWasNumber(StringBuilder buffer, int index, char cchar) {
            if (lastCharWasSpecial) return;
            if (Character.isDigit(cchar)) {
                if (index != 0 && !lastCharWasNumber) buffer.append(' ');
                lastCharWasNumber = true;
                buffer.append(cchar);
                this.shouldContinue = false;
            } else {
                lastCharWasNumber = false;
            }
        }

        private char processFirstCharacterCheck(final StringBuilder buffer, int index, char cchar) {
            if (index == 0) {
                cchar = Character.toUpperCase(cchar);
                buffer.append(cchar);
                this.shouldContinue = false;
            }
            return cchar;
        }

        private char processCapitalizeCommand(char cchar) {
            if (capNextChar) {
                capNextChar = false;
                cchar = Character.toUpperCase(cchar);
            }
            return cchar;
        }

        private void processSpecialChars(final StringBuilder buffer, char cchar) {
            lastCharWasSpecial = false;
            if (cchar == ' ' || cchar == '_') {

### Summary of `processWriteQueue` Method

The `processWriteQueue` method is designed to process a queue of write operations for a data store. It continuously polls for operations from a queue, batches them, and processes them in batches. Here's a step-by-step breakdown of the method:

1. **Initialization**:
   - A `WriteStatus` object is created to track the status of the write operations.

2. **Infinite Loop**:
   - The method runs in an infinite loop, continuously processing write operations.

3. **Polling for Operations**:
   - The method polls for `DataStoreRequest` objects from `writeOperationsQueue` with a timeout specified by `dataStoreConfig.pollTimeoutMS()`.
   - If an operation is available, it is added to the `writeOperationsBatch` and tracked in the `status.tracker`.

4. **Batching Operations**:
   - The method continues to poll for operations and add them to the batch until the batch size exceeds `dataStoreConfig.processQueueMaxBatchSize()`.

5. **Processing Batches**:
   - If the batch is not empty, it is processed by calling `recievedWriteBatch` with a copy of the batch.
   - The batch size is added to `status.writeBatchSize`.
   - The batch is then cleared.

6. **Handling Empty Batches**:
   - If the batch is empty, the method calls `flushWritesIfNeeded()` to handle any pending writes.

7. **Batch Size Reporting**:
   - If the size of `status.writeBatchSize` exceeds 1000, the method calls `status.sendBatchSize(source, outputDataQueue)` to report the batch size.

This method ensures that write operations are processed efficiently in batches, with appropriate handling for empty batches and reporting of batch sizes.

7282	```java
public static String num(Number count) {
    if (count == null) return "";
    if (count instanceof Double || count instanceof BigDecimal) {
        String s = count.toString();
        if (s.charAt(1) == ' ' && s.length() > 7) {
            s = s.substring(0, 5);
        }
        return s;
    } else if (count instanceof Integer || count instanceof Long || count instanceof Short || count instanceof BigInteger) {
        String s = count.toString();
        s = new StringBuilder(s).reverse().toString();
        CharBuf buf = CharBuf.create(s.length());
        int index = 0;
        for (char c : s.toCharArray()) {
            index++;
            buf.add(c);
            if (index % 3 == 0) {
                buf.add(' ');
            }
        }
        if (buf.lastChar() == ' ') {
            buf.removeLastChar();
        }
        s = buf.toString();
        s = new StringBuilder(s).reverse().toString();
        return s;
    }
    return count.toString();
}
```

**Summary:**
The `num` method takes a `Number` object as input and returns a formatted string. If the input is `null`, it returns an empty string. If the input is a `Double` or `BigDecimal`, it checks if the string representation of the number has a space at the second position and a length greater than 7. If so, it truncates the string to the first 5 characters. If the input is an `Integer`, `Long`, `Short`, or `BigInteger`, it reverses the string, inserts spaces every three characters, and then reverses it back. If the input is of any other type, it simply returns the string representation of the number.

public static int roundUpToPowerOf2(int number) {
    int rounded = number >= 1_000 ? 1_000 : 
        (rounded = Integer.highestOneBit(number)) != 0 ? 
            (Integer.bitCount(number) > 1 ? rounded << 1 : rounded) : 
        1;
    return rounded;
}
```

**Summary:**

If `number` is greater than or equal to 1000, it returns 1000. Otherwise, it finds the highest one bit in `number` and checks if there is more than one bit set. If there is, it shifts the highest one bit left by one position to get the next power of 2; otherwise, it returns the highest one bit itself. If `number` is 0, it returns 1.

/**
 * Sorts a list based on a specified field or the objects themselves.
 *
 * @param list       The list to be sorted.
 * @param sortBy     The field name to sort by, or "this" to sort by the objects themselves.
 * @param fields     A map of field names to FieldAccess objects.
 * @param ascending  Whether to sort in ascending order.
 * @param nullsFirst Whether to place null values first.
 */
public static void sort(List list, String sortBy, Map<String, FieldAccess> fields, boolean ascending, boolean nullsFirst) {
    try {
        if (list == null || list.size() == 0) {
            return;
        }
        Object o = list.get(0);
        if (sortBy.equals("this")) {
            Collections.sort(list, thisUniversalComparator(ascending, nullsFirst));
            return;
        }
        final FieldAccess field = fields.get(sortBy);
        if (field != null) {
            Collections.sort(list, Sorting.universalComparator(field, ascending, nullsFirst));
        }
    } catch (Exception ex) {
        Exceptions.handle(ex, "list", list, "\nsortBy", sortBy, "fields", fields, "ascending", ascending, "nullFirst", nullsFirst);
    }
}

7294	```java
/**
 * Sets the value of a field in the parent object from a map.
 * 
 * @param parentObject The parent object whose field value needs to be set.
 * @param field The field whose value needs to be set.
 * @param mapInner The map containing the value to be set.
 */
private void setFieldValueFromMap(final Object parentObject, final FieldAccess field, final Map mapInner) {
    Class<?> fieldClassType = field.type();
    Object value = null;

    if (!Typ.isMap(fieldClassType)) {
        if (!fieldClassType.isInterface() && !Typ.isAbstract(fieldClassType)) {
            value = fromMap(mapInner, field.type());
        } else {
            Object oClassName = mapInner.get("class");
            if (oClassName != null) {
                value = fromMap(mapInner, Reflection.loadClass(oClassName.toString()));
            } else {
                value = null;
            }
        }
    } else if (Typ.isMap(fieldClassType)) {
        Class<?> keyType = (Class<?>) field.getParameterizedType().getActualTypeArguments()[0];
        Class<?> valueType = (Class<?>) field.getParameterizedType().getActualTypeArguments()[1];
        Set<Map.Entry> set = mapInner.entrySet();
        Map<Object, Object> newMap = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        for (Map.Entry entry : set) {
            Object evalue = entry.getValue();
            Object key = entry.getKey();
            if (evalue instanceof ValueContainer) {
                evalue = ((ValueContainer) evalue).toValue();
            }
            key = Conversions.coerce(keyType, key);
            evalue = Conversions.coerce(valueType, evalue);
            newMap.put(key, evalue);
        }
        value = newMap;
    }

    field.setValue(parentObject, value);
}

/**
 * Creates a comparator that compares objects based on a specified field.
 * 
 * @param field The field to compare by.
 * @param ascending Whether the comparison should be in ascending order.
 * @param nullsFirst Whether null values should be considered first.
 * @return A comparator that compares objects based on the specified field.
 */
public static Comparator universalComparator(final FieldAccess field, final boolean ascending, final boolean nullsFirst) {
    return new Comparator() {
        @Override
        public int compare(Object o1, Object o2) {
            Object value1 = null;
            Object value2 = null;
            if (ascending) {
                value1 = field.getValue(o1);
                value2 = field.getValue(o2);
            } else {
                value1 = field.getValue(o2);
                value2 = field.getValue(o1);
            }
            return Sorting.compare(value1, value2, nullsFirst);
        }
    };
}

public static Comparator thisUniversalComparator(final boolean ascending, final boolean nullsFirst) {
    return new Comparator() {
        @Override
        public int compare(Object o1, Object o2) {
            Object value1, value2;
            if (ascending) {
                value1 = o1;
                value2 = o2;
            } else {
                value1 = o2;
                value2 = o1;
            }
            return Sorting.compare(value1, value2, nullsFirst);
        }
    };
}
```

/**
 * Executes a main query plan based on the given criteria expressions.
 * 
 * @param expressions An array of criteria expressions.
 * @return A ResultSet containing the results of the query.
 */
private ResultSet mainQueryPlan(Criteria[] expressions) {
    ResultSetInternal results = new ResultSetImpl(this.fields);
    
    if (expressions == null || expressions.length == 0) {
        results.addResults(searchableCollection.all());
    } else {
        Group group = expressions.length == 1 && expressions[0] instanceof Group 
                      ? (Group) expressions[0] 
                      : ObjectFilter.and(expressions);
        doFilterGroup(group, results);
    }
    
    return results;
}

/**
 * Synchronizes the output stream to disk if it is dirty.
 * 
 * @return true if the synchronization is successful, false otherwise.
 */
public boolean syncToDisk() {
    if (outputStream != null && dirty) {
        try {
            if (outputStream instanceof FileChannel) {
                FileChannel channel = (FileChannel) outputStream;
                channel.force(true);
            }
            dirty = false;
            return true;
        } catch (Exception ex) {
            cleanupOutputStream();
            return false;
        }
    } else {
        return false;
    }
}
```

public void nextBufferToWrite(final ByteBuffer bufferOut) throws InterruptedException {

        bytesTransferred += size;
        bytesSinceLastFlush += size;

        try {
            outputStream.close();

            cleanupOutputStream();
            e.printStackTrace(System.err);
        } finally {
            outputStream = null;
        }
    }
}

7331	```java
/**
 * Writes data from a ByteBuffer to an output stream, handling exceptions and flushing periodically.
 * 
 * @param bufferOut The ByteBuffer containing the data to write.
 * @throws InterruptedException If the operation is interrupted.
 */
private void write(final ByteBuffer bufferOut) throws InterruptedException {
    initOutputStream();
    try {
        if (outputStream != null) {
            outputStream.write(bufferOut);
        } else {
            error.set(true);
        }
        if (bytesSinceLastFlush > FLUSH_EVERY_N_BYTES) {
            syncToDisk();
            bytesSinceLastFlush = 0;
        }
    } catch (ClosedByInterruptException cbie) {
        throw new InterruptedException("File closed by interruption");
    } catch (Exception e) {
        cleanupOutputStream();
        error.set(true);
        e.printStackTrace(System.err);
        diagnose();
        Exceptions.handle(e);
    }
}
```

7367	```java
/**
 * Lists resources at the specified path.
 * 
 * @param path The path to the resources.
 * @return A list of resource names.
 * @throws CouchDbException If an error occurs.
 */
public static List<String> listResources(String path) {
    try {
        Class<CouchDbUtil> clazz = CouchDbUtil.class;
        URL dirURL = clazz.getClassLoader().getResource(path);
        if (dirURL != null && dirURL.getProtocol().equals("file")) {
            return Arrays.asList(new File(dirURL.toURI()).list());
        }
        if (dirURL != null && dirURL.getProtocol().equals("jar")) {
            String jarPath = dirURL.getPath().substring(5, dirURL.getPath().indexOf("!"));
            JarFile jar = new JarFile(URLDecoder.decode(jarPath, "UTF-8"));
            Enumeration<JarEntry> entries = jar.entries();
            Set<String> result = new HashSet<>();
            while (entries.hasMoreElements()) {
                String name = entries.nextElement().getName();
                if (name.startsWith(SPRING_BOOT_DIR)) {
                    name = name.substring(SPRING_BOOT_DIR.length());
                }
                if (name.startsWith(path)) {
                    String entry = name.substring(path.length());
                    int checkSubdir = entry.indexOf("/");
                    if (checkSubdir >= 0) {
                        entry = entry.substring(0, checkSubdir);
                    }
                    if (entry.length() > 0) {
                        result.add(entry);
                    }
                }
            }
            close(jar);
            return new ArrayList<>(result);
        }
        return null;
    } catch (Exception e) {
        throw new CouchDbException(e);
    }
}
```

7391	```java
/**
 * Reads the next row from the input stream.
 * 
 * @return true if a valid row is read, false otherwise.
 * @throws CouchDbException if an error occurs while reading the stream.
 */
private boolean readNextRow() {
    boolean hasNext = false;
    try {
        if (!stop) {
            String row = "";
            do {
                row = getReader().readLine();
            } while (row.length() == 0);
            if (!row.startsWith("{\"last_seq\":")) {
                setNextRow(gson.fromJson(row, Row.class));
                hasNext = true;
            }
        }
    } catch (Exception e) {
        terminate();
        throw new CouchDbException("Error reading continuous stream.", e);
    }
    if (!hasNext) terminate();
    return hasNext;
}
```

7394	```java
public static Observable<Void> write(final Observable<byte[]> data, final ServletOutputStream out) {
    return Observable.create(new Observable.OnSubscribe<Void>() {
        @Override
        public void call(Subscriber<? super Void> subscriber) {
            Observable<Void> events = create(out).onBackpressureBuffer();
            Observable<Void> writeobs = Observable.zip(data, events, (b, aVoid) -> {
                try {
                    out.write(b);
                } catch (IOException ioe) {
                    Exceptions.propagate(ioe);
                }
                return null;
            });
            writeobs.subscribe(subscriber);
        }
    });
}
```

**Summary:**
The `write` method takes an `Observable<byte[]>` and a `ServletOutputStream` as parameters and returns an `Observable<Void>`. It creates an `Observable` that emits `null` values. The method uses `Observable.zip` to combine the input `data` with an `events` observable, which is created from the `out` stream and buffers backpressure. For each byte array in the `data`, it writes the bytes to the `out` stream, handling any `IOException` by propagating it. The resulting `Observable<Void>` emits `null` after each write operation.

7398	```java
/**
 * Determines if the given HTTP server exchange represents a query.
 * 
 * @param serverExchange The HTTP server exchange to check.
 * @return true if the request method is GET or HEAD, or if the request method is POST and the relative path matches a post query pattern; false otherwise.
 */
private boolean isQuery(HttpServerExchange serverExchange) {
    String method = serverExchange.getRequestMethod().toString();
    if (method.equalsIgnoreCase("GET") || method.equalsIgnoreCase("HEAD")) {
        return true;
    } else if (method.equalsIgnoreCase("POST")) {
        return postQuery != null && postQuery.matcher(serverExchange.getRelativePath()).find();
    } else {
        return false;
    }
}
```
7399	```markdown
### Summary of `sendAuthenticationRequest` Method

The `sendAuthenticationRequest` method is responsible for sending an authentication request to a server. It takes two parameters: `HttpServerExchange` and `PooledConnection`. The method performs the following steps:

1. **Retrieve Authentication Context**: It retrieves the `AuthContext` from the `HttpServerExchange` using a key (`AUTH_CONTEXT_KEY`).

2. **Determine HTTP Verb**: It determines the HTTP verb (e.g., GET, POST) from the `HttpServerExchange`.

3. **Determine Resource**: It determines the resource to be accessed. If the request is not a query, it checks if `USER_WRITE_ACCESS` is disabled. If disabled, it uses a legacy resource; otherwise, it uses the actual resource. If the request is a query, it uses a predefined resource.

4. **Generate Subject Access Review**: It generates a `SubjectAccessReview` using the tenant, verb, and resource.

5. **Build Client Request**: It builds a `ClientRequest` using the `AuthContext`.

6. **Notify Client Request Start**: It notifies the start of the client request.

7. **Send Request**: It sends the request through the `PooledConnection` and sets up a `RequestReadyCallback` to handle the response.
```
7400	```java
/**
 * Determines the HTTP verb for the given server exchange.
 * If the request is a query type, it is treated as a GET request.
 * Otherwise, it retrieves the verb based on the request method.
 * If the method is not handled, it defaults to a read access verb.
 *
 * @param serverExchange The server exchange to determine the verb for.
 * @return The HTTP verb as a String.
 */
private String getVerb(HttpServerExchange serverExchange) {
    if (isQuery(serverExchange)) {
        return VERBS.get(GET);
    } else {
        String verb = VERBS.get(serverExchange.getRequestMethod());
        if (verb == null) {
            log.debugf("Unhandled http method '%s'. Checking for read access.", serverExchange.getRequestMethod());
            verb = VERBS_DEFAULT;
        }
        return verb;
    }
}
```

7402	```java
/**
 * Handles the result of an HTTP request.
 *
 * @param serverExchange The HTTP server exchange.
 * @param connection The pooled connection.
 * @param allowed Whether the request is allowed.
 */
private void onRequestResult(HttpServerExchange serverExchange, PooledConnection connection, boolean allowed) {
    // Release the connection to make it eligible for garbage collection.
    connectionPools.get(serverExchange.getIoThread()).release(connection);
    
    // Remove the authentication context attachment.
    AuthContext context = serverExchange.removeAttachment(AUTH_CONTEXT_KEY);
    
    // Update API and authentication latency metrics.
    apiLatency.update(context.getClientResponseTime(), NANOSECONDS);
    authLatency.update(context.getLatency(), NANOSECONDS);
    
    // Dispatch the request to the container handler if allowed, otherwise end the exchange with a FORBIDDEN status.
    if (allowed) {
        serverExchange.dispatch(containerHandler);
    } else {
        endExchange(serverExchange, FORBIDDEN);
    }
}
```

7405	The `findScheduledJobs` method is designed to retrieve and process scheduled jobs from a database using a reactive programming approach with RxJava. Here's a summary of the method:

1. **Input Parameters**:
   - `Date timeSlice`: A date object representing the time slice up to which scheduled jobs are to be fetched.
   - `rx.Scheduler scheduler`: A scheduler to execute the database operation asynchronously.

2. **Database Execution**:
   - The method uses `session.executeAndFetch(findAllScheduled.bind(), scheduler)` to execute a database query asynchronously. The `findAllScheduled` query is bound to the provided scheduler.

3. **Filtering and Mapping**:
   - The results are filtered to exclude null jobs using `filter(filterNullJobs)`.
   - Each row is then mapped to a `JobDetails` object using `map(row -> createJobDetails(...))`. This involves extracting various fields from the row, such as UUID, job name, description, parameters, trigger, job status, and the provided `timeSlice`.

4. **Aggregation**:
   - The mapped `JobDetails` objects are collected into a `HashMap` where the key is the job ID (`UUID`) and the value is a `SortedSet` of `JobDetails` sorted by trigger time.
   - This aggregation is done using `collect(HashMap::new, (map, details) -> { ... })`.

5. **Flattening and Selection**:
   - The `HashMap` is flattened into a sequence of entries using `flatMap(map -> Observable.from(map.entrySet()))`.
   - For each entry, the first `JobDetails` object in the sorted set is selected using `map(entry -> entry.getValue().first())`.

6. **Output**:
   - The method returns an `Observable<JobDetails>` containing the first scheduled job for each job ID that meets the specified criteria.

In summary, the `findScheduledJobs` method fetches scheduled jobs from a database, filters and maps them to `JobDetails` objects, aggregates them by job ID, and returns the first scheduled job for each ID up to the specified time slice.

/**
 * Completes a multi-part upload to an object in a bucket.
 *
 * @param objectKey The key of the object to upload.
 * @param fileName The name of the file being uploaded.
 * @param eTag The ETag of the uploaded parts.
 * @param uploadID The upload ID for the multi-part upload.
 * @param length The total length of the uploaded data.
 * @throws QSException If an error occurs during the upload.
 */
private void completeMultiUpload(String objectKey, String fileName, String eTag, String uploadID, long length) throws QSException {
    CompleteMultipartUploadInput input = new CompleteMultipartUploadInput(uploadID, partCounts, 0);
    input.setContentLength(length);

    if (!QSStringUtil.isEmpty(fileName)) {
        try {
            String keyName = QSStringUtil.percentEncode(fileName, "UTF-8");
            input.setContentDisposition(String.format("attachment; filename=\"%s\"; filename*=utf-8''%s", keyName, keyName));
        } catch (UnsupportedEncodingException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
    }

    if (!QSStringUtil.isEmpty(eTag)) {
        input.setETag(eTag);
    }

    RequestHandler requestHandler = bucket.completeMultipartUploadRequest(objectKey, input);
    sign(requestHandler);
    Bucket.CompleteMultipartUploadOutput response = (Bucket.CompleteMultipartUploadOutput) requestHandler.send();

    if (response.getStatueCode() == 200 || response.getStatueCode() == 201) {
        uploadModel.setUploadComplete(true);
        setData(objectKey, recorder);
    }

    if (callBack != null) {
        callBack.onAPIResponse(objectKey, response);
    }
}

7465	```java
/**
 * Maps a ResponseEntity containing JSON data to a NotificationResponse object.
 * 
 * @param request The PortletRequest object.
 * @param response The ResponseEntity containing the JSON data.
 * @return A NotificationResponse object.
 */
private NotificationResponse mapToNotificationResponse(PortletRequest request, ResponseEntity<String> response) {
    // Configure JsonPath to handle default path leaf to null
    Configuration config = Configuration.builder().options(Option.DEFAULT_PATH_LEAF_TO_NULL).build();
    ReadContext readContext = JsonPath.using(config).parse(response.getBody());

    // Check the success status from the response
    String success = readContext.read(SUCCESS_QUERY);
    if (!"true".equalsIgnoreCase(success)) {
        String error = readContext.read(MESSAGE_QUERY);
        return notificationError(error);
    }

    // Read the actual tasks from the response
    Object rows = readContext.read(ROWS_QUERY);
    if (!(rows instanceof JSONArray)) {
        throw new RuntimeException("Expected 'rows' to be an array of tasks");
    }

    // Get the source of the notification
    String source = getNotificationSource(request);
    List<NotificationEntry> list = new ArrayList<>();

    // Map each task to a NotificationEntry and attach actions
    for (int i = 0; i < ((JSONArray) rows).size(); i++) {
        NotificationEntry entry = mapNotificationEntry(readContext, i, source);
        if (entry != null) {
            attachActions(request, entry);
            list.add(entry);
        }
    }

    // Build the NotificationResponse object
    NotificationResponse notification = new NotificationResponse();
    if (!list.isEmpty()) {
        NotificationCategory category = getNotificationCategory(request);
        category.addEntries(list);
        notification.setCategories(Arrays.asList(category));
    }

    return notification;
}
```
7466	```java
/**
 * Maps a notification entry from the given read context and index.
 *
 * @param readContext The read context containing the data.
 * @param index The index of the notification entry.
 * @param source The source of the notification.
 * @return The mapped notification entry, or null if the entry is completed.
 */
private NotificationEntry mapNotificationEntry(ReadContext readContext, int index, String source) {
    boolean completed = readContext.read(format(ROW_COMPLETED_QUERY_FMT, index), Boolean.class);
    if (completed) {
        return null;
    }

    NotificationEntry entry = new NotificationEntry();
    entry.setSource(source);

    String id = readContext.read(format(ROW_ID_QUERY_FMT, index));
    entry.setId(id);

    String title = readContext.read(format(ROW_NAME_QUERY_FMT, index));
    entry.setTitle(title);

    String desc = readContext.read(format(ROW_DESCRIPTION_QUERY_FMT, index));
    entry.setBody(desc);

    String link = readContext.read(format(ROW_LINK_QUERY_FMT, index));
    URL fixedLink = normalizeLink(link);
    if (fixedLink != null) {
        entry.setUrl(fixedLink.toExternalForm());
    }

    Date createDate = readContext.read(format("$.rows[%d].createdDate", index), Date.class);
    Map<NotificationState, Date> states = new HashMap<>();
    states.put(NotificationState.ISSUED, createDate);

    try {
        String dateStr = readContext.read(format(ROW_DUE_DATE_QUERY_FMT, index));
        if (!StringUtils.isBlank(dateStr)) {
            synchronized (dateFormat) {
                Date dueDate = dateFormat.parse(dateStr);
                entry.setDueDate(dueDate);
            }
        }
    } catch (Exception e) {
        log.warn("Error parsing due date. Ignoring", e);
    }

    return entry;
}
```

/**
 * Reads a JSON file and converts it to a NotificationResponse object.
 * 
 * @param filename The name of the file to read.
 * @return The NotificationResponse object or an error response if the file is not found or cannot be read.
 */
private NotificationResponse readFromFile(String filename) {
    NotificationResponse rslt;
    logger.debug("Preparing to read from file: {}", filename);
    URL location = getClass().getClassLoader().getResource(filename);
    if (location != null) {
        try {
            File f = new File(location.toURI());
            rslt = mapper.readValue(f, NotificationResponse.class);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            String msg = "Failed to read the data file: " + location;
            logger.error(msg, e);
            rslt = prepareErrorResponse(getName(), msg);
        }
    } else {
        String msg = "Data file not found: " + filename;
        rslt = prepareErrorResponse(getName(), msg);
    }
    return rslt;
}

7479	```java
/**
 * Finds the closest point on a plane to a given point.
 * 
 * @param P The point to find the closest point to.
 * @param closestPt The closest point on the plane.
 */
public void closestPoint(Point3D_F64 P, Point3D_F64 closestPt) {
    // Calculate the vector from point B to point P
    GeometryMath_F64.sub(B, P, D);
    
    // Calculate dot products
    double a = E0.dot(E0);
    double b = E0.dot(E1);
    double c = E1.dot(E1);
    double d = E0.dot(D);
    double e = E1.dot(D);
    
    // Calculate determinant
    double det = a * c - b * b;
    
    // Calculate s and t
    double s = b * e - c * d;
    double t = b * d - a * e;
    
    // Determine region and call corresponding method
    if (s + t <= det) {
        if (s < 0) {
            if (t < 0) {
                region4();
            } else {
                region3();
            }
        } else if (t < 0) {
            region5();
        } else {
            region0(det);
        }
    } else {
        if (s < 0) {
            region2();
        } else if (t < 0) {
            region6();
        } else {
            region1();
        }
    }
    
    // Calculate the closest point on the plane
    closestPt.x = B.x + s * E0.x + t * E1.x;
    closestPt.y = B.y + s * E0.y + t * E1.y;
    closestPt.z = B.z + s * E0.z + t * E1.z;
}
```

7485	```java
public static void bounding(Quadrilateral_F64 quad, Rectangle2D_F64 rectangle) {
    // Set the minimum x and y coordinates of the rectangle to the minimum x and y coordinates of the quadrilateral
    rectangle.p0.x = Math.min(quad.a.x, quad.b.x);
    rectangle.p0.x = Math.min(rectangle.p0.x, quad.c.x);
    rectangle.p0.x = Math.min(rectangle.p0.x, quad.d.x);
    rectangle.p0.y = Math.min(quad.a.y, quad.b.y);
    rectangle.p0.y = Math.min(rectangle.p0.y, quad.c.y);
    rectangle.p0.y = Math.min(rectangle.p0.y, quad.d.y);

    // Set the maximum x and y coordinates of the rectangle to the maximum x and y coordinates of the quadrilateral
    rectangle.p1.x = Math.max(quad.a.x, quad.b.x);
    rectangle.p1.x = Math.max(rectangle.p1.x, quad.c.x);
    rectangle.p1.x = Math.max(rectangle.p1.x, quad.d.x);
    rectangle.p1.y = Math.max(quad.a.y, quad.b.y);
    rectangle.p1.y = Math.max(rectangle.p1.y, quad.c.y);
    rectangle.p1.y = Math.max(rectangle.p1.y, quad.d.y);
}
