7486	```java
/**
 * Calculates the bounding rectangle for a given polygon.
 * 
 * @param polygon The input polygon.
 * @param rectangle The output rectangle that will be set to the bounding box of the polygon.
 */
public static void bounding(Polygon2D_F64 polygon, Rectangle2D_F64 rectangle) {
    // Initialize the rectangle's corners with the first point of the polygon
    rectangle.p0.set(polygon.get(0));
    rectangle.p1.set(polygon.get(0));

    // Iterate through each point in the polygon
    for (int i = 0; i < polygon.size(); i++) {
        Point2D_F64 p = polygon.get(i);

        // Update the minimum x-coordinate
        if (p.x < rectangle.p0.x) {
            rectangle.p0.x = p.x;
        }

        // Update the maximum x-coordinate
        else if (p.x > rectangle.p1.x) {
            rectangle.p1.x = p.x;
        }

        // Update the minimum y-coordinate
        if (p.y < rectangle.p0.y) {
            rectangle.p0.y = p.y;
        }

        // Update the maximum y-coordinate
        else if (p.y > rectangle.p1.y) {
            rectangle.p1.y = p.y;
        }
    }
}

7487	Calculates the center of a quadrilateral by averaging the coordinates of its four vertices.
7488	```java
public static void vertexAverage(Polygon2D_F64 input, Point2D_F64 average) {
    average.setIdx(0, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < input.size(); i++) {
        Point2D_F64 v = input.vertexes.data[i];
        average.x += v.x;
        average.y += v.y;
    }
    average.x /= input.size();
    average.y /= input.size();
}
```

/**

7494	```java
/**
 * Determines if a point is inside a triangle formed by three given points.
 *
 * @param a The first vertex of the triangle.
 * @param b The second vertex of the triangle.
 * @param c The third vertex of the triangle.
 * @param pt The point to check.
 * @return true if the point is inside the triangle, false otherwise.
 */
public static boolean containTriangle(Point2D_F64 a, Point2D_F64 b, Point2D_F64 c, Point2D_F64 pt) {
    boolean ret = false;
    if (((a.y > pt.y) != (b.y > pt.y)) && (pt.x < (b.x - a.x) * (pt.y - a.y) / (b.y - a.y) + a.x)) {
        ret = true;
    }
    if (((b.y > pt.y) != (c.y > pt.y)) && (pt.x < (c.x - b.x) * (pt.y - b.y) / (c.y - b.y) + b.x)) {
        ret = !ret;
    }
    if (((c.y > pt.y) != (a.y > pt.y)) && (pt.x < (a.x - c.x) * (pt.y - c.y) / (a.y - c.y) + c.x)) {
        ret = !ret;
    }
    return ret;
}

7495	```java
/**
 * Calculates the intersection point of two parametric lines.
 *
 * @param a The first parametric line.
 * @param b The second parametric line.
 * @param ret The point to store the intersection result, or null to create a new point.
 * @return The intersection point if it exists, otherwise null.
 */
public static Point2D_F64 intersection(LineParametric2D_F64 a, LineParametric2D_F64 b, Point2D_F64 ret) {
    double t_b = a.getSlopeX() * (b.getY() - a.getY()) - a.getSlopeY() * (b.getX() - a.getX());
    double bottom = a.getSlopeY() * b.getSlopeX() - b.getSlopeY() * a.getSlopeX();
    if (bottom == 0) return null;
    t_b /= bottom;
    double x = b.getSlopeX() * t_b + b.getX();
    double y = b.getSlopeY() * t_b + b.getY();
    if (ret == null) ret = new Point2D_F64();
    ret.set(x, y);
    return ret;
}
```
7496	```java
/**
 * Calculates the intersection point of two line segments.
 *
 * @param l_0 The first line segment.
 * @param l_1 The second line segment.
 * @param ret The point to store the intersection result.
 * @return The intersection point if it exists, otherwise null.
 */
public static Point2D_F64 intersection(LineSegment2D_F64 l_0, LineSegment2D_F64 l_1, Point2D_F64 ret) {
    double a0 = l_0.b.x - l_0.a.x;
    double b0 = l_0.b.y - l_0.a.y;
    double a1 = l_1.b.x - l_1.a.x;
    double b1 = l_1.b.y - l_1.a.y;

    double top = b0 * (l_1.a.x - l_0.a.x) + a0 * (l_0.a.y - l_1.a.y);
    double bottom = a0 * b1 - b0 * a1;

    if (bottom == 0) return null;

    double t_1 = top / bottom;
    if (t_1 < 0 || t_1 > 1) return null;

    top = b1 * (l_0.a.x - l_1.a.x) + a1 * (l_1.a.y - l_0.a.y);
    bottom = a1 * b0 - b1 * a0;

    double t_0 = top / bottom;
    if (t_0 < 0 || t_0 > 1) return null;

    if (ret == null) ret = new Point2D_F64();
    ret.set(l_1.a.x + a1 * t_1, l_1.a.y + b1 * t_1);

    return ret;
}
```
7497	```java
/**
 * Calculates the intersection point of two lines defined by four points.
 *
 * @param lineA0 The first point of the first line.
 * @param lineA1 The second point of the first line.
 * @param lineB0 The first point of the second line.
 * @param lineB1 The second point of the second line.
 * @param output The point to store the intersection result. If null, a new point is created.
 * @return The intersection point if the lines intersect, otherwise null.
 */
public static Point2D_F64 intersection(Point2D_F64 lineA0, Point2D_F64 lineA1, Point2D_F64 lineB0, Point2D_F64 lineB1, Point2D_F64 output) {
    if (output == null) {
        output = new Point2D_F64();
    }

    double slopeAx = lineA1.x - lineA0.x;
    double slopeAy = lineA1.y - lineA0.y;
    double slopeBx = lineB1.x - lineB0.x;
    double slopeBy = lineB1.y - lineB0.y;

    double top = slopeAy * (lineB0.x - lineA0.x) + slopeAx * (lineA0.y - lineB0.y);
    double bottom = slopeAx * slopeBy - slopeAy * slopeBx;

    if (bottom == 0) {
        return null;
    }

    double t = top / bottom;
    output.x = lineB0.x + t * slopeBx;
    output.y = lineB0.y + t * slopeBy;

    return output;
}

7501	```java
/**
 * Calculates the intersection area of two 2D rectangles.
 *
 * @param a The first rectangle.
 * @param b The second rectangle.
 * @return The area of the intersection, or 0 if the rectangles do not intersect.
 */
public static double intersectionArea(Rectangle2D_F64 a, Rectangle2D_F64 b) {
    if (!intersects(a, b)) return 0;
    double x0 = Math.max(a.p0.x, b.p0.x);
    double x1 = Math.min(a.p1.x, b.p1.x);
    double y0 = Math.max(a.p0.y, b.p0.y);
    double y1 = Math.min(a.p1.y, b.p1.y);
    return (x1 - x0) * (y1 - y0);
}
```

7526	```java
public void setParamVector(double x, double y, double z) {
    // Calculate the absolute values of x, y, and z
    double ax = Math.abs(x);
    double ay = Math.abs(y);
    double az = Math.abs(z);
    
    // Determine the maximum absolute value
    double max = Math.max(ax, ay);
    max = Math.max(max, az);
    
    // If the maximum value is zero, set theta to 0 and unitAxisRotation to (1, 0, 0)
    if (max == 0) {
        theta = 0;
        unitAxisRotation.set(1, 0, 0);
    } else {
        // Normalize the vector (x, y, z) by dividing each component by the maximum value
        x /= max;
        y /= max;
        z /= max;
        
        // Calculate the magnitude of the normalized vector
        theta = Math.sqrt(x * x + y * y + z * z);
        
        // Set the components of unitAxisRotation to the normalized vector components
        unitAxisRotation.x = x / theta;
        unitAxisRotation.y = y / theta;
        unitAxisRotation.z = z / theta;
        
        // Scale theta by the maximum value
        theta *= max;
    }
}
```

If this difference is less than or equal to π/2, it returns the difference. Otherwise, it returns π minus the difference, effectively giving the shorter arc distance between the two angles on a unit circle.
7528	```java
/**
 * Determines if a line intersects with two planes and calculates the intersection point.
 * 
 * @param a The first plane.
 * @param b The second plane.
 * @param line The line to check for intersection.
 * @return true if the line intersects with both planes, false otherwise.
 */
public static boolean intersect(PlaneGeneral3D_F64 a, PlaneGeneral3D_F64 b, LineParametric3D_F64 line) {
    // Calculate the direction of the line as the cross product of the two plane normals
    GeometryMath_F64.cross(a.A, a.B, a.C, b.A, b.B, b.C, line.slope);
    
    // Check if the line's direction is zero (parallel to the planes)
    if (line.slope.normSq() == 0) {
        return false;
    }
    
    // Calculate the closest point on plane 'a' to the origin
    double n2 = a.A * a.A + a.B * a.B + a.C * a.C;
    double closestX = a.A * a.D / n2;
    double closestY = a.B * a.D / n2;
    double closestZ = a.C * a.D / n2;
    
    // Calculate the direction vector from the closest point to the intersection
    double slopeX = a.B * line.slope.z - a.C * line.slope.y;
    double slopeY = a.C * line.slope.x - a.A * line.slope.z;
    double slopeZ = a.A * line.slope.y - a.B * line.slope.x;
    
    // Calculate the intersection point
    double top = b.D - b.A * closestX - b.B * closestY - b.C * closestZ;
    double bottom = b.A * slopeX + b.B * slopeY + b.C * slopeZ;
    double d = top / bottom;
    line.p.x = closestX + d * slopeX;
    line.p.y = closestY + d * slopeY;
    line.p.z = closestZ + d * slopeZ;
    
    return true;
}
```

7531	```java
public static void interpolate(Se2_F64 a, Se2_F64 b, double where, Se2_F64 output) {
    // Interpolate translation
    double w0 = 1.0 - where;
    output.T.x = a.T.x * w0 + b.T.x * where;
    output.T.y = a.T.y * w0 + b.T.y * where;

    // Interpolate rotation
    double yaw0 = a.getYaw();
    double yaw1 = b.getYaw();
    double cw = UtilAngle.distanceCW(yaw0, yaw1);
    double ccw = UtilAngle.distanceCCW(yaw0, yaw1);
    double yaw;
    if (cw > ccw) {
        yaw = yaw0 + ccw * where;
    } else {
        yaw = yaw0 - cw * where;
    }
    output.setYaw(yaw);
}
```

**Summary:**
The `interpolate` method takes two `Se2_F64` objects `a` and `b`, a `double` value `where`, and an `Se2_F64` object `output`. It interpolates the translation and rotation between `a` and `b` based on the `where` parameter. The translation is linearly interpolated, while the rotation is interpolated using the clockwise and counterclockwise distances between the two angles. The result is stored in the `output` object.

Using these slopes, it calculates the intersection point of the perpendicular bisectors of the segments, which is the center of the circle. The radius is determined by the distance from the center to one of the points. If the lines are parallel (i.e., the denominator is zero), the method returns `false`. Otherwise, it sets the circle's center and radius and returns `true`.
7541	The `circleRadiusSq` method calculates the squared radius of a circle that passes through three given points `x0`, `x1`, and `x2`. It first finds the midpoints of the segments `x0x1` and `x1x2`. Then, it calculates the slopes of the lines `x0x1` and `x1x2`. The method then finds the intersection point of these two lines. 7543	```java
/**
 * Finds the closest point on a 3D line to a given point.
 *
 * @param line The 3D line.
 * @param pt The point.
 * @param ret The point to store the result in. If null, a new point will be created.
 * @return The closest point on the line to the given point.
 */
public static Point3D_F64 closestPoint(LineParametric3D_F64 line, Point3D_F64 pt, Point3D_F64 ret) {
    if (ret == null) {
        ret = new Point3D_F64();
    }
    double dx = pt.x - line.p.x;
    double dy = pt.y - line.p.y;
    double dz = pt.z - line.p.z;
    double n2 = line.slope.normSq();
    double d = (line.slope.x * dx + line.slope.y * dy + line.slope.z * dz);
    ret.x = line.p.x + d * line.slope.x / n2;
    ret.y = line.p.y + d * line.slope.y / n2;
    ret.z = line.p.z + d * line.slope.z / n2;
    return ret;
}

/**
 * Finds the closest point on a plane to the origin.
 *
 * @param plane The plane to find the closest point on.
 * @param found The point to store the result in. If null, a new point will be created.
 * @return The closest point on the plane to the origin.

public static Point3D_F64 closestPointOrigin(PlaneGeneral3D_F64 plane, Point3D_F64 found) {
    if (found == null) {
        found = new Point3D_F64();
    }
    double n2 = plane.A * plane.A + plane.B * plane.B + plane.C * plane.C;
    found.x = plane.A * plane.D / n2;
    found.y = plane.B * plane.D / n2;
    found.z = plane.C * plane.D / n2;
    return found;
}

7545	```java
/**
 * Finds the closest point on a 3D line segment to a given point.
 *
 * @param line The line segment.
 * @param pt The point.
 * @param ret The point to store the result in. If null, a new point will be created.
 * @return The closest point on the line segment to the given point.
 */
public static Point3D_F64 closestPoint(LineSegment3D_F64 line, Point3D_F64 pt, Point3D_F64 ret) {
    if (ret == null) {
        ret = new Point3D_F64();
    }

    double dx = pt.x - line.a.x;
    double dy = pt.y - line.a.y;
    double dz = pt.z - line.a.z;

    double slope_x = line.b.x - line.a.x;
    double slope_y = line.b.y - line.a.y;
    double slope_z = line.b.z - line.a.z;

    double n = Math.sqrt(slope_x * slope_x + slope_y * slope_y + slope_z * slope_z);
    double d = (slope_x * dx + slope_y * dy + slope_z * dz) / n;

    if (d <= 0) {
        ret.set(line.a);
    } else if (d >= n) {
        ret.set(line.b);
    } else {
        ret.x = line.a.x + d * slope_x / n;
        ret.y = line.a.y + d * slope_y / n;
        ret.z = line.a.z + d * slope_z / n;
    }

    return ret;
}

/**
 * Calculates the acute angle between two lines in 2D space.
 *
 * @param a The first line in general form.
 * @param b The second line in general form.
 * @return The acute angle between the two lines in radians.
 */
public static double acuteAngle(LineGeneral2D_F64 a, LineGeneral2D_F64 b) {
    double la = Math.sqrt(a.A * a.A + a.B * a.B);
    double lb = Math.sqrt(b.A * b.A + b.B * b.B);
    double value = (a.A * b.A + a.B * b.B) / (la * lb);
    value = Math.max(-1.0, Math.min(1.0, value));
    return Math.acos(value);
}

/**
 * Checks if the current object is identical to another object within a given tolerance.
 * 
 * @param t The object to compare with.
 * @param tol The tolerance for comparison.
 * @return true if the objects are identical within the tolerance, false otherwise.
 */
public boolean isIdentical(T t, double tol) {
    if (t.getDimension() != getDimension()) return false;
    int N = getDimension();
    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        double diff = Math.abs(getIdx(i) - t.getIdx(i));
        if (diff > tol) return false;
    }
    return true;
}

7577	```java
/**
 * Determines if two points have the same sign based on their coordinates.
 * 
 * @param xa The x-coordinate of the first point.
 * @param ya The y-coordinate of the first point.
 * @param xb The x-coordinate of the second point.
 * @param yb The y-coordinate of the second point.
 * @param tol The tolerance value for comparison.
 * @return true if the points have the same sign, false otherwise.
 */
public static boolean identicalSign(double xa, double ya, double xb, double yb, double tol) {
    double dx0 = xb - xa;
    double dy0 = yb - ya;
    double dx1 = xb + xa;
    double dy1 = yb + ya;
    double error0 = dx0 * dx0 + dy0 * dy0;
    double error1 = dx1 * dx1 + dy1 * dy1;
    if (error0 < error1) {
        return error0 <= tol * tol;
    } else {
        return error1 <= tol * tol;
    }
}

7579	```java
/**
 * Converts an {@link EllipseRotated_F64} to an {@link EllipseQuadratic_F64}.
 *
 * @param input The input ellipse in rotated form.
 * @param output The output ellipse in quadratic form. If null, a new one will be created.
 * @return The converted ellipse in quadratic form.
 */
public static EllipseQuadratic_F64 convert(EllipseRotated_F64 input, EllipseQuadratic_F64 output) {
    if (output == null) {
        output = new EllipseQuadratic_F64();
    }

    double x0 = input.center.x;
    double y0 = input.center.y;
    double a = input.a;
    double b = input.b;
    double phi = input.phi;

    double cphi = Math.cos(phi);
    double sphi = Math.sin(phi);
    double cphi2 = cphi * cphi;
    double sphi2 = sphi * sphi;
    double a2 = a * a;
    double b2 = b * b;
    double x02 = x0 * x0;
    double y02 = y0 * y0;

    output.A = cphi2 / a2 + sphi2 / b2;
    output.B = sphi * cphi / a2 - sphi * cphi / b2;
    output.C = sphi2 / a2 + cphi2 / b2;
    output.D = -x0 * cphi2 / a2 - y0 * sphi * cphi / a2 - x0 * sphi2 / b2 + y0 * sphi * cphi / b2;
    output.E = -x0 * sphi * cphi / a2 - y0 * sphi2 / a2 + x0 * sphi * cphi / b2 - y0 * cphi2 / b2;
    output.F = x02 * cphi2 / a2 + 2 * x0 * y0 * sphi * cphi / a2 + y02 * sphi2 / a2 + x02 * sphi2 / b2 - 2 * x0 * y0 * sphi * cphi / b2 + y02 * cphi2 / b2 - 1;

    return output;
}
```
7580	```java
/**
 * Computes a point on an ellipse given a parameter t and an ellipse definition.
 * 
 * @param t The parameter value.
 * @param ellipse The ellipse definition.
 * @param output The output point to store the result. If null, a new point will be created.
 * @return The computed point on the ellipse.
 */
public static Point2D_F64 computePoint(double t, EllipseRotated_F64 ellipse, Point2D_F64 output) {
    if (output == null) {
        output = new Point2D_F64();
    }
    double ct = Math.cos(t);
    double st = Math.sin(t);
    double cphi = Math.cos(ellipse.phi);
    double sphi = Math.sin(ellipse.phi);
    
    // Coordinate in ellipse frame
    double x = ellipse.a * ct;
    double y = ellipse.b * st;
    
    // Put into global frame
    output.x = ellipse.center.x + x * cphi - y * sphi;
    output.y = ellipse.center.y + x * sphi + y * cphi;
    
    return output;
}
```
7581	The `computeAngle` method calculates the angle between a given point and the major axis of an ellipse. It first transforms the point into the ellipse's reference frame by rotating it according to the ellipse's orientation. 7582	```java
/**
 * Computes the tangent vector at a given parameter \( t \) on an ellipse.
 *
 * @param t The parameter value on the ellipse.
 * @param ellipse The ellipse on which to compute the tangent.
 * @param output The vector to store the result. If null, a new vector will be created.
 * @return The tangent vector at the given parameter \( t \).
 */
public static Vector2D_F64 computeTangent(double t, EllipseRotated_F64 ellipse, Vector2D_F64 output) {
    if (output == null) {
        output = new Vector2D_F64();
    }

    double ct = Math.cos(t);
    double st = Math.sin(t);
    double cphi = Math.cos(ellipse.phi);
    double sphi = Math.sin(ellipse.phi);

    // Point in ellipse frame multiplied by b^2 and a^2
    double x = ellipse.a * ct * ellipse.b * ellipse.b;
    double y = ellipse.b * st * ellipse.a * ellipse.a;

    // Rotate vector normal into world frame
    double rx = x * cphi - y * sphi;
    double ry = x * sphi + y * cphi;

    // Normalize and change into tangent
    double r = Math.sqrt(rx * rx + ry * ry);
    output.x = -ry / r;
    output.y = rx / r;

    return output;
}
```

7586	```java
/**
 * Calculates the perpendicular distance from a point to a line in 3D space.
 *
 * @param l The line in parametric form.
 * @param p The point in 3D space.
 * @return The perpendicular distance from the point to the line.
 */
public static double distance(LineParametric3D_F64 l, Point3D_F64 p) {
    double x = l.p.x - p.x;
    double y = l.p.y - p.y;
    double z = l.p.z - p.z;
    double cc = x * x + y * y + z * z;
    double b = MiscOps.dot(x, y, z, l.slope) / l.slope.norm();
    double distanceSq = cc - b * b;
    if (distanceSq < 0) {
        return 0;
    } else {
        return Math.sqrt(distanceSq);
    }
}
```
7587	```java
/**
 * Calculates the shortest distance from a point to a line segment in 3D space.
 *
 * @param l The line segment.
 * @param p The point.
 * @return The shortest distance from the point to the line segment.
 */
public static double distance(LineSegment3D_F64 l, Point3D_F64 p) {
    // Calculate the vector components from point p to the start of the line segment l.a
    double dx = p.x - l.a.x;
    double dy = p.y - l.a.y;
    double dz = p.z - l.a.z;

    // Calculate the squared distance from point p to the start of the line segment
    double cc = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz;

    // Calculate the direction vector of the line segment
    double slope_x = l.b.x - l.a.x;
    double slope_y = l.b.y - l.a.y;
    double slope_z = l.b.z - l.a.z;

    // Calculate the length of the line segment
    double n = Math.sqrt(slope_x * slope_x + slope_y * slope_y + slope_z * slope_z);

    // Calculate the projection of the vector from p to l.a onto the line segment
    double d = (slope_x * dx + slope_y * dy + slope_z * dz) / n;

    // Check if the projection is outside the line segment
    if (d <= 0) {
        return p.distance(l.a);
    } else if (d >= n) {
        return p.distance(l.b);
    }

    // Calculate the squared distance from the projection to the point
    double distanceSq = cc - d * d;

    // Handle potential numerical errors that could make distanceSq negative
    if (distanceSq < 0) {
        return 0;
    } else {
        return Math.sqrt(distanceSq);
    }
}
```

7591	```java
/**
 * Calculates the squared distance between two line segments.
 *
 * @param segmentA The first line segment.
 * @param segmentB The second line segment.
 * @return The squared distance between the two line segments.
 */
public static double distanceSq(LineSegment2D_F64 segmentA, LineSegment2D_F64 segmentB) {
    // Calculate slopes of the segments
    double slopeAX = segmentA.slopeX();
    double slopeAY = segmentA.slopeY();
    double slopeBX = segmentB.slopeX();
    double slopeBY = segmentB.slopeY();

    // Calculate the intersection point relative to segmentA
    double ta = slopeBX * (segmentA.a.y - segmentB.a.y) - slopeBY * (segmentA.a.x - segmentB.a.x);
    double bottom = slopeBY * slopeAX - slopeAY * slopeBX;

    // Check if the segments intersect
    if (bottom != 0) {
        ta /= bottom;
        // Check if the intersection point is within segmentA
        if (ta >= 0 && ta <= 1.0) {
            // Calculate the intersection point relative to segmentB
            double tb = slopeAX * (segmentB.a.y - segmentA.a.y) - slopeAY * (segmentB.a.x - segmentA.a.x);
            tb /= slopeAY * slopeBX - slopeBY * slopeAX;
            // Check if the intersection point is within segmentB
            if (tb >= 0 && tb <= 1.0) {
                return 0; // Segments intersect
            }
        }
    }

    // Calculate the squared distance from each endpoint of segmentA to segmentB
    double closest = Double.MAX_VALUE;
    closest = Math.min(closest, distanceSq(segmentA, segmentB.a));
    closest = Math.min(closest, distanceSq(segmentA, segmentB.b));
    closest = Math.min(closest, distanceSq(segmentB, segmentA.a));
    closest = Math.min(closest, distanceSq(segmentB, segmentA.b));

    return closest; // Return the minimum squared distance
}
```

7600	```java
/**
 * Finds the closest point on a line segment to a given point.
 *
 * @param line The line segment.
 * @param p The point.
 * @param output The output point (can be null).
 * @return The closest point on the line segment.
 */
public static Point2D_F64 closestPoint(LineSegment2D_F64 line, Point2D_F64 p, Point2D_F64 output) {
    if (output == null) {
        output = new Point2D_F64();
    }
    double slopeX = line.b.x - line.a.x;
    double slopeY = line.b.y - line.a.y;
    double t = slopeX * (p.x - line.a.x) + slopeY * (p.y - line.a.y);
    t /= slopeX * slopeX + slopeY * slopeY;
    if (t < 0) {
        t = 0;
    } else if (t > 1) {
        t = 1;
    }
    output.x = line.a.x + slopeX * t;
    output.y = line.a.y + slopeY * t;
    return output;
}
```

/**
 * Creates a random 3D vector with components within a specified range.
 *
 * @param min The minimum value for each component.
 * @param max The maximum value for each component.
 * @param rand The random number generator to use.
 * @return A 3D vector with random components.
 */
public static Vector3D_F64 createRandom(double min, double max, Random rand) {
    double range = max - min;
    Vector3D_F64 a = new Vector3D_F64();
    a.x = range * rand.nextDouble() + min;
    a.y = range * rand.nextDouble() + min;
    a.z = range * rand.nextDouble() + min;

}

7604	```java
/**
 * Computes a perpendicular canonical vector to the given vector.
 *
 * @param A The input vector.
 * @param output The output vector to store the result. If null, a new vector will be created.
 * @return The perpendicular canonical vector.
 */
public static Vector3D_F64 perpendicularCanonical(Vector3D_F64 A, Vector3D_F64 output) {
    if (output == null) {
        output = new Vector3D_F64();
    }

    // Normalize the input vector for scaling
    double scale = Math.abs(A.x) + Math.abs(A.y) + Math.abs(A.z);
    if (scale == 0) {
        output.set(0, 0, 0);
    } else {
        double x = A.x / scale;
        double y = A.y / scale;
        double z = A.z / scale;

        // Ensure numerical stability by swapping the largest variable
        if (Math.abs(x) > Math.abs(y)) {
            output.set(z, 0, -x);
        } else {
            output.set(0, z, -y);
        }
    }

    return output;
}
```

/**
 * Checks if two 3D vectors are identical within a given tolerance.

 * @return true if the vectors are identical within the tolerance, false otherwise.
 */
public static boolean isIdentical(Vector3D_F64 a, Vector3D_F64 b, double tol) {
    if (Math.abs(a.x - b.x) > tol) return false;
    if (Math.abs(a.y - b.y) > tol) return false;
    return Math.abs(a.z - b.z) <= tol;
}

7634	```java
/**
 * Parses an include node in an XML file.
 * 
 * @param origResult The original set of results.
 * @param serverFile The server file containing the include node.
 * @param node The include node to parse.
 * @param updatedParsedXmls The list of updated parsed XML files.
 * @return The updated set of results.
 */
private Set<String> parseIncludeNode(Set<String> origResult, File serverFile, Element node, List<File> updatedParsedXmls) {
    Set<String> result = origResult;
    String includeFileName = node.getAttribute("location");
    if (includeFileName == null || includeFileName.trim().isEmpty()) {
        return result;
    }

    File includeFile = null;
    if (isURL(includeFileName)) {
        try {
            File tempFile = File.createTempFile("serverFromURL", ".xml");
            FileUtils.copyURLToFile(new URL(includeFileName), tempFile, COPY_FILE_TIMEOUT_MILLIS, COPY_FILE_TIMEOUT_MILLIS);
            includeFile = tempFile;
        } catch (IOException e) {
            warn("The server file " + serverFile + " includes a URL " + includeFileName + " that cannot be accessed. Skipping the included features.");
            debug(e);
            return result;
        }
    } else {
        includeFile = new File(includeFileName);
    }

    try {
        if (!includeFile.isAbsolute()) {
            includeFile = new File(serverFile.getParentFile().getAbsolutePath(), includeFileName).getCanonicalFile();
        } else {
            includeFile = includeFile.getCanonicalFile();
        }
    } catch (IOException e) {
        warn("The server file " + serverFile + " includes a file " + includeFileName + " that cannot be accessed. Skipping the included features.");
        debug(e);
        return result;
    }

    if (!updatedParsedXmls.contains(includeFile)) {
        String onConflict = node.getAttribute("onConflict");
        Set<String> features = getServerXmlFeatures(null, includeFile, updatedParsedXmls);
        result = handleOnConflict(result, onConflict, features);
    }

    return result;
}
```

7647	```java
/**
 * Checks if the given artifact is a Spring Boot Uber Jar.
 * 
 * @param artifact The file to check.
 * @return true if the artifact is a Spring Boot Uber Jar, false otherwise.
 */
public static boolean isSpringBootUberJar(File artifact) {
    if (artifact == null || !artifact.exists() || !artifact.isFile()) {
        return false;
    }
    try (JarFile jarFile = new JarFile(artifact)) {
        Manifest manifest = jarFile.getManifest();
        if (manifest != null) {
            Attributes attributes = manifest.getMainAttributes();
            if (attributes.getValue(BOOT_VERSION_ATTRIBUTE) != null && attributes.getValue(BOOT_START_CLASS_ATTRIBUTE) != null) {
                return true;
            } else {
                Enumeration<JarEntry> entries = jarFile.entries();
                while (entries.hasMoreElements()) {
                    JarEntry entry = entries.nextElement();
                    String entryName = entry.getName();
                    if (!entryName.startsWith("org") && (entryName.matches(BOOT_JAR_EXPRESSION) || entryName.matches(BOOT_WAR_EXPRESSION))) {
                        return true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    } catch (IOException e) {
        // Handle IOException
    }
    return false;
}

    }
    throw new ArquillianConfigurationException("This should never happen.");
}

/**
 * Sets the count and interval values for a trigger based on the provided DTO.

private static void setCountIntervalValues(TriggerInfo dto, TriggerBuilder<org.quartz.Trigger> builder) {
    SimpleScheduleBuilder builderSc = SimpleScheduleBuilder.simpleSchedule();
    if (dto.getRepeatCount() != 0) {
        builderSc.withRepeatCount(dto.getRepeatCount());
    }
    if (dto.getRepeatInterval() > 0) {
        builderSc.withIntervalInMilliseconds(dto.getRepeatInterval());
    }
    builder.withSchedule(builderSc);
}

/**
 * Sets the start and end times for a trigger based on the provided DTO.
 * If the start time is greater than -1, it sets the trigger to start at that time.
 * Otherwise, it sets the trigger to start immediately.
 * If the end time is greater than -1, it sets the trigger to end at that time.
 *
 * @param dto The DTO containing the start and end times.
 * @param builder The TriggerBuilder to configure.
 */
private static void setStartEndTime(TriggerInfo dto, TriggerBuilder<org.quartz.Trigger> builder) {
    if (dto.getStartTime() > -1) {
        builder.startAt(new Date(dto.getStartTime()));
    } else {
        builder.startNow();
    }
    if (dto.getEndTime() > -1) {
        builder.endAt(new Date(dto.getEndTime()));
    }
}

7691	```java
public void changePassword(T user, String currentPassword, String newPassword, String newPassword2) throws AuthenticationException {
    // Verify the current password
    verifyPassword(user, currentPassword);
    
    // Check if the new password and re-typed password match
    if (!newPassword.equals(newPassword2)) {
        throw new AuthenticationException(user.getUsername() + ": New password and re-type password must be same");
    }
    
    // Check if the new password is different from the current password
    if (newPassword.equals(currentPassword)) {
        throw new AuthenticationException(user.getUsername() + ": New password and old password must be different");
    }
    
    // Verify the strength of the new password
    verifyPasswordStrength(currentPassword, newPassword, user);
    
    // Attempt to change the password in the user store
    Optional<? extends UserEntry> optional = userStore.changePassword(user.getUsername(), newPassword);
    
    // Check if the password update was successful
    if (!optional.isPresent()) {
        throw new AuthenticationException(user.getUsername() + ": Can't update UserEntry Password");
    }
}

7699	```java
/**
 * Starts a process with transaction handling.
 * 
 * <ol>
 *   <li>Calls the `before` method.</li>
 *   <li>Wraps the transaction using `transactionWrapper`.</li>
 *   <li>Calls the `success` method if no exceptions occur.</li>
 *   <li>Calls the `error` method and handles the exception if an exception occurs.</li>
 *   <li>Finally, calls the `finish` method.</li>
 * </ol>
 * 
 * @throws Exception if an exception occurs and no exception handler is provided.
 */
private void start() {
    try {
        before();
        transactionWrapper.wrap();
        success();
    } catch (Exception e) {
        error();
        if (exceptionHandler != null) {
            exceptionHandler.onException(e);
        } else {
            throw e;
        }
    } finally {
        finish();
    }
}
```
7700	```java
/**
 * Configures a field by name in a criteria object.
 * 
 * @param <E> The type of the entity.
 * @param criteria The criteria object to configure.
 * @param name The name of the field to configure, in dot notation (e.g., "x.y.z").
 * @return A holder object containing the current field name, criteria, and field metadata.
 * @throws RuntimeException If the field name is empty or null, if the field reference is not defined, or if the join field is not created.
 */
public static <E> Holder<E> configureFieldByName(Criteria<E> criteria, String name) {
    if (Validations.isEmptyOrNull(name)) return null;

    String[] names = name.split("\\.");
    String currentName;
    int step = 0;
    CriteriaParent<E> currentCriteria = criteria;
    FieldMeta currentFieldMeta;
    StringJoiner aliasJoiner = new StringJoiner("$");

    do {
        currentName = names[step];
        if (Validations.isEmptyOrNull(currentName)) {
            throw new RuntimeException(currentName + " defined name is wrong!");
        }
        currentFieldMeta = criteria.getMeta().getFieldMap().get(currentName);
        step++;
        aliasJoiner.add(currentCriteria.getAlias());

        if (step >= names.length) break;

        if (currentFieldMeta.getReference() == null) {
            throw new RuntimeException(currentName + " join field of " + name + "'s reference target information must defined!");
        }

        CriteriaJoin<E> criteriaJoin = currentCriteria.getJoin(currentName);
        if (criteriaJoin == null) {
            currentCriteria.createJoin(currentName, currentFieldMeta.getReference().getTargetEntity(), currentFieldMeta.getReference().getReferenceId());
        }
        currentCriteria = criteriaJoin;
    } while (step < names.length);

    Holder<E> holder = new Holder<>();
    holder.currentFieldName = currentName;
    holder.currentCriteria = currentCriteria;
    holder.currentFieldMeta = currentFieldMeta;
    return holder;
}
```

7719	```java
/**
 * Compares two Readers to check if they contain the same content.
 *
 * @param in1 the first Reader to compare
 * @param in2 the second Reader to compare
 * @return true if both Readers are equal, false otherwise
 * @throws IOException if an I/O error occurs
 */
public static boolean equal(Reader in1, Reader in2) throws IOException {
    if (in1 == in2) {
        return true;
    }
    if (in1 == null || in2 == null) {
        return false;
    }
    in1 = buffer(in1);
    in2 = buffer(in2);
    int c1 = in1.read();
    int c2 = in2.read();
    while (c1 != -1 && c2 != -1 && c1 == c2) {
        c1 = in1.read();
        c2 = in2.read();
    }
    return in1.read() == -1 && in2.read() == -1;
}

7742	```java
/**
 * Finds the nearest forecast for a given date and time.
 *
 * @param dateTime The date and time to find the nearest forecast for.
 * @return An Optional containing the nearest forecast, or an empty Optional if no forecast is found.
 */
public Optional<MeteoExtrasForecast> findNearestForecast(ZonedDateTime dateTime) {
    ZonedDateTime dt = toZeroMSN(dateTime.withZoneSameInstant(METZONE));
    PointForecast chosenForecast = null;
    for (Forecast forecast : getLocationForecast().getForecasts()) {
        if (forecast instanceof PointForecast) {
            PointForecast pointForecast = (PointForecast) forecast;
            if (isDateMatch(dt, cloneZonedDateTime(pointForecast.getFrom()))) {
                chosenForecast = pointForecast;
                break;
            } else if (chosenForecast == null) {
                chosenForecast = pointForecast;
            } else if (isNearerDate(pointForecast.getFrom(), dt, chosenForecast.getFrom())) {
                chosenForecast = pointForecast;
            }
        }
    }
    if (chosenForecast == null) {
        return Optional.empty();
    }
    return Optional.of(new MeteoExtrasForecast(chosenForecast, getIndexer().getWidestFitPeriodForecast(chosenForecast.getFrom()).orElse(null)));
}

7753	```java
/**
 * Retrieves the best fit period forecast for a given time range.
 *
 * @param from the start time of the requested period
 * @param to the end time of the requested period
 * @return an Optional containing the best fit period forecast, or an empty Optional if no forecast is found
 */
Optional<PeriodForecast> getBestFitPeriodForecast(ZonedDateTime from, ZonedDateTime to) {
    if (from == null || to == null) {
        return Optional.empty();
    }

    ZonedDateTime requestFrom = toZeroMSN(from);
    ZonedDateTime requestTo = toZeroMSN(to);

    List<PeriodForecast> forecastsList = dayIndex.get(new DayIndexKey(requestFrom));
    if (forecastsList == null) {
        return Optional.empty();
    }

    PeriodForecast chosenForecast = null;
    long score = 0;
    long tmpScore = 0;

    for (PeriodForecast forecast : forecastsList) {
        ZonedDateTime actualFrom = cloneZonedDateTime(forecast.getFrom());
        ZonedDateTime actualTo = cloneZonedDateTime(forecast.getTo());

        if (requestFrom.equals(actualFrom) && requestTo.equals(actualTo)) {
            return Optional.of(forecast);
        } else if ((requestFrom.isBefore(actualFrom) && requestTo.isBefore(actualFrom)) ||
                   (requestFrom.isAfter(actualTo) && requestTo.isAfter(actualTo)) ||
                   actualTo.isEqual(actualFrom)) {
            continue;
        } else {
            tmpScore = hoursBetween(requestFrom, actualFrom);
            tmpScore = Math.abs(tmpScore);

            if ((score == 0 && tmpScore > 0) || tmpScore > score) {
                score = tmpScore;
                chosenForecast = forecast;
            }
        }
    }

    return Optional.ofNullable(chosenForecast);
}
```

/**
 * Parses a regular expression and constructs a Subre (subregular expression) tree.
 * 
 * @param stopper The character that stops the parsing.
 * @param type The type of the regular expression.
 * @param initState The initial state of the NFA (Nondeterministic Finite Automaton).
 * @param finalState The final state of the NFA.
 * @return The root of the constructed Subre tree.
 * @throws RegexException If there are unbalanced parentheses.
 */
private Subre parse(int stopper, int type, State initState, State finalState) throws RegexException {
    State left, right;
    Subre branches, branch, t;
    int firstbranch = 1;

    assert stopper == ' ' || stopper == EOS;
    branches = new Subre(' ', Subre.LONGER, initState, finalState);
    branch = branches;

    do {
        if (0 == firstbranch) {
            branch.right = new Subre(' ', Subre.LONGER, initState, finalState);
            branch = branch.right;
        }
        firstbranch = 0;

        left = nfa.newstate();
        right = nfa.newstate();
        nfa.emptyarc(initState, left);
        nfa.emptyarc(right, finalState);

        branch.left = parsebranch(stopper, type, left, right, false);
        branch.flags |= up(branch.flags | branch.left.flags);

        if ((branch.flags & ~branches.flags) != 0) {
            for (t = branches; t != branch; t = t.right) {
                t.flags |= branch.flags;
            }
        }
    } while (eat(' '));

    assert see(stopper) || see(EOS);
    if (!see(stopper)) {
        assert stopper == ' ' && see(EOS);
        throw new RegexException("Unbalanced parentheses.");
    }

    if (branch == branches) {
        assert branch.right == null;
        t = branch.left;
        branch.left = null;
        branches = t;
    } else if (!messy(branches.flags)) {
        branches.left = null;
        branches.right = null;
        branches.op = ' ';
    }

    return branches;
}

7815	```java
void freestate(State s) {
    assert s != null;
    assert s.nins == 0;
    assert s.nouts == 0;

    if (s.next != null) {
        s.next.prev = s.prev;
    } else {
        assert s == slast;
        slast = s.prev;
    }

    if (s.prev != null) {
        s.prev.next = s.next;
    } else {
        assert s == states;
        states = s.next;
    }
}
```

Similarly, if it is the first state, it updates `states` to the next state.

        assert parent.eos[1] != Constants.COLORLESS;
        eos[1] = parent.eos[1];
    }
}

7822	```java
/**
 * Recursively dumps arcs from a given arc to a state, appending to a StringBuilder.
 * 
 * @param a The current arc to process.
 * @param s The state associated with the arc.
 * @param pos The current position in the StringBuilder.
 * @param sb The StringBuilder to append the arc information to.
 * @return The updated position in the StringBuilder.
 */
int dumprarcs(Arc a, State s, int pos, StringBuilder sb) {
    if (a.outchain != null) {
        pos = dumprarcs(a.outchain, s, pos, sb);
    }
    dumparc(a, s, sb);
    if (pos == 5) {
        sb.append("\n");
        pos = 1;
    } else {
        pos++;
    }
    return pos;
}

7823	```java
void dumparc(Arc a, State s, StringBuilder sb) {
    sb.append("\t");
    switch (a.type) {
        case Compiler.PLAIN: sb.append(String.format("[%d]", a.co)); break;
        case Compiler.AHEAD: sb.append(String.format(">%d>", a.co)); break;
        case Compiler.BEHIND: sb.append(String.format("<%d<", a.co)); break;
        case Compiler.LACON: sb.append(String.format(":%d:", a.co)); break;
        case ' ': case ' ': sb.append(String.format("%c%d", (char)a.type, a.co)); break;
        case Compiler.EMPTY: break;
        default: sb.append(String.format("0x%x/0%d", a.type, a.co)); break;
    }
    if (a.from != s) {
        sb.append(String.format("?%d?", a.from.no));
    }
    sb.append("->");
    if (a.to == null) {
        sb.append("null");
        Arc aa;
        for (aa = a.to.ins; aa != null; aa = aa.inchain) {
            if (aa == a) { break; }
        }
        if (aa == null) {
            LOG.debug("?!?");
        }
    } else {
        sb.append(String.format("%d", a.to.no));
    }
}
```

7826	```java
/**
 * Combines two arcs based on their types and constraints.
 * 
 * @param con The first arc.
 * @param a The second arc.
 * @return The result of combining the two arcs.
 * @throws RegexException If the combination is impossible.
 */
int combine(Arc con, Arc a) throws RegexException {
    int combinedType = (con.type << 8) | a.type;
    switch (combinedType) {
        case (' ' << 8) | Compiler.PLAIN:
        case Compiler.AHEAD << 8 | Compiler.PLAIN:
        case Compiler.BEHIND << 8 | Compiler.PLAIN:
            if (con.co == a.co) {
                return SATISFIED;
            }
            return INCOMPATIBLE;
        case ' ' << 8 | ' ':
        case Compiler.AHEAD << 8 | Compiler.AHEAD:
        case Compiler.BEHIND << 8 | Compiler.BEHIND:
            if (con.co == a.co) {
                return SATISFIED;
            }
            return INCOMPATIBLE;
        case ' ' << 8 | Compiler.BEHIND:
        case Compiler.BEHIND << 8 | ' ':
        case ' ' << 8 | Compiler.AHEAD:
        case Compiler.AHEAD << 8 | ' ':
            return INCOMPATIBLE;
        case ' ' << 8 | Compiler.AHEAD:
        case Compiler.BEHIND << 8 | ' ':
        case Compiler.BEHIND << 8 | Compiler.AHEAD:
        case ' ' << 8 | ' ':
        case ' ' << 8 | Compiler.BEHIND:
        case Compiler.AHEAD << 8 | ' ':
        case Compiler.AHEAD << 8 | Compiler.BEHIND:
        case ' ' << 8 | Compiler.LACON:
        case Compiler.BEHIND << 8 | Compiler.LACON:
        case ' ' << 8 | Compiler.LACON:
        case Compiler.AHEAD << 8 | Compiler.LACON:
            return COMPATIBLE;
        default:
            throw new RuntimeException("Impossible arc");
    }
}
```

7828	The `markreachable` function is a recursive method used to mark all states that are reachable from a given state `s` and are not equal to a specified state `okay`. It takes three parameters: `s` (the current state), `okay` (the state to avoid marking), and `mark` (the state to mark). The function first checks if the current state `s` is equal to `okay`. If it is, the function returns without making any changes. If not, it sets the `tmp` field of the current state `s` to `mark`. Then, it iterates through all the outgoing arcs of the current state `s` using a loop. For each outgoing arc `a`, it recursively calls the `markreachable` function with the destination state `a.to`, the `okay` state, and the `mark` state. This process continues until all reachable states have been marked.
7829	The `markcanreach` function is a recursive method used to mark states in a graph. It takes three parameters: `s` (the current state), `okay` (the state to check against), and `mark` (the state to mark if the condition is met). The function checks if the current state `s` is not equal to `okay`. If it is not, the function returns immediately. If `s` is equal to `okay`, it sets the `tmp` field of `s` to `mark`. Then, it iterates through the incoming arcs of `s` using a loop. For each incoming arc `a`, it recursively calls `markcanreach` on the source state `a.from`, passing the same `okay` and `mark` parameters. This process continues until all reachable states from `s` that match the `okay` state are marked with the `mark` state.
7830	The `fixempties` function iteratively eliminates empty arcs in a nondeterministic finite automaton (NFA) until no more empty arcs remain. It uses a `do-while` loop to repeatedly process the NFA, checking each state and its outgoing arcs. If an empty arc is found and can be unemptied, the function updates the NFA and marks progress. After each iteration, if progress was made, the NFA is dumped. The loop continues until no more empty arcs are found.
7831	The `unempty` function takes an `Arc` object `a` as input and performs the following operations:

1. It retrieves the `from` and `to` states of the arc.
2. It asserts that the arc type is `Compiler.EMPTY` and that neither the `from` nor `to` state is `pre` or `post`.
3. If the `from` and `to` states are the same, it frees the arc and returns `true` (indicating a vacuous loop).
4. It decides which end of the arc to work on by comparing the number of outgoing arcs from the `from` state to the number of incoming arcs to the `to` state. If the `from` state has more outgoing arcs, it sets `usefrom` to `false`; otherwise, it sets `usefrom` to `true`.
5. If the `from` state has fewer outgoing arcs than incoming arcs, it sets `usefrom` to `false`.
6. It frees the arc.
7. If `usefrom` is `true`, it checks if the `from` state has only one outgoing arc. If so, it moves the incoming arcs to the `to` state and frees the `from` state. Otherwise, it copies the incoming arcs to the `to` state.
8. If `usefrom` is `false`, it checks if the `to` state has only one incoming arc. If so, it moves the outgoing arcs from the `to` state to the `from` state and frees the `to` state. Otherwise, it copies the outgoing arcs from the `to` state to the `from` state.
9. Finally, it returns `true`.

7841	```java
/**
 * Interprets the command line arguments and executes the specified tasks.
 *
 * @param commandLine The command line arguments.
 * @param options The available options.
 * @param taskFactory The factory for creating tasks.
 * @throws CliExecutionException If an error occurs during task execution.
 */
private void interpretCommandLine(CommandLine commandLine, Options options, TaskFactory taskFactory) throws CliExecutionException {
    if (commandLine.hasOption(OPTION_HELP)) {
        printUsage(options, null);
        System.exit(1);
    }

    List<String> taskNames = commandLine.getArgList();
    if (taskNames.isEmpty()) {
        printUsage(options, "A task must be specified, i.e. one of " + gatherTaskNames(taskFactory));
        System.exit(1);
    }

    List<Task> tasks = new ArrayList<>();
    for (String taskName : taskNames) {
        Task task = taskFactory.fromName(taskName);
        if (task == null) {
            printUsage(options, "Unknown task " + taskName);
        }
        tasks.add(task);
    }

    Map<String, Object> properties = readProperties(commandLine);
    PluginRepository pluginRepository = getPluginRepository();

    try {
        executeTasks(tasks, options, commandLine, pluginRepository, properties);
    } catch (PluginRepositoryException e) {
        throw new CliExecutionException("Unexpected plugin repository problem while executing tasks.", e);
    }
}
```

If a `ParseException` occurs during parsing, it prints the usage message with the error message and exits the program with a status code of 1.

7847	```java
/**
 * Creates a plugin class loader.
 * 
 * @return The plugin class loader.
 * @throws CliExecutionException If an error occurs while reading the plugin directory.
 */
private ClassLoader createPluginClassLoader() throws CliExecutionException {
    ClassLoader parentClassLoader = Task.class.getClassLoader();
    File homeDirectory = getHomeDirectory();
    if (homeDirectory != null) {
        File pluginDirectory = new File(homeDirectory, DIRECTORY_PLUGINS);
        if (pluginDirectory.exists()) {
            List<URL> urls = new ArrayList<>();
            Path pluginDirectoryPath = pluginDirectory.toPath();
            SimpleFileVisitor<Path> visitor = new SimpleFileVisitor<Path>() {
                @Override
                public FileVisitResult visitFile(Path file, BasicFileAttributes attrs) throws IOException {
                    if (file.toFile().getName().endsWith(".jar")) {
                        urls.add(file.toFile().toURI().toURL());
                    }
                    return FileVisitResult.CONTINUE;
                }
            };
            try {
                Files.walkFileTree(pluginDirectoryPath, visitor);
            } catch (IOException e) {
                throw new CliExecutionException("Cannot read plugin directory.", e);
            }
            LOGGER.debug("Using plugin URLs: " + urls);
            return new com.buschmais.jqassistant.commandline.PluginClassLoader(urls, parentClassLoader);
        }
    }
    return parentClassLoader;
}
```

/**
 * Adds a route to the router.
 *
 * @param pathPattern The path pattern for the route.
 * @param target The target object for the route.
 * @return The current router instance.
 */
public OrderlessRouter<T> addRoute(String pathPattern, T target) {
    PathPattern p = new PathPattern(pathPattern);
    if (routes.containsKey(p)) {
        return this;
    }
    routes.put(p, target);
    addReverseRoute(target, p);
    return this;
}

/**
 * Compares two entries to determine their order based on whether they are folders or not.
 * 
 * @param e1 The first entry to compare.
 * @param e2 The second entry to compare.
 * @return -1 if e1 is a folder and e2 is not, 1 if e1 is not a folder and e2 is, and 0 if both are folders or both are not.
 */
protected int compareFolders(final Entry e1, final Entry e2) {
    final boolean f1 = e1 instanceof Folder;
    final boolean f2 = e2 instanceof Folder;
    if (f1 && !f2) {
        return -1;

        return 1;
    } else {
        return 0;
    }
}

        funcMapper = AccessController.doPrivileged(new PrivilegedAction<ProtectedFunctionMapper>() {

7875	```java
/**
 * Parses a JSP file and returns a Node.Nodes object representing the parsed page.
 *
 * @param inFileName The name of the input file to parse.
 * @param parent The parent node of the parsed page.
 * @param jarFileUrl The URL of the JAR file containing the input file.
 * @return A Node.Nodes object representing the parsed page.
 * @throws FileNotFoundException If the input file is not found.
 * @throws JasperException If an error occurs during parsing.
 * @throws IOException If an I/O error occurs.
 */
private Node.Nodes doParse(String inFileName, Node parent, URL jarFileUrl) throws FileNotFoundException, JasperException, IOException {
    Node.Nodes parsedPage = null;
    isEncodingSpecifiedInProlog = false;
    isDefaultPageEncoding = false;
    hasBom = false;
    JarFile jarFile = getJarFile(jarFileUrl);
    String absFileName = resolveFileName(inFileName);
    String jspConfigPageEnc = getJspConfigPageEncoding(absFileName);
    determineSyntaxAndEncoding(absFileName, jarFile, jspConfigPageEnc);
    if (parent != null) {
        compiler.getPageInfo().addDependant(absFileName);
    }
    comparePageEncodings(jspConfigPageEnc);
    if (isXml) {
        parsedPage = JspDocumentParser.parse(this, absFileName, jarFile, parent, isTagFile, directiveOnly, sourceEnc, jspConfigPageEnc, isEncodingSpecifiedInProlog);
    } else {
        InputStreamReader inStreamReader = null;
        try {
            inStreamReader = JspUtil.getReader(absFileName, sourceEnc, jarFile, ctxt, err);
            JspReader jspReader = new JspReader(ctxt, absFileName, sourceEnc, inStreamReader, err);
            parsedPage = Parser.parse(this, absFileName, jspReader, parent, isTagFile, directiveOnly, jarFileUrl, sourceEnc, jspConfigPageEnc, isDefaultPageEncoding, hasBom);
        } finally {
            if (inStreamReader != null) {
                try {
                    inStreamReader.close();
                } catch (Exception any) {
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if (jarFile != null) {
        try {
            jarFile.close();
        } catch (Throwable t) {
        }
    }
    baseDirStack.pop();
    return parsedPage;
}
```

/**
 * Calculates the last modification timestamp among all channel information.

private Optional<Instant> calcLastMod() {
    Instant globalLastMod = null;
    for (final ChannelInformation ci : this.channelService.list()) {
        final Optional<Instant> lastMod = Optional.ofNullable(ci.getState().getModificationTimestamp());
        if (globalLastMod == null || lastMod.get().isAfter(globalLastMod)) {

7879	The `basicFindClassLoaders` method retrieves a list of class loaders from the current context, filters them based on certain conditions, and returns the filtered list. Here's a summary of the method:

1. **Retrieve Class Context**: The method starts by retrieving the class context using `contextFinder.getClassContext()`, which returns an array of `Class` objects representing the current execution stack.

2. **Initialize Result List**: An `ArrayList` named `result` is initialized to store the filtered class loaders. The initial capacity is set to 1.

3. **Iterate Through Class Context**: The method iterates through the class context array starting from the second element (index 1) to the end.

4. **Check Class and Class Loader**: For each class in the stack, the method checks if the class meets certain criteria using `checkClass(stack[i])`. If the class meets the criteria, it retrieves the class loader of the class.

5. **Filter Class Loaders**: The method further filters the class loaders based on the following conditions:
   - The class loader is not `null`.
   - The class loader is not the same as the current class loader (`this`).
   - The class loader is not already in the result list.

6. **Stop at Framework or Bundle Class Loader**: The iteration stops if the current class is part of a bundle, as determined by `Activator.getBundle(stack[i]) != null`.

7. **Add to Result List**: If the class loader meets all the conditions, it is added to the result list, and the `previousLoader` is updated to the current class loader.

8. **Return Result**: Finally, the method returns the filtered list of class loaders.

In summary, the `basicFindClassLoaders` method filters and returns a list of class loaders from the current execution stack based on specific criteria, stopping at framework or bundle class loaders.

7883	```java
public static <T> PaginationResult<T> paginate(final Integer startPage, final int pageSize, final List<T> fullDataSet) {
    return paginate(startPage, pageSize, (start, length) -> {
        final int len = fullDataSet.size();
        if (start > len) {
            return Collections.emptyList();
        }
        return fullDataSet.subList(start, Math.min(start + length, len));
    });
}
```

**Summary:**
The `paginate` method is a generic method that takes three parameters: `startPage`, `pageSize`, and `fullDataSet`. It returns a `PaginationResult` object. The method uses a lambda expression to handle the pagination logic. If the `start` index is greater than the size of the `fullDataSet`, it returns an empty list. Otherwise, it returns a sublist of `fullDataSet` starting from the `start` index and having a maximum size of `length`.

/**
 * Converts a string representation of a MetaKey into a MetaKey object.
 * 
 * @param string The string representation of the MetaKey.
 * @return A MetaKey object if the string is valid, otherwise null.
 */
public static MetaKey fromString(final String string) {
    final int idx = string.indexOf(' ');
    if (idx < 1) { // -1: none at all, 0: empty namespace
        return null;
    }
    if (idx + 1 >= string.length()) { // empty key segment
        return null;
    }
    return new MetaKey(string.substring(0, idx), string.substring(idx + 1), true);
}

7887	```java
/**
 * Parses the implicit TLD (Tag Library Descriptor) file for a given path in the JSP compilation context.
 * 
 * @param ctxt The JspCompilationContext containing the resource path.
 * @param path The path to the implicit TLD file.
 * @throws JasperException If an error occurs during parsing or resource access.
 */
private void parseImplicitTld(JspCompilationContext ctxt, String path) throws JasperException {
    InputStream is = null;
    TreeNode tld = null;
    try {
        URL uri = ctxt.getResource(path);
        if (uri == null) {
            return; // No implicit.tld file found
        }
        is = uri.openStream();
        // Parse the XML document from the input stream
        tld = new ParserUtils().parseXMLDocument(IMPLICIT_TLD, is, ctxt.getOptions().isValidationEnabled());
    } catch (Exception ex) {
        throw new JasperException(ex);
    } finally {
        if (is != null) {
            try {
                is.close();
            } catch (Throwable t) {
                // Ignore close exceptions
            }
        }
    }

    // Extract JSP version from the TLD
    this.jspversion = tld.findAttribute("version");
    Iterator list = tld.findChildren();
    while (list.hasNext()) {
        TreeNode element = (TreeNode) list.next();
        String tname = element.getName();
        if ("tlibversion".equals(tname) || "tlib-version".equals(tname)) {
            this.tlibversion = element.getBody();
        } else if ("jspversion".equals(tname) || "jsp-version".equals(tname)) {
            this.jspversion = element.getBody();
        } else if (!"shortname".equals(tname) && !"short-name".equals(tname)) {
            err.jspError("jsp.error.implicitTld.additionalElements", path, tname);
        }
    }

    // Validate JSP version
    Double jspVersionDouble = Double.valueOf(this.jspversion);
    if (Double.compare(jspVersionDouble, Constants.JSP_VERSION_2_0) < 0) {
        err.jspError("jsp.error.implicitTld.jspVersion", path, this.jspversion);
    }
}

7917	```java
public static Node.Nodes parse(ParserController pc, String path, JspReader reader, Node parent, boolean isTagFile, boolean directivesOnly, URL jarFileUrl, String pageEnc, String jspConfigPageEnc, boolean isDefaultPageEncoding, boolean hasBom) throws JasperException {
    Parser parser = new Parser(pc, reader, isTagFile, directivesOnly, jarFileUrl, hasBom);
    Node.Root root = new Node.Root(reader.mark(), parent, false);
    root.setPageEncoding(pageEnc);
    root.setJspConfigPageEncoding(jspConfigPageEnc);
    root.setIsDefaultPageEncoding(isDefaultPageEncoding);
    root.setHasBom(hasBom);

    if (hasBom) {
        char bomChar = (char) reader.nextChar();
        if (bomChar != 0xFEFF) {
            parser.err.jspError(reader.mark(), "jsp.error.invalidBom", Integer.toHexString(bomChar).toUpperCase());
        }
    }

    if (directivesOnly) {
        parser.parseTagFileDirectives(root);
        return new Node.Nodes(root);
    }

    PageInfo pageInfo = pc.getCompiler().getPageInfo();
    if (parent == null) {
        parser.addInclude(root, pageInfo.getIncludePrelude());
    }

    while (reader.hasMoreInput()) {
        parser.parseElements(root);
    }

    if (parent == null) {
        parser.addInclude(root, pageInfo.getIncludeCoda());
        parser.pageInfo.setRootPath(path);
    }

    Node.Nodes page = new Node.Nodes(root);
    return page;
}
```

**Summary:**
The `parse` method is a static method that parses a JSP file and constructs a parse tree. It takes parameters such as `ParserController`, `path`, `JspReader`, `Node`, `isTagFile`, `directivesOnly`, `URL`, `pageEnc`, `jspConfigPageEnc`, `isDefaultPageEncoding`, and `hasBom`. The method initializes a `Parser` and a `Node.Root`, sets various properties on the root node, and handles BOM (Byte Order Mark) if present. If `directivesOnly` is true, it parses tag file directives and returns the root node. Otherwise, it processes include prelude, parses elements until no more input is available, processes include coda, and sets the root path if the parent is null. Finally, it returns a `Node.Nodes` containing the root node.

7921	```java
/**
 * Parses JSP attributes and body.
 *
 * @param parent The parent node.
 * @param tag The tag name.
 * @param bodyType The body type.
 * @return true if parsing is successful, false otherwise.
 * @throws JasperException if an error occurs during parsing.
 */
private boolean parseJspAttributeAndBody(Node parent, String tag, String bodyType) throws JasperException {
    boolean result = false;
    if (reader.matchesOptionalSpacesFollowedBy("<jsp:attribute")) {
        // Parse <jsp:attribute> elements
        parseNamedAttributes(parent);
        result = true;
    }
    if (reader.matchesOptionalSpacesFollowedBy("<jsp:body")) {
        // Parse ActionBody
        parseJspBody(parent, bodyType);
        reader.skipSpaces();
        if (!reader.matchesETag(tag)) {
            err.jspError(reader.mark(), "jsp.error.unterminated", "&lt;" + tag);
        }
        result = true;
    } else if (result && !reader.matchesETag(tag)) {
        // Translation error if <jsp:attribute> is present but not followed by <jsp:body> or the end tag
        err.jspError(reader.mark(), "jsp.error.jspbody.required", "&lt;" + tag);
    }
    return result;
}
```

/**
 * Checks if the user is authenticated based on the deploy key from the request.
 *
 * @param by The element to check for authentication.
 * @param request The HTTP request containing the authorization information.
 * @return true if the user is authenticated, false otherwise.
 */
protected boolean isAuthenticated(final By by, final HttpServletRequest request) {
    // Parse the authorization information from the request
    final String[] authToks = parseAuthorization(request);
    if (authToks == null) {
        return false; // Authentication failed if no tokens are found
    }

    // Extract the deploy key from the tokens
    final String deployKey = authToks[1];
    logger.debug("Deploy key: '{}'", deployKey);

    // Get the channel service from the request
    final ChannelService service = getService(request);
    if (service == null) {
        logger.info("Called 'isAuthenticated' without service");
        return false; // Authentication failed if no service is found
    }

    // Check if the deploy key is valid
    return service.getChannelDeployKeyStrings(by).orElse(Collections.emptySet()).contains(deployKey);
}

    if (error == null) {

/**
 * Loads a tag file and returns the corresponding Class object.
 * 
 * @param compiler The compiler instance.
 * @param tagFilePath The path to the tag file.
 * @param tagInfo The tag information.
 * @param parentPageInfo The parent page information.

 * @throws JasperException If an error occurs during the loading process.

private Class loadTagFile(Compiler compiler, String tagFilePath, TagInfo tagInfo, PageInfo parentPageInfo) throws JasperException {
    JspCompilationContext ctxt = compiler.getCompilationContext();
    JspRuntimeContext rctxt = ctxt.getRuntimeContext();
    synchronized (rctxt) {
        JspServletWrapper wrapper = (JspServletWrapper) rctxt.getWrapper(tagFilePath);
        if (wrapper == null) {
            wrapper = new JspServletWrapper(ctxt.getServletContext(), ctxt.getOptions(), tagFilePath, tagInfo, ctxt.getRuntimeContext(), (URL) ctxt.getTagFileJarUrls().get(tagFilePath));
            rctxt.addWrapper(tagFilePath, wrapper);
            // Use same classloader and classpath for compiling tag files
            wrapper.getJspEngineContext().setClassLoader((URLClassLoader) ctxt.getClassLoader());
            wrapper.getJspEngineContext().setClassPath(ctxt.getClassPath());
        } else {
            // Make sure that JspCompilationContext gets the latest TagInfo
            // for the tag file.
            wrapper.getJspEngineContext().setTagInfo(tagInfo);
        }
        Class tagClazz;
        int tripCount = wrapper.incTripCount();
        try {
            if (tripCount > 0) {
                // When tripCount is greater than zero, a circular
                // dependency exists.  The circularily dependant tag
                // file is compiled in prototype mode, to avoid infinite
                // recursion.
                JspServletWrapper tempWrapper = new JspServletWrapper(ctxt.getServletContext(), ctxt.getOptions(), tagFilePath, tagInfo, ctxt.getRuntimeContext(), (URL) ctxt.getTagFileJarUrls().get(tagFilePath));
                tagClazz = tempWrapper.loadTagFilePrototype();
                tempVector.add(tempWrapper.getJspEngineContext().getCompiler());
            } else {
                tagClazz = wrapper.loadTagFile();
            }
        } finally {
            wrapper.decTripCount();

        // dependant list.  The only reliable dependency information

7962	```java
/**
 * Locates the URI root for a given file.
 * 
 * @param f The file to locate the URI root for.
 */
private void locateUriRoot(File f) {
    String tUriBase = uriBase;
    if (tUriBase == null) {
        tUriBase = "/";
    }
    try {
        if (f.exists()) {
            f = new File(f.getCanonicalPath());
            while (f != null) {
                File g = new File(f, "WEB-INF");
                if (g.exists() && g.isDirectory()) {
                    uriRoot = f.getCanonicalPath();
                    uriBase = tUriBase;
                    if (log.isLoggable(Level.INFO)) {
                        log.info(Localizer.getMessage("jspc.implicit.uriRoot", uriRoot));
                    }
                    break;
                }
                if (f.exists() && f.isDirectory()) {
                    tUriBase = "/" + f.getName() + "/" + tUriBase;
                }
                String fParent = f.getParent();
                if (fParent == null) {
                    break;
                } else {
                    f = new File(fParent);
                }
            }
            if (uriRoot != null) {
                File froot = new File(uriRoot);
                uriRoot = froot.getCanonicalPath();
            }
        }
    } catch (IOException ioe) {
        // Ignore the exception as a null value for uriRoot is non-error meaning.
    }
}
```

3. **Increment `lzPos`**: It increments `lzPos` by 1. If `lzPos` reaches the maximum value of an integer (`Integer.MAX_VALUE`), it performs normalization:
   - It calculates a normalization offset by subtracting `cyclicSize` from `Integer.MAX_VALUE`.
   - It calls `hash.normalize` with the normalization offset.
   - It calls `normalize` with `chain`, `cyclicSize`, and the normalization offset.
   - It adjusts `lzPos` by subtracting the normalization offset.

4. **Increment `cyclicPos`**: It increments `cyclicPos` by 1. If `cyclicPos` reaches the value of `cyclicSize`, it resets `cyclicPos` to 0.

5. **Return Value**: Finally, it returns the value of `avail`.

In summary, the `movePos` method manages the positions of `lzPos` and `cyclicPos`, normalizing them if they reach their maximum values, and returns the availability status.

7967	The `skipUntil` method is designed to skip characters in a stream until a specified limit string is encountered. It returns a `Mark` object indicating the position before the limit string was found. If the limit string is not found, it returns `null`. The method uses a nested loop to compare characters of the limit string with the characters in the stream. If a mismatch is found, it resets the stream to the beginning of the current comparison and continues searching.
7968	```java
Mark skipUntilIgnoreEsc(String limit) throws JasperException {
    Mark ret = null;
    int limlen = limit.length();
    int ch;
    int prev = ' '; // Doesn't matter

    skip:
    for (ret = mark(), ch = nextChar(); ch != -1; ret = mark(), prev = ch, ch = nextChar()) {
        if (ch == ' ' && prev == ' ') {
            ch = 0; // Double \ is not an escape char anymore
        } else if (ch == limit.charAt(0) && prev != ' ') {
            for (int i = 1; i < limlen; i++) {
                if (peekChar() == limit.charAt(i)) {
                    nextChar();
                } else {
                    continue skip;
                }
            }
            return ret;
        }
    }
    return null;
}
```

**Summary:**
The method `skipUntilIgnoreEsc` is designed to skip characters in a string until a specific sequence is encountered, ignoring double spaces as escape characters. It uses a loop to iterate through the characters, marking the current position and checking for the sequence defined by the `limit` parameter. If the sequence is found, it returns the marked position; otherwise, it returns `null`.

/**
 * Pops the current file from the stack and restores the parser state.
 * 
 * @return true if the file was successfully popped, false otherwise.
 * @throws JasperException if the current file is not registered.
 */
private boolean popFile() throws JasperException {
    // Check if the stack is created and the current file ID is valid
    if (current == null || currFileId < 0) {
        return false;
    }

    // Restore parser state
    String fName = getFile(currFileId);
    currFileId = unregisterSourceFile(fName);
    if (currFileId < -1) {
        err.jspError("jsp.error.file.not.registered", fName);
    }

    // Pop the previous stream from the stack
    Mark previous = current.popStream();
    if (previous != null) {
        master = current.baseDir;
        current = previous;
        return true;
    }

    // Return false if the current file is undefined
    return false;
}

7999	The `getBufSize` method calculates the total buffer size required for a compression algorithm. 8000	```java
/**
 * Calculates the total memory usage for a given dictionary size and other parameters.
 * 
 * @param dictSize The size of the dictionary.
 * @param extraSizeBefore Extra size before the dictionary.
 * @param extraSizeAfter Extra size after the dictionary.
 * @param matchLenMax Maximum match length.
 * @param mf The memory format (MF_HC4 or MF_BT4).
 * @return The total memory usage in kilobytes.
 * @throws IllegalArgumentException if an invalid memory format is provided.
 */
public static int getMemoryUsage(int dictSize, int extraSizeBefore, int extraSizeAfter, int matchLenMax, int mf) {
    // Calculate buffer size and add a little extra
    int m = getBufSize(dictSize, extraSizeBefore, extraSizeAfter, matchLenMax) / 1024 + 10;
    
    // Add memory usage based on the memory format
    switch (mf) {
        case MF_HC4:
            m += HC4.getMemoryUsage(dictSize);
            break;
        case MF_BT4:
            m += BT4.getMemoryUsage(dictSize);
            break;
        default:
            throw new IllegalArgumentException();
    }
    
    return m;
}
```

/**
 * Checks if a system JAR is located in the WEB-INF directory.
 *
 * @param path The path to check.
 * @return true if the system JAR is in WEB-INF, false otherwise.
 */
private boolean systemJarInWebinf(String path) {
    if (path.indexOf("/WEB-INF/") < 0) {
        return false;
    }
    Boolean useMyFaces = (Boolean) ctxt.getServletContext().getAttribute("com.sun.faces.useMyFaces");
    if (useMyFaces == null || !useMyFaces) {
        for (String jar : systemJsfJars) {
            if (path.indexOf(jar) > 0) {
                return true;
            }
        }
    }
    for (String jar : systemJars) {
        if (path.indexOf(jar) > 0) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

static String quote(char c) {
    StringBuilder b = new StringBuilder();
    b.append(' ');
    if (c == ' ') {
        b.append(' ').append(' ');
    } else {
        b.append(c);
    }
    b.append(' ');
    return b.toString();
}

/**
 * Generates declarations for a JSP page.

private void generateDeclarations(Node.Nodes page) throws JasperException {
    class DeclarationVisitor extends Node.Visitor {
        private boolean getServletInfoGenerated = false;

        /**
         * Generates the getServletInfo() method if the 'info' attribute is present in the page directive.
         *
         * @param n The node representing the page directive.
         * @throws JasperException If an error occurs during the generation process.
         */
        public void visit(Node.PageDirective n) throws JasperException {
            if (getServletInfoGenerated) {
                return;
            }
            String info = n.getAttributeValue("info");
            if (info == null) {
                return;
            }
            getServletInfoGenerated = true;
            out.printil("public String getServletInfo() {");
            out.pushIndent();
            out.printin("return ");
            out.print(quote(info));
            out.println(";");
            out.popIndent();
            out.printil("}");
            out.println();
        }

        /**
         * Prints the text of a declaration node.
         *
         * @param n The node representing the declaration.
         * @throws JasperException If an error occurs during the generation process.
         */
        public void visit(Node.Declaration n) throws JasperException {
            n.setBeginJavaLine(out.getJavaLine());
            out.printMultiLn(n.getText());
            out.println();
            n.setEndJavaLine(out.getJavaLine());
        }

        /**
         * Visits a custom tag node, including its body and custom tag plugins.
         *
         * @param n The node representing the custom tag.
         * @throws JasperException If an error occurs during the generation process.
         */
        public void visit(Node.CustomTag n) throws JasperException {
            if (n.useTagPlugin()) {
                if (n.getAtSTag() != null) {
                    n.getAtSTag().visit(this);
                }
                visitBody(n);
                if (n.getAtETag() != null) {
                    n.getAtETag().visit(this);
                }
            } else {
                visitBody(n);
            }
        }
    }

    out.println();
    page.visit(new DeclarationVisitor());
}

private void exportChannel(final By by, final OutputStream stream) throws IOException {

    channelService.accessRun(by, ReadableChannel.class, channel -> {
        putDataEntry(zos, "names", makeNames(channel.getId()));
        putDataEntry(zos, "description", channel.getId().getDescription());

    });

    channelService.accessRun(by, TriggeredChannel.class, channel -> {
        putTriggers(zos, channel);
    });

    zos.finish();
    // Do not close the stream, as there might be other channels following.
}

/**
 * Selects the most specific JspPropertyGroup based on the path and extension.
 * 
 * @param prev The previous JspPropertyGroup.
 * @param curr The current JspPropertyGroup.
 * @return The most specific JspPropertyGroup.
 */
private JspPropertyGroup selectProperty(JspPropertyGroup prev, JspPropertyGroup curr) {
    if (prev == null) {
        return curr;
    }
    if (prev.getExtension() == null) {
        return prev;
    }
    if (curr.getExtension() == null) {
        return curr;
    }
    String prevPath = prev.getPath();
    String currPath = curr.getPath();
    if (prevPath == null && currPath == null) {
        return prev;
    }
    if (prevPath == null && currPath != null) {
        return curr;
    }
    if (prevPath != null && currPath == null) {
        return prev;
    }
    if (prevPath.length() >= currPath.length()) {
        return prev;
    }
    return curr;
}
```

public static String escapeXml(String s) {
    if (s == null) return null;
    StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
    for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
        char c = s.charAt(i);
        if (c == '<') sb.append("&lt;");
        else if (c == '>') sb.append("&gt;");
        else if (c == '\'') sb.append("&apos;");
        else if (c == '&') sb.append("&amp;");
        else if (c == '"') sb.append("&quot;");
        else sb.append(c);
    }
    return sb.toString();
}

/**
 * Converts a given string into a valid Java identifier.
 * 
 * @param identifier The string to be converted.
 * @return A valid Java identifier.
 */
public static final String makeJavaIdentifier(String identifier) {
    StringBuilder modifiedIdentifier = new StringBuilder(identifier.length());
    
    // Check if the first character is a valid Java identifier start
    if (!Character.isJavaIdentifierStart(identifier.charAt(0))) {
        modifiedIdentifier.append(' ');
    }
    
    // Iterate through each character in the identifier
    for (int i = 0; i < identifier.length(); i++) {
        char ch = identifier.charAt(i);
        
        // Check if the character is a valid Java identifier part and not a space
        if (Character.isJavaIdentifierPart(ch) && ch != ' ') {
            modifiedIdentifier.append(ch);
        } 
        // If the character is a space, append a space
        else if (ch == ' ') {
            modifiedIdentifier.append(' ');
        } 
        // Otherwise, mangle the character
        else {
            modifiedIdentifier.append(mangleChar(ch));
        }
    }
    
    // Check if the modified identifier is a Java keyword and append a space if it is
    if (isJavaKeyword(modifiedIdentifier.toString())) {
        modifiedIdentifier.append(' ');
    }
    
    return modifiedIdentifier.toString();
}
```

The resulting hexadecimal digits are then concatenated into a string and returned.
8051	The `isJavaKeyword` method checks if a given string is a Java keyword. It uses a binary search algorithm to efficiently determine if the string exists in an array of Java keywords. The method iterates through the array, comparing the input string with the middle element. If the input string matches the middle element, the method returns `true`. If the input string is less than the middle element, the search continues in the left half of the array. If the input string is greater than the middle element, the search continues in the right half of the array. If the input string is not found in the array, the method returns `false`.
