/**
 * Unmarshals a JSON string into an instance of the specified class.
 *
 * @param src   the JSON string to be unmarshalled
 * @param clazz the class of the object to be unmarshalled into
 * @param <T>   the type of the object to be unmarshalled
 * @return the unmarshalled object
 */
@SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
public static <T> T unmarshal(String src, Class<T> clazz) {
    T result = null;
    try {
        Unmarshaller avm = JAXBContext.newInstance(clazz).createUnmarshaller();
        result = (T) avm.unmarshal(new StringReader(src));
    } catch (JAXBException e) {
        Throwables.propagate(e);
    }
    return result;
}

    if (rawType.equals(WebContext.class)) {
        return context;
    } else if (rawType.equals(HttpServletRequest.class)) {
        return context.request();
    } else if (rawType.equals(HttpServletResponse.class)) {
        return context.response();
    } else if (rawType.equals(HttpSession.class)) {
        return context.session();
    } else if (rawType.equals(ServletContext.class)) {

/**
 * Returns the default value for a given primitive type.
 * 
 * @param type The type of the primitive.
 * @return The default value for the given primitive type.
 */
protected Object primitive(Type type) {
    Class<?> rawType = Types.getRawType(type);
    if (rawType.equals(Boolean.TYPE)) {
        return false;
    } else if (rawType.equals(Character.TYPE)) {
        return '\0';
    } else if (rawType.equals(Byte.TYPE)) {
        return (byte) 0;
    } else if (rawType.equals(Double.TYPE)) {
        return 0.0;
    } else if (rawType.equals(Float.TYPE)) {
        return 0.0f;
    } else if (rawType.equals(Integer.TYPE)) {
        return 0;
    } else {
        // short
        return (short) 0;
    }
}

/**
 * Converts a user-defined value type to the specified type.
 * 
 * @param object The object to be converted.
 * @param type The target type for conversion.
 * @return The converted object or null if conversion is not possible.
 */
protected Object convertUserDefinedValueType(Object object, Class<?> type) {
    if (type.isAssignableFrom(object.getClass())) {
        return object;
    } else if (object instanceof String) {
        try {
            Constructor<?> constructor = type.getConstructor(String.class);
            return constructor.newInstance(object);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            logger.debug("Cannot invoke [public " + type.getName() + "(String.class)] constructor on [" + type + "]", e);
        }
        try {
            return type.getMethod("valueOf", String.class).invoke(null, object);
        } catch (Exception e1) {
            logger.debug("Cannot invoke [public static " + type.getName() + ".valueOf(String.class)] method on [" + type + "]", e1);
        }
    } else {
        logger.warn("Parameter [" + object + "] cannot be converted to [" + type + "]");
    }
    return null;
}

                    }

            }
        }
    );

                Object attribute = session.getAttribute(name);
                if (attribute instanceof Collection<?>) {

                        map.put(key, session.getAttribute(key));
                    }
                }
                return (map.isEmpty()) ? null : map.values();
            }
        }
    );

public static ClassLoader getDefault() {
    ClassLoader loader = null;
    try {
        loader = Thread.currentThread().getContextClassLoader();
    } catch (Exception e) {
        // Ignore the exception
    }
    if (loader == null) {
        loader = ClassLoaderUtils.class.getClassLoader();
        if (loader == null) {
            loader = ClassLoader.getSystemClassLoader();
        }
    }
    return loader;
}
```

If that fails (due to an exception), it falls back to the class loader of the `ClassLoaderUtils` class. If that also fails, it defaults to the system class loader. The method returns the first non-null class loader found.
10096	```java
/**
 * Retrieves a resource URL using the specified class loader or the current thread's context class loader.
 * 
 * @param name The name of the resource to retrieve.
 * @param classLoader The class loader to use for resource lookup.
 * @return The URL of the resource, or null if the resource is not found.
 */
public static URL getResource(String name, ClassLoader classLoader) {
    Validate.notNull(name, "resourceName must be not null");
    if (name.startsWith("/")) {
        name = name.substring(1);
    }
    if (classLoader != null) {
        URL url = classLoader.getResource(name);
        if (url != null) {
            return url;
        }
    }
    ClassLoader loader = Thread.currentThread().getContextClassLoader();
    if (loader != null && loader != classLoader) {
        URL url = loader.getResource(name);
        if (url != null) {
            return url;
        }
    }
    return ClassLoader.getSystemResource(name);
}
```

 * @throws MalformedURIException If the port number is out of the valid range (0-65535) or if the host is null and the port is not -1.
 */
private void setPort(int p_port) throws MalformedURIException {
    if (p_port >= 0 && p_port <= 65535) {
        if (m_host == null) {
            throw new MalformedURIException("Port cannot be set when host is null!");
        }
    } else if (p_port != -1) {
        throw new MalformedURIException("Invalid port number!");
    }
    n_port = p_port;
}
```
10106	```java
/**
 * Appends a path to the existing path, ensuring the result is a valid URI.
 * 
 * @param p_addToPath The path to append.
 * @throws MalformedURIException If the path contains invalid characters.
 */
private void appendPath(String p_addToPath) throws MalformedURIException {
    if (p_addToPath == null || p_addToPath.length() == 0) {
        return;
    }
    if (!isURIString(p_addToPath)) {
        throw new MalformedURIException("Path contains invalid character!");
    }
    if (m_path == null || m_path.length() == 0) {
        m_path = p_addToPath.startsWith("/") ? p_addToPath : "/" + p_addToPath;
    } else if (m_path.endsWith("/")) {
        m_path = p_addToPath.startsWith("/") ? m_path.concat(p_addToPath.substring(1)) : m_path.concat(p_addToPath);
    } else {
        m_path = p_addToPath.startsWith("/") ? m_path.concat(p_addToPath) : m_path.concat("/" + p_addToPath);
    }
}
```

/**
 * Parses a JSON response into a specified Java object.
 *
 * @param response The JSON response string.
 * @param responseClass The class type of the object to parse into.
 * @param <T> The type of the object to parse into.
 * @return The parsed object, or null if an error occurs.
 */
private <T> T parseQuery(final String response, final Class<T> responseClass) {
    T queryResponse;
    try {
        queryResponse = MAPPER.readValue(response, responseClass);
    } catch (JsonParseException | JsonMappingException e) {
        try {
            final ErrorResponse error = MAPPER.readValue(response, ErrorResponse.class);
            LOGGER.error("Query returned an error: {}", error);
            return null;
        } catch (IOException e1) {
            LOGGER.error("Failed to read error response.", e1);
        }
        LOGGER.error("Error reading response.", e);
        return null;
    } catch (IOException e) {
        LOGGER.error("Error reading response.", e);
        return null;
    }
    return queryResponse;
}

2. It iterates over each `ClassDeclaration` in the package using a for-each loop. For each class declaration, it calls the `accept` method on the current object (which is the `visitPackageDeclaration` method itself), passing the `ClassDeclaration` object as an argument. This allows the `visitPackageDeclaration` method to process each class declaration.

3. It iterates over each `InterfaceDeclaration` in the package using a for-each loop. For each interface declaration, it calls the `accept` method on the current object (which is the `visitPackageDeclaration` method itself), passing the `InterfaceDeclaration` object as an argument. This allows the `visitPackageDeclaration` method to process each interface declaration.

4. Finally, it calls the `accept` method on the `post` visitor object, passing the `PackageDeclaration` object as an argument. This allows the `post` visitor to perform any necessary actions after processing the package declaration.

/**
 * Returns a map of type <String, V>. If the map is not already initialized,
 * it synchronizes on the current object to ensure thread safety and initializes
 * the map using the `initialize()` method.
 *
 * @return the map of type <String, V>
 */
protected Map<String, V> getAsMap() {
    Map<String, V> result = map;
    if (result == null) {
        synchronized (this) {
            result = map;
            if (result == null) {
                map = (result = initialize());
            }
        }
    }
    return result;
}

/**
 * Determines if a file should be accepted based on its extension.
 * 
 * @param pathname The file to check.
 * @return true if the file should be accepted, false otherwise.
 */
public boolean accept(File pathname) {
    String name = pathname.getName();
    int iLastDot = name.lastIndexOf('.');
    String strExtension = "";
    if ((iLastDot != -1) && (iLastDot != name.length() - 1)) {
        strExtension = name.substring(iLastDot + 1);
    }
    if (m_rgstrIncludeExtensions != null) {
        for (int i = 0; i < m_rgstrIncludeExtensions.length; i++) {
            if (m_rgstrIncludeExtensions[i].equalsIgnoreCase(strExtension)) {
                return true; // Accept
            }
        }
        return false; // Not in included - return
    }
    if (m_rgstrExcludeExtensions != null) {
        for (int i = 0; i < m_rgstrExcludeExtensions.length; i++) {
            if (m_rgstrExcludeExtensions[i].equalsIgnoreCase(strExtension)) {
                return false; // Don't accept
            }
        }
    }
    return true; // Accept this file
}
```

10153	```java
/**
 * Retrieves a declared field from a class, optionally searching recursively through superclasses.
 *
 * @param clazz      the class to search
 * @param fieldName  the name of the field to retrieve
 * @param recursively whether to search recursively through superclasses
 * @return the field if found, or null if not found
 */
public static Field getDeclaredField(Class<?> clazz, String fieldName, boolean recursively) {
    try {
        return clazz.getDeclaredField(fieldName);
    } catch (NoSuchFieldException e) {
        Class<?> superClass = clazz.getSuperclass();
        if (superClass != null && recursively) {
            return getDeclaredField(superClass, fieldName, true);
        }
    } catch (SecurityException e) {
        log.error("{}", e.getMessage(), e);
    }
    return null;
}
```

10163	```java
/**
 * Initializes the message queue based on the provided common properties.
 * If the message queue is disabled, logs an info message.
 * If the message queue class is not configured, logs an error and throws an IllegalStateException.
 * If the message queue class is configured, requests a singleton or non-singleton instance from the message factory.
 * If the message class cannot be instantiated, logs an error and throws an IllegalStateException.
 *
 * @param commonProps the common properties containing the message queue configuration
 */
private void initMessageQueue(final CommonProperties commonProps) {
    try {
        final String messageClassName = commonProps.getMessageQueueClassName();
        if (!commonProps.isMessageQueueEnabled()) {
            LOG.info("Message queue has been disabled in the JAAS configuration");
        } else if (messageClassName == null) {
            final String error = "Message queue has been enabled in the JAAS configuration, but no message queue class has been configured";
            LOG.error(error);
            throw new IllegalStateException(error);
        } else {
            if (commonProps.isMessageQueueSingleton()) {
                LOG.debug("Requesting singleton message class instance of '" + messageClassName + "' from the message factory");
                this.messageQ = MessageQFactory.getSingleton(messageClassName, commonProps);
            } else {
                LOG.debug("Requesting non-singleton message class instance of '" + messageClassName + "' from the message factory");
                this.messageQ = MessageQFactory.getInstance(messageClassName, commonProps);
            }
        }
    } catch (FactoryException e) {
        final String error = "The message class cannot be instantiated. This is most likely a configuration problem. Is the configured class available in the classpath?";
        LOG.error(error, e);
        throw new IllegalStateException(error, e);
    }
}
```

public void service(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response) throws IOException {
    log.fine("void service(HttpServletRequest, HttpServletResponse): called");
    
    // Retrieve parameters and attributes from the request
    String contentType = (String) request.getAttribute("contentType");
    String contentDisposition = (String) request.getAttribute("contentDisposition");
    InputStream inputStream = (InputStream) request.getAttribute("inputStream");
    
    // Build the response header
    if (contentType != null) {
        response.setContentType(contentType);
    }
    if (contentDisposition != null) {
        response.addHeader("Content-disposition", contentDisposition);
    }
    
    // Create a stream to write the data out to
    BufferedOutputStream outputStream = new BufferedOutputStream(response.getOutputStream());
    
    // Read the entire input stream and write the results into the response in chunks of 8k
    int length;
    byte[] chunk = new byte[8192];
    while ((length = inputStream.read(chunk)) != -1) {
        outputStream.write(chunk, 0, length);
    }
    
    // Clear up any open streams and ensure they are flushed
    outputStream.flush();
    inputStream.close();
}

/**
 * Removes the value associated with the specified key from the map.
 * 
 * @param key the key whose value is to be removed
 * @return the value that was removed, or null if the key was not found
 */
public V remove(Object key) {
    // Check if the key is in the map
    Integer index = keyToIndex.get(key);
    if (index == null) {
        return null;
    }

    // Remove the key from the keyToIndex map and keySet
    keyToIndex.remove(key);
    keySet.remove(key);

    // Remove the value from the data array
    V removedValue = data.remove(index.intValue());

    // Adjust the indices in the keyToIndex map for any keys with indices greater than the removed index
    for (K nextKey : keyToIndex.keySet()) {
        Integer nextIndex = keyToIndex.get(nextKey);
        if (nextIndex > index) {
            keyToIndex.put(nextKey, nextIndex - 1);
        }
    }

    // Return the removed value
    return removedValue;
}
```

10217	```java
/**
 * Sets the value of a property on an object using the appropriate setter method.
 * 
 * @param callee The object on which the property will be set.
 * @param property The name of the property to set.
 * @param value The value to set for the property.
 * @throws IllegalArgumentException If no setter method exists for the property or if the value type is not compatible with any setter method.
 * @throws IllegalStateException If the setter method cannot be accessed.
 */
protected void setProperty(Object callee, String property, Object value) {
    // Initialize the meta bean if it has not already been initialized.
    if (!initialized) {
        initialize(callee);
    }

    // Get the setter methods for the property.
    Method[] setterMethods = setters.get(property);
    if ((setterMethods == null) || (setterMethods.length == 0)) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("No setter method for the property " + property + " exists.");
    }

    // Choose the appropriate setter method based on the value type.
    Method setterMethod = null;
    Class<?> valueType = (value == null) ? null : value.getClass();

    if (value == null) {
        setterMethod = setterMethods[0];
    } else {
        for (Method method : setterMethods) {
            Class<?> argType = method.getParameterTypes()[0];
            if (argType.isAssignableFrom(valueType)) {
                setterMethod = method;
                break;
            } else if (argType.isPrimitive() && !valueType.isPrimitive() && isAssignableFromPrimitive(valueType, argType)) {
                setterMethod = method;
                break;
            } else if (valueType.isPrimitive() && !argType.isPrimitive() && isAssignableFromPrimitive(argType, valueType)) {
                setterMethod = method;
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    if (setterMethod == null) {
        Class<?> calleeType = (callee == null) ? null : callee.getClass();
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("No setter method for property " + property + ", of type, " + calleeType + " will accept the type of value specified, " + valueType + ".");
    }

    // Call the setter method with the value.
    try {
        Object[] args = new Object[]{value};
        setterMethod.invoke(callee, args);
    } catch (InvocationTargetException e) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("The setter method for the property " + property + " threw an invocation target exception.", e);
    } catch (IllegalAccessException e)

10224	```java
/**
 * Attempts to unify two terms.
 * 
 * @param left The left term to unify.
 * @param right The right term to unify.
 * @param leftTrail The trail for the left term.
 * @param rightTrail The trail for the right term.
 * @return true if the terms can be unified, false otherwise.
 */
public boolean unifyInternal(Term left, Term right, List<Variable> leftTrail, List<Variable> rightTrail) {
    if (left == right) {
        return true;
    }
    if (!left.isVar() && !right.isVar() && left.isConstant() && right.isConstant() && left.equals(right)) {
        return true;
    } else if (left.isVar()) {
        return unifyVar((Variable) left, right, leftTrail, rightTrail);
    } else if (right.isVar()) {
        return unifyVar((Variable) right, left, rightTrail, leftTrail);
    } else if (left.isFunctor() && right.isFunctor()) {
        Functor leftFunctor = (Functor) left;
        Functor rightFunctor = (Functor) right;
        if (!left.equals(right)) {
            return false;
        }
        int arity = leftFunctor.getArity();
        for (int i = 0; i < arity; i++) {
            Term leftArgument = leftFunctor.getArgument(i);
            Term rightArgument = rightFunctor.getArgument(i);
            if (!unifyInternal(leftArgument, rightArgument, leftTrail, rightTrail)) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    } else {
        return false;
    }
}
```
10225	```java
/**
 * Attempts to unify a variable with a term.
 * 
 * @param leftVar The variable to unify.
 * @param rightTerm The term to unify with.
 * @param leftTrail The trail for the left variable.
 * @param rightTrail The trail for the right variable.
 * @return true if the unification is successful, false otherwise.
 */
protected boolean unifyVar(Variable leftVar, Term rightTerm, List<Variable> leftTrail, List<Variable> rightTrail) {
    if (leftVar.isBound()) {
        return unifyInternal(leftVar.getValue(), rightTerm, leftTrail, rightTrail);
    } else if (rightTerm.isVar() && ((Variable) rightTerm).isBound()) {
        return unifyInternal(leftVar, rightTerm.getValue(), leftTrail, rightTrail);
    } else {
        leftVar.setSubstitution(rightTerm);
        leftTrail.add(leftVar.getStorageCell(leftVar));
        return true;
    }
}

/**
 * Compiles a query into a WAM (Warren Abstract Machine) compiled query.
 * 
 * @param clause The clause to compile.
 * @throws SourceCodeException If there is an error in the source code.
 */
private void compileQuery(Clause clause) throws SourceCodeException {
    // Initialize variables and data structures
    WAMCompiledQuery result = new WAMCompiledQuery();
    Map<Byte, Integer> varNames = new TreeMap<>();
    TreeSet<Integer> seenRegisters = new TreeSet<>();
    int lastAllocatedTempReg = findMaxArgumentsInClause(clause);
    int numPermanentVars = 0;
    int cutLevelVarSlot = -1;
    SizeableList<WAMInstruction> preFixInstructions = new SizeableLinkedList<>();
    SizeableList<WAMInstruction> postFixInstructions = new SizeableLinkedList<>();

    // Find free non-anonymous variables in the clause
    Set<Variable> freeVars = TermUtils.findFreeNonAnonymousVariables(clause);
    Set<Integer> freeVarNames = new TreeSet<>();
    for (Variable var : freeVars) {
        freeVarNames.add(var.getName());
    }

    // Allocate permanent variables for the query
    allocatePermanentQueryRegisters(clause, varNames);

    // Gather information about variable and constant occurrences
    gatherPositionAndOccurrenceInfo(clause);

    // Generate prefix code for the clause
    preFixInstructions.add(new WAMInstruction(WAMInstruction.WAMInstructionSet.AllocateN, REG_ADDR, (byte) (numPermanentVars & 0xff)));
    if (cutLevelVarSlot >= 0) {
        preFixInstructions.add(new WAMInstruction(WAMInstruction.WAMInstructionSet.GetLevel, STACK_ADDR, (byte) cutLevelVarSlot));
    }
    result.addInstructions(preFixInstructions);

    // Compile the body of the clause
    Functor[] expressions = clause.getBody();
    FunctorName fn = new FunctorName("tq", 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < expressions.length; i++) {
        Functor expression = expressions[i];
        boolean isFirstBody = i == 0;
        BuiltIn builtIn = expression instanceof BuiltIn ? (BuiltIn) expression : this;
        SizeableLinkedList<WAMInstruction> instructions = builtIn.compileBodyArguments(expression, false, fn, i);
        result.addInstructions(expression, instructions);
        instructions = builtIn.compileBodyCall(expression, isFirstBody, false, false, numPermanentVars);

10232	```java
public static ByteBuffer putPaddedInt32AsString(ByteBuffer buffer, int value, int length) {
    // Ensure there is sufficient space in the buffer to hold the result.
    int charsRequired = BitHackUtils.getCharacterCountInt32(value);
    length = (charsRequired < length) ? length : charsRequired;

    // Take an explicit index into the buffer to start writing to, as the numbers will be written backwards.
    int index = buffer.position() + length - 1;

    // Record the start position, to remember if a minus sign was written or not, so that it does not get
    // overwritten by the zero padding.
    int start = buffer.position();

    // Advance the buffer position manually, as the characters will be written to specific indexes backwards.
    buffer.position(buffer.position() + length);

    // Take care of the minus sign for negative numbers.
    if (value < 0) {
        buffer.put(MINUS_ASCII);
        start++; // Stop padding code overwriting minus sign.
    } else {
        value = -value;
    }

    // Write the digits least significant to most significant into the buffer. As the number was converted to be
    // negative the remainders will be negative too.
    do {
        int remainder = value % 10;
        value = value / 10;
        buffer.put(index--, (byte) (ZERO_ASCII - remainder));
    } while (value != 0);

    // Write out the padding zeros.
    while (index >= start) {
        buffer.put(index--, ZERO_ASCII);
    }

    return buffer;
}
```

### Summary:
This method `putPaddedInt32AsString` takes a `ByteBuffer`, an integer `value`, and an integer `length` as parameters. It ensures there is enough space in the buffer to hold the result. The method calculates the number of characters required to represent the integer and adjusts the length if necessary. It then writes the integer as a string in reverse order, padding with zeros if necessary. If the integer is negative, it handles the minus sign appropriately. The method returns the modified `ByteBuffer`.

10236	```java
/**
 * Reads a term and processes it based on its type.
 * 
 * @param term The term to be read.
 */
private void read(Term term) {
    if (term.isNumber()) {
        NumericType numericType = (NumericType) term;
        if (numericType.isInteger()) {
            IntLiteral jplInteger = (IntLiteral) term;
            getContentHandler().startIntegerTerm(jplInteger.longValue());
        } else if (numericType.isFloat()) {
            FloatLiteral jplFloat = (FloatLiteral) term;
            getContentHandler().startFloatTerm(jplFloat.doubleValue());
        }
    } else if (term.isVar()) {
        Variable var = (Variable) term;
        getContentHandler().startVariable(interner.getVariableName(var.getName()));
    } else if (term.isAtom()) {
        Functor atom = (Functor) term;
        getContentHandler().startAtom(interner.getFunctorName(atom.getName()));
    } else if (term.isCompound()) {
        Functor functor = (Functor) term;
        getContentHandler().startCompound();
        getContentHandler().startAtom(interner.getFunctorName(functor.getName()));
        for (com.thesett.aima.logic.fol.Term child : functor.getArguments()) {
            read(child);
        }
        getContentHandler().endCompound();
    } else {
        throw new IllegalStateException("Unrecognized Lojix term: " + term);
    }
}

10281	The `search` method iteratively increases a bound until a search succeeds. It uses a depth-bounded search approach, where the bound is initially set to a starting value and then increased by a small increment (`epsilon`) or to the next smallest bound property value beyond the fringe. If the depth-bounded search fails but knows that there are more successor states at deeper levels, it catches the `MaxBoundException` and updates the bound for the next iteration. The method returns the first goal node found or `null` if the search space is exhausted.
10282	```java
public SearchNode search(QueueSearchState<O, T> initSearch, Collection<T> startStates, int maxSteps, int searchSteps) throws SearchNotExhaustiveException {
    // Initialize the queue with start states and get the goal predicate.
    Queue<SearchNode<O, T>> queue = initSearch.enqueueStartStates(startStates);
    UnaryPredicate<T> goalPredicate = initSearch.getGoalPredicate();

    // Continue searching until the queue is empty or a goal state is found.
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        // Extract the head node from the queue.
        SearchNode<O, T> headNode = peekAtHead ? queue.peek() : queue.remove();

        // Expand successors if the node has not been expanded yet.
        if (!headNode.isExpanded()) {
            headNode.expandSuccessors(queue, reverseEnqueue);
        }

        // Get the node to be goal checked.
        SearchNode<O, T> currentNode = peekAtHead ? queue.peek() : headNode;

        // Goal check if the node is expanded.
        if (currentNode.isExpanded()) {
            currentNode = peekAtHead ? queue.remove() : headNode;
            if (goalPredicate.evaluate(currentNode.getState())) {
                return currentNode;
            }
        }

        // Check if the maximum number of steps limit is reached.
        if (maxSteps > 0) {
            searchSteps++;
            initSearch.setStepsTaken(searchSteps);
            if (searchSteps >= maxSteps) {
                if (queue.isEmpty()) {
                    return null;
                } else {
                    throw new SearchNotExhaustiveException("Maximum number of steps reached.", null);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // No goal state found.
    return null;
}
```

            term = stringLiteral();
            break;

            term = atom();
            break;

            consumeToken(RPAREN);

        case INTEGER_LITERAL:

        case STRING_LITERAL:

        case FUNCTOR:

            null, null, null,
            new SourceCodePositionImpl(nextToken.beginLine, nextToken.beginColumn, nextToken.endLine, nextToken.endColumn)
        );
    } else {
        nextToken = tokenSource.poll();
        return nextToken;
    }
}

public static int ticksToYears(long ticks) {
    // Calculate the number of years based on the given ticks
    long unitMillis = MILLIS_PER_YEAR / 2;
    long i2 = (ticks >> 1) + ((1970L * MILLIS_PER_YEAR) / 2);
    if (i2 < 0) {
        i2 = i2 - unitMillis + 1;
    }
    int year = (int) (i2 / unitMillis);
    long yearStart = millisToYearStart(year);
    long diff = ticks - yearStart;
    if (diff < 0) {
        year--;
    } else if (diff >= (MILLIS_PER_DAY * 365L)) {
        long oneYear = isLeapYear(year) ? MILLIS_PER_DAY * 366L : MILLIS_PER_DAY * 365L;
        yearStart += oneYear;
        if (yearStart <= ticks) {
            year++;
        }
    }
    return year;
}

/**
 * Calculates the number of milliseconds from the start of the given year to the Unix epoch (January 1, 1970).
 * 
 * @param year The year for which to calculate the milliseconds.
 * @return The number of milliseconds from the start of the given year to the Unix epoch.
 */
public static long millisToYearStart(int year) {
    // Calculate the number of leap years elapsed prior to the year in question.
    int leapYears = year / 100;
    if (year < 0) {
        leapYears = ((year + 3) >> 2) - leapYears + ((leapYears + 3) >> 2) - 1;
    } else {
        leapYears = (year >> 2) - leapYears + (leapYears >> 2);
        if (isLeapYear(year)) {
            leapYears--;
        }
    }
    // Calculate the number of milliseconds from the start of the given year to the Unix epoch.
    return ((year * 365L) + leapYears - DAYS_TO_1970) * MILLIS_PER_DAY;
}

3. **Rehashing Loop**:
   - The method enters a loop that continues until the rehashing is successful.
   - Inside the loop, it assumes the rehashing will succeed (`rehashedOk = true`).
   - It changes the hash functions using `changeHashFunctions()`.
   - A new hash table of the new size is created.
   - Each entry from the old table is rehashed into the new table. If any entry fails to be rehashed, `rehashedOk` is set to `false`, and the loop breaks.

4. **Completion**:
   - Once the rehashing is successful, the old table is no longer needed, and the method exits the loop.

This method ensures that the hash table remains efficient by preventing it from becoming too full, which can degrade performance.

public ActionForward perform(ActionMapping mapping, ActionForm form, HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response) throws IOException, ServletException {
    log.fine("perform: called");
    SortForm sortForm = (SortForm) form;
    HttpSession session = request.getSession();
    ServletContext application = session.getServletContext();
    log.fine("variables in the servlet context: ");
    for (Enumeration e = application.getAttributeNames(); e.hasMoreElements(); ) {
        log.fine(e.nextElement().toString());
    }
    List list = (List) session.getAttribute(sortForm.getList());
    Comparator comparator = (Comparator) application.getAttribute(sortForm.getComparator());
    log.fine("comparator = " + comparator);
    SortStateBean sortStateBean = (SortStateBean) session.getAttribute(sortForm.getSortState());
    if (sortStateBean == null) {
        log.fine("There is no sort state bean");
        sortStateBean = new SortStateBean();
    }
    if (!sortStateBean.getState().equals(SortStateBean.FORWARD) || !sortStateBean.getSortProperty().equals(sortForm.getSortStateProperty())) {
        Collections.sort(list, comparator);
        sortStateBean.setState(SortStateBean.FORWARD);
    } else {
        Collections.sort(list, comparator);
        Collections.reverse(list);
        sortStateBean.setState(SortStateBean.REVERSE);
    }
    session.setAttribute(sortForm.getList(), list);
    sortStateBean.setSortProperty(sortForm.getSortStateProperty());
    session.setAttribute(sortForm.getSortState(), sortStateBean);
    return mapping.findForward("success");
}

10339	```java
public SearchNode search(QueueSearchState<O, T> initSearch, Collection<T> startStates, int maxSteps, int searchSteps) throws SearchNotExhaustiveException {
    // Initialize the queue with start states and get the goal predicate.
    Queue<SearchNode<O, T>> queue = initSearch.enqueueStartStates(startStates);
    UnaryPredicate<T> goalPredicate = initSearch.getGoalPredicate();
    
    // Flags and variables for tracking beyond-fringe states and their bounds.
    boolean beyondFringe = false;
    float minBeyondBound = Float.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
    
    // Continue searching until the queue is empty or a goal state is found.
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        // Extract the head node from the queue.
        SearchNode<O, T> headNode = peekAtHead ? queue.peek() : queue.remove();
        
        // Expand successors and add them to the queue if they are within the max bound.
        Queue<SearchNode<O, T>> successors = new LinkedList<>();
        headNode.expandSuccessors(successors, reverseEnqueue);
        for (SearchNode<O, T> successor : successors) {
            float boundProperty = boundPropertyExtractor.getBoundProperty(successor);
            if (boundProperty <= maxBound) {
                queue.offer(successor);
            } else {
                beyondFringe = true;
                minBeyondBound = Math.min(boundProperty, minBeyondBound);
            }
        }
        
        // Check if the current node is a goal state.
        SearchNode<O, T> currentNode = peekAtHead ? queue.remove() : headNode;
        if (currentNode.isExpanded() && goalPredicate.evaluate(currentNode.getState())) {
            return currentNode;
        }
        
        // Check if the maximum number of steps limit has been reached.
        if (maxSteps > 0) {
            searchSteps++;
            initSearch.setStepsTaken(searchSteps);
            if (searchSteps >= maxSteps) {
                if (queue.isEmpty()) {
                    return null;
                } else {
                    throw new SearchNotExhaustiveException("Maximum number of steps reached.", null);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    // If no goal state is found, check for beyond-fringe states and throw an exception if any are found.
    if (beyondFringe) {
        throw new MaxBoundException("Max bound reached.", null);
    } else {
        return null;
    }
}
```

/**
 * Converts the list to an array of the specified type.
 *
 * @param <T> the type of the array elements
 * @param a   the array into which the elements of the list are to be stored, if it is big enough;
 *            otherwise, a new array of the same runtime type is allocated for this purpose.
 * @return an array containing the elements of the list
 */
public <T> T[] toArray(T[] a) {
    int size = size();
    if (a.length < size) {
        a = (T[]) java.lang.reflect.Array.newInstance(a.getClass().getComponentType(), size);
    }
    Iterator<E> it = iterator();
    Object[] result = a;
    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        result[i] = it.next();
    }
    if (a.length > size) {
        a[size] = null;
    }
    return a;
}

10369	```java
/**
 * Searches for a goal path using a bidirectional search algorithm.
 * 
 * @return The goal path as a SearchNode if found, otherwise null.
 * @throws SearchNotExhaustiveException If the search is not exhaustive.
 */
public SearchNode<O, T> findGoalPath() throws SearchNotExhaustiveException {
    // Continue searching until either queue is empty
    while (!forwardQueue.isEmpty() || !reverseQueue.isEmpty()) {
        // Process forward search if forward queue is not empty
        if (!forwardQueue.isEmpty()) {
            SearchNode<O, T> currentForwardNode = forwardQueue.remove();
            forwardFringe.remove(currentForwardNode.getState());
            
            // Check if the current node matches any node in the reverse fringe
            if (reverseFringe.containsKey(currentForwardNode.getState())) {
                return joinBothPaths(currentForwardNode, reverseFringe.get(currentForwardNode.getState()));
            } else {
                // Expand successors and add to forward queue and fringe
                Queue<SearchNode<O, T>> newStates = new LinkedList<>();
                currentForwardNode.expandSuccessors(newStates, false);
                forwardQueue.addAll(newStates);
                for (SearchNode<O, T> nextSearchNode : newStates) {
                    forwardFringe.put(nextSearchNode.getState(), nextSearchNode);
                }
            }
        }
        
        // Process reverse search if reverse queue is not empty
        if (!reverseQueue.isEmpty()) {
            SearchNode<O, T> currentReverseNode = reverseQueue.remove();
            reverseFringe.remove(currentReverseNode.getState());
            
            // Check if the current node matches any node in the forward fringe
            if (forwardFringe.containsKey(currentReverseNode.getState())) {
                return joinBothPaths(forwardFringe.get(currentReverseNode.getState()), currentReverseNode);
            } else {
                // Expand successors and add to reverse queue and fringe
                Queue<SearchNode<O, T>> newStates = new LinkedList<>();
                currentReverseNode.expandSuccessors(newStates, false);
                reverseQueue.addAll(newStates);
                for (SearchNode<O, T> nextSearchNode : newStates) {
                    reverseFringe.put(nextSearchNode.getState(), nextSearchNode);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Return null if no goal path is found
    return null;
}
```
10370	The `joinBothPaths` method is designed to combine two search paths, a forward path and a reverse path, into a single path. If an alternative path join algorithm is provided, it delegates to that algorithm. Otherwise, it uses a default algorithm that iterates through the reverse path until it reaches the goal state. For each node in the reverse path, it creates a corresponding node in the forward path and updates the path depth. Finally, it returns the last forward search node found.

10420	```java
/**
 * Emits code into a ByteBuffer for a WAMMachine.
 *
 * @param buffer The ByteBuffer to write the code into.
 * @param machine The WAMMachine that will host the code.
 * @param callPoint The call point of the functor within the machine.
 * @throws LinkageException If the instruction listing size exceeds Integer.MAX_VALUE.
 */
public void emmitCode(ByteBuffer buffer, WAMMachine machine, WAMCallPoint callPoint) throws LinkageException {
    // Ensure the instruction listing size does not exceed max int.
    if (sizeof() > Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
        throw new IllegalStateException("The instruction listing size exceeds Integer.MAX_VALUE.");
    }

    // Track the size of the emitted code in bytes.
    int length = 0;

    // Insert the compiled code into the machine's code area.
    for (WAMInstruction instruction : instructions) {
        instruction.emmitCode(buffer, machine);
        length += instruction.sizeof();
    }

    // Record the machine and call point.
    this.machine = machine;
    this.callPoint = callPoint;

    // Mark the code as linked into a machine.
    this.status = LinkStatus.Linked;
}
```

/**
 * Retrieves the property value for a given key based on the caller's class and method name.
 * 
 * @param key The key for which the property value is to be retrieved.
 * @return The property value.
 */
public String getProperty(String key) {
    // Get the caller's class and method name from the stack trace.
    String className = null;
    String methodName = null;
    StackTraceElement[] stack = Thread.currentThread().getStackTrace();
    
    // Check that the stack trace contains at least two elements.
    if (stack.length >= 2) {
        className = stack[1].getClassName();
        methodName = stack[1].getMethodName();
    }
    
    // Return the property value using the caller's class and method name.
    return getProperty(className, methodName, key);
}

10424	```java
/**
 * Retrieves properties for a given key.
 * 
 * @param key The key for which properties are to be retrieved.
 * @return An array of properties.
 */
public String[] getProperties(String key) {
    // Try to get the caller's class name and method name by throwing an exception and searching the stack frames.
    String className = null;
    String methodName = null;
    // Java 1.4 onwards only.
    try {
        throw new Exception();
    } catch (Exception e) {
        StackTraceElement[] stack = e.getStackTrace();
        // Check that the stack trace contains at least two elements, one for this method and one for the caller.
        if (stack.length >= 2) {
            className = stack[1].getClassName();
            methodName = stack[1].getMethodName();
        }
    }
    // Delegate to the getProperties method with the caller's class name, method name, and key.
    return getProperties(className, methodName, key);
}

protected void leaveFunctor(Functor functor) {

    if (!traverser.isInHead() && pos >= 0) {
        Functor transformed = builtInTransform.apply(functor);
        if (functor != transformed) {
            BuiltInFunctor builtInFunctor = (BuiltInFunctor) transformed;
            Term parentTerm = traverser.getParentContext().getTerm();
            if (parentTerm instanceof Clause) {
                Clause parentClause = (Clause) parentTerm;
                parentClause.getBody()[pos] = builtInFunctor;
            } else if (parentTerm instanceof Functor) {
                Functor parentFunctor = (Functor) parentTerm;
                parentFunctor.getArguments()[pos] = builtInFunctor;
            }
        }
    }
}

    if (address == null) {
        errorHandler.error("No remote host is set for SocketAppender named \"" + this.name + "\".");
        return;
    }
    if (oos != null) {
        try {
            if (locationInfo) event.getLocationInformation();
            oos.writeObject(event);
            oos.flush();
            if (++counter >= RESET_FREQUENCY) {
                counter = 0;
                oos.reset();
            }
        } catch (IOException e) {
            oos = null;

        }
    }
}

10441	```java
public void commit() {
    // Check if in a higher transactional mode than none, otherwise commit does nothing.
    if (!getIsolationLevel().equals(IsolationLevel.None)) {
        // Extract the current transaction id.
        TxId txId = TxManager.getTxIdFromThread();
        
        // Wait until the global write lock can be acquired by this transaction.
        try {
            acquireGlobalWriteLock(txId);
        } catch (InterruptedException e) {
            // The commit was interrupted, so cannot succeed.
            throw new IllegalStateException("Interrupted whilst commit is waiting for global write lock.", e);
        }
        
        // Check that this transaction has made changes to be committed.
        List<TxOperation> alterations = txWrites.get(txId);
        try {
            if (alterations != null) {
                // Loop through all the writes that the transaction wants to apply to the resource.
                for (TxOperation nextAlteration : alterations) {
                    // Apply the change and update the term resource.
                    nextAlteration.execute();
                }
                // Clear the write behind cache for this transaction as its work has been completed.
                txWrites.remove(txId);
            }
        } finally {
            // Release the global write lock.
            releaseGlobalWriteLock();
        }
    }
}
```

**Summary:**
The `commit` method checks if the current transactional mode is higher than `None`. If so, it proceeds to commit the transaction. It acquires a global write lock, checks for any changes made by the transaction, applies these changes, and then clears the write cache. Finally, it releases the global write lock. If the commit is interrupted, it throws an `IllegalStateException`.
10442	```java
public void rollback() {
    // Check if in a higher transactional mode than none, otherwise rollback does nothing.
    if (!getIsolationLevel().equals(IsolationLevel.None)) {
        // Extract the current transaction id.
        TxId txId = TxManager.getTxIdFromThread();
        // Check that this transaction has made changes to be rolled back.
        List<TxOperation> alterations = txWrites.get(txId);
        if (alterations != null) {
            // Loop through all the writes that the transaction wants to apply to the resource.
            for (TxOperation nextAlteration : alterations) {
                // Cancel the operation.
                nextAlteration.cancel(false);
            }
        }
        // Discard all the changes that the transaction was going to make.
        txWrites.remove(txId);
    }
}
```

**Summary:**
The `rollback` method checks if the current transactional mode is higher than `None`. If so, it retrieves the current transaction ID and checks if there are any changes to roll back. If there are, it iterates through each operation, cancels it, and then removes all the transaction's changes from the `txWrites` list.

public void requestWriteOperation(TxOperation op) {
    // Check if in a higher transactional mode than none and capture the transaction id if so.
    TxId txId = null;
    if (getIsolationLevel().compareTo(IsolationLevel.None) > 0) {
        // Extract the current transaction id.
        txId = TxManager.getTxIdFromThread();
        // Ensure that this resource is enlisted with the current session.
        enlistWithSession();
    }
    // For non-transactional isolation levels, apply the requested operation immediately.
    if (getIsolationLevel().equals(IsolationLevel.None)) {
        op.execute();
    }
    // Add the operation to the transaction write-behind cache for the transaction id, if using transactional
    // isolation, to defer the operation until commit time.
    else {
        addCachedOperation(txId, op);
    }
}

/**
 * Adds a cached write operation to the transaction's write cache.
 *
 * @param txId The transaction ID.
 * @param cachedWriteOperation The cached write operation to add.
 */
private void addCachedOperation(TxId txId, TxOperation cachedWriteOperation) {
    List<TxOperation> writeCache = txWrites.get(txId);
    if (writeCache == null) {
        writeCache = new ArrayList<>();
        txWrites.put(txId, writeCache);
    }
    writeCache.add(cachedWriteOperation);
}
```

private void setAdditionVisitor() {
    setAdditionVisitor(new InclusiveNodeVisitor() {
        @Override
        public boolean add(ParametersNode node) {
            for (VariableDefinitionNode variable : NodeTreeUtils.getChildren(node, VariableDefinitionNode.class)) {
                _parameterDefinitions.add(variable);
                add(variable);
            }
            return super.add(node);
        }

        @Override
        public boolean add(RuleSetNode node) {
            SelectorGroupNode selectorGroup = NodeTreeUtils.getFirstChild(node, SelectorGroupNode.class);
            for (SelectorNode selectorNode : NodeTreeUtils.getChildren(selectorGroup, SelectorNode.class)) {
                StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
                for (Node selectorChild : selectorNode.getChildren()) {
                    sb.append(selectorChild.toString());
                }
                String selector = sb.toString();
                if (!_selectorToRuleSetMap.containsKey(selector)) {
                    _selectorToRuleSetMap.put(selector, node);
                }
            }
            return super.add(node);
        }

        @Override
        public boolean add(ScopeNode node) {
            NodeTreeUtils.moveChildren(node, ScopeNode.this);
            return false;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean add(VariableDefinitionNode node) {
            String name = node.getName();
            if (!_variableNameToValueMap.containsKey(name)) {
                _variableNameToValueMap.put(name, NodeTreeUtils.getFirstChild(node, ExpressionGroupNode.class));
            }
            return super.add(node);
        }

        @Override
        public boolean add(PropertyNode node) {
            String name = node.getName();
            if (name.equals(FILTER_PROPERTY)) {
                return super.add(node);
            }
            if (node.getChildren().get(0).toString().startsWith("-")) {
                return super.add(node);
            }
            if (_propertyNameToNodeMap.containsKey(name)) {
                PropertyNode oldPropertyNode = _propertyNameToNodeMap.get(name);
                int oldPropertyIndex = getChildren().indexOf(oldPropertyNode);
                if (oldPropertyNode.isVisible()) {
                    oldPropertyNode.setVisible(false);
                    hideWhiteSpaceNode(oldPropertyIndex - 1);
                    hideWhiteSpaceNode(oldPropertyIndex + 1);
                }
            }
            _propertyNameToNodeMap.put(name, node);
            return super.add(node);
        }
    });
}

protected Term decodeHeap(int start, Map<Integer, Variable> variableContext) {
    // Dereference the initial heap pointer.

    int val = getDerefVal();

            if (var == null) {
                var = new Variable(varNameId.decrementAndGet(), null, false);
                variableContext.put(val, var);
            }
            return var;

            return new Functor(f, arguments);

/**
 * Adds an element to the queue.
 * 
 * @param o the element to add
 * @return true if the element was added successfully, false otherwise
 * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the element is null
 */
public boolean offer(E o) {
    // Ensure the element is not null
    if (o == null) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("The 'o' parameter may not be null.");
    }

    // Derive the integer priority of the element and adjust it to the queue's range
    int level = priorityToLevel(p.apply(o));

    // Create a new node to hold the element
    Node<E> newNode = new DataNode<>(o, markers[level + 1]);

    // Add the element to the tail of the queue
    while (true) {
        // Get the current tail and the next reference
        Node<E> t = markers[level + 1].getTail();
        Node<E> s = t.getNext();

        // Recheck the tail reference to ensure it hasn't changed
        if (t == markers[level + 1].getTail()) {
            // Check if the next element reference is the tail marker
            if (s == markers[level + 1]) {
                // Try to join the new tail onto the old one
                if (t.casNext(s, newNode)) {
                    // Update the queue's tail reference
                    markers[level + 1].casTail(t, newNode);
                    // Increment the queue size count
                    count.incrementAndGet();
                    return true;
                }
            } else {
                // Update the tail reference if another thread has already added a new tail
                markers[level + 1].casTail(t, s);
            }
        }
    }
}

    // Take a copy of the event as a final variable
    final PropertyChangeEvent finalEvent = evt;
    
    // Check if there are any listeners
    if (listeners == null) {
        return; // No listeners, do nothing
    }
    
    // Synchronize on the list of listeners to prevent concurrent modification
    synchronized (listeners) {
        Iterator it = listeners.iterator();
        while (it.hasNext()) {
            // Get the next listener
            final PropertyChangeListener l = (PropertyChangeListener) it.next();
            
            // Create a Runnable to fire the property change event
            Runnable r = new Runnable() {
                public void run() {
                    l.propertyChange(finalEvent);
                }
            };
            
            // Run the Runnable in the Swing event queue
            SwingUtilities.invokeLater(r);
        }
    }
}
```

10511	```java
/**
 * Converts a string to a MultiTypeData object, attempting to determine its type.
 * 
 * @param s The string to convert.
 * @return A MultiTypeData object containing the converted value and its type flags.
 */
public static MultiTypeData getMultiTypeData(String s) {
    MultiTypeData result = new MultiTypeData();
    result.typeFlags = STRING;
    result.stringValue = s;
    result.nativeType = STRING;

    if ("true".equals(s) || "false".equals(s)) {
        result.booleanValue = Boolean.parseBoolean(s);
        result.typeFlags |= BOOLEAN;
    }

    try {
        result.intValue = Integer.parseInt(s);
        result.typeFlags |= INT;
    } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
        result.typeFlags &= (Integer.MAX_VALUE - INT);
    }

    try {
        result.byteValue = Byte.parseByte(s);
        result.typeFlags |= BYTE;
    } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
        result.typeFlags &= (Integer.MAX_VALUE - BYTE);
    }

    if (s.length() == 1) {
        result.charValue = s.charAt(0);
        result.typeFlags |= CHAR;
    }

    try {
        result.shortValue = Short.parseShort(s);
        result.typeFlags |= SHORT;
    } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
        result.typeFlags &= (Integer.MAX_VALUE - SHORT);
    }

    try {
        result.longValue = Long.parseLong(s);
        result.typeFlags |= LONG;
    } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
        result.typeFlags &= (Integer.MAX_VALUE - LONG);
    }

    try {
        result.floatValue = Float.parseFloat(s);
        result.typeFlags |= FLOAT;
    } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
        result.typeFlags &= (Integer.MAX_VALUE - FLOAT);
    }

    try {
        result.doubleValue = Double.parseDouble(s);
        result.typeFlags |= DOUBLE;
    } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
        result.typeFlags &= (Integer.MAX_VALUE - DOUBLE);
    }

    return result;
}
```

10521	```java
/**
 * Checks and resolves an operator symbol to a specific fixity.
 *
 * @param candidate The candidate operator symbol to check.
 * @param fixities The possible fixities to resolve to.
 * @return The resolved operator symbol with the required fixity.
 * @throws SourceCodeException If the operator does not have the required fixity.
 */
protected static OpSymbol checkAndResolveToFixity(CandidateOpSymbol candidate, OpSymbol.Fixity... fixities) throws SourceCodeException {
    OpSymbol result = null;
    for (OpSymbol.Fixity fixity : fixities) {
        result = candidate.getPossibleOperators().get(fixity);
        if (result != null) {
            break;
        }
    }
    if (result == null) {
        throw new SourceCodeException("Operator " + candidate + " must be one of " + Arrays.toString(fixities) + ", but does not have the required form.", null, null, null, candidate.getSourceCodePosition());
    }
    return result;
}

/**
 * Creates a new search node based on the given successor.
 * 
 * @param successor The successor from which to create the new node.
 * @return A new search node with updated state, operation, parent, depth, and cost.
 * @throws SearchNotExhaustiveException If the search is not exhaustive.
 */
public SearchNode<O, T> makeNode(Successor successor) throws SearchNotExhaustiveException {
    SearchNode newNode;
    try {
        // Create a new instance of this class
        newNode = getClass().newInstance();
        
        // Set the state, operation, parent, depth, and cost for the new search node
        newNode.state = successor.getState();
        newNode.parent = this;
        newNode.appliedOp = successor.getOperator();
        newNode.depth = depth + 1;
        newNode.pathCost = pathCost + successor.getCost();
        
        // Check if there is a repeated state filter and copy the reference to it into the new node if so
        if (repeatedStateFilter != null) {
            newNode.setRepeatedStateFilter(repeatedStateFilter);
        }
        
        return newNode;
    } catch (InstantiationException e) {
        // In practice this should never happen but may if the nodes if some class loader error were to occur whilst
        // using a custom node implementation. Rethrow this as a RuntimeException.
        throw new IllegalStateException("InstantiationException during creation of new search node.", e);
    } catch (IllegalAccessException e) {
        // In practice this should never happen but may if the nodes to use are not public whilst using a custom node
        // implementation. Rethrow this as a RuntimeException.
        throw new IllegalStateException("IllegalAccessException during creation of new search node.", e);
    }
}

10523	```java
public static String rightPad(String stringToPad, String padder, int size) {
    if (padder.length() == 0) {
        return stringToPad;
    }
    StringBuffer strb = new StringBuffer(stringToPad);
    CharacterIterator sci = new StringCharacterIterator(padder);
    while (strb.length() < size) {
        for (char ch = sci.first(); ch != CharacterIterator.DONE; ch = sci.next()) {
            if (strb.length() < size) {
                strb.append(String.valueOf(ch));
            }
        }
    }
    return strb.toString();
}
```

**Summary:**
The `rightPad` method pads the given `stringToPad` with the characters from `padder` on the right until the total length of the resulting string reaches the specified `size`. If `padder` is empty, it returns the original `stringToPad`. The method uses a `StringBuffer` to build the result and a `CharacterIterator` to iterate through the `padder` characters.

public void reset() {
    // Allocate direct byte buffers for data, code, and stack areas.
    data = ByteBuffer.allocateDirect(TOP << 2).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).asIntBuffer();
    codeBuffer = ByteBuffer.allocateDirect(CODE_SIZE).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN);
    
    // Initialize pointers and registers.
    hp = HEAP_BASE;
    hbp = HEAP_BASE;
    sp = HEAP_BASE;
    ep = 0;
    bp = 0;
    b0 = 0;
    trp = TRAIL_BASE;
    up = TOP;
    
    // Turn off write mode and reset instruction pointer.
    writeMode = false;
    ip = 0;
    
    // Reset dereference variables and suspended state.
    derefTag = 0;
    derefVal = 0;
    suspended = false;
    
    // Call the overridden reset method of WAMBaseMachine.
    super.reset();
    
    // Set internal code addresses in the call table.
    setInternalCodeAddress(internFunctorName("call", 1), CALL_1_ID);
    setInternalCodeAddress(internFunctorName("execute", 1), EXECUTE_1_ID);
    
    // Notify the debug monitor if it exists.
    if (monitor != null) {
        monitor.onReset(this);
    }
}

/**
 * Attempts to unify two terms in a unification data structure.
 * 
 * @param a1 The first term to unify.
 * @param a2 The second term to unify.
 * @return true if the unification is successful, false otherwise.
 */
private boolean unify(int a1, int a2) {
    uPush(a1);
    uPush(a2);
    boolean fail = false;
    while (!uEmpty() && !fail) {
        int d1 = deref(uPop());
        int d2 = deref(uPop());
        int t1 = derefTag(d1);
        int v1 = derefVal(d1);
        int t2 = derefTag(d2);
        int v2 = derefVal(d2);
        if (d1 != d2) {
            if (t1 == WAMInstruction.REF || t2 == WAMInstruction.REF) {
                bind(d1, d2);
            } else if (t2 == WAMInstruction.STR) {
                int fn1 = data.get(v1);
                int fn2 = data.get(v2);
                byte n1 = (byte) (fn1 >>> 24);
                if (fn1 == fn2) {
                    for (int i = 1; i <= n1; i++) {
                        uPush(v1 + i);
                        uPush(v2 + i);
                    }
                } else {
                    fail = true;
                }
            } else if (t2 == WAMInstruction.CON) {
                if ((t1 != WAMInstruction.CON) || (v1 != v2)) {
                    fail = true;
                }
            } else if (t2 == WAMInstruction.LIS) {
                if (t1 != WAMInstruction.LIS) {
                    fail = true;
                } else {
                    uPush(v1);
                    uPush(v2);
                    uPush(v1 + 1);
                    uPush(v2 + 1);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return !fail;
}
```

/**
 * Swaps a tile to a specified location and counts the number of illegal swaps.
 * 
 * @param t The tile to be moved.
 * @param x The target x-coordinate.
 * @param y The target y-coordinate.
 * @return The count of illegal swaps performed.
 */
protected int swapTileToLocationCountingIllegal(char t, int x, int y) {
    int illegal = 0;
    int tileX = getXForTile(t);
    int tileY = getYForTile(t);

    // Shift the tile into the correct column
    while (tileX != x) {
        if ((tileX - x) > 0) {
            if (swapTiles(tileX, tileY, tileX - 1, tileY)) {
                illegal++;
            }
            tileX--;
        } else {
            if (swapTiles(tileX, tileY, tileX + 1, tileY)) {
                illegal++;
            }
            tileX++;
        }
    }

    // Shift the tile into the correct row
    while (tileY != y) {
        if (swapTiles(tileX, tileY, tileX, tileY - 1)) {
            illegal++;
        }
        tileY--;
    }

    return illegal;
}
```

 * Converts a list of arguments to a string representation.
 *
 * @param interner       the interner to use for variable and functor names
 * @param isFirst        whether this is the first element in the list

    String result = "";
    if (isFirst) {
        result += "[";

    result += arguments[0].toString(interner, printVarName, printBindings);

/**
 * Restores the values of an object from a map of property names and values.
 * 
 * @param ob The object to restore values to.
 * @param values A map containing property names and their corresponding values.
 * @throws NoSuchFieldException If no matching setter method is found for a property.
 */
public static void restoreValues(Object ob, Map<String, Object> values) throws NoSuchFieldException {
    Class<?> obClass = ob.getClass();
    for (String propName : values.keySet()) {
        Object nextValue = values.get(propName);
        Object paramValue = null;
        Class<?> paramType = null;

        if (nextValue == null) {
            paramValue = null;
            paramType = null;
        } else if (nextValue instanceof TypeConverter.MultiTypeData) {
            TypeConverter.MultiTypeData multiValue = (TypeConverter.MultiTypeData) nextValue;
            Set<Class<?>> setterTypes = ReflectionUtils.findMatchingSetters(ob.getClass(), propName);
            paramType = TypeConverter.bestMatchingConversion(multiValue, setterTypes);
            paramValue = TypeConverter.convert(multiValue, paramType);
        } else {
            paramValue = nextValue;
            paramType = nextValue.getClass();
        }

        String upperPropertyName = Character.toUpperCase(propName.charAt(0)) + propName.substring(1);
        try {
            Method setterMethod = obClass.getMethod("set" + upperPropertyName, paramType);
            setterMethod.invoke(ob, new Object[]{paramValue});
        } catch (NoSuchMethodException | IllegalAccessException | InvocationTargetException e) {
            NoSuchFieldException nsfe = new NoSuchFieldException("The object does not have a matching setter method 'set" + propName + "'.");
            nsfe.initCause(e);
            throw nsfe;
        }
    }
}

10615	```java
/**
 * Determines if a variable in a WAM instruction is a void variable.
 * A void variable is defined as a variable that occurs only once, is not in a non-argument position,
 * and is not permanently allocated on the stack.
 *
 * @param instruction The WAM instruction to check.
 * @return true if the variable is a void variable, false otherwise.
 */
private boolean isVoidVariable(WAMInstruction instruction) {
    SymbolKey symbolKey = instruction.getSymbolKeyReg1();
    if (symbolKey != null) {
        Integer count = (Integer) symbolTable.get(symbolKey, SymbolTableKeys.SYMKEY_VAR_OCCURRENCE_COUNT);
        Boolean nonArgPositionOnly = (Boolean) symbolTable.get(symbolKey, SymbolTableKeys.SYMKEY_VAR_NON_ARG);
        Integer allocation = (Integer) symbolTable.get(symbolKey, SymbolTableKeys.SYMKEY_ALLOCATION);
        boolean singleton = (count != null) && count.equals(1);
        boolean nonArgPosition = (nonArgPositionOnly != null) && TRUE.equals(nonArgPositionOnly);
        boolean permanent = (allocation != null) && ((byte) ((allocation & 0xff00) >> 8) == WAMInstruction.STACK_ADDR);
        if (singleton && nonArgPosition && !permanent) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}
```

/**
 * Generates a string representation of the arguments.
 * 
 * @return A string containing the arguments in a formatted manner.
 */
protected String toStringArguments() {
    String result = "";
    if (arity > 0) {
        result += "[ ";
        for (int i = 0; i < arity; i++) {
            Term nextArg = arguments[i];
            result += ((nextArg != null) ? nextArg.toString() : "<null>") + ((i < (arity - 1)) ? ", " : " ");
        }
        result += " ]";
    }
    return result;
}

10623	```java
/**
 * Executes a SQL query using the provided {@link SqlQueryBuilder}.
 * 
 * @param <T> The type of the measure appender.
 * @param sqlQueryBuilder The SQL query builder containing the query and parameters.
 * @return A list of results of type T.
 * @throws NovieRuntimeException If an error occurs during the query execution.
 */
private <T extends MeasureAppender> List<T> executeQuery(final SqlQueryBuilder<T> sqlQueryBuilder) throws NovieRuntimeException {
    sqlQueryBuilder.buildQuery();
    final String queryString = sqlQueryBuilder.getQueryString();
    LOG.debug(queryString);
    long beforeQuery = System.currentTimeMillis();
    List<T> returnValue = jdbcTemplate.query(queryString, sqlQueryBuilder.getMapSqlParameterSource(), sqlQueryBuilder);
    if (LOG.isInfoEnabled()) {
        LOG.info("SQL query successfully ran in " + (System.currentTimeMillis() - beforeQuery) + "ms.");
    }
    if (LOG.isDebugEnabled()) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (Entry<String, Object> e : sqlQueryBuilder.getMapSqlParameterSource().getValues().entrySet()) {
            if (sb.length() > 0) {
                sb.append(",");
            }
            sb.append(e.getKey());
            sb.append("=");
            sb.append(e.getValue());
        }
        sb.insert(0, "Parameters [");
        sb.append("]");
        LOG.debug(sb.toString());
    }
    return returnValue;
}

10632	```java
/**
 * Generates a UUID time by using the current system time and a counter.
 * If the counter reaches a certain threshold, the timestamp is incremented.
 * 
 * @return The UUID time.
 */
private static long getUUIDTime() {
    // Update the current timestamp if it has changed
    if (_currentMillis != System.currentTimeMillis()) {
        _currentMillis = System.currentTimeMillis();
        _counter = 0; // Reset counter
    }

    // Check if the counter has reached the threshold
    if (_counter + 1 >= MILLI_MULT) {
        _currentMillis++; // Increment timestamp
        _counter = 0; // Reset counter
    }

    // Calculate the UUID time
    long currentTime = (_currentMillis + GREG_OFFSET) * MILLI_MULT;
    return currentTime + _counter++; // Return UUID time plus incremented counter
}
```

10651	```java
public void processRequest(HttpServletRequest request) throws IOException, FileUploadException, StorageClientException, AccessDeniedException {
    boolean debug = LOGGER.isDebugEnabled();
    if (ServletFileUpload.isMultipartContent(request)) {
        if (debug) LOGGER.debug("Multipart POST");
        feedback.add("Multipart Upload");
        ServletFileUpload upload = new ServletFileUpload();
        FileItemIterator iterator = upload.getItemIterator(request);
        while (iterator.hasNext()) {
            FileItemStream item = iterator.next();
            if (debug) LOGGER.debug("Got Item {}", item);
            String name = item.getFieldName();
            InputStream stream = item.openStream();
            if (item.isFormField()) {
                ParameterType pt = ParameterType.typeOfRequestParameter(name);
                String propertyName = RequestUtils.propertyName(pt.getPropertyName(name));
                RequestUtils.accumulate(stores.get(pt), propertyName, RequestUtils.toValue(name, Streams.asString(stream)));
                feedback.add(pt.feedback(propertyName));
            } else {
                if (streamProcessor != null) {
                    feedback.addAll(streamProcessor.processStream(name, StorageClientUtils.getObjectName(item.getName()), item.getContentType(), stream, this));
                }
            }
        }
        if (debug) LOGGER.debug("No More items");
    } else {
        if (debug) LOGGER.debug("Trad Post");
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        Map<String, String[]> parameters = request.getParameterMap();
        if (debug) LOGGER.debug("Traditional POST {}", parameters);
        Set<Entry<String, String[]>> entries = parameters.entrySet();
        for (Entry<String, String[]> param : entries) {
            String name = (String) param.getKey();
            ParameterType pt = ParameterType.typeOfRequestParameter(name);
            String propertyName = RequestUtils.propertyName(pt.getPropertyName(name));
            RequestUtils.accumulate(stores.get(pt), propertyName, RequestUtils.toValue(name, param.getValue()));
            feedback.add(pt.feedback(propertyName));
        }
    }
}
```

10661	```java
/**
 * Compares the contents of two files.
 *
 * @param file1 the first file to compare
 * @param file2 the second file to compare
 * @return true if the contents of the files are equal, false otherwise
 * @throws IOException if an I/O error occurs
 */
public static Boolean contentEquals(Path file1, Path file2) throws IOException {
    if (!java.nio.file.Files.isRegularFile(file1)) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException(file1 + " is not a regular file");
    }
    if (!java.nio.file.Files.isRegularFile(file2)) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException(file2 + " is not a regular file");
    }

    FileChannel channel1 = null;
    FileChannel channel2 = null;
    MappedByteBuffer buffer1 = null;
    MappedByteBuffer buffer2 = null;

    try {
        long size1 = java.nio.file.Files.size(file1);
        long size2 = java.nio.file.Files.size(file2);
        if (size1 != size2) {
            return false;
        }

        long position = 0;
        long length = Math.min(Integer.MAX_VALUE, size1 - position);

        channel1 = FileChannel.open(file1);
        channel2 = FileChannel.open(file2);

        while (length > 0) {
            buffer1 = channel1.map(MapMode.READ_ONLY, position, length);
            buffer2 = channel2.map(MapMode.READ_ONLY, position, length);

            for (int i = 0; i < length; i++) {
                if (buffer1.get() != buffer2.get()) {
                    return false;
                }
            }

            position += length;
            length = Math.min(Integer.MAX_VALUE, size1 - position);

            cleanDirectByteBuffer(buffer1);
            buffer1 = null;
            cleanDirectByteBuffer(buffer2);
            buffer2 = null;
        }
    } finally {
        cleanDirectByteBuffer(buffer1);
        cleanDirectByteBuffer(buffer2);

        if (channel1 != null) {
            try {
                channel1.close();
            } catch (IOException e) {
                if (channel2 != null) {
                    channel2.close();
                }
                throw e;
            }
        }

        if (channel2 != null) {
            channel2.close();
        }
    }

    return true;
}
```
10662	### Summary:
The `cleanDirectByteBuffer` method is designed to clean a direct `ByteBuffer` by invoking its internal cleaner mechanism. If the input `ByteBuffer` is `null` or not direct, it throws an `IllegalArgumentException`. The method uses `AccessController.doPrivileged` to bypass security checks and access the `cleaner` method of the `ByteBuffer`. It then invokes the `clean` method of the cleaner to release any resources associated with the buffer, ensuring that the file it is mapped to is no longer locked. If any exceptions occur during this process, it throws a `RuntimeException` indicating that the buffer could not be cleaned.

void resize(int newCapacity) {

    int oldCapacity = oldTable.length;

    if (oldCapacity == MAXIMUM_CAPACITY) {
        threshold = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        return;
    }

    Entry<K, V>[] newTable = new Entry[newCapacity];

/**
 * Removes a mapping from the map if it is present.
 *
 * @param o the object to be removed
 * @return the removed mapping, or null if the object is not a map entry
 */
@SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
Entry<K, V> removeMapping(Object o) {
    if (!(o instanceof Map.Entry)) return null;
    Map.Entry<K, V> entry = (Map.Entry<K, V>) o;
    Object k = maskNull(entry.getKey());
    int hash = hash(k);
    int i = indexFor(hash, table.length);
    Entry<K, V> prev = table[i];
    Entry<K, V> e = prev;
    while (e != null) {
        Entry<K, V> next = e.next;
        if (e.hash == hash && validEntry(e) && e.equals(entry)) {
            if (auto_commit) {
                modCount++;
                size--;
                if (prev == e) table[i] = next;
                else prev.next = next;
            } else {
                e.setStatus(Entry.DELETED, getCurrentThreadId());
            }
            return e;
        }
        prev = e;
        e = next;
    }
    return e;
}
```

void addEntry(int hash, K key, V value, int bucketIndex) {
    // Insert a new entry at the specified bucket index.
    table[bucketIndex] = new Entry<>(hash, key, value, table[bucketIndex]);
    
    // If auto-commit is not enabled, set the entry status to ADDED for the current thread.
    if (!auto_commit) {
        table[bucketIndex].setStatus(Entry.ADDED, getCurrentThreadId());
    }
    
    // Increment the size and check if resizing is needed.
    if (++size >= threshold) {
        resize(2 * table.length);
    }
}

/**
 * Creates an immutable map that is a delegate of the given base map, with additional entries for keys that are not in the base map.
 * 
 * @param <K> the type of keys in the map
 * @param <V> the type of values in the map
 * @param base the base map to delegate to
 * @param keys the set of keys to include in the resulting map
 * @param augmentation a function that provides values for keys that are not in the base map
 * @return an immutable map that is a delegate of the base map with additional entries for the specified keys
 */
private static <K, V> ImmutableMap<K, V> createDelegate(final Map<K, V> base, final Set<? extends K> keys, final Function<K, V> augmentation) {
    final ImmutableMap.Builder<K, V> builder = ImmutableMap.builder();
    builder.putAll(base);
    keys.stream()
        .filter(key -> !base.containsKey(key))
        .forEach(key -> builder.put(key, augmentation.apply(key)));
    return builder.build();
}
```

/**
 * Safely invokes a method on a target object with the specified arguments.
 * 
 * @param target The object on which the method will be invoked.
 * @param methodName The name of the method to invoke.
 * @param args The arguments to pass to the method.
 * @param argsTypes The types of the arguments.
 * @return The result of the method invocation, or null if the invocation fails.
 */
private static Object safeMethod(Object target, String methodName, Object[] args, @SuppressWarnings("rawtypes") Class[] argsTypes) {
    if (target != null) {
        try {
            Method m = target.getClass().getMethod(methodName, argsTypes);
            if (!m.isAccessible()) {
                m.setAccessible(true);
            }
            return m.invoke(target, args);
        } catch (Throwable e) {
            LOGGER.info("Failed to invoke method " + methodName + " " + target, e);
        }
    }
    return null;
}
```

10696	```java
/**
 * Updates a single entity in the database.
 * 
 * @param object The entity to update.
 * @param properties The properties to update.
 * @throws RuntimeException If the entity is not persisted or if a collection property is provided.
 */
@Override
public void updateOne(E object, String... properties) {
    if (object.getId() == null) {
        throw new RuntimeException("Not a Persisted entity");
    }
    if (properties == null || properties.length == 0) {
        entityManager.merge(object);
        return;
    }
    StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
    sb.append("Update " + clazz.getName() + " SET ");
    Map<String, Object> cache = new HashMap<>();
    for (String prop : properties) {
        try {
            Field field = object.getClass().getDeclaredField(prop);
            field.setAccessible(true);
            Object value = field.get(object);
            if (value instanceof Collection) {
                throw new RuntimeException("Collection property is not supported.");
            }
            cache.put(prop, value);
            if (cache.size() > 1) {
                sb.append(" ,");
            }
            sb.append(prop).append(" = :").append(prop);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new RuntimeException(e);
        }
    }
    if (cache.size() == 0) {
        return;
    }
    sb.append(" WHERE id = " + object.getId());
    Query query = entityManager.createQuery(sb.toString());
    for (Entry<String, Object> entry : cache.entrySet()) {
        query.setParameter(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
    }
    query.executeUpdate();
}
```

public void setPingInterval(long newPingInterval) {

    if (newPingInterval > 0) {
        enableExecutorService(); // Enable the executor service if the new interval is positive
    }

    pingInterval = newPingInterval; // Update the ping interval

    if (pingInterval < 0) {
        stopPinging(); // Stop pinging if the new interval is negative
    } else {
        schedulePingServerTask(); // Schedule the ping server task if the new interval is non-negative
    }
}

/**
 * Initializes the XMPP connection.
 * 
 * <p>This method sets up the connection by initializing the packet reader and writer, 
 * starting them, and handling any exceptions that may occur during the process. If the 
 * connection is being initialized for the first time, it also sets up debugging listeners 
 * if debugging is enabled. If an exception occurs, it shuts down the readers and writers, 
 * closes the socket, and rethrows the exception.
 *

private void initConnection() throws XMPPException {

    compressionHandler = null;
    serverAckdCompression = false;

    initReaderAndWriter();

        if (isFirstInitialization) {
            packetWriter = new PacketWriter(this);
            packetReader = new PacketReader(this);
            if (config.isDebuggerEnabled()) {
                addPacketListener(debugger.getReaderListener(), null);
                if (debugger.getWriterListener() != null) {
                    addPacketSendingListener(debugger.getWriterListener(), null);
                }
            }

            packetWriter.init();
            packetReader.init();
        }

        packetWriter.startup();
        packetReader.startup();
        connected = true;

                listener.connectionCreated(this);
            }
        }
