        if (packetWriter != null) {
            try {
                packetWriter.shutdown();
            } catch (Throwable ignore) {
                /* ignore */
            }
            packetWriter = null;
        }
        if (packetReader != null) {
            try {
                packetReader.shutdown();
            } catch (Throwable ignore) {
                /* ignore */
            }
            packetReader = null;
        }
        if (reader != null) {
            try {
                reader.close();
            } catch (Throwable ignore) {
                /* ignore */
            }
            reader = null;
        }
        if (writer != null) {
            try {
                writer.close();
            } catch (Throwable ignore) {
                /* ignore */
            }
            writer = null;
        }
        if (socket != null) {
            try {
                socket.close();
            } catch (Exception e) {
                /* ignore */
            }
            socket = null;
        }

10709	```java
synchronized void notifyConnectionError(Exception e) {
    // If packetReader and packetWriter are already done, return immediately.
    if ((packetReader == null || packetReader.done) && (packetWriter == null || packetWriter.done)) return;

    // Mark packetReader and packetWriter as done.
    if (packetReader != null) packetReader.done = true;
    if (packetWriter != null) packetWriter.done = true;

    // Temporarily close the connection, allowing for reconnection.
    shutdown(new Presence(Presence.Type.unavailable));

    // Notify all connection listeners of the error.
    for (ConnectionListener listener : getConnectionListeners()) {
        try {
            listener.connectionClosedOnError(e);
        } catch (Exception e2) {
            // Catch and print any exception from a faulty listener to recover.
            e2.printStackTrace();
        }
    }
}
```

/**
 * Logs a message with a timestamp, thread name, and optional exception stack trace to the specified output stream.
 *
 * @param out     the output stream to log to
 * @param prefix  the prefix to prepend to the log message
 * @param message the message to log
 * @param t       the exception to log, or null if no exception
 */
private static void log(PrintStream out, String prefix, String message, Throwable t) {
    StringBuilder linePrefixBuilder = new StringBuilder();
    synchronized (fmt) {
        linePrefixBuilder.append(fmt.format(new Date()));
    }
    linePrefixBuilder.append(prefix);
    linePrefixBuilder.append(" [");
    linePrefixBuilder.append(Thread.currentThread().getName());
    linePrefixBuilder.append("] ");
    String linePrefix = linePrefixBuilder.toString();
    out.print(linePrefix);
    out.println(message);
    if (t != null) {
        t.printStackTrace(new PrintStream(out) {
            @Override
            public void println(String x) {
                synchronized (this) {
                    print(linePrefix);
                    super.println(x);
                    flush();
                }
            }
        });
    }
}

/**
 * Retrieves cached data for a given key.
 * 
 * @param keySpace The keyspace of the data.
 * @param columnFamily The column family of the data.
 * @param key The key of the data.
 * @return The cached data as a Map, or null if not found.
 * @throws StorageClientException If there is an error with the storage client.
 */
protected Map<String, Object> getCached(String keySpace, String columnFamily, String key) throws StorageClientException {
    Map<String, Object> m = null;
    String cacheKey = getCacheKey(keySpace, columnFamily, key);
    CacheHolder cacheHolder = getFromCacheInternal(cacheKey);
    if (cacheHolder != null) {
        m = cacheHolder.get();
        if (m != null) {
            LOGGER.debug("Cache Hit {} {} {}", new Object[]{cacheKey, cacheHolder, m});
        }
    }
    if (m == null) {
        m = client.get(keySpace, columnFamily, key);
        if (m != null) {
            LOGGER.debug("Cache Miss, Found Map {} {}", cacheKey, m);
        }
        putToCacheInternal(cacheKey, new CacheHolder(m), true);
    }
    return m;

/**
 * Generates a cache key based on the provided key space, column family, and key.
 * If the client is an instance of RowHasher, it uses the rowHash method to generate the key.
 * Otherwise, it concatenates the key space, column family, and key with a colon separator.
 *
 * @param keySpace   the key space
 * @param columnFamily the column family
 * @param key        the key
 * @return the cache key
 * @throws StorageClientException if an error occurs
 */
private String getCacheKey(String keySpace, String columnFamily, String key) throws StorageClientException {
    if (client instanceof RowHasher) {
        return ((RowHasher) client).rowHash(keySpace, columnFamily, key);
    }
    return keySpace + ":" + columnFamily + ":" + key;

10726	```java
/**
 * Removes a cached entry from the shared cache and registers a disposable action to handle the removal.
 * 
 * @param keySpace The keyspace of the cache entry.
 * @param columnFamily The column family of the cache entry.
 * @param key The key of the cache entry.
 * @throws StorageClientException If an error occurs during the removal process.
 */
protected void removeCached(String keySpace, String columnFamily, String key) throws StorageClientException {
    if (sharedCache != null) {
        // Create a cache key and put a null CacheHolder with the managerId to mark the entry as deleted.
        final String cacheKey = getCacheKey(keySpace, columnFamily, key);
        putToCacheInternal(cacheKey, new CacheHolder(null, managerId), false);
        LOGGER.debug("Marked as deleted in Cache {}", cacheKey);

        // If the client is an instance of Disposer, register a disposable action to remove the deleted marker from the cache.
        if (client instanceof Disposer) {
            ((Disposer) client).registerDisposable(new Disposable() {
                @Override
                public void setDisposer(Disposer disposer) {
                }

                @Override
                public void close() {
                    CacheHolder ch = sharedCache.get(cacheKey);
                    if (ch != null && ch.wasLockedTo(managerId)) {
                        sharedCache.remove(cacheKey);
                        LOGGER.debug("Removed deleted marker from Cache {}", cacheKey);
                    }
                }
            });
        }
    }
    // Remove the entry from the client.
    client.remove(keySpace, columnFamily, key);
}
```
10727	```java
/**
 * Caches and inserts data into a storage system.
 * 
 * @param keySpace The key space for the data.
 * @param columnFamily The column family for the data.
 * @param key The key for the data.
 * @param encodedProperties The encoded properties to be inserted.
 * @param probablyNew Indicates if the data is probably new.
 * @throws StorageClientException If an error occurs during the operation.
 */
protected void putCached(String keySpace, String columnFamily, String key, Map<String, Object> encodedProperties, boolean probablyNew) throws StorageClientException {
    String cacheKey = null;
    if (sharedCache != null) {
        cacheKey = getCacheKey(keySpace, columnFamily, key);
    }
    if (sharedCache != null && !probablyNew) {
        CacheHolder ch = getFromCacheInternal(cacheKey);
        if (ch != null && ch.isLocked(this.managerId)) {
            LOGGER.debug("Is Locked {}", ch);
            return; // Prevents updating an item that was not retrieved from the cache.
        }
    }
    LOGGER.debug("Saving {} {} {} {}", new Object[]{keySpace, columnFamily, key, encodedProperties});
    client.insert(keySpace, columnFamily, key, encodedProperties, probablyNew);
    if (sharedCache != null) {
        sharedCache.remove(cacheKey); // Removes stale state from the cache.
    }
}

10729	```java
/**
 * Includes a file or directory in the current context.
 * 
 * @param name The name to associate with the file or directory.
 * @param file The file or directory to include.
 */
protected final void include(String name, File file) {
    if (!file.exists()) {
        return;
    }
    if (!file.isDirectory()) {
        if (this.jarFilter.size() > 0) {
            boolean ok = false;
            for (String s : this.jarFilter) {
                if (file.getName().startsWith(s)) {
                    ok = true;
                }
            }
            if (!ok) {
                return;
            }
        }
        this.includeJar(file);
        return;
    }
    if (name == null) {
        name = "";
    } else {
        name += ".";
    }
    File[] dirs = file.listFiles(CF_Utils.DIRECTORIES_ONLY);
    for (int i = 0; i < dirs.length; i++) {
        try {
            this.locationMap.put(new URI("file://" + dirs[i].getCanonicalPath()), name + dirs[i].getName());
        } catch (IOException | URISyntaxException ignore) {
            return;
        }
        this.include(name + dirs[i].getName(), dirs[i]);
    }
}
```
10730	```java
/**
 * Includes a JAR file in the location map.
 * 
 * @param file The JAR file to include.
 */
private void includeJar(File file) {
    if (file.isDirectory()) {
        return;
    }

    URL jarURL = null;
    JarFile jar = null;
    try {
        jarURL = new URL("jar:" + new URL("file:/" + file.getCanonicalPath()).toExternalForm() + "!/");
        JarURLConnection conn = (JarURLConnection) jarURL.openConnection();
        jar = conn.getJarFile();
    } catch (MalformedURLException | IOException) {
        return;
    }

    if (jar == null) {
        return;
    }

    try {
        this.locationMap.put(jarURL.toURI(), "");
    } catch (URISyntaxException) {
    }

    for (Enumeration<JarEntry> e = jar.entries(); e.hasMoreElements(); ) {
        JarEntry entry = e.nextElement();
        if (this.pkgFilter != null && entry.getName().startsWith(this.pkgFilter)) {
            continue;
        }

        if (entry.isDirectory()) {
            if (entry.getName().toUpperCase(Locale.ENGLISH).equals("META-INF/")) {
                continue;
            }

            try {
                this.locationMap.put(new URI(jarURL.toExternalForm() + entry.getName()), CF_Utils.getPkgName(entry));
            } catch (URISyntaxException) {
                continue;
            }
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Creates a CommandResource if the command and capabilities are valid.
 *
 * @param provider   the provider of the command
 * @param command    the command to be executed
 * @param capabilities the capabilities of the player
 * @param context    the context in which the command is executed

public static Optional<CommandResource> createCommandResource(Identification provider, String command, Capabilities capabilities, Context context) {
    CommandResource commandResource = new CommandResource(provider, command, capabilities);
    if (!verifyCommand(command)) {
        context.getLogger().error("IllegalCommand!");
        return Optional.empty();
    }
    if (!verifyCapabilities(command, capabilities)) {

        return Optional.empty();

public static boolean verifyCapabilities(String command, Capabilities capabilities) {
    switch (command) {
        case PLAY:
        case PAUSE:
            return capabilities.hasPlayPauseControl();
        case SELECT_TRACK:
            return capabilities.isAbleToSelectTrack();
        case NEXT:
        case PREVIOUS:
            return capabilities.hasNextPrevious();
        case JUMP:
            return capabilities.isAbleToJump();
        case CHANGE_PLAYBACK:
            return capabilities.isPlaybackChangeable();
        case CHANGE_VOLUME:
            return capabilities.canChangeVolume();
        case STOP:
            return true;
    }
    return false;
}

10771	```java
/**
 * Executes a batch of CQL statements asynchronously.
 *
 * @param callback The callback to be invoked upon completion or failure of the batch execution.
 * @param statements The CQL statements to be executed in the batch.
 * @throws ExceedMaxAsyncJobsException If the maximum number of asynchronous jobs is exceeded.
 */
public void executeBatchAsync(FutureCallback<ResultSet> callback, Statement... statements) throws ExceedMaxAsyncJobsException {
    if (!asyncSemaphore.tryAcquire()) {
        if (callback == null) {
            throw new ExceedMaxAsyncJobsException(maxSyncJobs);
        } else {
            callback.onFailure(new ExceedMaxAsyncJobsException(maxSyncJobs));
        }
    } else {
        try {
            ResultSetFuture rsf = CqlUtils.executeBatchAsync(getSession(), statements);
            if (callback != null) {
                Futures.addCallback(rsf, wrapCallbackResultSet(callback), asyncExecutor);
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            asyncSemaphore.release();
            LOGGER.error(e.getMessage(), e);
        }
    }
}

10773	```java
/**
 * Retrieves a set of subclasses for a given fully qualified class name (FQCN).
 * 
 * @param fqcn The fully qualified class name.
 * @return A set of subclasses for the given FQCN.
 */
public Set<Class<?>> getSubclasses(String fqcn) {
    if (fqcn == null || StringUtils.startsWith(fqcn, ".") || StringUtils.endsWith(fqcn, ".")) {
        return new HashSet<>();
    }
    Class<?> clazz = null;
    try {
        clazz = Class.forName(fqcn);
    } catch (ClassNotFoundException ex) {
        this.clear();
        this.errors.add(ex);
        return new HashSet<>();
    }
    return getSubclasses(clazz);
}

10790	```java
/**
 * Parses an RSM (Result Set Management) object from an XML element.
 * 
 * @param queryElement The XML element containing the RSM data.
 * @return The parsed RSM object.
 */
public static RSM parseRSM(Element queryElement) {
    RSM rsm = new RSM();
    Element setElement = queryElement.element("set");
    if (setElement == null) {
        return rsm;
    }
    Element after = setElement.element("after");
    if (after != null) {
        rsm.setAfter(after.getText());
    }
    Element before = setElement.element("before");
    if (before != null) {
        String beforeText = before.getText();
        rsm.setBefore(beforeText == null ? "" : beforeText);
    }
    Element index = setElement.element("index");
    if (index != null) {
        rsm.setIndex(Integer.parseInt(index.getText()));
    }
    Element max = setElement.element("max");
    if (max != null) {
        rsm.setMax(Integer.parseInt(max.getText()));
    }
    return rsm;
}

10805	```java
/**
 * Reloads the properties from a file and notifies all registered listeners.
 * 
 * @param propertiesPath The path to the properties file.
 */
private void reloadProperties() {
    Properties temp = new Properties();
    BufferedReader bufferedReader = null;
    try {
        File properties = new File(propertiesPath);
        bufferedReader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(new FileInputStream(properties), "UTF8"));
        temp.load(bufferedReader);
        this.properties = temp;
        listeners.removeIf(weakReference -> weakReference.get() == null);
        listeners.forEach(weakReference -> {
            Consumer<PropertiesAssistant> consumer = weakReference.get();
            if (consumer != null) consumer.accept(this);
        });
    } catch (IOException e) {
        error("Error while trying to load the Properties-File: " + propertiesPath, e);
    } finally {
        if (bufferedReader != null) {
            try {
                bufferedReader.close();
            } catch (IOException e) {
                error("Unable to close input stream", e);
            }
        }
    }
}

10811	```java
public static boolean verify(EventModel eventModel, Capabilities capabilities, Identifiable player, List<Identifiable> activators) {
    // Check if the event model contains a descriptor for StartMusicRequest
    if (!eventModel.containsDescriptor(StartMusicRequest.ID)) return false;

    // Check if the capabilities handle play requests from outside
    if (!capabilities.handlesPlayRequestFromOutside()) {
        // If not, check if any activator is the owner of the event model's source
        if (activators.stream().noneMatch(identifiable -> identifiable.isOwner(eventModel.getSource()))) return false;
    }

    // Verify the playlist associated with the event model
    if (!PlaylistResource.getPlaylist(eventModel).map(playlist -> playlist.verify(capabilities)).orElse(true)) return false;

    // Check if the player is the target of the event model
    return SelectorResource.isTarget(eventModel, player).orElse(false);
}

public static Optional<PlaybackState> getPlaybackStateFromResource(ResourceModel x) {
    if (!x.getResourceID().equals(ID)) {

            return Optional.empty();

10827	```java
/**
 * Initializes the output directory for the application.
 * 
 * <p>
 * This method performs the following steps:
 * 1. Retrieves the parent directory of the user's current working directory.
 * 2. Constructs the target directory path by appending the application's target directory name.
 * 3. Checks if the target directory exists:
 *    - If it exists, it verifies if it is a directory and writable. If not, it exits with an error.
 *    - If it does not exist, it checks if the parent directory is a directory and writable. If not, it exits with an error.
 *    - If the parent directory is valid, it attempts to create the target directory. If creation fails, it exits with an error.
 * 4. If all checks pass, it sets the output directory to the target directory and returns 0.
 * </p>
 * 
 * @return 0 if the output directory is successfully initialized, -1 otherwise.
 */
protected final int initOutputDir() {
    String parent = System.getProperty("user.dir");
    String target = parent + File.separator + this.target;
    File targetDir = new File(target);
    File parentDir = targetDir.getParentFile();

    if (targetDir.exists()) {
        if (!targetDir.isDirectory()) {
            System.err.println(this.getAppName() + ": target dir <" + target + "> exists but is not a directory, exiting");
            return -1;
        }
        if (!targetDir.canWrite()) {
            System.err.println(this.getAppName() + ": target dir <" + target + "> exists but cannot write into it, exiting");
            return -1;
        }
    } else {
        if (!parentDir.isDirectory()) {
            System.err.println(this.getAppName() + ": target dir parent <" + parent + "> exists but is not a directory, exiting");
            return -1;
        }
        if (!parentDir.canWrite()) {
            System.err.println(this.getAppName() + ": target dir parent <" + parent + "> exists but cannot write into it, exiting");
            return -1;
        }
        if (!targetDir.mkdir()) {
            System.err.println(this.getAppName() + ": could not create target dir <" + target + ">, exiting");
            return -1;
        }
    }

    this.outputDir = target;
    return 0;
}
```

/**
 * Compares two objects based on a specified comparator or a default comparison.
 *
 * @param o1_status The status of the first object.
 * @param o1 The first object to compare.
 * @param o2_status The status of the second object.
 * @param o2 The second object to compare.
 * @param index The index of the comparator to use.
 * @return The result of the comparison.
 */
private int compare(final int o1_status, final Object o1, final int o2_status, final Object o2, final int index) {
    if (comparators[index] == null) {
        if (o1 instanceof TransactionalComparable) {
            return ((TransactionalComparable) o1).compareTo(o1_status, o2, o2_status);
        } else {
            return ((Comparable) o1).compareTo(o2);
        }
    } else {
        return comparators[index].compare(o1, o2);
    }
}
```

10855	The `nextGreater` method is designed to find the next greater node in a tree structure for a given node and a specific index. Here's a summary of the method:

   - `node`: The current node for which the next greater node is to be found.
   - `index`: The index used to access the left and right children of the nodes.

2. **Output**:
   - The method returns the next greater node in the tree. If the given node is the largest node in the tree, it returns `null`.

3. **Logic**:
   - If the given node is `null`, the method returns `null`.
   - If the node has a right child at the specified index, the method finds the least node in the right subtree of the given node. This least node is the next greater node.
   - If the node does not have a right child, the method traverses up the ancestry of the node. It continues moving up until it finds an ancestor whose left child is the current node. The parent of this ancestor is the next greater node.
   - If the traversal reaches the root of the tree without finding such an ancestor, the given node is the largest node, and the method returns `null`.

4. **Edge Cases**:
   - If the given node is `null`, the method returns `null`.
   - If the given node is the largest node in the tree, the method returns `null`.

This method effectively finds the next greater node by leveraging the structure of the tree and the relationships between nodes.

### Summary

The method updates the parent and child pointers accordingly to maintain the tree structure. If the node being rotated is the root, the root is updated to the new right child. If the node has a parent, the parent's left or right pointer is updated to point to the new right child. Finally, the node's left pointer is set to the new right child, and the new right child's parent pointer is set to the node.

10866	```java
/**
 * Rotates the given node to the right in the binary tree.
 *
 * @param node The node to be rotated.
 * @param index The index of the node in the tree.
 */
private void rotateRight(final Node<K, V> node, final int index) {
    Node<K, V> leftChild = node.getLeft(index);
    node.setLeft(leftChild.getRight(index), index);
    if (leftChild.getRight(index) != null) {
        leftChild.getRight(index).setParent(node, index);
    }
    leftChild.setParent(node.getParent(index), index);
    if (node.getParent(index) == null) {
        // node was the root ... now its left child is the root
        rootNode[index] = leftChild;
    } else if (node.getParent(index).getRight(index) == node) {
        node.getParent(index).setRight(leftChild, index);
    } else {
        node.getParent(index).setLeft(leftChild, index);
    }
    leftChild.setRight(node, index);
    node.setParent(leftChild, index);
}
```
10867	```markdown
### Summary

The `doRedBlackInsert` method is a part of a Red-Black tree insertion algorithm. It takes an `insertedNode` and an `index` as parameters. The method performs the following steps:

1. **Initial Color Change**: The inserted node is initially colored red.
2. **While Loop**: The loop continues as long as the current node is not the root and its parent is red.
   - **Left Subtree Case**: If the parent is a left child:
     - **Uncle is Red**: Change the parent and uncle to black, and the grandparent to red. Move the current node to the grandparent.
     - **Uncle is Black**:
       - **Right Child Case**: Rotate the current node left and move the current node to its parent.
       - Change the parent to black and the grandparent to red. Rotate the grandparent right.
   - **Right Subtree Case**: Similar to the left subtree case, but with left and right swapped.
3. **Final Color Change**: After the loop, the root node is colored black to maintain the Red-Black tree properties.
```
10868	The `doRedBlackDelete` method is a part of a Red-Black tree implementation and is responsible for deleting a node from the tree while maintaining the Red-Black properties. Here's a summary of the method:

1. **Loop Through Indices**: The method iterates over a range of indices (from `FIRST_INDEX` to `NUMBER_OF_INDICES`).

2. **Check for Both Children**: If the node to be deleted has both left and right children, it swaps the node with the next greater node in the tree.

3. **Determine Replacement Node**: The replacement node is chosen as the non-null child of the deleted node (left or right).

4. **Update Parent and Root**: The replacement node's parent is updated to the deleted node's parent. If the deleted node was the root, the replacement becomes the new root. Otherwise, the replacement is linked to the appropriate child of the deleted node's parent.

5. **Clean Up Deleted Node**: The deleted node's left, right, and parent pointers are set to `null`.

6. **Fixup if Necessary**: If the deleted node was black, the `doRedBlackDeleteFixup` method is called to maintain the Red-Black properties.

7. **Handle Null Replacement**: If the replacement node is `null`, it means the deleted node was a leaf. The method handles the case where the deleted node was the root or had no children, and calls `doRedBlackDeleteFixup` if the deleted node was black.

8. **Shrink the Tree**: Finally, the `shrink` method is called to potentially reduce the size of the tree.

This method ensures that the deletion operation in a Red-Black tree is performed efficiently while preserving the tree's balance properties.

10870	```java
/**
 * Inserts a new value into the map.
 * 
 * @param newNode The node containing the new value to be inserted.
 * @param thread_id The ID of the thread performing the insertion.
 * @throws IllegalArgumentException If the value already exists in the map or if a concurrent modification is detected.
 */
private void insertValue(final Node<K, V> newNode, final String thread_id) throws IllegalArgumentException {
    Node<K, V> node = rootNode[VALUE];
    while (true) {
        int cmp = compare(Node.ADDED, newNode.getData(VALUE), node.getStatus(), node.getData(VALUE), VALUE);
        if (cmp == 0) {
            if (nextEqualValid(getFloorEqualNode(node, VALUE), VALUE, thread_id) != null) {
                String debug_message = "Cannot store a duplicate value (\"" + newNode.getData(VALUE) + "\") in this Map. Value already exists for key " + node.getKey();
                log.debug(debug_message);
                throw new IllegalArgumentException(debug_message);
            }
            if (node.is(Node.ADDED, null)) throw new ConcurrentModificationException();
            if (node.getRight(VALUE) != null) {
                node = node.getRight(VALUE);
            } else if (node.getLeft(VALUE) != null) {
                node = node.getLeft(VALUE);
            } else {
                node.setRight(newNode, VALUE);
                newNode.setParent(node, VALUE);
                doRedBlackInsert(newNode, VALUE);
                break;
            }
        } else if (cmp < 0) {
            if (node.getLeft(VALUE) != null) {
                node = node.getLeft(VALUE);
            } else {
                node.setLeft(newNode, VALUE);
                newNode.setParent(node, VALUE);
                doRedBlackInsert(newNode, VALUE);
                break;
            }
        } else { // cmp > 0
            if (node.getRight(VALUE) != null) {
                node = node.getRight(VALUE);
            } else {
                node.setRight(newNode, VALUE);
                newNode.setParent(node, VALUE);
                doRedBlackInsert(newNode, VALUE);
                break;
            }
        }
    }
}
```

@Override
public void clear() {
    if (auto_commit) {
        modify();
        nodeCount = 0;
        rootNode[KEY] = null;
        rootNode[VALUE] = null;
    } else {
        String thread_id = getCurrentThreadId();
        ArrayList<Entry<K, V>> list = new ArrayList<>(entrySet());
        for (Iterator<Entry<K, V>> i = list.iterator(); i.hasNext(); ) {
            Node<K, V> node = (Node<K, V>) i.next();
            if (node.is(Node.ADDED, thread_id)) {
                doRedBlackDelete(node);
            } else {
                node.setStatus(Node.DELETED, thread_id);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

If `auto_commit` is true, it calls `modify()`, resets `nodeCount`, and sets the root node's key and value to null. If `auto_commit` is false, it retrieves the current thread ID, creates a list of all entries, and iterates through this list. If the node was not added by the current thread, it sets the node's status to deleted for the current thread.

10879	```java
public final void copyEntries(TransactionalBidiTreeMap<K, V> new_map) {
    K key;
    V val;
    int transaction_status;
    String transaction_id;

    new_map.setAutoCommit(isAutoCommit());

    if (!isAutoCommit()) {
        // Process committed and deleted entries first
        for (Iterator<Entry<K, V>> i = allEntrySet().iterator(); i.hasNext(); ) {
            TransactionalBidiTreeMap.Node<K, V> entry = (TransactionalBidiTreeMap.Node<K, V>) i.next();
            key = entry.getKey();
            val = entry.getValue();
            transaction_status = entry.getStatus();
            transaction_id = entry.getTransactionId();

            if (transaction_status != TransactionalBidiTreeMap.Node.ADDED) {
                try {
                    new_map.put(key, val);
                    new_map.commit();
                } catch (Exception e) {
                }

                try {
                    if (transaction_status == TransactionalBidiTreeMap.Node.DELETED) {
                        new_map.attach(transaction_id);
                        new_map.remove(key);
                    }
                } catch (Exception e) {
                }

                new_map.detach();
            }
        }

        // Process added entries
        for (Iterator<Entry<K, V>> i = allEntrySet().iterator(); i.hasNext(); ) {
            TransactionalBidiTreeMap.Node<K, V> entry = (TransactionalBidiTreeMap.Node<K, V>) i.next();
            key = entry.getKey();
            val = entry.getValue();
            transaction_status = entry.getStatus();
            transaction_id = entry.getTransactionId();

            if (transaction_status == TransactionalBidiTreeMap.Node.ADDED) {
                new_map.attach(transaction_id);
                try {
                    new_map.put(key, val);
                } catch (Exception e) {
                }
                new_map.detach();
            }
        }
    } else {
        for (Iterator<Entry<K, V>> i = allEntrySet().iterator(); i.hasNext(); ) {
            TransactionalBidiTreeMap.Node<K, V> entry = (TransactionalBidiTreeMap.Node<K, V>) i.next();
            key = entry.getKey();
            val = entry.getValue();
            try {
                new_map.put(key, val);
            } catch (Exception e) {
            }
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Executes an application based on the provided service object and arguments.
 * 
 * @param svc The service object to execute.
 * @param args The arguments to pass to the application.
 * @param orig The original class or application name.
 * @return An integer indicating the result of the execution.
 * 
 * <ul>
 *     <li>Returns the result of the application execution if the service object is an instance of ExecS_Application.</li>
 *     <li>Returns -1 if the service object is null.</li>
 *     <li>Returns -2 if the service object is not an instance of ExecS_Application.</li>
 *     <li>Returns -3 for any unexpected error.</li>
 * </ul>
 */
protected int executeApplication(Object svc, String[] args, String orig) {
    if (svc != null && (svc instanceof ExecS_Application)) {
        if (svc instanceof Gen_RunScripts) {
            ((Gen_RunScripts) svc).setClassMap(this.classmap);
        }
        if (svc instanceof Gen_ExecJarScripts) {
            ((Gen_ExecJarScripts) svc).setClassMap(this.classmap);
        }
        return ((ExecS_Application) svc).executeApplication(ArrayUtils.remove(args, 0));
    } else if (svc == null) {
        System.err.println("could not create object for class or application name <" + orig + ">");
        return -1;
    } else if (!(svc instanceof ExecS_Application)) {
        System.err.println("given class or application name <" + orig + "> is not instance of " + ExecS_Application.class.getName());
        return -2;
    } else {
        System.err.println("unexpected error processing for class or application name <" + orig + ">");
        return -3;
    }
}

10899	```java
/**
 * Checks if the current execution is taking place within a JAR file.
 * 
 * @return true if the execution is within a JAR file, false otherwise.
 */
protected boolean inExecJar() {
    Class<Gen_ExecJarScripts> clazz = Gen_ExecJarScripts.class;
    String className = clazz.getSimpleName() + ".class";
    String classPath = clazz.getResource(className).toString();
    
    // Check if the class path starts with "jar"
    if (!classPath.startsWith("jar")) {
        System.err.println(this.getAppName() + ": not started in a jar, cannot proceed");
        return false;
    }
    
    // Construct the path to the MANIFEST.MF file
    String manifestPath = classPath.substring(0, classPath.lastIndexOf("!") + 1) + "/META-INF/MANIFEST.MF";
    Manifest manifest;
    
    try {
        // Load the MANIFEST.MF file
        manifest = new Manifest(new URL(manifestPath).openStream());
    } catch (IOException ex) {
        System.err.println(this.getAppName() + ": exception while retrieving manifest: " + ex.getMessage());
        return false;
    }
    
    // Get the main attributes from the manifest
    Attributes attr = manifest.getMainAttributes();
    
    // Check if the main class is specified in the manifest
    if (StringUtils.isBlank(attr.getValue("Main-Class"))) {
        System.err.println(this.getAppName() + ": no main class in manifest, probably not an executable JAR, cannot continue");
        return false;
    }
    
    return true;
}
```

/**
 * Retrieves an image from the specified URL.
 * 
 * @param url The URL of the image to retrieve.
 * @return The BufferedImage object representing the image, or an error image if an exception occurs.
 */
public BufferedImage getImage(URL url) {
    String now = new Date().toString();
    if (url == null) {
        return errorImage(now, "(No image url)");
    }
    try {
        HttpURLConnection urlconn = (HttpURLConnection) url.openConnection();
        urlconn.setReadTimeout(msTimeout);
        urlconn.setConnectTimeout(msTimeout);
        urlconn.setRequestMethod("GET");
        urlconn.connect();
        BufferedImage image = ImageIO.read(urlconn.getInputStream());
        if (image == null) {
            return errorImage(now, "(Null image read)");
        }
        imageWidth = image.getWidth();
        imageHeight = image.getHeight();
        return image;
    } catch (SocketTimeoutException e) {
        logger.warn("getImage({}) => {} {}", url, e.getClass().getCanonicalName(), e.getMessage());
        return errorImage(now, msTimeout + "ms TIMEOUT");
    } catch (Exception e) {
        logger.warn("getImage({}) => {} {}", url, e.getClass().getCanonicalName(), e.getMessage());
        return errorImage(now, "(No image)", url.toString(), e.getMessage());
    }
}

10925	```java
public static final String escapeForXML(String string) {
    if (string == null) {
        return null;
    }
    char ch;
    int i = 0;
    int last = 0;
    char[] input = string.toCharArray();
    int len = input.length;
    StringBuffer out = new StringBuffer((int) (len * 1.3));
    for (; i < len; i++) {
        ch = input[i];
        if (ch > ' ') {
            continue;
        } else if (ch == '<') {
            if (i > last) {
                out.append(input, last, i - last);
            }
            last = i + 1;
            out.append(LT_ENCODE);
        } else if (ch == '>') {
            if (i > last) {
                out.append(input, last, i - last);
            }
            last = i + 1;
            out.append(GT_ENCODE);
        } else if (ch == '&') {
            if (i > last) {
                out.append(input, last, i - last);
            }
            last = i + 1;
            out.append(AMP_ENCODE);
        } else if (ch == '"') {
            if (i > last) {
                out.append(input, last, i - last);
            }
            last = i + 1;
            out.append(QUOTE_ENCODE);
        }
    }
    if (last == 0) {
        return string;
    }
    if (i > last) {
        out.append(input, last, i - last);
    }
    return out.toString();
}
```

    if (event.containsDescriptor(LeavingEvent.ID) || event.containsDescriptor(PresenceEvent.ID)) {
        if (event.containsDescriptor(LeavingEvent.ID)) {
            if (event.containsDescriptor(LeavingEvent.GENERAL_DESCRIPTOR)) {
                present = false;
                strictPresent = false;
            } else if (event.containsDescriptor(LeavingEvent.STRICT_DESCRIPTOR)) {
                nonStrictAvailable().thenAccept(available -> {
                    if (!available) {
                        present = false;
                        strictPresent = false;
                    }
                });
            }
        } else {
            present = true;
            if (event.containsDescriptor(PresenceEvent.STRICT_DESCRIPTOR)) {
                strictPresent = true;
            }
        }
        if (event.containsDescriptor(PresenceEvent.STRICT_DESCRIPTOR)) {
            lastSeen = LocalDateTime.now();
        }
    }
}
```

**Summary:**
The `eventFired` method handles events related to `LeavingEvent` and `PresenceEvent`. If the event contains the `LeavingEvent.ID`, it checks for specific descriptors (`GENERAL_DESCRIPTOR` and `STRICT_DESCRIPTOR`). If the `GENERAL_DESCRIPTOR` is present, it sets `present` and `strictPresent` to `false`. If the `STRICT_DESCRIPTOR` is present, it asynchronously checks if the event is non-strict and updates `present` and `strictPresent` accordingly. If the event contains the `PresenceEvent.ID`, it sets `present` to `true` and updates `strictPresent` if the `STRICT_DESCRIPTOR` is present. It also updates `lastSeen` if the `STRICT_DESCRIPTOR` is present.

10941	```java
/**
 * Checks if the hash table contains a value.
 * 
 * @param value The value to search for.
 * @return true if the value is found, false otherwise.
 */
public boolean containsValue(Object value) {
    if (value == null) {
        for (int i = 0, isize = data.length; i < isize; i++) {
            HashEntry entry = data[i];
            while (entry != null) {
                if (entry.getValue() == null) {
                    return true;
                }
                entry = entry.next;
            }
        }
    } else {
        for (int i = 0, isize = data.length; i < isize; i++) {
            HashEntry entry = data[i];
            while (entry != null) {
                if (isEqualValue(value, entry.getValue())) {
                    return true;
                }
                entry = entry.next;
            }
        }
    }
    return false;
}
```
10942	The `put` method in the provided code is used to insert a key-value pair into a hash table. Here's a summary of the method:

1. **Calculate Hash Code**: The method first calculates the hash code for the given key using the `hash` method. If the key is `null`, it uses a predefined constant `NULL`.

2. **Determine Index**: It then determines the index in the hash table where the key-value pair should be stored using the `hashIndex` method, which takes the hash code and the length of the data array.

3. **Check Existing Entry**: The method checks if there is already an entry at the calculated index. If there is, it iterates through the linked list of entries at that index.

4. **Update Existing Entry**: If it finds an entry with the same hash code and key, it updates the value of that entry and returns the old value.

5. **Add New Entry**: If no matching entry is found, it adds a new entry to the hash table at the calculated index.

6. **Return Value**: If an old value is updated, it returns the old value. If a new entry is added, it returns `null`.

This method ensures that the hash table handles collisions by using linked lists to store multiple entries at the same index.
10943	The `clear` method in the provided code is designed to reset the hash table by removing all entries and resetting the size and modification count. Here is a summary of the method:

- **Purpose**: Clears all entries from the hash table.
- **Steps**:
  1. **Increment Modification Count**: The `modCount` is incremented to indicate a structural change in the hash table.
  2. **Store Current Data**: The current data array is stored in a temporary variable `data`.
  3. **Nullify Entries**: A loop iterates through the data array from the last element to the first, setting each element to `null`.
  4. **Reset Size**: The size of the hash table is reset to 0.
- **Effect**: After calling this method, the hash table will be empty, and the size will be 0.
10944	```java
/**
 * This method implements a hash function for a given key, similar to the JDK 1.4 implementation.
 * It performs a series of bitwise operations to ensure a good distribution of hash values.
 * 
 * @param key The object for which the hash code is to be computed.
 * @return The computed hash code.
 */
protected int hash(Object key) {
    int h = key.hashCode();
    h += ~ (h << 9);
    h ^= (h >>> 14);
    h += (h << 4);
    h ^= (h >>> 10);
    return h;
}
```

10947	```java
/**
 * Ensures that the hash table has a capacity of at least the specified new capacity.
 * If the new capacity is greater than the current capacity, the hash table is resized
 * to the new capacity, and all existing entries are rehashed into the new table.
 * 
 * @param newCapacity the minimum capacity to ensure
 */
protected void ensureCapacity(int newCapacity) {
    int oldCapacity = data.length;
    if (newCapacity <= oldCapacity) {
        return;
    }
    if (size == 0) {
        threshold = calculateThreshold(newCapacity, loadFactor);
        data = new HashEntry[newCapacity];
    } else {
        HashEntry<K, V> oldEntries[] = data;
        HashEntry<K, V> newEntries[] = new HashEntry[newCapacity];
        modCount++;
        for (int i = oldCapacity - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            HashEntry<K, V> entry = oldEntries[i];
            if (entry != null) {
                oldEntries[i] = null; // help GC
                do {
                    HashEntry<K, V> next = entry.next;
                    int index = hashIndex(entry.hashCode, newCapacity);
                    entry.next = newEntries[index];
                    newEntries[index] = entry;
                    entry = next;
                } while (entry != null);
            }
        }
        threshold = calculateThreshold(newCapacity, loadFactor);
        data = newEntries;
    }
}
```
10948	The `calculateNewCapacity` method calculates a new capacity for a data structure, ensuring it does not exceed a maximum capacity. It starts with a new capacity of 1 and doubles it until it is at least the proposed capacity. If the resulting capacity exceeds the maximum capacity, it is set to the maximum capacity. The method returns the calculated capacity.

10950	```java
/**
 * Loads data from a binary stream into a map.
 *
 * @param key          the expected key to match in the stream
 * @param output       the map to store the loaded data
 * @param binaryStream the input stream containing the binary data
 * @param type         the expected type of the data
 * @throws IOException if there is an error reading from the stream or if the data does not match the expected key or type
 */
public static void loadFromStream(String key, Map<String, Object> output, InputStream binaryStream, String type) throws IOException {
    DataInputStream dis = new DataInputStream(binaryStream);
    String ckey = dis.readUTF();
    if (!key.equals(ckey)) {
        throw new IOException("Body Key does not match row key, unable to read");
    }
    readMapFromStream(output, dis);
    String cftype = null;
    try {
        cftype = dis.readUTF();
    } catch (IOException e) {
        LOGGER.debug("No type specified");
    }
    if (cftype != null && !cftype.equals(type)) {
        throw new IOException("Object is not of expected column family, unable to read expected [" + type + "] was [" + cftype + "]");
    }
    LOGGER.debug("Finished Reading");
    dis.close();
    binaryStream.close();
}
